title: Landscape Archive Model Template
prompt:
请根据【{argument name="主题" default="主题"}】创作一张高完成度、高质感、适合系列化发布的「地景档案模型 / Landscape Archive Model」视觉图。

这不是普通地图，也不是普通风景插画或城市效果图，而是一张结合“二维地图图纸 + 三维立体区域模型 + 专业说明系统 + 博物馆展陈感”的高端档案式视觉图。画面需要像一件被真实制作出来的地理研究模型、城市规划沙盘、建筑提案模型或世界观设定展品，具有专业、克制、精密、可触摸的高级质感。

【基础设定】
主题：【{argument name="主题内容" default="主题，例如火山口湖 / 广州 / 重庆山城 / 海岛城市 / 古城遗址 / 末日废墟 / 幻想大陆 / 游戏主城"}】
主题类型：【自然地貌 / 城市空间 / 混合景观】
核心主体：【{argument name="核心主体" default="核心主体，例如火山口、峡谷、山脉、湖泊、CBD、老城区、地标群、岛屿城市、遗址群、主城区域"}】
内容重点：【内容重点，例如地形高差 / 城市地标 / 路网结构 / 水系关系 / 自然与城市关系 / 设定集展示】
风格方向：【风格方向，例如地理测绘风、纸雕模型风、建筑提案风、博物馆档案风、城市规划风、游戏设定集风】
主色调：【主色调，例如米白、浅灰、羊皮纸白、沙色、雪白】
辅助色：【辅助色，例如土褐、岩灰、冷灰、淡蓝、苔绿】
点缀色：【点缀色，例如黑色细线、红色路线、蓝色水文线、黄色编号标记】
画幅比例：【画幅比例，例如16:9横版 / 3:4竖版 / 4:5竖版 / 1:1方图】

【画面结构】
画面主体是一块放置在干净桌面或白色布面上的矩形地图模型板。底板具有真实厚度，边缘可见剖面结构，像一块精致的地图切片或模型底座。地图表面覆盖清晰但克制的信息层，包括等高线、道路网络、水文线、分区边界、地理纹理、坐标感、轻微标注和图纸边框。

在地图中央或偏中心区域，从二维地图中立体“生长”出一个三维主体模型，成为整张图的视觉核心。

如果【主题类型】为自然地貌：
主体可由山体、峡谷、火山口、湖泊、盆地、岛屿、冰川、断层、海岸线等构成，强调地形高差、层叠等高线结构、岩壁纹理和自然地貌起伏。

如果【主题类型】为城市空间：
主体可由核心城区、CBD、老城街区、地标建筑群、滨水区、路网节点、桥梁、水系、公园绿地等构成，强调建筑体块、城市识别度、空间层次与规划结构。

如果【主题类型】为混合景观：
需同时整合自然地形与人工建成环境，例如山城、海岛城市、古城遗址、末日废墟、幻想主城、科幻基地等，让自然地貌与城市结��共同构成核心视觉。

【细节要求】
- 模型表面保留地图图纸感与专业信息感
- 地形区域应有等高线、坡面层次、凹陷与起伏关系
- 建筑区域应有体块感、街区关系和清晰层次
- 水域使用低饱和淡蓝色表现
- 绿地、森林、公园、山体可用苔绿色或低饱和绿色表现
- 路网、路径、交通轴线或探索线路可用细线表现，但不要喧宾夺主
- 若有地标建筑或重点结构，应具备明确识别度
- 若有幻想、科幻或游戏设定元素，应保留档案模型 and 图纸展示感，而不是做成纯场景插画

【说明系统】
地图板边缘需要设计完整而克制的说明模块，包括：
- 外框线和内框线
- 比例尺
- 图例区
- 标题区
- 档案编号
- 索引标记
- 注释标签
- 简洁的符号说明
文字不必全部可读，但整体必须呈现真实、清晰、精密、有秩序的档案式排版结构。

【构图与镜头】
采用斜俯视等轴测或沙盘式构图，镜头从上方约30到45度观察整块模型板，让观众同时看到地图平面、立体主体高度、边缘厚度和说明区。视觉重心集中在中央主体模型，阅读路径为：先看核心主体，再看周边地形/路网/水系/街区信息，最后看图例、比例尺和说明区。

【材质与光影】
整体需要具有真实模型摄影质感：
- 纸张纹理
- 地图印刷质感
- 纸雕或沙盘模型感
- 建筑模型或地形切片质感
- 柔和自然光
- 细腻真实阴影
- 干净背景
- 低饱和、高级、克制
避免卡通化、廉价游戏UI感、过度杂乱、过度炫技，重点突出“地图底板 + 立体主体 + 专业说明系统”的统一视觉。

最终效果应像一张可以用于地理科普、城市研究、建筑提案、文旅视觉专题、世界观设定集或高端系列封面的地景档案模型图。

title: Sphere Character Meme Template
prompt:
A stylized 3D character based on a fixed meme template.

PRIORITY ORDER:
1. Exact spherical body shape (MOST IMPORTANT)
2. Identity resemblance
3. Visual polish

BASE MODEL (ABSOLUTELY LOCKED):

- A PERFECT sphere body (no deformation at all)
- No torso, no waist, no flattening
- The silhouette must always read as: "a ball with thin arms and legs"
- Thin, simple arms and legs attached directly to the sphere
- Neutral standing pose, arms relaxed

- The body must look identical across all outputs
- This is the same reused 3D model every time

If the character looks humanoid instead of spherical, it is incorrect.

---

IDENTITY MAPPING:

Map the provided character onto this spherical body:

- Place facial features directly on the sphere
- Preserve:
- eye shape, size, spacing, expression
- eyebrows and attitude
- simple mouth if needed

- Add key identity elements:
- hair (wrapped around the sphere)
- hat (must sit naturally on top of the sphere)
- accessories (glasses, etc.)
- colors and patterns

- The character must be recognizable at a glance

- This is NOT a redesign:
→ it should look like the same character forced into this body

---

CLOTHING MAPPING (CRITICAL):

- The body MUST remain a perfect sphere
- Clothing must NOT change the body shape

- Clothes are applied as a surface layer on the sphere
- Think: painted, printed, or lightly embossed onto the sphere

---

STYLE:

- Smooth matte plastic material
- Clean, minimal geometry
- Toy-like Pixar / vinyl figure style
- Soft reflections

---

SCENE:

{argument name="background" default="A cozy child’s bedroom"}:
- Wooden floor
- Bed with striped blanket
- Children’s drawings on the wall
- Warm ambient lighting
- Soft depth of field

---

RENDER:

- High-quality 3D render (Blender / Octane style)
- Cinematic lighting
- Global illumination
- 50mm lens
- Sharp focus on character
- Soft shadows
- 4K resolution

---

FINAL INTENT:

The result should look like a meme:
the exact same spherical Mike Wazowski-style body every time,
with different characters awkwardly and humorously mapped onto it.

Everything must conform to the spherical body.
Nothing can override the sphere.

prompt: 创作一张细节极其丰富的日本周刊少年漫画杂志封面，全出血设计，画面爆炸且拥挤，不留空白。采用单幅垂直构图的杂志封面插画形式，堆叠了排版文字、角色艺术、动态效果和都市科幻的混乱感。顶部是一个巨大的风格化日文刊名，采用火橙红色，配有厚重的黑色轮廓和金色边缘，横跨页面宽度，文字为"週刊少年ブレイズ"，标题中集成了一个小型的 40 周年庆祝徽章。在最顶端边缘添加一行简短的日文标语。在右上角放置一个黑色期刊信息框，配以亮黄色和白色的文字，显示日期"2026年4月22日号"和价格"特別価格 380円"。主图以动态三角形构图呈现 3 位动漫角色。画面中心前景，主角女英雄向观众猛冲而来，采用强烈的透视缩短效果，一只手伸向镜头前方，几乎触碰到屏幕。她是一位十几岁的辣妹风动作女英雄，拥有 浅棕色带粉色挑染 的长波浪发，发丝狂乱飞舞，金棕色双眸锐利，带着自信而顽皮的笑容，拥有阳光亲吻般的肤色、多个耳环，散发着炫酷叛逆的街头战士气质。她的服装为黑金配色，包含 6 个关键可见部件：短款上衣、带金属饰边的短夹克、短裤、带垂坠链条的腰带、单腿腿带以及露指手套。在衣服上添加金色闪电图案和光泽高光。在她的手部和身体周围，绘制黄色能量弧线和速度线以强调冲击力。在她左侧中景处，放置一名白发少年，身穿黑白相间的未来主义战斗服，呈攻击姿态蹲伏，正将巨大的机械护手或武器瞄准观众，周围环绕着冰蓝色碎片和棱角分明的动态线条。在她右侧中景处，放置一名粉发少女，扎着双马尾或束发，挥舞着圆形刀刃武器，动作姿态中带有鲜艳的洋红色能量轨迹。在右上角背景中，添加第四个视觉焦点（非主要角色）：一名黑发少年身穿绿黑色战斗服，正斜向瞄准一把发光的科幻步枪，部分被文字和特效遮挡，融入背景动作中。背景是一个霓虹闪烁的未来主义日本夜间城市街道，采用倾斜视角，高耸的招牌、碎片、火花、破碎的残骸、电流条纹，以及饱和的蓝色、紫色、粉色和橙色。运用极端的对比度、光泽印刷质感、墨迹飞溅点缀、半色调漫画杂志风格以及高级动漫主视觉渲染。在左侧堆叠块中添加醒目的大型日文封面文案，使用厚实的白、黄、红、黑字体，包括突出的标题"新時代をブチ抜く 超熱量ヒロイン ここに爆誕!!"。在左侧添加 5 个特征标注框，采用彩色矩形框，配以粗体名称和下方的副标题：雷閃ブレイカー / 天城ノア, 空駆けエンジン / 南雲ハヤト, 魔境デリバリー / 倉科ミツル, 白狼ストライカー / 久世リョウ, 超深海クラッシュ / 早瀬シン。在右侧添加 5 个匹配的粗体特征标注框：極光パレット / 鳴海ユウト, 機巧グラフィティ / 胡野レイ, 龍骨ランナー / 火野アツシ, 王冠のラグナ / 深町カイ, 風神リベリオン / 東雲ガク。此外，在右侧添加 3 个促销标签，采用星形或爆炸形标签，配以大型黄色和白色文字：巻頭カラー, 特大ポスター付き, 新連載スタート。让整张封面呈现出热门战斗漫画新纪元大作首刊的感觉，充满活力、叛逆、炫目、精致，且具有极高冲击力的日本漫画杂志封面特征。

title: Sunset skateboard boy wearing baggy jeans
titleEn: Sunset skateboard boy wearing baggy jeans
prompt: A full-body street fashion photo of a young skater standing on a concrete beachside boardwalk at sunset, with tall palm trees silhouetted in the background and a warm pastel sky fading from peach to pale gold. The subject faces the camera in a relaxed editorial pose, one hand in a pocket and the other holding a worn skateboard vertically by the trucks. He wears a {argument name="beanie color" default="lavender"} knit beanie over shaggy medium-length dark hair, an oversized cropped faded tan workwear overshirt with two chest flap pockets and a small square logo patch, a plain white T-shirt visible underneath, a black-and-white checkerboard belt, extremely oversized dark indigo baggy jeans with contrast stitching and large utility-style patch pockets, and checkerboard slip-on skate shoes. The jeans should be the hero piece: extra wide leg, pooled and draping heavily over the shoes, exaggerated volume but believable denim structure. Natural candid photography, slightly soft filmic focus, muted tones, subtle grain, realistic lighting, fashion editorial meets skate culture, shot at eye level with a 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, Venice Beach atmosphere, background figures including a few pedestrians and 1 cyclist kept small and out of focus.

title: Character growth chart generator
Oil pastel fashion illustration style
prompt:
Transform the subject from the uploaded photo into a fashion illustration created with {argument name="medium" default="thick oil pastels or wax crayons"} on {argument name="surface" default="textured paper"}.
Fashion Illustration Style: Editorial and stylish, focusing on the subject’s outfit and overall look rather than background elements. Reminiscent of fashion magazine sketches.
Medium & Tools: Rendered with bold, chunky pastel strokes. Marks are grainy, textured, and uneven, leaving visible gaps and overlaps. No digital smoothness.
Linework: No black outlines or contour lines. Shapes are defined by overlapping pastel blocks of color.
Coloring: Flat matte fills in vibrant but muted tones. Slightly imperfect coverage, with paper texture peeking through. Minimal shading using broad pastel hatching, not gradients.
Details: Preserve the subject’s hairstyle, clothing, accessories, pose, and expression exactly, but simplify them into bold pastel forms. Logos or numbers should appear as painterly pastel marks, not sharp text.
Background: Solid, off-white sketchbook paper. Only a light scribbled ground shadow to anchor the figure.
Overall Tone: Chic, modern fashion sketch aesthetic — stylish, minimal, and editorial.
Negative Prompt: No outlines, no contour ink. No gradients, no digital airbrush, no vector-smooth shapes.

Use explosive black ink splashes, soot clouds, scratches, drips, and painterly debris to merge the soldiers, cliffs, and surf into one expressive composition. High contrast monochrome, misty atmosphere, desaturated grayscale only, cinematic and haunting, with lots of negative space and a fine-art concept-art feel.

She wears an oversized cream hoodie with teal accents and a small fluffy mascot badge on the chest. The room is dim and warm, lit by a black desk lamp on the upper left, a small glowing lamp near the window, and orange desk reflections, with a rainy or hazy night city skyline visible through the large window behind her. Surround her with exactly four translucent cyan holographic interface panels: one left upper panel labeled “STOCK WATCHLIST” showing a rising candlestick chart with green and red values, one left middle panel labeled “RESEARCH NOTES” with a document icon and small bar chart, one right upper panel labeled “DISCORD” with three visible user avatar rows and message lines, and one right middle panel labeled “PAPERS” showing pinned documents and a small line graph. The desk contains exactly eight prominent physical objects besides the laptop: a potted leafy plant, a pencil cup with pens, a stack of two books, loose sticky notes and papers, a spiral notebook with handwritten notes, two black pens, a dark mug with a small mascot emblem, and a plush round fluffy mascot with headphones. In the background on the right, include a bulletin board or wall with multiple pinned notes and papers, softly out of focus. Use rich blue-black shadows, warm amber highlights, teal hologram glow, detailed anime rendering, shallow depth of field, high detail, polished gpt-image-2 aesthetic, 16:9 widescreen composition, no watermark, no extra readable text beyond the specified panel labels.

SUBJECT: 
A single bottle dominates the center-left, illustrated in a semi-3D stylized form (not photoreal). The composition mechanic is “internal pressure distortion”. The eye enters through the most inflated part of the bottle (center bulge), then follows curved tension lines outward toward stretched typography on the right side. The camera uses a slightly low, close-up perspective with mild fisheye distortion, amplifying the sense of pressure and expansion. The bottle leans diagonally into the frame as if pushing against invisible resistance. Negative space on the right is intentionally stretched and warped, echoing the bottle’s deformation.

title: Anime Style KFC Princess Promo Poster
titleEn: Anime Style KFC Princess Promo Poster
prompt: A vibrant Japanese fast-food promotional poster in glossy anime advertising style, themed around KFC and a magical princess mascot. The composition is vertical and packed but still a single unified ad scene. At center-right, a cheerful young anime woman inspired by Princess Kaguya poses energetically toward the viewer with one hand reaching forward and the other arm lifted. She has long flowing golden-blonde hair, large sparkling amber-red eyes, a bright open smile, and ornate hair accessories including red floral ornaments, dangling beads, green ribbons, and a small gold crescent-moon crown. She wears a festive kimono-inspired outfit in coral red, soft pink, cream, and olive green with layered sleeves, floral patterns, decorative cords, bows, tassels, and a wide obi with a flower knot. Her hair and sleeves sweep dramatically as if caught in a lively breeze. In the lower left foreground, show 1 large KFC bucket overflowing with 4 pieces of crispy fried chicken, rendered extra crunchy, golden, juicy, and appetizing. Along the bottom foreground, include 3 side items: 1 chicken burger with sesame bun and lettuce, 1 small carton of fries, and 1 biscuit or pie-like pastry topped with glossy syrup. Use the KFC logo in the top right and on the bucket and fries carton, with the Colonel face partially censored by a rectangular blur on the bucket. Surround the scene with celebratory red-and-gold graphics, sparkles, brushstroke flourishes, and festive Japanese New Year-like motifs. Add large bold Japanese headline text at the upper left reading ケンタッキーの魅力 in thick red characters with white and gold outline. Add 2 white brushstroke callout bubbles on the left with red text: サクッと香ばしい！ and ジューシーで大満足！. Add a red flower-shaped badge on the right reading 今日のごほうびに. Add a red bottom banner with white text listing オリジナルチキン / バーガー / ビスケット. Extremely polished commercial illustration, high saturation, warm lighting, clean line art, glossy food rendering, energetic composition, premium poster finish.

title: 1960s art film poster
prompt:
Create a vertical poster composition on aged cream paper with a handmade analog feel. Use rough ripped paper edges, layered magazine cutouts, photocopy grain, halftone texture, ink bleed, and slightly imperfect screen-print registration. Keep the subject as the main black-and-white photographic portrait, placed prominently in the center or upper center.

Surround the subject with graphic blocks of deep red, cobalt blue, warm yellow, black, and ivory. Add supporting collage fragments such as a rainy European street, film-strip borders, newspaper clippings, urban silhouettes, and cinematic details, arranged like a handmade 1960s art-house movie poster.

Use bold condensed typography with a strong visual hierarchy. Add large headline text: “{argument name="main title" default="[MAIN TITLE]"}”. Add smaller subtitle text: “{argument name="subtitle" default="[SUBTITLE]"}”. Add bottom text: “{argument name="event details" default="[BRAND NAME / EVENT NAME / COMING SOON / DATE]"}”. If needed, include a small top line reading “[TAGLINE]”.

The final result should feel cinematic, intellectual, rebellious, and editorial — like a lost 1960s European film poster with a strong point of view. Keep it raw, tactile, printed, imperfect, and handmade. Avoid a glossy modern finish.

title: Doraemon Style Newton's Second Law Comics
titleEn: Doraemon Style Newton's Second Law Comics
prompt:
Goal: Create a colorful educational manga-style science comic page teaching Newton's second law through a Doraemon-inspired classroom experiment, with a cheerful Japanese children’s comic aesthetic and clear Chinese educational captions.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 page, thick black outer border, divided into exactly 5 horizontal sections: 1 header story panel, 2 experiment panels, 1 conclusion panel, and 1 bottom key-summary strip. Use bright primary colors, clean ink outlines, schoolyard background, blue sky, trees, fence, and school building.

Layout and text content: Top left has a yellow torn-paper label reading {argument name="page label" default="第4页"}. Across the top headline, large bold Chinese title reads {argument name="main headline" default="实验一：同一辆车，用力越大，加速度越大"}, with blue emphasis on “同一辆车” and red emphasis on “用力越大，加速度越大”.

Section 1, introduction panel: On the left, a blue robotic cat character resembling a classic round-headed cartoon cat smiles widely and raises one finger, wearing a red collar and bell. In the center/right stand exactly 4 children: a boy in a yellow shirt with his face intentionally blurred/blanked, a girl in a pink top and green skirt, a large boy in an orange sweater, and a spiky-haired boy in a purple hoodie. Speech bubbles: the cat says “我们用小车来做实验，看看力大小对加速度的影响！” and the spiky-haired boy says “好耶！我们开始吧！”.

Section 2, experiment panel labeled in a blue rounded rectangle “实验1：小力推”: A schoolyard scene with the girl pushing a small blue wagon from left to right using a rope/handle. The wagon contains exactly 2 visible objects: one teddy bear and one striped ball. Add small dust puffs behind the wheels. A red arrow points right with blue text “慢慢地向前运动”. Speech bubbles: the girl says “我轻轻推……” and the blurred-face boy on the right says “哇，小车走得很慢！”.

Section 3, experiment panel labeled in a blue rounded rectangle “实验2：大力推”: The large boy in the orange sweater pushes the same blue wagon hard from left to right, leaning forward with speed lines, sweat drops, and stronger motion. The wagon again contains exactly 2 visible objects: the teddy bear and striped ball. A larger red arrow points right with red text “快速地向前运动”. Speech bubbles: the large boy says “我使劲推！” and the blurred-face boy on the right says “哇哦！小车一下子跑得好快啊！”.

Section 4, conclusion panel: On the left, the blue robotic cat points with a teaching stick and says “从实验可以看出：同一辆车，力越大，小车的加速效果越明显！”. In the center is a green chalkboard on a wooden easel. The chalkboard title reads “实验结论：同一辆车（质量相同）”, and it shows exactly 2 miniature illustrated comparison rows: small-force push with text “小力→小加速度”, and large-force push with text “大力→大加速度”. On the right stand exactly 4 children again: blurred-face yellow-shirt boy, pink-and-green girl, orange-sweater large boy, and purple-hoodie spiky-haired boy. Speech bubbles read “原来力越大，加速度就越大！” and “这就是“力与加速度的关系”啊！”.

Section 5, bottom key-summary strip: Pale yellow rounded rectangle with blue dashed border. On the left, the blue robotic cat smiles and raises one finger next to a star icon. Large blue heading reads {argument name="summary heading" default="本页重点"}. Main red sentence reads {argument name="summary sentence" default="质量相同：力越大，加速度越大。"}. On the right, show a formula card with bold red and blue symbols “F↑ → a↑”, plus a simple orange traffic cone icon with curved motion marks.

Visual style: Emulate a polished Japanese educational comic magazine layout inspired by Ohmsha-style science explainers: thick black panel dividers, clean cel-shaded colors, expressive cartoon faces, readable bold Chinese typography, speech bubbles with black outlines, and a friendly elementary-school science tone.

Constraints: Keep exactly 5 horizontal sections, exactly 4 children in the group scenes, exactly 2 wagon contents in each experiment panel, and preserve the intentionally blurred/blank face of the yellow-shirt boy wherever he appears. Avoid photorealism, avoid extra panels, avoid watermarks, and keep all text legible.

title: Ink Riding Warrior
prompt: A dramatic vertical Chinese ink wash painting in monochrome black, charcoal, and soft gray on off-white rice paper, in the style of expressive shan shui brush art and heroic historical wuxia illustration. On the right side, a lone armored general sits upright on a dark warhorse atop a rocky cliff, viewed from behind and slightly in profile, looking out over a vast army below. The warrior wears layered black lamellar armor, a flowing windblown cloak, and a topknot with long trailing ribbons; he holds a straight sword angled downward beside the horse. The horse is muscular and glossy black, standing firmly near the cliff edge with its tail and mane subtly swept by the wind. Below and across the lower half of the scene, a dense battlefield mass of soldiers appears as misty silhouettes with upright spears and several battle flags, partially obscured by fog. In the distance, steep mountain peaks emerge through drifting mist on the upper right, with 7 small birds flying across the pale sky near the center. On the left side, include 2 large vertical columns of bold black Chinese calligraphy in wild cursive brush strokes: the main quote reading “一身转战三千里，一剑曾当百万师”, with a smaller vertical signature “王维” below, plus a small red seal stamp. title: Crumple Chair concept sofa development board
titleEn: Crumple Chair concept sofa development board
prompt:
Design Concept: The Crumple Chair Core Philosophy: Translating the "controlled chaos" of a tossed paper ball into a sculptural, high-comfort seating experience.

Stage 1: Observation & Morphological Analysis The goal is to deconstruct the image of the crumpled paper into usable geometric data. Crease Mapping: Identify the primary "valley" and "ridge" lines. These represent potential structural ribs or seams in the chair. Faceted Planes: Break down the sphere into a series of non-uniform polygons. Each flat surface of the paper becomes a potential panel for the chair’s upholstery or shell. Shadow Study: Analyze how the "tossed" form creates deep recesses. These natural pockets guide where the user’s weight will be cradled.

Stage 2: Iterative Form Exploration Moving from a sphere to a seat through "Digital Crumpling." Subtractive Sculpting: Imagine the paper ball as a solid mass. Use Boolean operations to "carve out" a seating cavity that fits the human form while maintaining the external jagged texture. Tension Simulation: Use 3D software (like Rhino or Blender) to simulate a flat sheet of material being compressed. This ensures the folds look authentic and not "modeled." The "Toss" Logic: Experiment with gravity-based simulation dropping a digital mesh to see how it settles naturally, mimicking the "tossed" origin.

Stage 3: Ergonomic Translation & Blueprinting Refining the raw aesthetic into a functional object. The Comfort Core: Overlay a standard ergonomic template (Seating Angle: 105°–110°) over the crumpled form. Adjust the internal "folds" to provide lumbar support and pressure relief. Blueprint Generation: Create technical orthographic views (Front, Side, Top). Map out the dimensions: Seat Height: 450mm Total Width: 850mm Surface Smoothing: Maintain the sharp "paper edges" on the exterior shell while softening the interior contact points for skin comfort.

Stage 4: Structural Integration & Scaling Making the concept physically viable. The Skeleton: Design a hidden internal frame (likely CNC-bent steel rods or a 3D-printed lattice) that follows the most prominent ridges of the paper folds to provide rigidity. Material Selection: * Option A (High-End): Faceted, cast aluminum with a white powder coat. Option B (Soft): Vacuum-formed recycled plastic shell covered in "memory-fold" technical fabric that retains a wrinkled appearance.

Stage 5: Final Prototyping & Material Finish Textural Replication: Apply a matte, slightly porous finish to the material to mimic the tactile feel of heavy-bond paper. Lighting Contrast: Use directional studio lighting in the final renders to emphasize the "tossed" shadows, making the chair look like a giant piece of discarded inspiration. Design Tip: To keep the "tossed" look authentic, avoid symmetry. The most compelling aspect of a crumpled paper ball is its unique irregularity—ensure the left and right sides of the chair are balance-equivalent but not identical

prompt:
Transform the uploaded travel photo into a playful travel scrapbook chibi collage while preserving the original photo as the base image.

Keep the original photo recognizable and structurally intact. Preserve the main person's facial features, expression, body shape, pose, outfit, lighting, and real background. Do not replace the person, change their identity, redraw their face, or alter the actual travel setting. The edit should feel like illustration and scrapbook elements have been layered on top of a real photo.

Add 4 to 7 cute chibi-style mini versions of the person from the uploaded photo. Each mini character should be based on the same person, keeping consistent facial traits, hairstyle, outfit details, and overall personality. Use big-head chibi proportions, lively expressions, refined details, and a light cartoon-rendered look.

Make every mini character do a different natural travel action. Choose varied candid moments such as taking photos, walking while looking around, reading a map, checking navigation, pulling luggage, drinking coffee, gazing at scenery, posing near a landmark, crouching to notice flowers or street details, filming with a phone, having hair blown by the wind, looking around while slightly lost, or jumping happily. The poses should feel spontaneous and life-like, as if captured during a real trip, not staged.

Overlay hand-drawn doodles, handwritten notes, and sticker-like details to create a relaxed travel journal scrapbook style. Use mainly white and soft pink accents, with slightly uneven hand-drawn lines. Include elements such as arrows, stars, hearts, sparkles, tiny airplanes, location pins, dashed route lines, hand-drawn circles, tape pieces, stickers, and small decorative marks.

Add 3 to 6 short handwritten English phrases related to travel mood and memories. Vary the phrases each time instead of using a fixed set. Examples of the tone include: "go somewhere new", "chase the horizon", "little moments matter", "memory unlocked", "lost but happy", "soft days", "just wandering", "no plans, just go", "take it slow", "follow the sun", "breathe and see", "quiet joy", and "this feels right".

Place the handwritten phrases near the person, mini characters, or travel actions so the text interacts naturally with the image. Avoid neat or formal typography. The writing should feel casual, personal, and spontaneously added to a travel journal.

The final image should feel light, healing, airy, cute, and relaxed, with a sense of freedom and travel nostalgia. Keep a balanced mix of real photo and subtle illustration enhancement. The viewer should first recognize it as a real travel photo, then notice the charming chibi characters and scrapbook details.

title: Japanese GPT-Image-2 animation concert banner
prompt:
Goal: Create a high-energy Japanese promotional banner announcing an image generation update for ChatGPT / GPT-Image-2, styled like an anime idol rock concert advertisement.

Canvas: Wide horizontal social media banner, approximately 2:1 aspect ratio, cinematic 1024×512 feel. Fill the frame edge to edge with no white margins.

Layout: Place huge bold Japanese headline text across the top two-thirds, centered and slightly arched with heavy black drop shadow and white fill. Under it, place a smaller centered subtitle. The bottom half is an anime band performance scene with five visible characters and a drum kit, surrounded by glowing UI panels, stars, sparkles, and neon concert lighting.

Text content: Main headline in Japanese: {argument name="headline text" default="ChatGPTによる画像生成が 大幅アップデート!"}. Subtitle in Japanese: {argument name="subtitle text" default="GPT-Image-2が無料で使える"}. Use thick rounded sans-serif display lettering, bright white with black outline/shadow, designed for maximum readability over a busy background.

Subject details: Include exactly five anime band members across the lower half: 1) far left, a blue-haired keyboardist in a pale blue-and-white outfit behind a keyboard; 2) left-center, a pink twin-tail idol singer holding a microphone, wearing a frilly pink stage dress with flower hair accessories; 3) center-right foreground, the main blonde/yellow-haired energetic idol drummer/front performer, smiling, holding a drumstick, wearing a cropped yellow jacket, white top, star motifs, and hair clips; 4) right-center, a dark-haired green-accented guitarist/bassist in a black streetwear outfit; 5) far right, a black-haired female guitarist in a black off-shoulder rock outfit holding a purple electric guitar. Put a golden drum kit behind the two central characters. The center performer should be the most prominent and brightly lit.

Background and effects: Behind the band, show a glowing circular golden OpenAI-like knot logo as a stage backdrop. Add futuristic interface screens on the left and right edges, with colorful dashboards, rings, waveform-like graphics, and thumbnail panels. Use a deep black and purple concert background with orange, pink, gold, and blue neon beams. Scatter many glowing five-point stars, music notes, lens flares, confetti sparkles, and light streaks throughout.

Visual style: Polished modern anime illustration, idol concert poster, saturated colors, glossy highlights, dramatic rim lighting, high detail, dynamic composition, celebratory mood, crisp typography, strong contrast. Make it look like a viral Japanese tech-news thumbnail about AI image generation.

Constraints: Keep the text legible and dominant, do not add extra headline lines beyond the two specified text lines, keep exactly five band characters, avoid photorealism, avoid watermarks, avoid unreadable tiny text except decorative UI elements.

slug: 揉皱纸张家具概念设计-2_c5fb6e
title: Crumpled paper furniture concept design
prompt:
Design Concept: {argument name="furniture type" default="The Crumple Chair"} Core Philosophy: Translating the "controlled chaos" of a {argument name="inspiration" default="tossed paper ball"} into a sculptural, high-comfort seating experience.

Stage 1: Observation & Morphological Analysis The goal is to deconstruct the image of the crumpled paper into usable geometric data. Crease Mapping: Identify the primary "valley" and "ridge" lines. These represent potential structural ribs or seams in the chair. Faceted Planes: Break down the sphere into a series of non-uniform polygons. Each flat surface of the paper becomes a potential panel for the chair’s upholstery or shell. Shadow Study: Analyze how the "tossed" form creates deep recesses. These natural pockets guide where the user’s weight will be cradled. 

Stage 2: Iterative Form Exploration Moving from a sphere to a seat through "Digital Crumpling." Subtractive Sculpting: Imagine the paper ball as a solid mass. Use Boolean operations to "carve out" a seating cavity that fits the human form while maintaining the external jagged texture. Tension Simulation: Use 3D software (like Rhino or Blender) to simulate a flat sheet of material being compressed. This ensures the folds look authentic and not "modeled." The "Toss" Logic: Experiment with gravity-based simulation dropping a digital mesh to see how it settles naturally, mimicking the "tossed" origin. 

Stage 3: Ergonomic Translation & Blueprinting Refining the raw aesthetic into a functional object. The Comfort Core: Overlay a standard ergonomic template (Seating Angle: 105°–110°) over the crumpled form. Adjust the internal "folds" to provide lumbar support and pressure relief. Blueprint Generation: Create technical orthographic views (Front, Side, Top). Map out the dimensions: Seat Height: 450mm Total Width: 850mm Surface Smoothing: Maintain the sharp "paper edges" on the exterior shell while softening the interior contact points for skin comfort. 

Stage 4: Structural Integration & Scaling Making the concept physically viable. The Skeleton: Design a hidden internal frame (likely CNC-bent steel rods or a 3D-printed lattice) that follows the most prominent ridges of the paper folds to provide rigidity. title: AI Hair and Grooming Diagnostic Report
titleEn: AI Hair and Grooming Diagnostic Report
prompt:
アップロードされた{argument name="対象" default="男性"}の写真をもとに、顔立ち・骨格・目元・眉・唇・髪質・フェイスラインを分析し、その人物に似合うヘアスタイルとグルーミング（身だしなみ）を提案する美容診断ビジュアルレポートを作成してください。

A4縦長、日本の{argument name="性別" default="男性"}ビジュアル誌風の洗練された誌面デザイン。白〜チャコール基調、細い罫線、ネイビー・グレー系アクセント、余白を活かしたスタイリッシュなレイアウト。「AI HAIR & GROOMING DIAGNOSIS」の小さな英字サブタイトルを入れる。

人物の顔の同一性は維持し、髪型・髭・雰囲気のみ自然に変化させる。別人化しない。

構成は以下：

1. 上部に「ヘアスタイル診断」
   - 「一番似合う」「普通」「あまりおすすめしない」の3カラム比較
   - 同じ人物に異なる髪型を適用
   - 髪型名、短い理由、星評価を表示

2. 中段にヘアスタイル候補一覧
   - ビジネス / カジュアル / トレンドのカテゴリ
   - 小さなサムネイルをグリッド表示
   - 各サムネイルに短い髪型名を付ける

3. 下部に「グルーミング分析ガイド」
   - 大きめのポートレート
   - 顔タイプ診断チャート（卵型・面長・丸顔等）
   - タイプ名（例：クリーンシャープ）
   - 短い分析コメント
   - スタイリングポイント4項目
   - 似合うひげスタイル / 避けたいスタイルのビジュアル比較

文字は日本語で、見出し・短文・ラベル中心。長文は避け、簡潔にまとめる。分析チャート、評価スター、スタイル比較表示を含める。全体は実在の男性ビジュアル誌の特集ページのように、クールで信頼感のある仕上がりにする。

prompt: A humorous, highly detailed composite image showing a modern smartphone displaying a Chinese social-media Moments post about the Xuanwu Gate Incident, placed on the left side of the frame, with the posted battle image expanded into a large cinematic historical scene filling the right side. The phone should look like a black iPhone with thin bezels and a top notch, shown front-facing. On the phone screen, the app header bar is dark gray-black and reads “朋友圈” in white, with a back arrow on the left and a camera icon on the right. Below it is a social post from {argument name="poster name" default="唐王世民"}, with a small square profile avatar of an ancient Chinese warrior in armor and helmet. Under the name is a location pin and the text “长安·玄武门”, and a timestamp line “唐武德九年六月初四 巳时”. The main post text in Chinese says: “吾为国家除逆贼，请社稷。今日玄武门，功在千秋！⚔️💪”. Beneath the text is a square battle image preview matching the large scene on the right. Below the image is a metadata row showing exactly three items: “3.8万次浏览”, “赞 (666)”, and “(128)” beside a comment icon. Under that is a comments box with exactly 5 visible commenters, each with a tiny avatar and Chinese text styled like supportive social-media replies from historical figures. The comments should include these names in Chinese: “尉迟恭”, “房玄龄”, “李渊”, “杜如晦”, and “长孙无忌”, with the tone praising the success of the action; one comment line should suggest the emperor is shocked and the state is secured. The right side is a dramatic Tang-dynasty battle painting at sunset outside {argument name="gate name" default="玄武门"}, with a massive gray stone gate tower and the gate plaque reading “玄武门”. In the center foreground, a mounted armored archer in red-plumed helmet draws a bow while riding a brown horse; around him are exactly 7 clearly visible mounted or standing soldiers in Tang armor, plus 1 fallen armored figure on the ground pointing upward. Multiple yellow battle flags with the large black character “唐” wave through the dust; show at least 4 visible flags. Arrows fly through the sky, horses rear and turn, and the air is filled with dust, warm sunset light, and battlefield motion. The visual style is realistic historical epic key art with painterly detail, but the overall concept is comedic and anachronistic because it presents an ancient coup as a social-media朋友圈 post. Keep all visible interface text in Chinese, maintain believable mobile UI spacing, and blend the phone mockup with the expanded battle artwork in one widescreen composition.

title: Chinese Ink Animated Poster Style
prompt:
为【{argument name="主题" default="草船借箭"}】设计一张具有东方水墨动画气质的视觉海报。整体采用“重墨立骨、淡彩造境、留白叙事、边缘呼吸”的视觉逻辑。背景为温润宣纸质感，米白、浅青灰、淡水色自然晕染，带轻微纸纹、水痕和墨色扩散。

画面中的核心文字不固定在某一个位置，而是根据主体动作、视线方向、画面留白和视觉重心智能布局。标题可以出现在左侧、右侧、上方、下方、斜向、边缘半露，或围绕主体错落排布。文字位置要像画面自然生长出来的一部分，而不是后期贴上去的排版。

主标题作为浓墨视觉锚点参与构图，具有压住画面、托住主体、引导视线或制造节奏的作用。标题字体为手写重墨书法，笔画厚重、湿润、稚拙、不规则，带飞白、断笔、墨团、渗化和毛糙边缘。字形大小错落，重心略微摇晃，有儿童绘本与中国水墨动画片头的手工感。标题不使用规整商业字体，而要像一组黑色图形符号，与主体、边缘元素、留白空间产生呼应。

画面中心保持适度留白，让主要角色或核心物象轻轻落在纸面空气中。四周加入根据主题变化的淡彩边缘元素，例如【{argument name="边缘元素" default="柳枝、水花"}】，这些元素从画面外部伸入，只露局部，不完整展示。边缘元素使用水墨淡彩、透明晕染、局部虚化处理，制造画外空间和呼吸感。彩色主要出现在边缘和四角，中心区域保持克制干净。

整体气质诗意、童趣、东方、温润、有手绘感，像一帧会呼吸的中国水墨动画海报。画面要有“重墨文字做骨架，淡彩边缘做气氛，留白区域讲故事”的高级设计感。

title: Hardcore science fiction girl comic page
titleEn: Hardcore science fiction girl comic page
prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical one-page sci-fi shoujo manga page in a gritty watercolor-and-ink style, featuring {argument name="character name" default="Zero"} and a pale gothic heroine in a ruined post-apocalyptic city as a mechanical dragon attacks.

Canvas: Tall portrait manga page, about 2:3 aspect ratio, with a thin black outer border, off-white paper tone, diagonal white panel gutters, rough ink texture, muted gray, lavender, beige, and dusty brown colors.

Layout: Use exactly 6 comic panels. Panel 1 is a large full-width establishing panel across the top half: collapsed urban ruins, rubble, smoke, broken skyscrapers, multiple armored soldiers, a white-haired cybernetic male soldier standing with a rifle, and a pale long-haired girl kneeling in the debris. Panel 2 is a lower-left close-up portrait of the girl with very long platinum hair, black gothic dress, cross necklace, and a flat beige censorship rectangle covering the center of her face. Panel 3 is a narrow upper-right action panel showing a heavy armored/mechanical leg or weapon crashing through debris with speed lines. Panel 4 is a small middle-right panel with a partial character close-up and another beige censorship rectangle covering the face. Panel 5 is a large bottom-left monster reveal: a huge biomechanical dragon or kaiju head roaring with jagged teeth, red mechanical eyes, plated armor, debris flying, and tiny human figures in the foreground. Panel 6 is a bottom-right action panel showing the white-haired armored male protecting or pulling the pale girl back while soldiers and mechanical debris surround them.

Characters: The male lead is a tall, slim, white-haired anime cyborg soldier in black tactical armor with silver mechanical limbs, holding a rifle, calm but alert. The heroine is a delicate pale teenage girl with very long flowing platinum-blonde hair, black frilled gothic outfit, lace details, cross pendant, fragile shoujo expression, and kneeling or being escorted through rubble. Include several background armored troops and ruined military figures, but keep them secondary.

Text content: Include vertical Japanese manga speech bubbles and sound effects. Use exactly 5 speech bubbles: 2 in the top panel, 1 in the girl close-up, 1 in the small middle-right panel, and 1 in the bottom-right panel. Suggested bubble text defaults: {argument name="top left speech" default="旦那様の目が本物か、見つかるといいんだけど……"}, {argument name="top right speech" default="危険区域だからな、足場に確保してもらいたいものだ"}, {argument name="center speech" default="この気配まさか……？"}, {argument name="middle right speech" default="……何か、来るぞ。"}, {argument name="bottom right speech" default="ファンネリア！下がっていろ！"}. Add bold hand-drawn Japanese sound effects: a large red-black roar beside the monster and a dynamic impact sound across the bottom-right panel.

Visual style: Romantic shoujo manga character design mixed with dark military sci-fi, scratchy watercolor wash, dense pen hatching, dramatic diagonal composition, chaotic rubble detail, soft luminous hair, high-detail ruins, cinematic action, gritty texture rather than clean vector art.

Constraints: Keep the page black-and-white/muted color manga-like, avoid modern UI elements, avoid photorealism, no watermark, no English lettering, preserve the exact 6-panel layout and the two beige face-obscuring rectangles.

title: Chronowa Black Cat Character Set
prompt:
Goal: Create a clean monochrome-and-red Japanese character reference sheet poster for a cute black cat mascot named {argument name="character name" default="Chronowa"}, a night-music themed black cat wearing white sunglasses and red headphones.

Canvas: Vertical A4-style poster, white/off-white background, thin black border, subtle red corner marks, small halftone dots, diagonal tech lines, tiny skyline silhouettes, waveform accents, barcode at bottom left, and a black footer strip reading in English “LISTEN TO THE NIGHT.” Use a crisp vector/ink illustration style with limited palette: black, white, gray, and accent red.

Main layout: Place a large central full-body front-view black cat as the hero subject, sitting upright with a curled tail, oversized pointed ears, long whiskers, white angular sunglasses with black lenses and reflective highlights, and red-and-black headphones resting around the neck. Add a bold top title in Japanese plus English using {argument name="main title text" default="クロノワ / CHRONOWA"}, with a smaller tagline beneath using {argument name="tagline text" default="夜の音を聴く黒猫"}. Add a red crescent moon and black city skyline silhouette in the upper right.

Left character views: Include exactly 3 smaller cat pose panels stacked vertically on the left, each with a black label tab and red accent: 1) side view, cat sitting in profile wearing white sunglasses with headphones around neck; 2) listening pose, cat wearing red headphones over ears, paws touching headphones, small music note nearby; 3) relax pose, cat lying down with headphones around neck.

Right item box: Include exactly 2 item illustrations inside a bordered box: 1) white sunglasses; 2) red headphones. Label them in Japanese using the same graphic style.

Right mood icon box: Include exactly 6 small chibi mood icons in a 2-column by 3-row grid, all black cat icons with white sunglasses: 1) good mood with music note; 2) cool but moody; 3) shy/embarrassed; 4) alert with motion marks; 5) kind with small red heart; 6) slightly angry with red anger symbol.

Bottom information cards: Create exactly 8 bordered info cards across the lower third, numbered 01 through 08 with black slanted header tabs and red number accents. The 8 cards are: 01 profile; 02 personality; 03 features; 04 favorite things; 05 dislikes; 06 abilities; 07 setting; 08 quotes. Use compact Japanese text inside the cards, with small decorative icons such as a waveform, paw print, sun warning symbol, small cat silhouette, and red paw mark. For the quote card, include three short Japanese quote lines using {argument name="quote text" default="『今夜の音、悪くないね』 / 『星は苦手。世界が明るすぎる』 / 『いい夜だね。少しだけ、歩こうか』"}.

Text style: Use strong Japanese display typography, black labels with red side bars, small red waveform graphics, and clean technical annotation lines. Keep the poster readable but allow tiny Japanese text to feel like a designed reference sheet.

Constraints: Use exactly one central hero cat, exactly 3 left pose panels, exactly 2 item illustrations, exactly 6 mood icons, and exactly 8 bottom info cards. No humans, no extra characters, no full-color background, no photorealism, no watermark.

prompt: 请根据我上传的第一张手掌照片，结合第二张参考图的版式风格，生成一张高清 3:4 比例的中文掌纹解析图。 核心要求 请以第一张图中的真实手掌为主要分析对象，尽量保留原手掌的形态、手指比例、掌型、肤色、掌纹走向和真实质感。 第二张图只作为视觉风格参考： 参考它的中式玄学信息图风格、米白色背景、棕红色字体、传统书法标题、红色圆形编号、虚线引导线、掌纹线条标注、右侧文字分析栏、底部综合断语框。 不要照搬第二张图的手掌，不要复制水印，不要出现平台 logo。 画面风格 整体做成一张高级中式玄学风格的「掌纹解析图」。 画面比例：3:4 画质：高清、细节清晰、适合小红书发布 背景：米白色宣纸质感、淡淡复古纹理 主色：深棕色、红棕色、浅金色、米白色 字体风格：标题用中式书法感，正文用清晰可读的中文宋体/楷体风格 整体感觉：专业、古典、干净、高级，像传统命理大师出具的掌纹分析图卡。 标题设计 顶部大标题写： 「掌纹解析图」 副标题写： 「传统手相 · 易理参考 · 趋势分析」 标题旁边加一个红色小印章，印章文字写： 「天机」 底部小字写： 「仅供传统文化与娱乐参考」 手掌标注要求 请在手掌上用棕红色细线、虚线、圆点、编号标记出以下 12 个关键点。 每个编号要清晰对应右侧分析内容。 需要标注的 12 个点： 1. 生命线 2. 智慧线 3. 感情线 4. 命运线 5. 太阳线 6. 健康线 / 水星线 7. 婚姻线 8. 金星丘 9. 木星丘 10. 月丘 11. 拇指张开度 / 意志力 12. 手指形态与掌型 标注时要求： 线条要贴合第一张图真实掌纹的大致走向，不要乱画。 编号和文字不要遮挡手掌主体。 虚线引导线要像专业图解一样清晰。 手掌左侧、右侧和掌心内部都要有合理标注。 整体排版要像第二张图一样，左边是手掌解析图，右边是文字说明。 右侧分析文字要求 请在右侧生成 12 条中文分析，每条对应一个编号。 文字风格要像传统手相、易经、中医体质结合的分析，语言要专业、有预警感、有命理感，但不要太夸张。 每条控制在 2-4 行，文字清晰可读。 请使用以下分析内容： 1 生命线 弧度较大、整体不断，主精力底子不差，抗压后恢复力较强；中后段若显细碎，提示阶段性劳累与作息失衡时，要注意元气透支。 2 智慧线 线势偏长并略向下走，说明思维细腻、感受力强，做事有观察力与想象力；但也容易想得太多，情绪压力大时会反复内耗。 3 感情线 长度尚可，末端若有轻微分叉，代表感情认真、慢热，重投入也重精神契合；内心敏感，容易因期待高而失望。 4 命运线 掌心纵线偏淡，早年路径感不是一步到位，更多靠自己摸索累积；越到后期越稳，属于先试错、后定型的格局。 5 太阳线 太阳线偏细，名望运与成就感属于后发型，不是一夜爆发，而是靠作品、口碑、专业能力慢慢被看见。 6 健康线 / 水星线 此线偏隐，按传统中医观念，多提示脾胃、睡眠与情绪管理要放在前面；一紧张或熬夜，容易出现疲惫感与气血不足感。 7 婚姻线 侧缘细纹若不止一条，代表感情经历中有选择与衡量，不轻易定下；真正稳定往往来自成熟后的价值观契合。 8 金星丘 拇指根部较饱满，主重情义、顾家、生命力与亲和力较强；也说明对安全感和现实温度看得比较重。 9 木星丘 食指下方有一定起伏，代表上进心、自我要求与责任感不低；适合在团队中承担组织、带动、协调类角色。 10 月丘 掌缘下方纹理柔和，说明直觉、共情力与审美感不弱；想象力丰富，适合内容、审美、沟通相关事务。 11 拇指张开度 / 意志力 拇指张开角度自然，代表独立意识与执行意志较明显；不是盲从型，一旦想清楚方向，往往能持续推进。 12 手指形态与掌型 整体掌型偏长、手指较修长，属于理性中带感受型，重体验也重逻辑；做事不喜欢太粗糙，财运更适合稳扎稳打。 底部综合断语 请在画面底部设计一个古典边框信息框，标题写： 「综合断语」 内容写： • 整体格局偏中上，早年多摸索与变化，中后期逐步清晰并走向稳定累积。 • 性格理性务实而有同理心，适合以专业、审美、沟通或长期主义建立价值。 • 感情重真诚与精神契合，慢热但投入，成熟后更容易收获稳定关系。 • 近期最需注意的是作息、情绪与脾胃调养，守住状态，运势会更顺。 排版要求 左侧：放大手掌主体，占画面 55%-60%。 右侧：放 12 条编号分析，占画面 35%-40%。 底部：放综合断语框。 文字必须清晰、无乱码、无错别字、不要变形。 所有编号、线条、标题、正文要有统一的中式美学。 图片整体要像专业命理分析图，不要像普通手机截图。 不要出现英文。 不要出现水印。 不要改变原手掌的基本形状。 最终输出一张高清 3:4 中文掌纹解析海报。

title: Magic Academy Graduate Portrait System
prompt:
请基于用户上传的 1-3 张清晰个人照片，一次性生成 **9 张不同的单独精修毕业写真照片**，统一为 **{argument name="构图比例" default="3:4 竖构图"}**。  
主题为：

**「{argument name="写真主题" default="英伦魔法学院毕业写真"}」**

---

## 一、人物一致性

请严格保留用户本人真实身份特征，包括但不限于：

- 脸型
- 五官比例
- 眼睛形状
- 鼻子形状
- 嘴唇形状
- 肤色
- 年龄感
- 发型基础
- 体型
- 整体气质

9 张图里都必须清楚看起来是 **同一个真实女生**。  
不能变成陌生人，不能欧美化，不能网红化，不能过度磨皮，不能出现 AI 假脸。

请只把上传照片作为 **人物身份参考**，不要保留原照片中的现实背景、日常服装和原始构图。  
请重新生成一整组全新的 **英伦魔法学院毕业写真**。

---

## 二、整体定位

这组图的重点不是现实写真，而是：

**“英伦魔法学院毕业主题 + 超现实 AI 魔法场景 + 电影海报级视觉冲击。”**

整组图要像：

- 一套高概念魔法学院电影宣传海报
- 明显充满 AI 奇观视觉
- 具有夸张空间、宏大叙事、强烈魔法氛围
- 既保留毕业身份，又保留人物精修写真感

整体关键词：

- 英伦
- 学院
- 毕业
- 魔法
- 电影海报感
- 漂浮书页
- 飞书
- 巨型猫头鹰
- 星空穹顶
- 魔法光轨
- 哥特图书馆
- 神秘烛光
- 超现实空间
- 高级感
- 强叙事感

---

## 三、服装要求

服装请采用 **“学院毕业袍 + 魔法元素”** 的逻辑。

要求：

- 保留毕业袍 / 学位袍轮廓
- 保留学院帽 / 学位帽体系
- 加入学院围巾、学院徽章、学院纹章、边饰、领带、刺绣细节
- 内搭可使用白衬衫、领带、针织背心、百褶裙、学院长裙
- 整体像“魔法学院优秀毕业生”的纪念写真造型
- 服装统一、完整、有电影质感
- 不要做成舞台戏服
- 不要廉价 cosplay 感

---

## 四、场景与超现实奇观要求

9 张图要围绕魔法学院世界观展开，且明显比普通写真更夸张、更梦幻、更像 AI 视觉大片。

高优先级视觉元素：

- 高耸书架
- 哥特式图书馆
- 魔法书山
- 漂浮书页
- 飞书
- 巨型猫头鹰
- 烛光大厅
- 发光卷轴
- 星空穹顶
- 深蓝宇宙感天幕
- 发光魔法线条
- 环绕人物的咒语光轨
- 蓝白色魔法粒子
- 逆光烟雾
- 巨大古书封面
- 仪式感学院证书
- 光束穿过拱窗
- 大型魔法生物守护感构图

整体要像：  
**AI 才能做出的魔法学院电影海报奇观场景。**

---

## 五、光线与画质要求

光线要求：

- 冷蓝月光 / 星空光
- 暖金烛光
- 局部逆光
- 魔法发光粒子
- 氛围烟雾
- 明暗层次丰富
- 人物脸部清晰
- 面部和手部细节清楚
- 电影级光影

画质要求：

- 真实摄影质感
- 高精细
- 高级感
- 电影感
- 不要普通影楼感
- 不要平淡背景
- 不要塑料皮肤
- 不要脏乱廉价 CG 感

---

## 六、9张单独照片固定分配

请一次性输出以下 **9 张不同的单独精修照片**：

### 第1张｜主视觉海报图
- 全身或 3/4 身
- 人物站在高耸魔法图书馆中央
- 周围漂浮大量书页
- 手持魔杖或毕业卷轴
- 电影海报主视觉感极强

### 第2张｜施法近景图
- 半身近景
- 人物手持魔杖
- 书页从镜头前后飞过
- 背景有发光星空穹顶或魔法天幕
- 强调面部、手部和咒语感

### 第3张｜巨型猫头鹰守护图
- 中景或全身
- 背后或一侧出现巨大猫头鹰
- 人物抱书、拿卷轴或轻抬手施法
- 有明显守护与陪伴的叙事感

### 第4张｜环绕光轨施法图
- 全身
- 人物站立施法
- 周围出现盘旋的发光魔法环
- 空中悬浮书页
- 气氛更强、更戏剧化

### 第5张｜星空图书馆沉思图
- 半身或中近景
- 人物置身哥特式图书馆
- 背景是深蓝星空、烛光、发光书页
- 手持古书或魔法卷轴
- 表情安静、聪明、神秘

### 第6张｜书山与飞书图
- 中景
- 人物站在堆叠书山之间
- 头顶和四周飞书盘旋
- 构图夸张，空间尺度大
- 有明显超现实奇观效果

### 第7张｜毕业身份强化图
- 3/4 身
- 人物明确展示毕业袍、学院围巾、学院徽章、帽子体系
- 手持毕业证书或学院卷轴
- 背景为学院大厅 / 烛光礼堂 / 书架

### 第8张｜低机位英雄感海报图
- 全身或中景
- 低机位仰拍
- 人物站姿更有气场
- 书页、光效、粒子从人物周围向上延伸
- 像毕业后的最终主角海报

### 第9张｜情绪收束图
- 半身近景
- 人物在安静神秘的图书馆角落或拱窗前
- 可有烛光、羽毛、发光尘埃、轻微漂浮书页
- 一手轻扶古书或围巾
- 作为整组中最有情绪和故事感的一张

---

## 七、统一要求

9 张图必须统一：

- 同一个真实人脸
- 同一套英伦魔法学院毕业造型体系
- 同一学院配色体系
- 同一世界观体系
- 同一电影海报级氛围
- 同一超现实魔法奇观风格

9 张图必须有明显变化：

- 镜头远近
- 视角高低
- 动作
- 表情
- 道具互动
- 魔法奇观重点
- 构图方式

---

## 八、明确避免

- 不要平淡写真
- 不要低成本 cosplay 感
- 不要现代校园日常风
- 不要廉价影楼魔法风
- 不要背景堆砌得杂乱无主次
- 不要人物变脸
- 不要欧美化
- 不要网红脸
- 不要过度磨皮
- 不要 AI 假脸
- 不要错误手指
- 不要错误肢体结构

title: Cinematic Cycling Program
prompt:
Ultra-realistic cinematic close-up of a female cyclist tightening a baby pink performance glove around her wrist. Focus on fingers, tendons, and fabric stretch. Realistic tension and folds in the glove material. Cool foggy environment, soft diffused light, cinematic shallow depth of field, subtle breathing movement transferred into frame, ultra-realistic textures.

Panel 5 — Balaclava & Focused Eyes

Ultra-realistic cinematic close-up of a female cyclist wearing helmet and performance glasses while adjusting a baby pink balaclava over the lower half of her face. Tight symmetrical framing focused on eyes and hands. Slow controlled movement as the fabric stretches softly around her face. Slight condensation on glasses, calm determined eyes shifting subtly to the side. Foggy blurred background, cool cinematic lighting, photorealistic detail.

Panel 6 — Misty Mountain Establishing Shot

Ultra-realistic cinematic wide shot of foggy mountain valleys and dense forest under overcast skies. Heavy fog drifting through trees and across the road. Cold moody atmosphere, soft volumetric fog, subtle wind movement in branches and grass. Cool cinematic color grading, high dynamic range, deep atmospheric depth, almost static camera with very subtle cinematic push-in.

Panel 7 — Drone Tracking Cyclists

Ultra-realistic wide cinematic drone shot of three female road cyclists riding uphill together on a wet mountain road in foggy weather. The cyclists wear baby pink performance cycling apparel contrasting against the cold gray environment. Smooth lateral drone tracking movement parallel to the cyclists. Wet asphalt reflecting soft light, subtle tire spray, drifting fog crossing the road, synchronized pedaling rhythm, natural movement, documentary realism.

Panel 8 — Frontal Speed Shot

Ultra-realistic cinematic frontal drone shot of three female cyclists riding fast in single-file formation on a wet mountain road. Camera flies backward at the exact same speed, keeping constant framing and centered composition. Baby pink cycling jackets visible through rain and fog. Wet asphalt reflections, water spray from wheels, dynamic rain particles, cinematic stabilization with subtle natural drone float, cold atmospheric mountain background.

Panel 9 — Bicycle Drivetrain Finale

Ultra-realistic cinematic close-up from a camera mounted near the rear wheel and drivetrain of a road bicycle. Baby pink cycling shoe and lower apparel visible while pedaling intensely uphill in rain. Detailed chain, cassette, crankset, and wheel movement with realistic mechanical motion. Water droplets splashing onto the drivetrain, wet asphalt texture sharp and reflective. Natural vibrations from the bike, shallow depth of field, cinematic motion blur, foggy mountain atmosphere, premium high-end commercial realism.

prompt: 创建一个简洁现代的中文科技博客封面，采用 16:9 宽屏布局，背景为柔和的浅灰色，画布采用圆角设计，并呈现极简的仪表盘美学。在左侧顶部放置一个带有黄色圆点图标的小型圆角分类标签，文字为"VPS 实测 · 购买参考"。下方设置两行堆叠的超大号深海军蓝中文标题："DMIT 涨价之后"和"我把搬瓦工"。在标题下方添加一条短黄色下划线装饰，随后是中灰色的副标题"先看重点再下单"。排版应具有高级感、编辑感且易于阅读，对比度强烈，间距充裕。在右侧，展示一个悬浮的桌面应用风格服务器监控面板，主体为白色卡片，带有细腻阴影和圆角，顶部为浅米色浏览器栏，配有三个圆形窗口按钮。面板标题应为"BandwagonHost – CN2 GIA"，下方有一行较小的文字"洛杉矶 · CN2 GIA"以及绿色的"运行中"状态标签，右上角配有一个小型时钟图标和文字"运行时长 27 天"。面板内顶部一行包含 5 个指标卡片，标签分别为"CPU"显示"12%"、"内存"显示"28%"、"硬盘"显示"18%"、"带宽"显示"1.2 Mbps"以及"延迟（本地）"显示"156 ms"，每个指标配有一个青色小图标和一条细青色进度条。下方左侧放置一个大型折线图卡片，标题为"稳定性（近 7 天）"，右上角标注"可用性 99.92%"，图表内有一条青色波动曲线，纵轴刻度从 97% 到 100%，日期标签从"05-13"到"05-19"。图表右侧添加一个标题为"配置摘要"的规格卡片，列出 5 行内容："CPU 2 vCPU"、"内存 2 GB"、"硬盘 40 GB SSD"、"流量 1 TB/月"以及"系统 CentOS 7.9 64bit"。在左下角文字块与仪表盘重叠区域，添加一张较小的白色圆角阴影推荐卡片。标题行包含一个黄色书签图标，文字为"购买参考 · 重点看这几项"。内部列出 4 行内容："线路质量  CN2 GIA"、"稳定性  ★★★★☆"、"性价比  中上"以及"适用场景  建站 / 中转 / 轻应用"。在背景中添加柔和的装饰元素：左下角一个浅薄荷绿的抽象圆角形状，其上方为淡淡的薄荷绿点阵图案，并有一条浅色点状弧线从左侧文字区域延伸至仪表盘顶部，曲线上带有一个黄色小圆点。在画布右下角放置一个黄色圆角名牌，文字为"小墨同学"。整体使用深海军蓝、青色、黄色、白色和浅灰色的克制配色方案，呈现清晰的矢量风格渲染、细腻的阴影、宽敞的构图，打造出专业且精致的 AI 生成式 VPS 测评文章封面。

prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the base character sheet, redesign the same male student into a fictional Japanese dark-bureaucratic fantasy worldbuilding dossier. Keep his core body type, hairstyle, and face structure consistent, but replace the school uniform concept with 3 official role variants presented as a professional concept-art document on aged white paper with thin grid lines, black ink, muted grayscale, and deep red accent marks. Create a 3-column layout labeled 01, 02, and 03, each showing full-body front, side, and back views of the same character reimagined for a different job. Role 01 should be a tax collection officer in a long black coat with hanging paperwork, armband, shoulder straps, leather belts, and a compact case. Role 02 should be an arcane audit scribe with glasses, layered robe-like outerwear over formal clothes, dangling seals and inspection documents, a ledger or clipboard, writing tools, and a briefcase. Role 03 should be a sealed artifact courier with a military-style cap, face covering, heavier protective coat, straps, tags, and a large transport case plus a backpack-like cargo unit. Add vertical Japanese side notes beside each role, dense bureaucratic labels, official insignias, stamps, serial numbers, and small English sublabels for the role names. At the bottom, include 3 equipment sections, one under each column: for role 01 show exactly 3 items — a hard case, an official stamp, and 2 paper forms; for role 02 show exactly 4 items — a black device/ledger panel, a set of 4 pens, a tray of 6 seal sticks or cartridges, and 1 blue handbook; for role 03 show exactly 4 items — a transport chest, 2 paper tags/forms, 3 hanging sealing tools, and 2 circular sealing tools plus 1 document card. Include an additional footer strip with exactly 4 color swatches, exactly 3 insignia emblems, a notice block, and publication/record information boxes. Overall style: high-end anime concept sheet mixed with occult government archive design, meticulous costume detailing, restrained composition, realistic textile rendering, and a serious institutional mood.

title: Summer Selfie Sticker Collage
prompt: Please use the uploaded portrait as a reference. Create a 2x2 summer selfie collage with a {argument name="aspect ratio" default="9:16"} vertical aspect ratio, comprising four panels. Ensure that the facial features remain consistent, with soft, youthful features, a warm smile and natural skin texture. In each panel, depict the character outdoors in bright summer sunshine, wearing a straw hat. Have her strike a variety of poses across the four panels: a peace sign selfie, a pose cupping her face with her hands, an OK gesture, and a relaxed close-up selfie. Keep the composition cute, lively and casual. Add colourful, watercolour-style hand-drawn doodles around her: soft outlines around her body and hat, floating soap bubbles, small hearts, simple sun drawings, sparkles, and cute little animal stickers. Ensure the doodles have a playful, hand-drawn feel, like mobile phone photo stickers. Remove all watermarks, logos, AI labels, app labels and signature marks. Keep the decorative handwritten text, but replace it with neat, legible words such as {argument name="sticker labels" default="‘Sheena’, ‘sunny’, ‘cute day’ and ‘summer’"}. Make ‘{argument name="main text" default="happy day"}’ the most prominent text. Ensure the text looks like colourful, hand-drawn sticker lettering. Style: Soft Korean/Japanese-style summer selfie aesthetic, bright yet subtle sunlight, fresh colours, a slight film-like softness, a refreshing outdoor atmosphere, cute social media collages, clean ultra-high-resolution images. Elements to remove: Watermarks, logos, brand marks, AI labels, signatures, QR codes, random text, illegible characters, misspelled ‘happy day’, long captions, cluttered typography, unnecessary people, duplicate faces within a single panel, distorted faces, asymmetrical eyes, plastic-looking skin, excessively smooth skin, blurry faces, lack of detail, unnatural body proportions, distorted hands, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, twisted arms, severe overexposure, dull colours, severe compression artefacts, dark and underexposed panels.

title: Pakistani Street Fashion & Birds
prompt: Create a hyper-realistic cinematic DSLR street-fashion portrait of a {argument name="character description" default="stylish Pakistani girl"} standing full-body against a tall rough concrete urban wall covered with black graffiti splatter and abstract bird silhouettes, in a rainy city alley with wet reflective pavement and a softly blurred modern street background on the left. slug: 地铁生日应援灯箱照片-6_971800
title: Subway Birthday Lightbox Photo
prompt:
Goal: Create a realistic candid photo in a subway or underground station hallway showing a young woman posing beside a large digital birthday advertisement billboard for herself.

Canvas: Horizontal 16:9 photo, eye-level perspective, wide framing. Beige tiled station wall with grout lines and a polished gray floor. Fluorescent ceiling reflections and clean public-transit interior lighting.

Main subject: One young Korean woman stands on the left side of the frame, full body visible from head to upper thighs. She has long dark hair and wears a fitted black long-sleeve top, light blue high-waisted denim shorts with frayed hems, and a small black shoulder bag. Her face is covered by a rectangular soft blur privacy block. She smiles/poses toward the camera and points with both hands toward the billboard.

Billboard: One large horizontal digital screen mounted on the wall to the right, with a thick black frame. The billboard shows a pastel birthday fan-ad design for {argument name="character name" default="윤슬"}. The design is pink on the left blending into blue on the right, with dreamy clouds, sparkles, hearts, bubbles, and a large portrait of the same woman on the right side of the billboard. The portrait face is also covered by a large rectangular soft blur privacy block.

Text content on billboard: Include exactly 6 visible text groups: 1) small English text “HAPPY BIRTHDAY” near the upper left, 2) very large Korean name “윤슬” centered-left in pink and blue bubble lettering, 3) date “1996.02.15” below the name, 4) pink ribbon label “여신 탄신일”, 5) small handwritten Korean line near the lower left, “세상에서 가장 빛나는 순간, 언제나 윤슬과 함께할게 ♡”, 6) handwritten Korean message on the right, “윤슬아, 생일 축하해! 너의 모든 순간을 응원해. 사랑해 ♡”.

Visual style: Photorealistic smartphone travel snapshot, natural station lighting, slight wide-angle lens, realistic reflections on the billboard glass, subtle depth of field but most elements readable. The birthday billboard should look professionally designed and luminous, while the surrounding subway wall remains neutral and realistic.

Constraints: Use exactly 1 posing woman, exactly 1 wall-mounted digital billboard, exactly 2 blurred face privacy rectangles, and exactly 6 billboard text groups. Do not add extra people, extra signs, watermarks, logos, or unrelated text.

title: VINCO edit style project screenshot
prompt: Create a 4:5 editorial fashion lookbook moodboard for a fictional brand called {argument name="brand name" default="VINCO"}. The image is a dark-interface screenshot-style composition with a large rounded charcoal text panel across the upper half and a 2-by-3 grid of six fashion/editorial images in the lower left quadrant. The overall aesthetic blends Italian archival graphic design with late-1990s Southern California streetwear, mixing natural wine culture, skate utility, and sun-faded documentary fashion photography. Use gritty but precise art direction, midday outdoor light, slightly chaotic but disciplined typography, and real-person casting rather than polished fashion-model energy. In the top text panel, show a long white sans-serif creative-direction paragraph describing the shoot, with multiple lines of copy, like an AI prompt or design brief displayed inside a rounded dark gray bubble on a near-black background. In the image grid, include exactly 6 tiles: tile 1 shows a young man in an oversized faded olive T-shirt and dark pants standing in front of an off-white poster-like backdrop with bold {argument name="logo text" default="VINCO"} branding, barcode graphics, and small editorial text; tile 2 is a close-up still life of a dark wine bottle with a minimalist white label reading {argument name="bottle label" default="VINCO"}, photographed in warm sunlight with tactile paper texture and shadow; tile 3 shows a person from the back in a washed olive long-sleeve shirt with large subtle chest or back branding, white shorts, and a yellow hanging tag or sticker element near the top right, posed against a pale wall with blue stripe detail and editorial layout text; tile 4 shows a skateboarder crouching or riding away, photographed from behind, wearing a white T-shirt with a large black graphic block on the back and dark shorts, in golden sun on pavement; tile 5 is a printed wine ephemera flat lay with cream paper and a pale chartreuse-green wine label or booklet reading {argument name="product text" default="Vino Naturale"}, featuring grape illustration, small black text, and layered paper pieces; tile 6 shows a person facing camera in a white T-shirt with a race-bib style chest print reading 97, wearing a fluorescent yellow-green cap with small brand text, standing outdoors with palm trees and bright sky behind them. Keep the six images slightly imperfect and collage-like, as if pulled from a campaign deck or saved references. Use earthy tones throughout: olive, cream, charcoal, sun-bleached white, asphalt gray, muted brown, and one fluorescent yellow-green accent repeated in small details. Include visible interface framing around the composition: a dark app-like background, the lower image grid aligned left, and a rounded gray “Edit” button near the bottom left, plus a small circular icon near the bottom right, reinforcing that this is a screenshot of a generated moodboard rather than a clean standalone poster.

title: AI Supercar Poster Comparison
prompt: Create a side-by-side comparison graphic on a black background with a faint gray grid, styled like a Chinese social media benchmark post comparing two AI-generated supercar posters. At the very top, place 2 large headings: on the left in bold yellow text, “GPT image 2”, and on the right in bold white text, “Nano Banana”. Centered beneath them, show 2 distinct vertical racing poster designs placed next to each other with a narrow gap. The left poster should look like a dramatic high-end motorsport advertisement in black, red, and white, featuring a glossy red hypercar speeding on a wet racetrack at dusk with cinematic reflections, motion blur, and aggressive lighting. Include a small brand mark at top left, a giant title “VORTEX X7” with “X7” in bright red, and a subtitle like “BORN FOR SPEED. BUILT TO WIN.” Add 2 laurel-like badges on the right of the title area. In the lower half, include 3 content blocks: a left “SPECIFICATIONS” column with exactly 7 listed rows with icon bullets and labels for engine, horsepower, top speed, acceleration, transmission, drivetrain, curb weight, plus fuel capacity if needed as a compact final row; a middle “FEATURES” column with exactly 5 bullet points; and a bold pricing block with “STARTING AT” and a large red price of {argument name="price" default="$189,900"}. Add 1 limited-production badge, 1 slogan block reading “FEEL THE SPEED. OWN THE TRACK.”, and 1 red call-to-action strip reading “ORDER NOW”. Use tiny footer details and contact-style microtext along the bottom edge. The right poster should look more editorial and technical, in navy blue, charcoal, beige, and orange accents, featuring a dark blue hypercar drifting on a racetrack with smoke and landscape in the background. At the top, use a premium magazine-style header with 3 stacked title lines: “FORMULA APEX | AETHELRED APEX”, “CHAMPIONSHIP HERITAGE”, and a performance subtitle. In the lower portion, create a dense spec-sheet layout with exactly 8 major sections: “SPECIFICATION SHEET”, “COMPETITION PACK OPTIONS”, “ENGINE”, “SUSPENSION”, “CHASSIS”, “DRIVETRAIN”, “LAUNCH EDITION | RESERVE NOW”, and “SERVICE & SUPPORT”. Include a small performance graph, a boxed options panel with 3 icon cards, a launch price line showing {argument name="launch price" default="$2,850,000 USD"}, a build-slots area showing exactly 50 units worldwide, an allocation or progress tracker with segmented bars, a line stating production begins in {argument name="production year" default="2025"}, and dense fine-print technical copy. Beneath both posters, add a rounded rectangular black prompt box outlined in white, spanning most of the width. Attach a yellow rounded label overlapping its top-left corner containing the Chinese text “提示词”. Inside the box, place one line of bold white Chinese text: {argument name="prompt text" default="生成一张赛车海报图片，包含规格参数和价格信息。"}. The whole composition should feel like a polished AI image comparison screenshot for social media, with sharp typography, high contrast, clean alignment, and realistic poster mockup proportions.

title: Fantasy Anime Rock Band Concert
prompt:
Goal: Create a lavish fantasy anime rock-band concert illustration featuring {argument name="band name" default="a magical girl rock band"} performing on a glowing gothic crystal stage.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 cinematic composition, ultra-detailed, high-resolution anime key visual, dramatic concert lighting, deep violet and electric blue color palette with pink highlights.

Layout: Place the lead vocalist in the center foreground on a circular glowing stage sigil, surrounded by exactly 6 other band members and 1 small dog mascot. Arrange the performers in a full-stage ensemble: 2 musicians on the far left, 1 left-center bassist, 1 center vocalist, 1 drummer in the rear center, 1 right-center violinist, and 1 far-right keyboardist. Use strong depth, sparkling atmosphere, and bright purple audience glow sticks along the bottom edge.

Subject details: Show exactly 7 anime-style female band members: 1 far-left keyboardist seated/standing at a futuristic keyboard console; 1 left guitarist in black gothic idol fashion with cat-ear accessories holding an electric guitar; 1 left-center bassist in dark ornate clothing holding a bass guitar; 1 center lead singer with {argument name="lead singer hair color" default="blonde hair"}, wearing a pink plaid cropped idol top, short layered skirt, belts, ribbons, thigh straps, and tall lace-up platform boots, singing into a pink microphone on a stand with one hand extended toward the viewer; 1 rear-center drummer seated at a full drum kit with a glowing emblem on the bass drum; 1 right-center violinist in a red-and-black ornate stage outfit playing violin; 1 far-right keyboardist in a blue-and-white fantasy dress playing a glowing synthesizer. Add exactly 1 small Cavalier King Charles Spaniel mascot sitting at the lead singer’s feet, wearing a cute stage harness or decorative vest.

Stage and environment: The venue is a grand magical cathedral-concert hall made of crystalline arches, gothic spires, translucent purple prisms, floating shards, moonlit windows, and holographic musical displays. Behind the vocalist, create a huge circular stained-glass-like magic portal or ornate clockwork mandala glowing in lavender. Include two visible moons in the night sky, starry cosmic background, floating crystal decorations, fairy-like sparkles, and radiant stage beams.

Visual style: Extremely detailed Japanese anime illustration, idol-rock fantasy aesthetic, glossy lighting, intricate costumes, jewel-like textures, luminous neon outlines, cinematic backlight, volumetric haze, high contrast, sharp focus, elaborate accessories, magical particles, energetic live-concert mood.

Color and mood: Dominant {argument name="main color palette" default="purple, indigo, magenta, and icy blue"}; glamorous, powerful, celebratory, and dreamlike.

Constraints: Use exactly 7 human performers and exactly 1 dog mascot. No visible lyrics or readable poster text. Avoid extra band members. Keep the composition symmetrical around the lead vocalist, with the drummer clearly behind her and the dog clearly in the front foreground.

title: Movie texture Dr Pepper restaurant poster
titleEn: Movie texture Dr Pepper restaurant poster
prompt:
Goal: Create a hyper-realistic cinematic luxury soda advertisement poster for {argument name="brand name" default="Dr Pepper"}, with a glamorous nighttime diner atmosphere, glossy red color grading, and dramatic commercial beverage photography.

Canvas: Vertical poster, 2:3 aspect ratio, high-resolution, dark black-and-crimson palette, rain-slick street reflections, glowing neon, shallow depth of field, intense rim lighting, premium magazine-ad finish.

Main subject: A fashionable young woman stands in the left and center foreground, posing confidently beside a shiny red classic car. Her face is intentionally covered by a plain flat medium-brown rectangular censor block with no facial details visible. She has long dark wavy hair around the rectangle, realistic glowing skin on the visible neck and hands, hoop earrings, and a confident fashion-ad stance. Outfit: {argument name="woman outfit" default="burgundy fitted blazer, black crop top, black fitted jeans, and black heeled boots"}. One arm rests near the red car while the other hand extends toward the viewer holding the soda can.

Product focus: A large red chilled soda can dominates the foreground in her outstretched hand, tilted slightly, covered with condensation droplets and glossy highlights. The can label reads "Dr Pepper" in large white script, includes "Est. 1885", a circular "23" flavor emblem, and small decorative branding details. The can should be the sharpest object and feel oversized by forced perspective.

Liquid action: From the open top of the can, a dramatic thick ribbon of dark red carbonated soda erupts upward and sweeps across the entire top half of the poster in an elegant swirling wave. The soda splash contains sparkling bubbles, droplets, and exactly 5 visible ice cubes: one large cube near the upper right curve, one cube just below it on the right, one cube near the center of the splash above the can, one cube slightly lower near the can opening, and one smaller cube to the left of the can in the splash stream.

Background: A nostalgic American diner street at night, glowing with red neon and warm window lights. Include a prominent diner building in the upper background with a bright neon sign reading "DINER" on the roof, silhouettes of patrons inside, two vintage cars parked in front, and urban buildings behind it. On the far left, show a blurred close-up red neon diner sign cropped so only part of the word is visible. On the right background, include a large glowing roadside sign with the brand logo and a circular "23" emblem. Wet pavement reflects red lights and headlights.

Text content: In the lower right, add a large distressed bold condensed white headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="BOLD FLAVOR"} on two lines. Beneath it, add a smaller uppercase tagline reading {argument name="tagline text" default="NOT ORDINARY. NEVER BORING."}, with "NEVER BORING." emphasized in red. Keep the text clean, legible, and integrated into the poster like a professional soda campaign.

Visual style: Hyper-realistic, cinematic, high contrast, glossy commercial retouching, luxury beverage photography, dramatic perspective, volumetric neon glow, crisp condensation, tiny soda bubbles, red-and-black monochromatic atmosphere, premium advertising poster aesthetic.

Constraints: Use exactly one woman, one main soda can, one red car in the foreground, one diner building, one roadside brand sign, and exactly 5 ice cubes. Do not add extra characters in the foreground, do not add additional headline copy, avoid cartoon or illustration style, and keep all visible text spelled clearly.

slug: 超写实超现实海报设计提示词-2_833dc5
title: Hyper-Realistic Surreal Poster Design Prompts
prompt:
ジャンル：{argument name="ジャンル" default="ハンバーガー"}
ブランド名：{argument name="ブランド名" default="かし子"}

この画像をベースに、世界中のどこにも存在しない、発想が常識を完全に逸脱したフォトリアルなポスター画像を生成してください。

単なる延長ではなく、「意味は通じるが解釈が狂っている」レベルまで発想を飛躍させること。

【絶対条件】
・フォトリアル表現（実写のような質感、空気感、光の粒子まで再現）
・言語はすべて日本語

【誇張・ブーストする要素】
■フォントデザイン
・文字そのものが物体化・現象化している
・フォントがテーマと物理的に相互作用している

■文字の配置
・通常のレイアウトを無視し、空間そのものに配置
・視線誘導が異常に強い配置

■構図
・非現実的なパース、極端な広角、歪み、スケール破壊
・手前・中景・奥のレイヤーが明確で、情報密度が異常に高い
・一瞬で目を引く中心要素＋細部に無数の違和感

■ライティング
・映画レベルのシネマティック照明
・強烈な逆光、リムライト、ネオン、粒子光、ボリュームライト
・光自体が意味を持つ（導線や強調として機能）

■キャッチコピー
・短く、強烈で、意味が分かるのに理解が追いつかない日本語
・状況とズレているのに妙にハマるコピー

【追加演出】
・現実と非現実が同時に成立している違和感
・一部が物理法則を無視している
・広告として成立しているクオリティ（プロレベル）

最終的に「理解できるのに理解が追いつかない」「二度見する」ポスターにすること。
参考画像がキャラクターの場合、そのブランドを身につけている・使用している・食べようとしている、等の動作等を適用する。
実在のブランドロゴ・会社名・人名等は一切使用せず、完全オリジナルにする。最終仕上げ時に実在のものが含まれていないか確認すること。
過度な描き込みによるノイズやバランスの崩れを抑制し、画面全体の統一感と洗練された印象を維持する。

titleEn: Tim Cook MMO Group Boss: Apple Store Epic Encounter
prompt: 创作一张电影级奇幻 MMO 团本 Boss 加载界面风格的插图，并带有完整的自定义游戏 UI 叠加层。场景设定在黄昏时分，背景是玻璃立方体 Apple Store，建筑正面中央有发光的白色 Apple Logo。广场中央站着一个巨大的团本 Boss 版本的 Tim Cook，标记为"建筑师 (The Architect)"，身穿合身的黑色高领毛衣、深色长裤和运动鞋，一只手拿着发光的智能手机，另一只手自然张开，姿态从容。他的面部经过模糊或匿名化处理。整体基调史诗、讽刺且具有高制作水准，如同《魔兽世界》团本遭遇战界面与企业科技恶搞的结合。在他周围，20 名奇幻团本玩家组成半圆战斗阵型面向 Boss，包括身穿盔甲的战士、潜行者、法师、萨满、猎人以及兽人族和人类等多种种族和剪影。其中几位正在施放明亮的法术，包括橙色火焰、蓝色闪电、绿色能量和紫色虚空魔法。在 Boss 附近加入 3 个小型机器人小怪，每个都标记为"供应商小怪 (Supplier Add)"，拥有矮胖的工业风躯干，正面印有 Apple Logo。此外，加入 2 个活跃的战斗机制气泡：Boss 右侧有一个标记为"利润护盾 (Margin Shield)"的蓝色球形护盾，更右侧有一个标记为"封闭系统 (Closed System)"的紫色圆形穹顶，内部困着一名人形敌人。将图像构建为完整的团本 UI 构图。左上角：一个大型扩展包风格的标题，写着"SIEGE OF THE INFINITE LOOP"，副标题为"20-MAN HORDE RAID"。最左侧：一个垂直的"团队框架 (RAID FRAMES)"面板，列出 1 到 20 号共 20 个玩家姓名，并带有彩色生命值条。顶部中央：一个 Boss 头像框，显示 Boss 名称 Tim Cook、副标题"建筑师"以及 100% 的红色生命值条。右上角：一个大型遭遇战指南面板，标题为"遭遇战：TIM COOK – \"建筑师\""，包含 3 个阶段。第一阶段标题："供应链主导 (100% – 70%)"，包含 3 个技能："物流激增 (Logistics Surge) – 召唤一波供应商小怪。"、"利润护盾 (Margin Shield) – 10 秒内减少 40% 所受伤害。"以及"季度压力 (Quarterly Pressure) – 可叠加的减益效果，若未驱散则会爆炸。"第二阶段标题："生态系统锁定 (70% – 30%)"，包含 3 个技能："封闭系统 (Closed System) – 隔离 3 名玩家，需解谜才能返回。"、"订阅流失 (Subscription Drain) – 全团持续伤害。"以及"设备同步 (Device Sync) – 在正确阵型中集合以避免尖刺伤害。"第三阶段标题："还有一件事 (ONE MORE THING) (30% – 0%)"，包含 3 个技能："惊喜发布 (Surprise Launch) – 每 20 秒造成大规模范围爆发伤害。"、"现实扭曲力场 (Reality Distortion Field) – 短暂反转控制。"以及"狂暴：市场崩溃 (Enrage: Market Collapse) – Boss 在 3 分钟时狂暴。"右下角：一个"潜在掉落 (POTENTIAL LOOT)"面板，列出 4 件带有稀有度颜色文本的物品："高效执行官斗篷 (史诗)"、"发布会之刃 (史诗)"、"生态系统之戒 (史诗)"和"投资者青睐 (奖励 – 困难模式)"。下方添加一个红黑相间的小徽章，写着"困难模式 (HARD MODE)"，以及一行文字"在战斗中激活 \"投资者电话会议\" 以"，其余文本被截断或遮挡。左下角：一个"聊天 (CHAT)"框，包含 4 行文字，包括 Boss 的嘲讽台词和玩家回复，例如"Tim Cook 大喊：创新。纪律。卓越。这就是我们获胜的方式。"、"Tim Cook 大喊：我们的生态系统坚不可摧。"、"Tim Cook 大喊：还有一件事……"、"Lok'tarbrok：Lok'tar ogar！"底部中央：一个奇幻动作条，包含 12 个装饰性槽位中的技能图标，部分带有数字，部分显示冷却时间文本，包括"2m"和"1m"。使用戏剧性的体积光、湿润广场上的光泽反射、逼真的环境渲染、高度精细的奇幻角色、夸张的法术效果、暗角效果、清晰的 UI 排版以及精致的 AAA 级游戏主视觉构图。

title: Realistic Female Track Athlete Portrait
prompt: Create a realistic full-body vertical portrait of an adult female track-and-field athlete standing upright and facing the camera against a plain gray concrete wall with circular form-tie holes. She has a fit, athletic build with toned shoulders, arms, waist, and legs, and wears a {argument name="uniform color" default="deep red"} two-piece competition uniform: a racerback sports crop top with white curved side stripes and small white athletic logos on the chest, plus matching low-rise running briefs with white side stripes and a small white logo near the hip. Her {argument name="hair color" default="reddish brown"} medium-length bob hair is softly styled with outward-flipped ends, and her face is covered by a centered rectangular pixelated privacy block in a skin-tone color. Use bright natural sunlight from the upper left, realistic skin shading, subtle shadows on the wall, sharp high-resolution detail, straight-on camera angle, cropped from head to mid-thigh, documentary sports portrait style, no text, no extra people, no props.

title: Vintage Beagle Flora Illustration
prompt: Using the provided reference image, transform the photo into a vintage naturalist encyclopedia plate in the style of a 19th-century scientific animal-and-botany illustration. Keep the same beagle and the same potted houseplant from the reference as the main subjects, but redraw them as finely inked and lightly hand-colored specimen illustrations on an aged off-white page. Preserve the dog's seated pose, collar and tag, and the plant's pot and overall structure. Add a formal infographic layout with 8 labeled figure areas total: 1 large central full-body beagle study, 1 large right-side plant study, 4 left-column inset studies labeled “Fig. 1. Head (Frontal View)”, “Fig. 2. Head (Profile View)”, “Fig. 3. Collar & Tag”, and “Fig. 4. Forepaw (Anterior View)”, 3 bottom comparative detail studies labeled “Eye”, “Nose”, and “Leaf (Detail)”, plus 1 bottom-right notes panel. Add delicate dotted annotation callouts around the main dog and plant identifying features such as eyes, ears, nose, chest, legs, paws, coat, leaves, stem, and roots. Include the page title “THE BEAGLE & THE HOUSEPLANT” at the top, the subtitle “Observations on a Domestic Companion and Its Environment”, corner plate markings “PL. I.” and “Tab. 1.”, a central caption “Fig. 5. The Beagle (Canis lupus familiaris) Adult. Seated Position.”, a plant caption “Fig. 6. Houseplant in Pot (Dracaena sp.)”, a bottom section title “Fig. 7. Comparative Study: Details”, and a notes box containing 5 lines: “Location: Indoor”, “Observations: Peaceful coexistence between companion animal and potted plant.”, “Date: May 17, 2024”, “Observer: Naturalist’s Journal”, and “Plate I.” Use clean engraved linework, restrained watercolor washes, subtle paper texture, decorative border corners, and a symmetrical museum-plate composition.

title: Minimalist hand-drawn ink sketch
prompt: 围绕具体主题内容生成一张极简稚拙的纸面手绘图像，先把主题从完整照片式信息中抽离出来，压缩成几笔仍能认出的抖动黑线、最低识别轮廓和少量关键符号，再让大片干净空白托住它。主体靠外轮廓、姿态、孔洞、边缘、物体关系和一两个手写标记被读懂；线条像黑色墨水笔或粗铅笔画在纸上，粗细不均，转折处略有堆黑，圆形带着手抖的偏差，长线微微漂移，内部细节只留下必要短线。对象的复杂度要降到识别临界点，少一笔会难认，多一笔会太精，衣物、器具、植物、建筑、食物、机器或抽象符号都转成白色块面、黑色边缘、松散连接线和一处最能说明身份的小特征。若出现人物，脸保持纸白，只用点状眼睛、短鼻线和极少表情，头发、胡子、衣褶、手脚都压成涂黑块、断线或松散轮廓，让人物像被记住的符号而不是肖像。背景是纸面场或浅色平场，承担呼吸、尺度和安静观看的功能，上方和四周保留明显空白；单主体落在中部或偏下位置，多元素内容压成低位横向关系带，用几条颤动底线串联，让上方空场保持沉默。色彩服从黑线和空白，白色或近白底占最大面积，黑线拥有结构权，低饱和淡色只用于形体分组和情绪温度，小面积暖色或深色只作为语义重音；填色略不均匀，边缘轻微错开轮廓，保留纸白漏出、颗粒和手工涂抹感。文字若出现，应像同一支黑笔写在物体表面的低精度标签或小注，字形不齐、间距松、略有错位，但仍能读懂，文字属于物体本身而不是外部版式。整体保持低完成度与高清识别之间的张力，像一张被认真留下的随手画，空、轻、笨拙、可读，带轻微扫描纸感、墨水残差、断线、重复描痕和非均匀涂色痕迹。

title: Origami Style K-Pop Idol Portrait
prompt: Create a square 1:1 ultra-detailed origami paper-craft portrait of {argument name="character name" default="a stylish young Korean pop idol"} shown from the chest up in a three-quarter profile facing right, with the facial area deliberately covered by a smooth centered square censor block in a warm taupe-brown gradient. The subject has layered tousled {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair made from sharp folded paper facets, a visible left ear with two dangling silver earrings, and a dramatic angular {argument name="jacket color" default="metallic gold"} hooded jacket over a black inner shirt, all constructed from folded triangular paper panels with crisp creases, shadows, and realistic handmade texture. The background is an ornate Japanese-inspired origami collage with black and charcoal mountains, cream paper planes, gold foil accents, and exactly 3 large fan or sunburst shapes: one gold semicircle at upper left, one cream folded fan at left center, and one cream folded fan at right center. Include exactly 12 visible origami flowers: 2 large white flowers with gold stamens at the upper left and upper right, 1 small pale pink flower on the left edge, 2 pink flowers near the lower-left edge, 5 pink cherry blossoms on the lower-right branch, and 2 white cherry blossoms on the lower-right branch. Use a premium editorial fashion-poster composition, shallow paper-relief depth, warm studio lighting, high contrast between matte black paper and metallic gold paper, intricate crease lines, handcrafted shadows, and no readable text or watermark. Keep the face censor square clean and flat while the rest of the image remains highly detailed.

title: KBO Baseball Broadcast Snapshot
prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the strongest identity anchor. The woman must look like the exact same adult woman from the reference image, not just a similar Korean woman. Preserve her exact facial identity with high priority: same small oval face, same delicate jawline, same large clear eyes, same eye spacing, same eyelid shape, same straight nose, same soft muted pink lips, same pale clear skin tone, same refined calm expression, and same long black softly wavy hair. Create an ultra-realistic candid KBO baseball broadcast screenshot of the same woman accidentally caught by a live TV camera in the spectator seats. The team name is LG and F1. Her face should remain closer to the reference image than to a generic stadium fan. Do not change her into another person. Do not make her face wider, older, sharper, more westernized, or more idol-like. Keep the same delicate studio-portrait identity, but translated naturally into a real stadium environment. She is seated among a lively Korean baseball crowd, holding an iced drink and a cheering stick, wearing a clean white baseball jersey over a simple casual top. She is adjusting her hair with one hand .. She notices the camera and gives a small natural smile, slightly surprised but composed. Use a realistic far-distance broadcast camera look: telephoto compression, mild video softness, slight motion blur in the crowd, stadium lighting, natural skin texture, imperfect candid framing, 16:9 horizontal TV broadcast composition.
