title: Q rabbit OpenPose icon
prompt: A simple centered full-body illustration of a cute chibi {argument name="animal type" default="rabbit"} character on a plain {argument name="background color" default="light gray"} background, drawn in a flat cartoon style with thick clean black outlines and minimal shading. The character has a white body, a large rounded head, 2 tall upright ears with bright cyan inner ear shapes, 2 large oval eyes with cyan irises, black pupils, and small highlights, tiny curved eyebrows, a small red-pink nose area, and a slight smiling mouth. The pose is front-facing with both arms stretched straight out horizontally to the sides, legs apart in a simple standing pose, and a short fluffy tail visible on the right side of the body as a curved semicircle made of short black dash marks. Overlay a clear OpenPose-style skeleton marker system on top of the character: 2 purple eye keypoints, 1 red nose keypoint, 1 blue neck keypoint, 2 shoulder keypoints, 2 elbow keypoints, 2 wrist keypoints, 1 yellow spine or pelvis center point, 2 hip keypoints, 2 knee keypoints, and 2 ankle keypoints, for a total of 17 colored points connected by thin colored lines across the face, shoulders, torso, arms, and legs. Use vivid point colors including purple, magenta, red, blue, cyan, green, yellow, orange, and teal so the pose overlay is clearly visible. Keep the composition vertically centered, symmetrical, clean, and diagram-like, with the cute mascot character and pose-estimation overlay as the sole subject.

title: Retro Alpine Train Lounge
prompt: Create a photorealistic ultra-wide 3:1 panoramic interior scene inside a vintage alpine train dining car or observation lounge, with warm polished wood paneling, rounded wooden ceiling trim, large rectangular windows wrapping around both sides and the front, and soft sheer white curtains on the right. The seating consists of two long facing green leather bench sofas forming a cozy booth, with simple wooden armrests and bases. In the center is a small round pedestal table covered by a white lace tablecloth, holding a tiny glowing table lamp and a small book or object. Outside every window is a bright winter mountain landscape: snow-covered pine trees in the foreground, misty snowy peaks in the distance, and a large central mountain framed by the front window under pale blue daylight. Use realistic natural light, crisp snow reflections, subtle interior shadows, nostalgic luxury railcar design, symmetrical centered composition, calm Sunday getaway mood, no people, no text. Emphasize high detail, cinematic realism, clean glass, warm brown wood against cool white snow, and a peaceful panoramic travel atmosphere. Customize the scene as a {argument name="vehicle type" default="vintage alpine train observation lounge"}, with {argument name="seat color" default="deep green leather"}, {argument name="outside landscape" default="snowy alpine mountains and pine forest"}, {argument name="time of day" default="bright winter morning"}, and {argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:1 ultra-wide panorama"}.

title: Emotional Occlusion Fashion Portrait
prompt: Create a cinematic vertical fashion portrait of a confident adult woman standing indoors against a dark minimalist wall, shown from mid-thigh upward. She has long straight {argument name="hair color" default="deep burgundy red"} hair falling over her shoulders, wears a fitted {argument name="outfit" default="black ribbed turtleneck sweater and high-waisted black pencil skirt"}, and poses with both arms crossed in a poised, slightly aloof stance. Her face is intentionally covered by a centered opaque square censor block in a soft skin-tone brown gradient, hiding all facial features while leaving the hair, ear, neck, and outfit visible. Use moody low-key studio lighting with soft highlights on the hair and clothing, a dark brown-black background, subtle shadow falloff, and a small modern black table lamp glowing at the lower right edge of the frame. Composition should feel elegant, intelligent, restrained, and intimidating, with realistic fabric texture, natural body proportions, shallow depth of field, high-end editorial photography style, vertical 9:16 framing, no text, no watermark, no extra people.

The lighting is typical indoor fluorescent, giving the image a documentary, everyday feel.

title: Edible History Chocolate Stereoscopic Book
prompt: Create a square 1:1 macro photography image of an open antique history book on a clean white background, styled like an edible history pop-up book. The book is thick, vintage, leather-bound, and lying open flat at 180 degrees. Its pages are aged parchment with yellowed paper, worn edges, and visible paper texture. title: Shadow Ensemble Movie Poster Template
prompt: 请根据【主题：{argument name="角色名" default="写人物名字"}】创作一张高完成度、高叙事张力、适合系列化发布的「暗潮群像封面 / Shadow Ensemble Cover」。这不是普通角色插画，也不是简单的战斗海报，而是一张具有小说封面感、漫画主视觉感、游戏宣传感和暗黑奇幻插画感的“群像式动作封面”。画面需要通过一个巨大的精神核心人物、多个中景动作角色、背景威胁元素、局部能量光效和留白标题区，共同构成一个完整的角色阵营与世界观封面。【基础设定】主题：{argument name="场景主题" default="咒术战斗 / 暗黑西游 / 赛博猎人 / 山海经猎妖队 / 末日幸存者 / 魔法学院战斗团"}作品名：[作品名]系列名 / 品牌名：[品牌名或系列名]副标题：[副标题]风格方向：{argument name="风格" default="暗黑奇幻、复古漫画封面、手绘厚涂、奇幻小说封面、游戏主视觉"}主色调：墨绿黑灰 / 深蓝霓虹 / 暗棕金红 / 沙黄铁锈 / 深紫金色点缀色：血红能量、青绿色法术光、金色神光、蓝色雷电画幅比例：2:3竖版 / 3:4竖版 / 4:5竖版 / 9:16竖版【画面结构】采用竖版封面构图。画面中必须有一个体量巨大的主视觉人物，作为整张图的精神核心和气质压场元素。这个人物可以是侧脸、半身像、背影、正面凝视或巨大轮廓，占据画面右侧、上方或背景主区域，表情冷静、神秘、有压迫感，不一定参与战斗，但必须统领整张图的气质。在中景安排3到6个动作角色，形成一个战斗阵营群像。角色之间需要有明确分工和姿态差异，例如冲锋、持刀、施法、防御、召唤、跳跃、警戒、远程攻击等。避免所有人物站桩，必须形成强烈的动作节奏和视觉动线。背景中加入敌方威胁或世界观元素，例如怪物、巨兽、反派阴影、机械军团、妖魔、废墟、森林、异空间、战场烟雾或城市灾难。背景威胁不应喧宾夺主，而应像阴影一样包裹角色，增强危机感和叙事深度。画面需要设置1到2个高饱和能量爆点，例如红色火焰拳、蓝色雷电、绿色诅咒气息、紫色魔法、金色神光或白色刀光。能量光效应集中在关键角色或关键武器上，形成视觉焦点，不要全画面平均发光。【构图方式】整体采用“大型精神核心人物 + 中景动作群像 + 背景威胁阴影 + 底部或侧边留白标题区”的结构。画面可以使用斜向动线组织角色，让角色群像从左上到右下、或从下方冲向中央，形成强烈推进感。保留一块明显的留白标题区，建议位于左下、底部或画面侧边。留白区域使用米白、灰白、浅纸色或低饱和背景色，用于放置【品牌名 / 作品名 / 副标题】。标题排版应具有出版物封面感，可以使用优雅衬线字体、复古标题字、漫画封面标题或高级杂志式排版。文字区要清晰，不要被角色和背景完全遮挡。插画边缘不要做成完整矩形铺满，可以使用不规则笔刷边缘、墨迹扩散、撕纸式留白或自然消散的方式，让角色和背景像从纸面中生长出来，增强手绘封面感和艺术质感。【视觉风格】整体风格应为手绘厚涂与漫画封面结合，具有纸张质感、笔触感、暗部层次和复古出版物气质。光影以低调暗光为主，背景压暗，人物轮廓清晰，局部能量光提供高对比焦点。画面不要过度干净，不要像普通AI光滑插画，应保留手绘纹理、纸张颗粒、边缘笔触和暗色雾气。色彩上采用低饱和暗调为主，辅以少量高饱和能量色。整体氛围应具有压迫感、神秘感、战斗感和世界观厚度。【画面目标】最终画面应像一张成熟的奇幻小说封面、漫画特别篇封面、游戏角色阵营主视觉或IP宣传海报。它需要同时具备：1. 清晰的主视觉人物；2. 有动作节奏的角色群像；3. 明确的敌方威胁或世界观背景；4. 强烈但克制的能量光效；5. 可阅读的标题文字区；6. 复古手绘封面的整体质感。请确保画面信息丰富但不混乱，角色层级清晰，视觉重心明确，阅读路径自然，适合后续替换主题继续生成同系列作品。

prompt: 创作一张风格简洁、对称的中文风水信息图海报，采用传统历法风格，背景为暖浅米色。顶部主标题为醒目的深红色中文书法字体，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="2026 年九宫飞星图"}，下方配有较小的黑色副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="（丙午年）"}。在左上角添加一个装饰性的罗盘，标有四个中文方位：上南、下北、左东、右西。构图中心为一个 3x3 的九宫格，包含 9 个带细致中式边角的方形面板，间距均匀且对齐完美。每个方格内包含一个大号彩色数字、一个中文星名、一行以"吉星"或"凶星"开头的文字，以及一个象征性的插图。顶行 3 个面板：左上角标注"东南"，紫色边框面板内为数字 9 和文字"九紫右弼星"，以及"吉星：喜庆、姻缘、贵人"，配以紫色气球、礼盒和小型烟花爆竹插图；顶部中央标注"正南"，橙色边框面板内为数字 5 和文字"五黄廉贞星"，以及"凶星：灾祸、意外、疾病"，配以金葫芦和系有红绳的古钱币插图；右上角标注"西南"，金色边框面板内为数字 7 和文字"七赤破军星"，以及"凶星：破财、口舌、盗贼"，配以铜铃和银剑插图。中行 3 个面板：左侧对齐"正东"大号垂直侧边文字，绿色边框面板内为数字 8 和文字"八白左辅星"，以及"吉星：财运、置业、积蓄"，配以盆景式摇钱树和金元宝插图；中间中央上方覆盖一个蓝色胶囊标签，标注"中宫"，蓝色边框面板内为数字 1 和文字"一白贪狼星"，以及"吉星：人缘、感情、智慧"，配以木架水晶球插图；右侧对齐"正西"大号垂直侧边文字，绿色边框面板内为数字 3 和文字"三碧禄存星"，以及"凶星：是非、口舌、争执"，配以竹子和小型叠石喷泉插图。底行 3 个面板：左下角标注"东北"，绿色边框面板内为数字 4 和文字"四绿文曲星"，以及"吉星：学业、文昌、考试"，配以打开的书本、毛笔和砚台，背景衬有竹叶；底部中央标注"正北"，金色边框面板内为数字 6 和文字"六白武曲星"，以及"吉星：权力、贵人、偏财"，配以底座上持球的金色石狮子雕像插图；右下角标注"西北"，灰色边框面板内为数字 2 和文字"二黑巨门星"，以及"凶星：病痛、伤害、阻滞"，配以石塔和小香炉插图。在网格周围使用 6 个外部方位标签：顶行上方为"东南"、"正南"、"西南"，底行下方为"东北"、"正北"、"西北"，每个标签均位于与面板颜色匹配的圆角胶囊内。在网格两侧添加 2 个大号垂直侧边方位标签：左侧为"正东"，右侧为"正西"。在底部中心添加一个药丸形状的图例，分为两段：红色段显示"吉星：1、4、6、8、9"，深灰色段显示"凶星：2、3、5、7"。在部分物体后方加入淡淡的云纹，营造传统氛围。整体风格为清晰的矢量信息图，物体渲染带有柔和的水彩质感，具备高可读性、平衡的间距以及优雅的中国玄学图表美感。

title: Cinematic character posters with layered depth
titleEn: Cinematic character posters with layered depth
prompt:
Design a high-end cinematic character poster in a layered depth composition (9:16 vertical) with a strong foreground–midground–background separation instead of silhouette framing.
The {argument name="character" default="character"} stands slightly off-center in a dynamic, perspective-driven pose, interacting naturally with the {argument name="environment" default="environment (wind, light, particles, fabric movement)"}. The camera angle should feel intentional—low-angle for power or slight tilt for tension—creating a sense of motion and presence.
The background should not be contained inside shapes. Instead, build a living world around the character:
atmospheric environments (fog, city lights, ruins, nature, etc.)
light rays, volumetric glow, drifting particles
subtle storytelling elements placed naturally in space (not collage-based)
Introduce floating fragments or layered planes (glass shards, light panels, memories, holographic slices, or torn paper edges) that orbit or intersect the scene, each containing faint symbolic visuals tied to the character’s story—keep them minimal and elegant, not cluttered.
Lighting should be cinematic and directional:
strong key light shaping the subject
rim lighting to separate from background
soft gradients and shadow falloff for depth
Color palette should follow a {argument name="color palette" default="controlled dual-tone system (e.g., teal–orange, violet–gold, crimson–black)"} with smooth transitions and no oversaturation.
Typography:
place the title in a clean, modern cinematic layout
integrate text subtly into the environment (ground plane, light projection, or floating UI style)
avoid heavy or oversized typography
Overall style: ultra-realistic + cinematic editorial, sharp detail on subject, soft atmospheric depth in background, minimal but intentional storytelling elements, premium movie-poster quality.
Avoid: silhouette fill compositions, heavy collage density, watercolor textures, or ink-wash edges. Focus on spatial depth, realism, and cinematic immersion.

title: Anime-style folding bike activity poster
prompt:
A bright, cheerful anime-style promotional poster for a folding bike cycling event, designed like a polished Japanese advertisement with dense typography, stickers, callouts, and event info panels. The scene shows a sunny riverside promenade under a vivid blue sky with fluffy clouds, green tree branches framing the top right, flower beds, bunting, drifting petals, and a distant modern city skyline across the water. In the foreground, a cute teen/young adult anime girl with {argument name="hair color" default="light chestnut brown"} shoulder-length wavy hair, side-swept bangs, and two colorful hairpins smiles directly at the viewer and winks with one eye. She is posed in dynamic perspective, reaching one hand toward the camera as if inviting the viewer to join her. She wears a yellow hooded windbreaker, a white T-shirt printed with colorful bicycle lettering, dark blue shorts, black thigh-high stockings, and a light blue backpack. Beside her is a mint-green compact folding bicycle labeled "FOLDY," shown unfolded and parked on the promenade with visible small wheels, frame hinge, handlebars, saddle, pedals, and kickstand, emphasizing portability and urban leisure cycling. Use a glossy, high-saturation anime poster aesthetic with clean linework, soft facial rendering, energetic lighting, and playful graphic decoration.

Fill the poster with Japanese ad-style layout elements. At the top left, a huge multicolored headline reads "Let’s FOLDING RIDE!" in oversized playful bubble and block lettering, with a smaller curved Japanese line above it reading "さあ、いっしょに出かけよう！" and a blue ribbon-like subtitle below reading "フォールディングバイクで、もっと自由に、もっと遠くへ！". At the upper right, place a yellow burst badge with a tiny flag icon containing the text "フォールディングバイク サイクリングイベント 開催！". Add a white speech bubble near the girl’s face with pink outline and handwritten-feel Japanese text: "ねえ、キミ！ 折りたたみは どこへでも行けるよ♪ 一緒に 行こっ！". Near the bicycle, include a small angled sticker with text "コンパクトにたためて 持ち運びラクラク♪". Near the lower center-left, add a section label "イベントの楽しみポイント♪" followed by exactly 4 round icon features in pastel circles: 1) a pink bicycle icon with text "折りたたみで 持ち運び自由！" 2) a blue camera icon with text "フォトスポットで 思い出を残そう！" 3) a yellow drink icon with text "カフェタイムで ほっとひと息♪" 4) a purple gift icon with text "オリジナルグッズ プレゼント！".

On the lower right, add a rounded white information card with green accents titled "FOLDING BIKE サイクリングイベント" and large pink date text "6.15(日)". Inside the card, present exactly 4 event detail rows with colored circular icons: 1) calendar row: "開催日 2025. ※雨天時は6.22(日)に順延" 2) location row: "集合所 みなとみらい 臨港パーク" with smaller note "(神奈川県横浜市)" 3) course row: "コース みなとみらい〜湾沿いの気持ちいいルートを走ります" with smaller note "(約20km、初心者安心！)" 4) fee row: "参加費 3,000円" with smaller note "(保険・記念品付き) ※レンタルバイクあり（要予約）". At the bottom of this card, add a pink strip reading "初心者歓迎！ひとり参加も大歓迎！". Along the very bottom of the poster, create a wide pink banner with large Japanese copy "さあ、次の休日は一緒に走ろう！" and smaller text on the left "お申し込み・詳細は公式サイトへ！". In the center-bottom place a search-bar style box containing {argument name="search text" default="フォールディングライド 2025"}. To its right, add a black-and-white QR code and a pink label reading "エントリーはこちらから！". In the bottom-right corner, include a small inset photo-style illustration of two cyclists riding together with a handwritten note "たのしいかも♡". Maintain a lively, magazine-quality event poster composition with exactly 1 main character, 1 folding bike, 1 large event info card, 1 speech bubble, 1 yellow burst badge, 1 angled portability sticker, 4 feature icons, 1 QR code, and 1 inset image.

카메라를 약간 아래로 내려다보는 로우 앵글 시선으로, 입술을 살짝 벌린 채 신비롭고 몽환적인 표정을 짓고 있습니다. 인물의 눈은 70% 정도만 뜨고 있습니다. 오른손을 어깨 높이까지 들어 올려 작은 들국화 한송이를 섬세하게 쥐고 있으며, 상체를 살짝 틀어 허리 라인이 드러나는 우아하고 역동적인 포즈를 취하고 있습니다.

[의상]
인물은 배꼽이 보이는 [{argument name="상의" default="파스텔 핑크색의 오프숄더"}]상의를 입고 있으며, [파스텔 블루색]의 치마를 입고 있습니다. 

[인물 헤어스타일 및 메이크업 디테일]
자연스럽게 묶어 올린 검은색 머리카락 사이로 몇 가닥의 앞머리가 바람과 물기에 흩날리며 얼굴을 살짝 가리고 있습니다. 메이크업은 투명하고 깨끗한 피부 표현을 중심으로 눈매를 자연스럽게 살렸으며, 촉촉하고 붉은 입술로 생기를 더했습니다.

[배경 요소 (옵션)]
오래된 고딕 양식 성당 내부를 연상시키는 어두운 회색 석조 건물의 벽면이 배경입니다. 인물의 하단 뒤쪽으로는 빛이 들어오는 아치형 창문들이 흐릿하게 보이며, 공중에 가득 채워져 있습니다.

title: Japanese Eco-Community Poster Design | High-End Japanese Eco-Brand Vision

prompt: 一张精美的日本社区与可持续发展项目宣传海报，项目名称为 セカイムラ，设计风格如同高端生态生活方式宣传单。垂直布局，简洁优雅，采用柔和的米色纸张背景，营造出明亮且充满愿景的氛围。上半部分以构图中心的一个巨大半透明地球仪为主体，右上方散发出温暖的日出光芒。地球仪内部呈现出一幅令人惊叹的绿色山谷航拍景观，山谷通向宁静的蓝色海湾或湖泊，下方点缀着村庄和农田，极具电影感和乌托邦色彩。在地球仪上方，放置一行较小的日文标语 世界は1つの村になる。，下方是加粗的深海军蓝日文书法字体主标题：セカイムラ。围绕地球仪，拼贴 8 张自然融入边缘的生活照：1) 左上，两人在树下户外交谈；2) 左中上，几人在稻田里共同劳作；3) 左中，夜晚在质朴木结构建筑内围坐；4) 左下，自然环境中的两人肖像；5) 右上，一群人在温暖的室内灯光下长桌聚餐；6) 右中，一人在照料植物或农作物；7) 右中下，夕阳下人们在山脊上牵手排成一列；8) 右下，一人正在进食或手持食物的特写肖像。摄影风格应体现人文感、社区感，略带理想化，具有柔和的景深、自然的肤色、黄金时刻的高光以及平滑的广告海报合成效果。下半部分在浅米色背景上包含 3 张间距均匀的功能卡片，由细微的垂直分隔线隔开。左侧卡片 1 标题为深蓝色的"セカイムラ 新月会"，配有夜间篝火圆圈照片及一段简短的日文描述文本。中间卡片 2 标题为暖金色的"セカイムラ 満月会"，配有灯串下室内晚间聚会的圆形照片，圆圈周围有装饰性的放射状太阳光线，下方附带简短的日文描述文本。右侧卡片 3 标题为绿色的"セカイムラ 米部が今の一押し"，标题旁有小型稻苗插画，配有一碗白米饭的圆形照片及一段简短的日文描述文本。在这些卡片下方，添加一行居中的深蓝色日文声明：人・自然・文化がつながり、循環する未来を一緒につくる。在此下方，横向排列 4 个小型图标及文字项，每个图标配有简单的细线条图标和两行日文标签：1) 人物图标配"つながる 仲間と出会える"；2) 房屋图标配"まなぶ 暮らしを学べる"；3) 新芽图标配"つくる 未来を共につくる"；4) 地球图标配"ひろがる 世界にひろげる"。最底部中心处包含一个圆形徽标，后接日文项目名称，下方为网站 URL：www.sekaimura.com。右下角添加一个小型二维码，并附带微小的日文说明，提示详情请见网站。采用深海军蓝、森林绿、金色、米色和天蓝色的精致配色方案。整体风格：高端日本非营利组织海报、生态社区品牌设计、鼓舞人心、和谐、带有微妙图形设计元素的写实拼贴、平衡的排版、柔和的光晕以及杂志级的印刷质感。

title: Super chaotic Japanese vintage digital camera snapshot

prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the exact identity base for the main subject. Preserve their authentic facial structure, recognizable appearance, hairstyle, body proportions, skin texture, and overall identity with high consistency. Completely ignore any unrelated background from the original image.

Create a hyper-chaotic early-2000s Japanese digicam snapshot aesthetic with raw paparazzi energy and accidental comedy.

Scene: the subject is sprinting wildly through a busy city street while yelling and laughing in pure chaos, desperately trying to catch a {argument name="animal" default="mischievous cat"} that just stole a {argument name="stolen item" default="large shiny fish"} from a market stall. The cat is gripping the slippery silver fish tightly in its mouth while running directly toward the camera.

Composition must prioritize TWO focal subjects:

1. PRIMARY FOCUS → the cat’s face
2. SECONDARY FOCUS → the human subject’s face

The cat dominates the foreground frame with its face pushed absurdly close into the lens, partially cropped near the lower-right side. Massive fisheye distortion stretches its features dramatically — huge bulging eyes, exaggerated whiskers, detailed fur texture, fish flapping violently with droplets and motion streaks flying outward.

Behind the cat, the subject is charging forward aggressively with intense energy, reaching toward the animal mid-run. Their expression is loud, chaotic, and comedic, eyes locked directly onto the cat to create strong interaction and pursuit tension.

Styling:
Randomized layered {argument name="fashion style" default="Y2K Tokyo streetwear"} inspired by chaotic Shibuya nightlife fashion — oversized zip hoodies, vintage mesh layers, mini bags, low-rise pieces, striped arm warmers, chunky accessories, early-2000s sneaker styling, messy fashionable youth aesthetic.

Camera & framing:
extreme low-angle fisheye lens, ultra-wide invasive perspective, severe Dutch angle, asymmetrical framing, warped spatial distortion, exaggerated depth compression, aggressive foreshortening.

Motion treatment:
insanely intense movement blur with radial streaking, shutter drag, CCD sensor smearing, directional speed trails, accidental camera shake, stretched highlights, warped moving objects, imperfect chaotic snapshot timing.

Environment:
sunny crowded urban street with pigeons exploding into flight across the frame, scattered newspapers and debris flying through the air, warped pedestrians, market elements smeared by motion, overexposed sunlight leaking into one corner of the frame.

Lighting & texture:
harsh direct flash combined with bright outdoor sunlight, dirty CCD digicam texture, blown highlights, chromatic aberration, digital noise, bloom artifacts, compressed early-2000s camera look, gritty nostalgic cyber-chaos atmosphere.

Ultra-raw candid energy, messy composition, humorous accidental masterpiece aesthetic.

slug: 人气迥异的双胞胎教师-1_45a4e0
title: Popular Twin Teachers
prompt:
参照画像の{argument name="人物" default="双子"}の人物を維持、リアルな実写風、{argument name="場所" default="日本の明るい保育園"}の室内。カラフルな遊具、おもちゃ、本棚、子供用の机や椅子が並ぶ温かい雰囲気の保育室。昼間の柔らかな自然光が差し込んでいる。

双子の二人は{argument name="職業" default="保育士"}として働いている。同じデザインの優しい雰囲気の保育士エプロンを着用している。
しかし二人の人気には極端な差がある。

片方の保育士は園児たちから圧倒的な人気を集めている。大勢の子供たちが周囲に集まり、手をつないだり、抱きついたりしている。人気保育士は満面の笑顔で子供たちと接し、優しく話しかけている。周囲には楽しそうな笑顔が溢れ、保育室の中心的存在になっている。

一方、もう片方の双子の保育士の周囲には子供が誰一人いない。近くには空いたスペースだけが広がっている。本人は少し離れた場所に立ちながら、人気者の双子と子供たちの輪を切なそうに見つめている。寂しそうな表情、少し困ったような笑顔、どこか居場所のなさを感じる雰囲気。

カメラは保育室全体を見渡せる位置から撮影。左側には子供たちに囲まれた人気保育士、右側にはぽつんと立つ不人気保育士が映る。二人とも同じ顔なのに待遇だけが極端に違うというコミカルな状況。子供たちの自然な表情、保育園らしい温かい空気感、ドキュメンタリー風テレビ特集のようなリアリティ。自然光、リアルな肌質、フォトリアル、超高精細、リアルなテレビ番組・ドキュメンタリー品質。企業ロゴや実在グループ名は一切入れない。

画面上部には『人気保育士に密着』、下部には『子供たちに好かれる秘訣は？』というテレビ番組風テロップ。

title: Kids Mark Stroke Style

title: Anime Live2D 3-sided chat screenshot
prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical smartphone screenshot of an AI chat interface showing a generated anime character model sheet for Live2D use.

Canvas: 691 × 1024 vertical mobile screenshot, white background, soft iOS-like UI with lots of empty space and rounded translucent controls.

Top status bar: Show the time “2:50” at top left, a muted bell icon beside it, and exactly 3 status indicators at top right: cellular bars, Wi‑Fi, and a black battery pill reading “95”.

Header UI: Under the status bar, place exactly 4 floating rounded controls: a circular hamburger menu button on the left, a white pill labeled “Thinking” in blue, a white pill on the right containing an outlined edit/pencil icon, and a white pill with a three-dot menu.

Chat content: On the upper right, show a small full-body anime girl sticker sitting/kneeling, facing forward, with long blonde twin tails fading to lavender tips, aqua eyes, pale skin, lavender hair bows, a white frilly sleeveless blouse, and a mint-aqua skirt. Beneath it, place one large rounded light-gray user message bubble containing Japanese text: {argument name="user message" default="画像をLive2Dに使う用に三面図にして"}.

Generated image card: Below the message bubble, display one large embedded character reference sheet image on a white background. It contains exactly 3 full-body views of the same character, evenly spaced left to right: 1) front view labeled {argument name="front label" default="正面図"}, 2) right-facing side view labeled {argument name="side label" default="側面図（右向き）"}, and 3) back view labeled {argument name="back label" default="背面図"}. Add faint horizontal guide lines and small Japanese height markers along the left side, like a model turnaround sheet. The character is a cute anime girl named {argument name="character name" default="unnamed blonde twin-tail girl"}: long blonde twin tails with lavender gradient ends, pastel purple ribbon bows, turquoise eyes, soft blush, white ruffled sleeveless top with vertical buttons, mint turquoise high-waisted skirt with frilled hem and asymmetrical trailing fabric, slim legs, white ankle-strap sandals with small turquoise accents. Keep proportions consistent across all 3 views and make the art delicate, clean, and pastel.

Overlay controls on the generated card: Add exactly 2 floating buttons over the bottom of the image card: a rounded white button at lower left reading “編集する” and a circular white share button at lower right with an upward arrow icon.

Bottom reaction bar: At the bottom edge, show exactly 3 small icons: thumbs up, thumbs down, and an ellipsis.

Visual style: Crisp mobile screenshot, minimal white interface, soft shadows, Japanese chat app aesthetic, pastel anime illustration, clean line art, no watermark, no extra panels, no additional characters.

prompt: Create an ultra-realistic cinematic dreamy lifestyle photograph of {argument name="subject" default="a young woman"} sitting alone on the white roof of a vintage {argument name="van color" default="turquoise"} van in a vast pastel wildflower field. Use a closer low-angle portrait framing that focuses on her upper body, dangling legs, and the rooftop/side window section of the van, with the van filling the lower half of the image and a wide soft blue sky filling the upper background. She sits casually on the roof edge with both legs hanging straight down, wearing {argument name="outfit" default="a pale blue sleeveless summer dress and white sneakers"}, holding a small bouquet of mixed wildflowers in both hands on her lap, looking slightly upward with a soft natural smile and relaxed youthful mood. Her long dark hair is gently blown by the wind and the dress fabric flows softly. Tie a cluster of exactly 6 pastel balloons beside her on the left, in pale blue and white, floating from white strings attached near the van roof. Add handwritten white diary-style sketch text in the sky: exactly 4 phrases reading {argument name="main sky phrase" default="my happy place"} arched above her head, plus “bloom” on the left, “sunny day” on the right, and one small curved motion mark near the bouquet. Integrate exactly 16 white doodles around the sky and field: 4 five-point stars, 4 simple flowers, 2 smiley faces, 1 large smile curve near the lower left, 1 sparkle diamond at the bottom right, 1 small butterfly-like mark, and 3 short decorative curved strokes. Keep the doodles hand-drawn, thin, chalky white, naturally composited as if floating in the air. Lighting is bright natural daylight with soft overexposed highlights, dreamy glow, bloom effect, pastel film tones, low contrast, smooth highlight roll-off, airy clean negative space, and a color palette of turquoise, sky blue, soft white, pastel pink, pastel yellow, and warm cream. prompt: 一张电影质感的奇幻动漫海报，采用竖构图。画面展示了两位孩童模样的冒险者，站在一座宏伟的魔法图书馆大教堂中，背景是高耸入云的哥特式拱门和两侧参天的书架，空中飘浮着书页，闪烁着微光尘埃。中央有一座宏伟的楼梯，通向一扇如传送门般、布满复杂天体魔法阵图案的窗户。视角低沉而富有戏剧性，略微仰视，两位角色均向观众伸出一只手，做出邀请的姿态。左侧角色稍高，留着银白色短发，刘海柔顺，佩戴大型叶片状耳饰或动物耳，身穿海军蓝连帽外套，内搭暖橙色上衣，深色长裤，结实的靴子，背着黑色斜挎包；脸部通过构图或角度进行部分遮挡。右侧角色稍矮，设计风格相呼应，留着银白色波波头，发梢带有绿色调，拥有一双青绿色大眼睛，同样佩戴叶片状耳饰，身穿海军蓝连帽外套，内搭橙色衣物，深色短裤，靴子，背着装饰有星星等小挂件的淡紫色单肩包。在他们伸出的双手之间，创造出一团明亮的魔法光芒，两种能量在此交汇：青蓝色光流环绕左侧角色，暖粉金色光流环绕右侧角色，伴随着火花粒子和丝带状轨迹。光影氛围左侧为冷蓝色，右侧为暖金洋红色，在中心交融成耀眼的白光。添加丰富的氛围细节：发光的微尘、魔法丝线、飘浮的纸张、层次分明的建筑，营造出奇迹与探索感。海报顶部居中处加入优雅的白色衬线体日文标语：“わかることと、感じること。2つの力で世界をひらく。”（理解与感受，以双重力量开启世界。）海报底部放置巨大的发光金色衬线体标题 “{argument name="title text" default="Epix&Ria"}”，并采用华丽的电影海报排版。高细节、精致的主视觉图，奇幻冒险电影海报，质感丰富，光芒四射，情感充沛，令人惊叹，顶级插画宣传艺术。

title: Image generation case diagram
prompt:
[CORE TASK]
Transform the provided input image into a pose-and-light analysis sheet.

This is NOT a finished character illustration.
This is NOT a clothing sheet.
This is NOT a beauty-preserving redraw.

This is a white-line rough mannequin conversion.

[PRIMARY GOAL]
Extract and visualize only:
- pose structure
- body balance
- camera angle
- body line flow
- inferred light source placement
- illuminated areas and light intensity

[INPUT ROLE]
Use the provided image as the strict anchor for:
- pose
- camera angle
- body tilt
- weight distribution
- approximate lighting situation

Do NOT preserve:
- face rendering
- hairstyle rendering
- clothing detail
- accessories
- weapon detail
- background architecture
- character identity
- emotional expression

[FIGURE CONVERSION]
single rough mannequin-like human figure
white body contour lines
white internal construction lines
simple mannequin head
no face
no eyes
no mouth
no eyelashes
no personality
no individual identity

human figure should look like:
- rough pose mannequin
- anatomy proxy
- line-based body guide
- structural sketch
- white-line rough dummy

keep:
- pose readability
- silhouette flow
- head tilt
- torso direction
- pelvis direction
- limb placement

[BACKGROUND]
pure black background
negative-style dark field
no scenery
no props
no architecture
no environmental storytelling

[LINE STYLE]
rough white line drawing
clean but sketch-like
construction-line feeling
anatomy guide lines visible
joint flow visible
body contour emphasized
no polished illustration finish

[LIGHT ESTIMATION]
predict the likely light source positions from the input image
visualize the light sources and illuminated areas using green glow only

use green light intensity with variation:
- strongest green where the light directly hits
- medium green for wrap light
- soft green for reflected or fading light

mark the estimated light sources with labels and arrows such as:
- Main Light
- Rim Light
- Fill Light
- Floor Bounce
- Back Light
only if appropriate

IMPORTANT:
do not invent random lights
infer lighting from the original input image
if the lighting is ambiguous, keep the annotations simple and plausible

[GREEN LIGHT VISUALIZATION]
show green glow on:
- head / skull plane
- neck
- shoulders
- chest plane
- ribcage direction
- pelvis edge
- thigh planes
- knee contact points
- floor contact bounce if applicable

use green light not as decoration,
but as lighting analysis information

[POSE PRIORITY]
1. preserve pose structure
2. preserve camera angle
3. preserve body balance
4. preserve head-torso relationship
5. visualize likely light direction
6. show illuminated areas with readable green intensity variation

[NEGATIVE]
finished person,
cute girl,
detailed face,
hair rendering,
clothing rendering,
weapon emphasis,
beautiful anatomy

title: VEYA role blueprint
prompt:
Goal: Create a polished anime-style character design sheet for {argument name="character name" default="VEYA"}, a futuristic streetwear heroine with organic ivory armor growths.

Canvas: Wide horizontal concept art board, 16:9 aspect ratio, warm off-white background, clean margins, premium game/animation production sheet presentation. Put the name “VEYA” in thin uppercase letters at the top left with a short horizontal line beneath it.

Layout: Show exactly 4 full-body character views across the upper and left area: 1 large dynamic hero pose on the far left, 1 smaller front view, 1 smaller back view, and 1 smaller side view. On the upper right, include exactly 6 cropped head bust studies arranged in a 3-by-2 grid, all showing the same hairstyle from slightly varied angles/expressions. Along the bottom, include exactly 4 labeled detail panels under the label “DETAILS”: close-up of the organic armored hand, close-up of the vine-like leg armor, close-up of the cropped jacket and neck area, and close-up of cargo pants pocket construction. To the lower middle-right, include exactly 1 object under the label “PROP”: a seed-pod-shaped ivory sculptural artifact with layered leaf forms and a glowing round core. To its right, include the label “SILHOUETTE” with exactly 2 black character silhouettes, one front-facing and one back-facing. On the far lower right, include the label “PALETTE” with exactly 4 vertical color swatches: near-black, charcoal gray, warm beige ivory, and off-white.

Subject details: The character is a young adult woman with tan skin, athletic slim build, asymmetrical long {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair swept dramatically over one side, shaved/undercut on the opposite side, and a confident urban attitude. She wears a cropped black sleeveless top, a short oversized dark cropped jacket or vest with angular shoulders, high-waisted charcoal cargo jogger pants with seams and pockets, a slim belt, and chunky cream-and-black sneakers. Add distinctive organic ivory armor shaped like twisting leaves or branches on one arm and one lower leg, with layered petal-like plates, subtle gray shadows, and elegant botanical curves.

Visual style: High-end 2D concept art, clean ink lines, soft cel shading, subtle watercolor texture, muted charcoal and ivory palette, fashionable sci-fi fantasy streetwear, crisp production-design sheet, no photorealism. Faces should be simplified or softly obscured rather than highly detailed, while clothing, hair, armor, and props remain sharp and readable.

Constraints: Keep the composition uncluttered and balanced; preserve all visible labels in English: “VEYA”, “DETAILS”, “PROP”, “SILHOUETTE”, and “PALETTE”. Use exactly 4 full-body views, 6 head busts, 4 detail panels, 1 prop, 2 silhouettes, and 4 palette swatches. Do not add extra characters, weapons, logos, watermarks, or background scenery.

title: Hand-painted interactive graffiti
prompt:
Analyze the uploaded image and preserve the original subject, composition, and lighting. Do not alter the identity or structure of the main subject. Add playful, hand-drawn doodles that interact directly with the subject in the image. The doodles should mimic, follow, or exaggerate the shapes, gestures, or motion present—such as outlining poses, extending limbs, adding motion lines, or creating imaginative elements that “respond” to the subject.(2)

Ensure the doodles feel naturally integrated into the scene, as if they were drawn on top of the photo with intention. prompt: 一张处于浅色模式下的 AI 聊天应用界面垂直手机截图，展示了图像刚刚生成完成的瞬间。最上方是一个简洁的移动应用标题栏，左侧为汉堡菜单图标，中间是蓝色的标题"Thinking"及其右侧的箭头图标，右侧为撰写图标和三点菜单。下方是浅灰色用户消息气泡的底部，其中包含 4 行日语文本：“水彩や線画、油彩、カラー版画、 金箔アクセントなどを取り入れ てテクスチャも入れて立体的に、 芸術爆発させて”。在气泡下方，白色背景上显示灰色的系统状态行"Thought for a couple of seconds"，随后是深灰色的日语行"画像が作成されました"。在其下方，居中显示一张占据屏幕下半部分大部分区域的大型圆角生成艺术预览图。艺术作品本身是一幅超精细的宇宙视觉拼贴画，采用方形构图：一个微小的发光人形站在底部中心位置的消失点，向外辐射光芒；两个巨大的半透明人像侧脸从左右中景向内侧对视；旋转的星系、恒星、星云、行星、漂浮的几何框架、透明球体、金箔碎片、线条艺术、喷溅颜料和分层纹理充斥着整个画面。采用深靛蓝、群青、紫罗兰、洋红、白色和发光金色的戏剧性调色板，结合了水彩、油画、版画、墨线和金属箔装饰，呈现出爆发性的绘画能量。画面中包含树枝状形态、右侧抽象的建筑台阶、左侧类似莲花的图案、嵌入空间中的多个微型场景，以及向中心人物汇聚的密集发光粒子轨迹。整体截图应呈现出真实的 iPhone 应用拍摄质感，除艺术作品外，界面简洁极简，生成的图像作为视觉焦点。

title: Cinematic Men's Suit Portrait
prompt: A high-end 8K cinematic {argument name="color style" default="black-and-white"} portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="man"} in a {argument name="clothing" default="sharp, professional suit"}, looking away from the camera with a focused, stoic expression. He is standing in a three-quarter profile against a solid, deep black background. The man has styled, dark wavy hair and a clean-shaven face with refined, natural skin textures. He is wearing a dark, tailored blazer over a crisp white dress shirt with an open collar. His hands are positioned at chest level: his left hand is adjusted by his right hand, prominently displaying a large, detailed luxury silver chronograph watch with a black face. The lighting is dramatic and directional, creating high-contrast highlights on the side of his face, the fabric of his lapel, and the metallic shine of the watch and ring. Hyper-realistic details capture the individual hairs, the weave of the suit fabric, and a sharp, lifelike glint in his eyes.

prompt: Create a cinematic cyberpunk portrait of one edgy female hacker/assassin in a rainy neon city at night, shown from the chest up in a tight three-quarter side profile facing right. She has {argument name="hair color" default="black"} messy hair tied in a high bun with loose strands, cybernetic cables trailing from the bun and neck, small glowing green implants near the ear, and dark earrings. Her face is intentionally covered by one large opaque dark gray square censor block centered over the eyes, nose, and mouth. She wears one glossy black tactical leather jacket with layered straps, buckles, shoulder armor, fingerless gloves, dangling chains, and one bright green illuminated device on her upper arm. Her right hand is raised near her covered mouth holding one glossy {argument name="object being bitten" default="green bell pepper"}, as if biting it, making the ordinary object look stylish and cool. The background is a dark futuristic alley filled with green fog, rain haze, reflections, shallow depth of field, and exactly two prominent vertical neon light bars: one bright bar on the far left and one bright bar on the right behind her. Use a moody high-contrast black-and-emerald palette, dramatic rim lighting, wet surfaces, realistic fashion editorial photography, ultra-detailed textures, cyberpunk atmosphere, 1:1 square composition, no visible text, no watermark.

slug: 沙发上放松的女性素描-0_21f48c
title: Relaxing Female Sketch on the Sofa
titleEn: Relaxing Female Sketch on the Sofa
prompt: A soft, muted anime-style interior illustration of a young woman lounging sideways on a sofa in a relaxed, unposed way. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} long slightly messy hair with loose strands falling over her shoulders, and she is wearing an oversized off-shoulder knit sweater in charcoal gray that slips down to reveal one shoulder, plus loose light beige sweatpants and soft socks. Her pose is casual and limp, with her body curled across the couch, one elbow propped into a large cushion, her hand supporting her cheek, and her legs folded to the side. Her visible expression should feel tired, quiet, introspective, and emotionally drained but comfortable. The scene is framed as a medium full-body shot from the front at sofa height. The room is calm and minimal, with 1 sofa, 3 large cushions, 1 round wooden coffee table in the foreground, 1 ceramic mug on the table with a simple cat doodle and the handwritten text "ねこ", 1 smartphone lying flat on the table, 1 notebook or paperback book with small Japanese handwriting on the cover, 1 small paper note taped to the wall reading "なんとかなるよ", and 1 leafy plant branch entering from the upper right side. Use a desaturated warm gray and beige palette, delicate pencil-like linework, light watercolor wash shading, subtle texture like sketch paper, and a wistful slice-of-life mood. Keep the composition airy, intimate, and understated, like a quiet illustration from a lifestyle art book.

title: Gesture Ink Fashion Illustration
prompt:
ASPECT_RATIO: [{argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:4"}]

SOURCE_IMAGE: [{argument name="reference" default="uploaded photo"}]

ACCENT_COLOR: [{argument name="accent color" default="single vivid highlight color"}]

Use the uploaded photo as the base image and the only identity source. Keep the person exactly the same and clearly recognizable. Ignore the original framing and always recompose into a tight close-up or upper-body editorial crop, with the face dominating the frame. Transform the image into a gestural editorial ink fashion illustration. The style must be built from bold black brushwork, not delicate sketch lines.

Use:

very thick black brush strokes

broad dry-brush sweeps

large asymmetrical black ink masses

long loose calligraphic lines

broken contours

scratchy secondary linework

strong black-on-ivory contrast

smooth monochrome skin

The thick strokes must be clearly dominant. Do not render the portrait mainly with thin contour lines. Do not make it neat, polished, or softly illustrated. The image should feel painted with a loaded brush and finished with sharp expressive pen marks.

Keep the portrait stylish and high-fashion.

Use one hero accessory, preferably oversized translucent tinted sunglasses.

The accent color [ACCENT_COLOR] must live mainly inside that accessory, especially in the lenses, as a bold luminous tint. Only tiny supporting traces of the same color may appear elsewhere.

prompt:
请根据【主题：{argument name="主题" default="汉服"}】自动生成一张“博物馆图鉴式中文拆解信息图”。

title: Anime X Platform Battle Poster
prompt:
Create a dramatic anime-style social media battle poster inspired by X/Twitter, split vertically down the center into two opposing halves with a glowing lightning-like divide and a huge luminous VS at the bottom center. The composition is a tall smartphone-optimized promotional key visual with dense layered UI cards, speech bubbles, tweet screenshots, reaction counters, and explosive energy effects. At the top center, place a large X logo with the title text "BATTLE" and the Japanese subtitle "Xでレスバ中". The left side is a cool purple and black theme, the right side is a hot red and white theme, with sparks, streaks, embers, and motion lines flying across both sides.

Show 2 anime schoolgirl characters facing off. On the left, a calm, composed girl representing logical rebuttal: long dark black-to-purple gradient hair, straight bangs, pale skin, slim build, black sailor-style school uniform with purple neck ribbon, pleated skirt, black knee socks, loafers, holding a smartphone in one hand and touching her glasses or temple with the other. Her face is intentionally obscured by a rectangular blur mosaic over the central face area. Her stance is reserved and still. Surround her with purple glowing tweet cards and speech bubbles. Her display name and handle should appear repeatedly as "雲居モヤ @kumoi_moya". Include exactly 3 large quoted statement boxes on her side with these Japanese texts: "それ、前提が雑だよね。", "感情だけでは通らないよ。", and "論点、そこじゃない。". Also include exactly 5 smaller purple UI/comment elements on her side: 1) a small comment bubble reading "それな 千代先輩、強すぎ…", 2) a small comment bubble reading "論理的で草 完全に正論パンチ", 3) a like card reading "いいね! 12.8K", 4) a repost card reading "リポスト 9,341", and 5) a dark trend card reading "おすすめトレンド #モヤVSエナ 42,857件のポスト". Add a central dark smartphone tweet panel tilted slightly, showing her tweet with profile icon, name, handle, the text "それ、前提が雑だよね。", and counters "312", "1,204", and "8,745".

On the right, show an aggressive, fiery girl representing emotional counterattack and confidence: vivid red hair in a high messy side bun with long loose hair, bright teal eyes, fair skin, energetic expression, open shouting mouth, pointing directly toward the opponent with one hand while the other hand rests on her hip. She wears a white blouse, black jumper-style dress or vest dress, oversized red bow tie, white loose socks scrunched around the ankles, and black loafers. Surround her with red glowing tweet cards and notification-style UI. Her display name and handle should appear repeatedly as "緋空エナ @hisora_ena". Include exactly 3 large quoted statement boxes on her side with these Japanese texts: "ちゃんと読んでから言ってる!?", "正論ぶってるだけでしょ!", and "逃げてないで答えて!". Also include exactly 6 smaller red UI/comment elements on her side: 1) a top notification badge card reading "通知 99+", 2) a small comment bubble reading "エナちゃん つよすぎるww", 3) a small comment bubble reading "言いたいこと全部言ってくれる!", 4) a like card reading "いいね! 18.7K", 5) a like card reading "いいね! 23.6K", and 6) a repost card reading "リポスト 11.2K". Add a red tweet panel near the center showing her tweet with profile icon, name, handle, the text "ちゃんと読んでから言ってる!?", and counters "278", "1,652", and "10.9K".

In the lower middle area, place exactly 3 central dark interface cards bridging both sides: 1) a quote-post card labeled "引用ポスト" showing both users and the exchange "論点、そこじゃない。" and "正論ぶってるだけでしょ!", 2) a reply count card reading "返信 1,876件", and 3) a bottom navigation bar styled like the X mobile app with home, search, notifications, messages icons and a blue button labeled "ポスト". The overall aesthetic should be glossy, high-contrast, highly rendered anime illustration with neon edge lighting, intense backlighting, dynamic perspective, layered translucency, and a chaotic viral-internet argument atmosphere. Use crisp Japanese UI typography, dramatic red-vs-purple color contrast, and polished promotional-poster quality.

title: Sakura School Dating Sim Thumbnail
prompt: Create a bright anime-style YouTube thumbnail illustration in 16:9 landscape format, set at the entrance of a Japanese school during spring cherry blossom season. Show exactly 4 high-school girls standing side by side on the right half of the image, each wearing the same uniform: dark green sailor-style blazer with white trim, large burgundy bow, mustard-yellow pleated skirt, white socks, brown loafers, and each holding a brown leather school satchel in front of her. Give the 4 girls distinct hairstyles and hair colors: long flowing pink hair, short wavy light brown hair, long blonde hair, and long straight black hair. Keep their faces softly blurred or featureless so the thumbnail emphasizes the concept rather than individual identities. The background should feature a school gate, school building hints, blue sky, sunlight, abundant pink cherry blossom trees, and many falling sakura petals, with a polished colorful anime-game look, high saturation, crisp lighting, and cheerful romantic spring atmosphere. On the left half, add large bold Japanese thumbnail text reading {argument name="headline text" default="もっと！モット！ときめき'99"}, using thick rounded lettering, white fill with vivid pink outline and warm orange shadow, arranged dynamically with oversized emphasis on “モット!” and “'99”. Add small decorative hearts, sparkles, and an underline swoosh around the text. Compose it like a clickable nostalgic dating-sim themed thumbnail: characters on the right, text dominating the left, energetic diagonal layout, glossy highlights, clean readable typography, cinematic depth, floating petals in the foreground, no extra characters, no logos, no watermark.

title: Pale Blue Crocs Fashion Advertisement
prompt: A high-end studio advertising poster for {argument name="brand name" default="crocs"}, in a monochrome pastel blue and white color palette, with a glossy reflective floor and a soft sky-blue backdrop. The background is dominated by the word {argument name="headline text" default="CROCS"} in gigantic bold white condensed sans-serif letters spanning nearly the full height of the image. In the top-right corner, add small white text reading "Designed with ChatGPT". Feature 3 adult women with shoulder-length wavy light brown to dark blonde hair, all wearing loose oversized white long-sleeve tops and flowing white wide-leg pants, styled as minimalist fashion models with relaxed neutral expressions. Their faces are intentionally obscured or blurred. One model reclines against an enormous upright white clog shoe on the left side, one model sits casually on top of a giant white clog on the upper right, and one model lounges on the floor at the lower right, leaning back on one arm while seated partly on a glossy blue sphere. Include 2 oversized white clog shoes as hero props: one standing vertically on the left showing the sole and side profile, and one angled on blue crystalline blocks at center-right showing the upper and toe box. Both clogs are classic foam slip-on style with perforation holes, chunky tread, heel straps, and circular logo rivets. The center-right clog is decorated with exactly 8 visible charms pinned to the upper: a blue-green iridescent round charm, a white daisy with yellow center, a black-and-white round emblem near the strap, a small "CROCS" word charm, a dark flower, a peace-hand sign, an orange smiley face, a white cloud, and an orange flower. Scatter exactly 7 glossy floating or grounded blue spheres of varying sizes around the set: one large sphere behind the left model, one medium sphere floating near center, one medium sphere at bottom left foreground, one medium sphere used as a seat under the lower-right model, one small sphere near the upper left, and 2 additional blue spheres integrated into the composition. Add translucent sculptural gel-like forms at the far left and far right edges, plus angular blue crystal-like rocks beneath the right shoe. At the bottom center, place white promotional copy in a clean sans-serif font: {argument name="tagline line 1" default="Made for comfort, worn for confidence."} on the first line and {argument name="tagline line 2" default="Because life feels better when your feet stop complaining."} on the second line. Beneath that, show 4 minimalist feature icons with labels in white: "ICONIC COMFORT", "LIGHTWEIGHT", "EASY TO CLEAN", and "UNIQUELY YOU". Place the {argument name="logo text" default="crocs"} logo in bold lowercase white at the bottom center with a small trademark symbol. The overall style should feel like a premium surreal fashion campaign, clean editorial lighting, soft shadows, glossy textures, airy composition, and modern lifestyle product advertising.

slug: 日式美人鱼游泳拼贴画-4_6c3744
title: Japanese mermaid swimming collage
prompt:
Goal: Create a polished Japanese magazine-style photobook collage about a young woman getting a special hairstyle and entering the water for a swim performance, with an elegant sentimental tone. Use the headline {argument name="headline text" default="ミセスマーメイド"} and the theme of a first challenge, beauty, nervousness, and transformation.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 layout, approximately 1200×675 px, with a soft off-white paper background and thin white borders between photos. The design should feel like a lifestyle magazine spread or event memory board, mixing warm indoor preparation photos on the left and cool blue pool photos on the right.

Layout: Use exactly 9 photo panels in an overlapping scrapbook collage. Panel 1 is a large vertical portrait occupying the left third, showing the woman from chest up in a mustard-yellow lace dress, long dark wet-look twin ponytails, gold dangling earrings, and soft indoor light. Panels 2–4 are three smaller preparation photos stacked near the center-left: panel 2 shows three women chatting before the event, panel 3 shows a hairstylist working on one side ponytail, and panel 4 shows the back of the head with neat center parting and twin ponytails. Panel 5 is a tall central-right photo labeled as the main performance, showing the woman standing poolside in the same yellow dress with arms crossed, blue swimming pool behind her. Panel 6 is a large upper-right close-up in pool water, showing her wet twin ponytails and yellow outfit at water level. Panel 7 is a horizontal middle photo showing her from behind in the pool with both ponytails spread outward on the water. Panel 8 is a lower-center close-up of her emerging from the water. Panel 9 is a lower-right close-up of her in the pool with hands clasped near her cheek, smiling pose implied, yellow lace sleeves visible.

Subject details: The model is {argument name="character description" default="an elegant Japanese woman in her 30s with long dark brown hair styled into sleek twin ponytails"}. Outfit is {argument name="outfit" default="a mustard-yellow lace dress with long sleeves and gold dangling earrings"}. Hair should look glossy, carefully parted, and becoming wet in the pool photos. Keep the mood graceful, feminine, and aspirational.

Text content: Include exactly 6 pieces of visible Japanese text on beige paper tape or handwritten areas. 1) Large handwritten headline at upper left: 「ミセスマーメイド」. 2) Small handwritten subtext below it: 「はじめての挑戦、私らしく、美しく。」. 3) Beige tape caption over the lower-left portrait: 「緊張もワクワクもあるけれど、この時間も大切にしたい。」. 4) Beige label above the preparation photos: 「試合前」. 5) Beige label above the central standing pool photo: 「一本番」. 6) Beige tape caption across the upper-right pool close-up: 「水の中で、新しい私と出会えた気がした。」.

Visual style: Photorealistic editorial collage, soft natural lighting, shallow depth of field, warm beige tones on the left, vivid blue pool tones on the right, slightly nostalgic paper texture, clean white gutters, subtle drop shadows under the layered photos, handwritten Japanese calligraphy for the main title, typewriter-like Japanese text on tape labels.

Constraints: All human faces must be anonymized with smooth rectangular beige face masks matching the skin-tone censor blocks in the reference style; do not show identifiable facial features. Use exactly 9 photo panels and exactly 6 text elements. Do not add extra logos, watermarks, QR codes, English text, or additional captions.

请基于用户上传的 1-3 张清晰个人照片，一次性生成 **4 张不同的单独精修照片**，统一为 **3:4 竖构图**。  
主题为：**Y2K 美式韩流校园毕业写真**。

整体风格：**美式校园室内棚拍 + 韩流女团甜酷概念照 + Y2K 青春海报 + 手绘涂鸦背景 + AI 时代毕业情绪大片**。

这组图要有明确毕业主题，毕业感通过 **Yearbook、毕业证书封皮、学位帽、书本、储物柜、课桌、拍立得、Class of {argument name="毕业年份" default="2026"}、What’s Next、Future Loading** 等元素体现。

---

## 人物一致性

请严格保留用户本人真实身份特征，包括脸型、五官比例、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、肤色、年龄感、发型基础和整体气质。  
4 张图里都必须清楚看起来是同一个真实女生。

人物可以更精致、更上镜、更有杂志感，但要保留真实面部辨识度和自然皮肤质感。不要变成陌生人，不要网红假脸，不要过度磨皮。

---

## 服装妆造

造型为 **美式校园潮流 + 韩系女团甜酷 + Y2K 复古未来感**。

服装可使用：

- baby tee / 短款针织衫 / 学院风衬衫
- varsity jacket 校队夹克 / 短款西装外套
- 百褶短裙 / 低腰牛仔裙 / 工装裤
- 细领带 / 学院风丝带 / 校徽胸针
- 银色耳机 / 星星发夹 / 透明果冻包 / 复古墨镜
- 厚底运动鞋 / 玛丽珍鞋

整体要甜酷、干净、潮流、有校园感，有韩流爱豆概念照精致度。

妆容为 **韩系 Y2K 甜酷校园妆**：清透底妆、自然皮肤纹理、干净眉眼、细闪眼影、自然卧蚕、冷粉腮红、银色或冰粉高光、果冻感裸粉 / 豆沙粉 / 奶茶玫瑰唇色。

发型为年轻轻盈的韩系校园造型：自然大卷、微卷披发、半扎发、高马尾、八字刘海、碎发修饰，可搭配星星发夹、银色发夹、小蝴蝶结或透明果冻发夹。

---

## 场景背景

场景为 **美式韩流室内棚拍校园布景**，像杂志大片布景，不要真实外景。

背景融合：

- 美式校园储物柜
- 教室黑板
- 课桌椅
- Yearbook 墙
- 拍立得照片墙
- 便利贴、课程表、书本
- 手绘涂鸦、星星、爱心、箭头、问号
- Y2K 贴纸、像素光标、银色气球、透明亚克力板
- Class of {argument name="毕业年份" default="2026"}、What’s Next、Future Loading、AI Era、Restart、Dream、Error 等少量英文视觉文字

背景要有设计师排版感、青春感、杂志感。文字作为视觉元素即可，不要大量堆字。

---

## AI 设计元素

画面中加入轻量 AI 元素，像 Y2K 海报图形设计：

- 半透明 AI 聊天气泡
- prompt 输入框
- loading bar
- floating UI 弹窗
- 像素光标
- 数据流贴纸
- 神经网络线条
- 手绘机器人头像
- glitch sticker
- holographic card
- 蓝粉色轻微光效
- 银色线框图形
- 未来职业路径小图
- 手绘 prompt 草稿纸

AI 元素要轻盈、时髦、青春，像围绕人物的时代背景 and 情绪注释。人物始终是视觉中心。

---

## 光线质感

整体为 **美式韩流室内棚拍杂志感**。

请使用：干净棚拍光、柔和主光、轻微闪光灯质感、奶油白高光、粉蓝环境光、银色边缘光、透明塑料反光、轻微胶片颗粒、Y2K 海报质感、高清真实摄影质感。

整体色调：**奶油白 + 粉蓝 + 银灰 + 黑色 + 冰紫 + 少量酸性绿色点缀**。  
画面要甜酷、干净、潮流、有设计感。

---

## 情绪表达

这组图要表达 **毕业前夜的青春感、AI 时代到来的迷茫感、年轻人站在人生新阶段入口的复杂情绪**。

情绪关键词：

甜酷、青春、松弛、明亮、迷茫、若有所思、轻微叛逆、毕业前夜感、时代变化中的复杂情绪。

表情可以有：

- 看向镜头，甜酷微笑
- 露齿笑，像被朋友逗笑
- 不看镜头，看向 AI 投影
- 低头翻 yearbook
- 坐在地上发呆
- 一只手撑脸，眼神放空
- 抱着毕业证书封皮若有所思
- 戴耳机看向远处

表情要自然真实，有抓拍感，不要营业式假笑。

---

## 固定输出 4 张照片

### 1）主视觉海报图

半身或中近景。人物站在或坐在 Y2K 手绘涂鸦背景前，手拿 yearbook 或毕业证书封皮，看向镜头。背景有 Class of {argument name="毕业年份" default="2026"}、What’s Next、AI prompt 输入框、loading bar、星星、问号、像素贴纸。  
表情甜酷、自信，适合做封面图。

### 2）locker 校园甜酷站姿

3/4 身或接近全身。人物站在美式储物柜前，身体微侧，一只手拿耳机或墨镜，另一只手抱书本、yearbook 或学位帽。  
背景有粉蓝涂鸦、课程表、AI chat bubble、prompt card、Y2K 贴纸。  
表情酷一点，看向镜头外，像韩流女团校园概念照。

### 3）毕业迷茫故事图

中景或 3/4 身。人物坐在地上、课桌边或储物柜旁，周围散落 yearbook、书本、拍立得、便利贴、笔记本电脑、毕业证书封皮、学位帽。

### 4）Y2K 韩流近景情绪图

半身近景或大头中近景。人物轻扶耳机、整理发夹、抱着 yearbook 或触碰半透明 AI 界面。

title: Hand-painted Yuru-kyara T-shirt prototype
prompt:
Create a white t-shirt product mockup (flat lay, front view, plain white background).

The t-shirt design uses black line art only. No color fill. No shading. White shirt throughout.

Illustration style: hand-drawn with a soft pencil or crayon. Lines are slightly wobbly and uneven, with inconsistent pressure — some strokes faint, some darker. Outlines do not always close perfectly. The overall impression is a casual, childlike sketch — imperfect but charming. Minimal detail. No clean vector lines. No digital precision.

The t-shirt has four printed zones:

TOP CENTER: Reproduce the festival logo from the first attached image exactly as-is — do not alter the font, layout, or graphic style in any way. Place it prominently at the top center of the shirt. Make it large enough to read clearly. Do NOT apply the hand-drawn or yuru-kyara style to this logo.

TOP RIGHT: A hand-drawn jagged speech bubble (spiky, explosive edges — like a shouting manga effect), slightly smaller than the character illustration. Inside the bubble, write "{argument name="dialogue" default="【ここにセリフを入力】"}" in clumsy, uneven hand-lettered characters. The bubble and text should feel comic and energetic.

MIDDLE: Redraw the character from the attached image in a loose, casual, yuru-kyara style — simplified, childlike, charmingly imperfect. Use the attached image as the sole reference for pose, expression, and content. Draw the character smaller — occupying no more than 40% of the shirt's height. Leave generous white space around the figure. The speech bubble may overlap with the top portion of the character illustration. Do not shrink the character to avoid overlap.

BOTTOM: The artist name "{argument name="artist name" default="【ここにアーティスト名を入力】"}" hand-lettered in uneven, shaky characters — as if written slowly and clumsily by hand with a pencil.

Keep all elements well-spaced and balanced. Clean, minimal, no background decoration.

title: Time-Travel Birthday Reunion Portrait
prompt:
请基于我上传的 **1 张清晰当前个人照片**，生成一张「**童年的我 和 现在的我 一起过生日**」的情感摄影作品。

请严格保留我当前照片中的**真实身份特征**，包括：
脸型、五官比例、眉眼结构、鼻子、嘴唇、下颌线、肤色、年龄感、发际线、发型特征和整体气质。

**不要把我变成另一个人，不要欧美化，不要网红化，不要过度美颜，不要生成 AI 假脸。**
整张图必须让人一眼看出：画面中的小孩和成年人是同一个人的不同人生阶段。

---

## 画面核心设定

生成一张 **4:5 竖版**、高度真实的摄影作品。

画面中有**两个人物**：
- 一个是**童年版本的我**
- 一个是**现在的我**

两个人物要出现在**同一个真实场景、同一张照片、同一种光线和同一套色调**里，像真的坐在一起过生日、一起拍下一张纪念照。

**不要分割线，不要左右分屏，不要双场景拼接，不要一半黑白一半彩色。**
整体必须像一张自然真实拍摄的生日合照，而不是海报拼贴。

---

## 人物关系与情绪

这是一张关于「**现在的我 和 小时候的我 相遇，并一起过生日**」的照片。
两人之间要有明显的**情感连接和交流感**，像是在同一时空里温柔相遇。

**情绪关键词：**
温暖、治愈、安静、柔和、感动、成长、自我和解、时间流动感

**可以是这样的互动状态：**
- 两人彼此对视
- 或一起低头看蛋糕
- 或成年人温柔看向小时候的自己，而小孩自然开心地回应

整体感觉要像：
**生日这一天，长大的我终于坐下来，陪小时候的自己一起吹蜡烛。**

---

## 左侧人物：童年版本的我

请根据我现在的长相，合理生成一个我童年的版本，**年龄约 [童年年龄，例如：5岁 / 6岁 / 7岁]**。

这个小孩必须保留与我现在相呼应的身份特征，让人看得出这是「小时候的我」，包括：
- 五官轮廓延续感
- 眼神气质延续感
- 脸型特征延续感
- 整体气质上的「像同一个人」

**童年版本要求：**
- 年龄感自然，像真实小朋友
- 表情天真、温暖、自然
- 穿着简洁日常，可为浅灰色 T 恤、针织上衣或简约童装
- 坐姿自然，不要僵硬
- 可以微笑、看向现在的我，或看向蛋糕
- **不能是陌生小孩，必须有「这是我小时候」的强烈既视感**

---

## 右侧人物：现在的我

右侧是现在的我，**必须严格参考我上传的照片长相**。

**成年版本要求：**
- 面容必须与参考照片匹配
- 看起来是现在的我，真实自然
- 年龄感与当前状态一致
- 穿着干净好看的日常服装，可为白色 / 米色 / 浅色上衣搭配蓝色牛仔裤
- 姿势自然松弛
- 可以双手托着下巴，也可以自然搭在桌面
- 眼神看向童年的自己，带着**温柔、平静、克制的微笑**

**成年版的情绪重点：**
像是在温柔注视过去的自己，陪伴她 / 他一起长大。

---

## 蛋糕与年龄元素

画面中间或偏前景位置放置一个**真实自然的生日蛋糕**。
蛋糕要成为画面的情感中心之一，但不要喧宾夺主。

**要求：**
- 蛋糕摆在桌面中央
- 造型简洁、真实、自然，适合生日氛围
- 蛋糕上有**点燃的数字蜡烛**
- 数字蜡烛内容为：**[当前年龄]**
- 蜡烛火光柔和温暖，微微照亮两个人物的脸 and 蛋糕表面
- 蛋糕是「现在的我和童年的我一起过生日」的重要象征

---

## 年份信息

请将以下年份以**低调、简洁、优雅的小字**呈现在画面中：
- 童年版本人物附近或上方：**([童年年份])**
- 现在版本人物附近或上方：**([当前年份])**

字体要简洁自然，像摄影作品中的轻量排版，**不能抢画面主体**。
除这些年份和蛋糕上的年龄数字外，**不要出现其他文字**。

---

## 场景与背景

场景为一个**纯净、柔和、极简的室内摄影空间**。

**背景颜色建议：** 浅灰、暖灰、米灰、奶油灰

**要求：**
- 背景干净简洁
- 没有复杂装饰、没有杂物、没有多余人物
- 有一张桌子即可
- 整体看起来像真实摄影棚或极简生活方式摄影空间

---

## 光线与色调

使用**柔和、温暖、电影感的布光**。

**要求：**
- 光线均匀自然
- 面部有轻微立体感
- 阴影柔和
- 整体色调统一
- 不要左右两边不同色温
- 不要做成两个年代拼接的视觉效果

整体色调要**温暖、治愈、真实**，像一张高级但自然的生日纪念照。

---

## 风格要求

整体风格为：**高质量写实摄影 · 极简情感摄影 · 生日纪念人像**
真实、自然、克制，适合发朋友圈、小红书、Instagram。

**画面重点是：**
同一个人的两个年龄阶段，在同一时空里一起过生日，并产生温柔的情绪交流。

---

## ⚠️ 重要限制

- **不要**改变我的核心长相
- **不要**把童年版本做成陌生小孩
- **不要**分屏、不要分割线、不要拼贴感
- **不要**一边黑白一边彩色
- **不要**欧美化、不要网红化、不要 AI 假脸
- **不要**卡通风、插画风、塑料皮肤
- **不要**夸张妆容、不要过度磨皮
- **不要**复杂背景、不要多余人物
- **不要**错误手部、不要多余手指
- **不要**文字乱码
- 除了 **([童年年份])、([当前年份])** 和蛋糕蜡烛上的 **[当前年龄]** 外，**不要出现其他文字**

---

## 最终输出

输出一张 **4:5 竖版、高度真实、温暖、极简、电影感**的生日情感摄影作品。

画面中，**童年的我和现在的我**坐在同一个场景里，一起过生日，中间有生日蛋糕和年龄蜡烛，两人像真实地在同一时空里相遇，形成一张关于**时间、成长与自我拥抱**的真实纪念照片。

[GRID LAYOUT] Structured 4×4 panel grid (16 frames total), evenly spaced with thin black divider lines. [WARDROBE] The dancer wears a stylish, performance-ready outfit: a well-fitted top paired with a short, flowy skirt. [PANEL STRUCTURE – EACH FRAME] Top-left: Step number + short dance move title (e.g., “Step 5 – Spin Transition”) Center: Full-body pose capturing a precise moment in the choreography Bottom-left: 3–4 lines of concise instruction describing the move Overlay: Motion arrows and directional guides illustrating how the dancer transitions [MOTION INDICATORS] Incorporate curved arrows for fluid motion, straight arrows for directional steps, and circular indicators for spins or turns. Emphasize rhythm, weight shifts, and body isolation. [RENDER QUALITY] High-detail sculpted 3D style with smooth grayscale shading, subtle shadows, and clean linework. Maintain a polished, concept-art level finish with clarity in every pose. [RESTRICTIONS] No color, no background scenery, no extra characters, no visual clutter, only the dancer and instructional elements.

prompt: Create a vintage illustrated postcard designed as a whimsical collaboration between {argument name="franchise name" default="The Little Prince"} and {argument name="space company name" default="SPACEX"}, shown as the front and back of the postcard side by side on one canvas. Use warm aged paper with slightly worn edges, subtle grain, faint stains, and a nostalgic mid-century print feel. The left half is the postcard image: a deep midnight blue starry sky with small golden stars and a tiny ringed planet, a large white rocket standing upright on a launch pad with bright exhaust at liftoff, and a small blond child in a green outfit with a long golden scarf sitting on a rocky hill beside an orange fox, both seen from behind and looking toward the rocket. Add elegant hand-lettered quote text in the sky that reads {argument name="quote" default="To the stars, what matters is invisible."}, with smaller serif and script attribution beneath: "ANTOINE DE SAINT-EXUPÉRY" and "The Little Prince". Along the bottom of the left panel, include 2 brand names: "The Little Prince" in blue script on the left and "SPACEX" in bold blue futuristic capitals on the right, separated by a small gold star and a thin divider line. Beneath that, add the slogan in spaced small caps: {argument name="tagline" default="EXPLORING WORLDS. CARING FOR WHAT MATTERS."}. The right half is the postcard back on the same aged paper, with a centered heading "POST CARD" near the top and a small gold star ornament below it. Add a circular postmark near the upper center-right with 4 visible text parts arranged inside the stamp: "PLANET EARTH", "MAY 23", "2024", and "BEYOND". In the top-right corner, place a blue postage stamp with perforated edges showing the Little Prince standing on a tiny planet under stars, with 4 readable text elements: "1943", "Le Petit Prince", "SPACE", and a small star symbol. The right side should have 2 writing columns divided by a vertical line. In the left writing area, place a handwritten-style message beginning with "Dear friend," followed by this text in neat cursive line breaks: "One day, we'll leave Earth not to escape it, but to understand it better. The universe is vast, but kindness is our compass. Let's take care of our home, as we reach for the stars." Then sign it on 3 lines: "The Little Prince", "and", "SPACEX". In the right address area, write "To you," on the first line, then "Somewhere wonderful" and "In the Universe" on the next lines with horizontal guide lines. Add small gold star doodles and, at the bottom-right corner, a simple line drawing of a tiny round planet with little flowers sprouting from it. Keep the palette limited to cream, navy, soft gold, muted green, warm orange, and blue-gray, with crisp but painterly illustration, accurate decorative typography, and a magical, hopeful, literary-meets-space-exploration tone.

slug: 日系-ai-工作流笔记本信息图-5_e1cc23
title: Japanese AI Workflow Notebook Infographic
prompt:
Goal: Create a square, hand-drawn Japanese notebook-style infographic about turning AI from a chat partner into an operations/work assistant, with a cute anime mascot at the bottom.

Canvas: 1:1 square image, cream lined notebook paper background with rounded corners, blue border line, visible metal spiral binding along the left edge, soft grid-paper tape decoration near the top left, and blue/yellow pen-marker accents. Overall look should be clean, friendly, handwritten, and sketchnote-like.

Text content: Use Japanese handwritten lettering. Top left page marker: “4/4”. Main title inside a blue outlined banner: {argument name="main title" default="実務への接続"}. Subtitle beneath it: “Manus / Codex / Claude Code / Newsletter”. Mid-page label in a dotted rounded rectangle: “自分のワークフローへ”. Large main message on the lower left: “AIはチャット相手から” above very large bold navy text {argument name="main message" default="作業担当へ"}. Speech bubble on the right of the character: {argument name="speech bubble text" default="毎日の型にする"}.

Layout: Top third contains exactly 3 connected workflow cards in a horizontal row, each with a numbered blue circle and rounded blue outline. Card 1 is labeled “Manusで収集” and shows a magnifying glass, document, and cloud icon. Card 2 is labeled “Codex/Claude Codeで整理” and shows a clipboard checklist, arrow, folder, and small hierarchy diagram. Card 3 is labeled “ニュースレターで発信” and shows an envelope with a paper and small heart. Add thick blue downward arrows between the cards and another blue arrow down from the center card to the dotted workflow label.

Lower section: On the left, place exactly 3 action rows with circular blue icons and Japanese labels: 1) magnifying glass icon with “調べる”, 2) folder icon with “整える”, 3) envelope icon with “発信する”. Underline or highlight each label with pale yellow marker strokes and dotted guide lines.

Character details: Bottom center-right features a cute anime cat-eared girl mascot from about knees up, with long pastel pink hair, white cat ears, a pink cat tail curling to the right, and a small gold hair clip reading “ME”. She wears a loose blue hoodie and dark skirt, holding a clipboard checklist with exactly 3 checked boxes. Keep the face area intentionally covered by a plain beige rectangular mask, as if anonymized. Use {argument name="character hair color" default="pastel pink"} hair and {argument name="hoodie color" default="blue"} hoodie if customized.

Visual style: Blue ink line art with occasional navy bold lettering, pale yellow highlights, soft sky-blue scribble fills, small sparkles, hearts, and radiating accent lines. Use a cheerful educational newsletter aesthetic, like a hand-drawn planner page mixed with kawaii anime illustration. Maintain legible text, balanced spacing, and no photorealism.

Constraints: Include exactly 3 workflow cards and exactly 3 action rows. Do not add extra panels, extra numbered steps, watermarks, logos, or English translations on the image beyond the subtitle line.

Render in polished modern anime key visual style, ultra-clean linework, luminous hair strands, subtle depth, and a wistful sci-fi mood.

prompt: 创作一张细节极其丰富的日本周刊少年漫画杂志封面，全出血设计，画面爆炸且拥挤，不留空白。采用单幅垂直构图的杂志封面插画形式，堆叠了排版文字、角色艺术、动态效果和都市科幻的混乱感。顶部是一个巨大的风格化日文刊名，采用火橙红色，配有厚重的黑色轮廓和金色边缘，横跨页面宽度，文字为"週刊少年ブレイズ"，标题中集成了一个小型的 40 周年庆祝徽章。在最顶端边缘添加一行简短的日文标语。在右上角放置一个黑色期刊信息框，配以亮黄色和白色的文字，显示日期"2026年4月22日号"和价格"特別価格 380円"。主图以动态三角形构图呈现 3 位动漫角色。画面中心前景，主角女英雄向观众猛冲而来，采用强烈的透视缩短效果，一只手伸向镜头前方，几乎触碰到屏幕。她是一位十几岁的辣妹风动作女英雄，拥有 浅棕色带粉色挑染 的长波浪发，发丝狂乱飞舞，金棕色双眸锐利，带着自信而顽皮的笑容，拥有阳光亲吻般的肤色、多个耳环，散发着炫酷叛逆的街头战士气质。她的服装为黑金配色，包含 6 个关键可见部件：短款上衣、带金属饰边的短夹克、短裤、带垂坠链条的腰带、单腿腿带以及露指手套。在衣服上添加金色闪电图案和光泽高光。在她的手部和身体周围，绘制黄色能量弧线和速度线以强调冲击力。在她左侧中景处，放置一名白发少年，身穿黑白相间的未来主义战斗服，呈攻击姿态蹲伏，正将巨大的机械护手或武器瞄准观众，周围环绕着冰蓝色碎片和棱角分明的动态线条。在她右侧中景处，放置一名粉发少女，扎着双马尾或束发，挥舞着圆形刀刃武器，动作姿态中带有鲜艳的洋红色能量轨迹。在右上角背景中，添加第四个视觉焦点（非主要角色）：一名黑发少年身穿绿黑色战斗服，正斜向瞄准一把发光的科幻步枪，部分被文字和特效遮挡，融入背景动作中。背景是一个霓虹闪烁的未来主义日本夜间城市街道，采用倾斜视角，高耸的招牌、碎片、火花、破碎的残骸、电流条纹，以及饱和的蓝色、紫色、粉色和橙色。运用极端的对比度、光泽印刷质感、墨迹飞溅点缀、半色调漫画杂志风格以及高级动漫主视觉渲染。在左侧堆叠块中添加醒目的大型日文封面文案，使用厚实的白、黄、红、黑字体，包括突出的标题"新時代をブチ抜く 超熱量ヒロイン ここに爆誕!!"。在左侧添加 5 个特征标注框，采用彩色矩形框，配以粗体名称和下方的副标题：雷閃ブレイカー / 天城ノア, 空駆けエンジン / 南雲ハヤト, 魔境デリバリー / 倉科ミツル, 白狼ストライカー / 久世リョウ, 超深海クラッシュ / 早瀬シン。在右侧添加 5 个匹配的粗体特征标注框：極光パレット / 鳴海ユウト, 機巧グラフィティ / 胡野レイ, 龍骨ランナー / 火野アツシ, 王冠のラグナ / 深町カイ, 風神リベリオン / 東雲ガク。此外，在右侧添加 3 个促销标签，采用星形或爆炸形标签，配以大型黄色和白色文字：巻頭カラー, 特大ポスター付き, 新連載スタート。让整张封面呈现出热门战斗漫画新纪元大作首刊的感觉，充满活力、叛逆、炫目、精致，且具有极高冲击力的日本漫画杂志封面特征。

slug: 充满压力的动漫风生产力拼贴画-3_26678a
title: Stressful anime-style productivity collage
prompt:
Goal: Create a dark, vertical anime collage illustrating {argument name="mood" default="my current incompetent state"}: an overwhelmed student/programmer trapped inside a gloomy machinery-and-productivity nightmare.

Canvas: Tall vertical poster, about 9:16 aspect ratio, black background with low-contrast charcoal gray details, muted sepia highlights, desaturated colors, soft film grain, vignette, smoky atmosphere, dense but readable collage composition.

Central subject: A tired, emotionless anime girl with {argument name="character appearance" default="short black hair, pale skin, heavy-lidded eyes, oversized dark hoodie"}. Show her multiple times: 1 small bust at the upper center tangled in cables, 1 chibi/sleepy version near the lower middle reaching forward from inside gears, and 1 full-body version at the bottom lying exhausted on a messy bed or blanket surrounded by papers and trash. Her expression should stay flat, drained, and sleep-deprived.

Main background and machinery: Fill the upper half with server racks, tangled black cables, smoke vents, and steampunk gears. Include exactly 4 prominent antique clock faces: 1 large clock at upper left, 1 medium pocket-watch clock near center-left, 1 large hanging clock in the vertical center, and 1 smaller clock integrated among gears. Add chains, cogwheels, paper airplanes, scattered notes, and faint sparks.

Productivity and school-task UI collage: Place exactly 8 floating interface/task panels across the middle area, all dim and slightly skewed like screenshots pasted into the scene: 1 OneNote window on the left with Chinese class notes and bullet points, 1 Microsoft To Do panel in the upper middle with several overdue tasks, 1 torn sticky-note cluster on the upper right with daily routines, 1 small chat window labeled like friends on the left, 1 class-group chat window below it, 1 small blue homework/deadline card on the right, 1 cloud-classroom/deadline card below it, and 1 red warning or reminder message card below those. The visible text may be mostly Chinese, but keep it tiny, imperfect, and secondary to the mood.

Media, fandom, and distraction strip: In the lower-middle area, include exactly 5 distraction panels/items in a row: 1 small anime sleep panel with three chibi characters, 1 dark computer/software panel, 1 music-production app icon resembling FL Studio, 1 grayscale band/anime screenshot panel with Chinese title text, and 1 grayscale panel labeled with an excited phrase like “MyGO!!!!!”.

Lower activity scenes and clutter: Add exactly 6 bottom-life vignettes/items around the exhausted character: 1 baseball game scene at lower left, 1 crumpled thought scribble nearby, 1 coding laptop at lower right showing terminal output, 1 electronics/breadboard or soldering setup with smoke and wires near center-right, 1 plate-and-bowl meal scene at far right, and 1 snack pile at lower left with potato chips and melon bread packaging. Scatter additional notebooks, phones, cans, tissues, receipts, and small papers around the final lying figure.

Visual style: Melancholic anime illustration, gothic productivity hell, detailed collage, dark academia meets cyberpunk servers and steampunk clocks. Use mostly black, charcoal, dusty brown, faded gray, muted blue, and occasional tiny warm lights. Keep everything intentionally dim, cluttered, and emotionally heavy, with the central character as the only recurring human focal point.

Text constraints: Use a few legible UI labels such as {argument name="task app label" default="Microsoft To Do"}, {argument name="note app label" default="OneNote"}, and {argument name="band panel label" default="MyGO!!!!!"}. Do not add a clean infographic layout, bright colors, watermark, or photorealistic style.

添加一套完整的日式格斗游戏 HUD，采用亮面蓝红对比界面风格。最上方放置一个中央舞台标题栏，文字为"东京迪士尼海洋 米奇广场 演出最前排对战"，中间显示大计时器"TIME 89"。左上角添加蓝色队伍标题"PLAYER1"及队名"最前排硬核粉丝 A"。右上角添加红色队伍标题"RIVAL"及队名"竞争对手组 B"。左侧堆叠 5 个蓝色玩家状态面板，包含头像、等级、日式职业昵称、HP、SP 和 BURST 槽。左侧 5 个标签分别为："Lv.25 硬核队长 勇树"、"Lv.24 肌肉男 武"、"Lv.23 眼镜宅 真司"、"Lv.23 开角心 MAX 健人"、"Lv.22 支援人员 亮"。右侧堆叠 5 个红色对手状态面板，标签为："Lv.27 对手队长 大辉"、"Lv.26 力量代表 胜"、"Lv.24 战略家 浩二"、"Lv.23 热血汉 陆"、"Lv.22 支援女生 咲"。每个面板应包含数值化的 HP 和 SP 以及分段式 BURST 槽，风格类似于日式街机 RPG 格斗界面。

在中心场景的格斗者上方放置 10 个战斗名牌，左侧队伍为蓝色，右侧队伍为红色。10 个标签分别为："Lv.24 武"、"Lv.25 勇树"、"Lv.23 真司"、"Lv.23 健人"、"Lv.22 亮"、"Lv.27 大辉"、"Lv.26 胜"、"Lv.23 陆"、"Lv.22 咲"、"Lv.22 美咲"。

左下角添加一个标题为"技能"的技能菜单，列出 5 个带有 SP 消耗的技能："冲刺突击 SP 20"、"肩推强夺 SP 25"、"用行李占位 SP 15"、"钻绳索 SP 10"、"本气的毅力 SP 50"。下方添加一个深色说明框，解释高亮技能"本气的毅力"，文字为："用气势威压对手，将其推开！一定时间内，对手更容易产生硬直！（大幅消耗 BURST 槽）效果时间：10 秒"。

底部中央添加一个标题为"道具"的道具菜单，包含 5 个显示图标和数量的槽位：水瓶"x3"、折叠紫色毛巾"x2"、蓝色抽绳包"x1"、灰色双肩包"x1"和盒饭"x2"。右下角添加一个标题为"任务"的任务面板，任务文字为"在演出开始前死守最前排！"，条件文字为"条件：将竞争对手组全员推回后方！"，倒计时文字为"距离演出开始：02:30"。旁边添加一个标题为"米奇广场 MAP"的小地图，显示广场上两队的红蓝点。在最底部边缘，包含用于技能使用、道具使用、抓取/推搡和冲刺等操作的小型日文控制器提示。

使用戏剧性的高饱和度光影、清晰的细节、写实的衣物褶皱、真实的广场石板路，呈现高端日本游戏截图的质感。画面应给人一种荒谬但可信的跨界感，仿佛是一张真实的东京迪士尼海洋人群照片与竞技街机对战游戏界面的结合。

prompt: Using the provided reference image, transform the ancient clay figurine into a high-end fashion editorial moodboard for a couture collection inspired directly by its form and surface language. Add a “COLOR PALETTE” row with 4 circular swatches in earthy clay, deep brown, warm ivory, and charcoal. Add an “ACCESSORIES & DETAIL” section with exactly 6 accessory items: ceramic & stone earrings, sculptural clay-leather bag, hand-built clay cuff, Jomon spiral brooch, bronze-clay necklace, sculpted strappy heels. Add a bottom “DETAIL CRAFTSMANSHIP” strip with 5 close-up panels: hand-embossed spirals, raised clay appliqué, ceramic bead embellishment, sculpted shoulder architecture, organic texture contrast. Overall aesthetic: museum artifact meets Paris haute couture, earthy and luxurious, highly detailed, premium fashion campaign board, elegant typography, realistic garments, tactile materials, and a refined editorial presentation.

【損壊度 1: 軽度損壊】

電気スパークはなし、またはごく微弱。
第一印象は元の人物・キャラクターのままだが、近くで見ると内部が人工構造だと分かる程度にする。

【損壊度 2: 中度損壊】

人間らしさ、キャラクターらしさ、美しさは残す。

【損壊度 3: 高度損壊】
重度の損壊表現。ただし元画像の人物・キャラクターだと分かるようにする。
顔半分、特に片目の周辺から頬にかけて外皮が大きく剥がれ、人工筋肉、神経ケーブル、機械眼の周辺構造、金属フレームが露出している状態にする。

slug: 手绘旅行日记-童趣城市路线插画-3_15b0e8

prompt:
请绘制一张色彩鲜艳、竖版（9:16）的手绘风格"北京 旅行日记插画"。画面风格应如同好奇的孩子用蜡笔绘制而成。使用柔和温暖的浅色背景（如浅黄色），搭配红色、蓝色和绿色等明亮色调，营造出舒适、童趣且充满旅行气息的氛围。

I. 主图：日记风格旅行路线

在插画中心绘制一条"蜿蜒的旅行路线"，用箭头和虚线连接多个地点。推荐景点将根据 1 天的行程自动生成：

示例格式（自动替换为与 北京 相关的内容）：

- "第一站：故宫 + 红墙黄瓦的皇家秘密"
- "第二站：天坛 + 祈年殿下的回音游戏"
- "第三站：胡同 + 穿梭老北京的小巷子"
- ...
- "终点站：糖葫芦 + 甜蜜的旅行记忆！"

> 旅行停靠点的数量会根据天数自动生成。如果未输入天数，默认生成 1 天/精华游路线。

II. 有趣的周边元素（根据城市自动替换）

在路线周围添加大量童趣元素，例如：

- 可爱的旅行角色："拿着糖葫芦的小朋友"、"背着背包的探险小童"等。
- 当地地标的 Q 版手绘图：如"天安门"、"长城"、"鸟巢"。
- 有趣的指示牌："小心迷路！"，"注意人群！"，"前方有美食！"（根据城市背景调整）。
- 贴纸风格的标语："北京 旅行记忆解锁！"，"北京 美食大冒险！"，"下一站去哪儿？"
- 当地美食的可爱小图标：如"烤鸭"、"炸酱面"、"豆汁"。
- 感叹语（保持童趣语气）："北京 太好玩了！"，"我还想再去一次！"

III. 整体风格要求

- 手绘蜡笔风格 / 儿童旅行日志风格
- 色彩明亮，构图饱满而温暖
- 强调旅行的快乐与探索感
- 所有文字均使用可爱的圆体手写字体
- 让整张图片看起来就像一页充满童真奇想的旅行日记。

title: Beethoven's Sacred Desk Collage
prompt: Create a wide cinematic mixed-media historical illustration of {argument name="composer name" default="Ludwig van Beethoven"} composing at a sacred writing desk while silence transforms into musical genius. Use a dramatic 16:9 horizontal canvas with dense collage energy, painterly realism mixed with ink splatter, torn paper, antique manuscript texture, and sweeping abstract motion. Center-left: a curly-haired early-19th-century composer in a black coat and red scarf bends over a dark wooden desk, writing intensely with one white quill on scattered sheet music; his face is obscured by a soft rectangular blur/shadow rather than detailed facial features. On the desk include exactly 3 visible writing objects: 1 white quill, 1 small black ink pot, and 1 taller brass inkwell. Surround him with exactly 3 historical-symbolic zones: left background shows a smoky Napoleonic battlefield with black flags, soldiers, fire, and a distant domed city under dark storm clouds; right background shows a peaceful pastoral river valley with green trees, hills, bright sky, and sunlight; foreground and midground show an explosive avalanche of musical manuscript pages. Include exactly 1 cello standing upright on the far right, warm brown varnish, partly covered by black and gold splatter. Include exactly 1 black bicorne hat in the lower-left foreground with exactly 2 decorations on it: a rosette cockade and a gold medal or insignia; place exactly 1 red cloth draped beside it. Fill the air with many black musical notes, staff lines, torn notation pages, circular cream-and-gold arcs, ink blots, scratches, and gold paint flecks, as if the music is erupting from the desk toward the pastoral landscape. Color palette: charcoal black, aged parchment cream, sepia brown, smoky gray, deep red accents, and metallic gold. Lighting should be high-contrast and theatrical, with the composer and desk dark and brooding, the right landscape luminous, and the whole image feeling like a baroque collage poster about {argument name="theme" default="deafness, war, and the creation of the Fifth and Sixth Symphonies"}. No readable modern text, no watermark, no clean digital UI, no extra people in the foreground.

title: NOVALITH Mobile SaaS Getting Started Page
titleEn: NOVALITH Mobile SaaS Getting Started Page
prompt:
Goal: Create a polished mobile onboarding/top screen for a fictional B2B data platform named {argument name="brand name" default="NOVALITH"}, in a premium Japanese SaaS visual style.

Canvas: Vertical smartphone screenshot, 9:16 aspect ratio, white background, iOS status bar at the top showing 9:41 with signal, Wi-Fi, and battery icons. Use generous margins and a clean app-advertising composition.

Layout: Place the NOVALITH logo near the top left, with a geometric turquoise-blue “N” mark and wide-spaced navy wordmark. Below it, set a large bold Japanese headline in dark navy: {argument name="headline text" default="データを、未来の意思決定に変える。"}. Under the headline, add a smaller two-line Japanese description: {argument name="body text" default="開発・運用・データの複雑さを解消し、信頼できるデータ基盤で、事業の成長を加速させます。"}. On the lower left, show exactly 3 feature blurbs with thin cyan outline icons: 1) stacked layers icon, title “統合された基盤”, description “データとシステムを一元的に統合”; 2) shield check icon, title “堅牢なガバナンス”, description “セキュリティと品質を標準で確保”; 3) rising bar chart icon, title “高速な意思決定”, description “信頼できるデータで意思決定を加速”.

Hero visual: On the right half, create a large glossy 3D smartphone card tilted slightly backward, overlapping a translucent teal-blue architectural block and a giant faceted 3D letter N behind it. The phone screen shows a Japanese dashboard UI with exactly 4 dashboard sections: 1) top metric cards, with “データパイプライン 128 +2.4%” and “データ品質スコア 98.6% +2.4%”; 2) pipeline status row with three connected icons labeled “データソース 24”, “処理中 128”, and “出力先 36”, plus small status dots; 3) line chart titled “データ量の推移” with dates from 5/06 to 5/12; 4) donut chart titled “データソース健全性” showing “96% 健全” and a legend with “健全 46”, “警告 3”, “エラー 1”. Keep the dashboard text small but believable and neatly aligned.

Bottom navigation and actions: Center exactly 3 small carousel dots above the buttons; the first dot is teal and active, the other two are pale gray. Add exactly 2 rounded buttons at the bottom: a filled teal gradient primary button labeled {argument name="primary button label" default="はじめる"} with a right arrow icon, and a white secondary button with teal outline labeled {argument name="secondary button label" default="あとで始める"}.

Visual style: Futuristic enterprise data analytics, crisp vector UI mixed with soft 3D glassmorphism. Palette is white, deep navy, cyan, teal, and aqua gradients. Add subtle polygon network lines, tiny nodes, faint dotted patterns, and light geometric overlays across the background. Use soft shadows, clean Japanese typography, high contrast, and a premium App Store marketing feel. Avoid clutter, avoid extra buttons, avoid extra feature items, and do not add watermarks.

prompt: # 概念人群肖像图｜Conceptual Crowd Portrait 请基于用户上传的一张清晰真人照片，生成一张极具视觉冲击力的「概念人群肖像图」。 ## 一、人物身份要求 请严格参考上传照片中的人物真实身份特征，包括： - 脸型轮廓 - 五官比例 - 眉眼结构 - 鼻子形状 - 嘴唇形状 - 发型基础 - 肤色与年龄感 - 眼神气质 - 整体人物辨识度 最终画面必须让人一眼看出是上传照片中的同一个人。 不要改变成陌生人，不要欧美化，不要网红化，不要过度美颜，不要生成 AI 假脸。 ## 二、核心创意 将人物肖像重新创作为一件大型概念装置艺术作品。 整个人物头像由成千上万个微型人物组成，这些小人像人群方阵一样密集排列，通过不同的站位、服装深浅、人物密度和阴影变化，共同拼出上传照片中人物的脸部、头发、五官、眼镜、胡须、衣服轮廓和整体神态。 画面看起来像一幅由真实人群组成的巨大肖像，也像一件放置在纯白空间中的当代艺术装置。 ## 三、画面构图 - 竖版构图，适合作为视觉海报或概念封面 - 航拍视角 / 等距俯视视角 - 人物头像占据画面主体 - 背景为极简纯白空间，保留大量留白 - 肖像周围分散站立着少量小人，增强空间比例感和真实尺度 - 人群整体形成清晰的人物轮廓，五官位置必须准确 ## 四、视觉元素 ### 人群结构 - 使用密集人群组成头发、眉毛、眼睛、鼻梁、嘴唇、下颌线和衣服 - 深色人群形成头发、眼镜、衣领和阴影区域 - 浅色人群形成脸部高光和皮肤区域 - 人群排列要自然，有真实拥挤感和微小随机变化 - 每个小人都要有独立姿态、衣着和方向，不要像复制粘贴 ### 光影效果 - 柔和电影感光线 - 低角度长阴影 - 人群脚下投射自然阴影 - 阴影方向统一，增强空间真实感 - 画面整体干净、高级、安静 ### 色彩风格 - 温暖中性色调 - 米白、浅棕、灰色、炭黑为主 - 深色服装用于强化人物轮廓 - 肤色区域用浅米色和暖灰色人群过渡 - 整体色彩克制，不要过度鲜艳 ## 五、艺术风格 整体风格参考： - 当代概念艺术 - 博物馆级装置艺术 - 超写实人群模拟 - 极简主义视觉海报 - 高级数字艺术 - 社会隐喻类视觉作品 - 电影感概念摄影 画面要有强烈的视觉隐喻感： 一个人的形象由无数个微小个体共同组成，既有宏观肖像的震撼，也有微观人群细节的可探索性。 ## 六、画面情绪 整体氛围关键词： - 超现实 - 深刻 - 安静 - 高级 - 现代 - 具有思想性 - 电影感 - 视觉震撼 - 适合传播 ## 七、渲染质量 - 超高细节 - 8K 质感 - 写实人群模拟 - 深焦画面，确保整个人群肖像清晰可见 - 微缩人物细节丰富 - 空间比例真实 - 画面干净，无杂乱背景 - 高级商业视觉质感 - 类似 Octane Render / 高端 3D 概念渲染效果 ## 八、负面限制 请避免以下问题： - 不要把人物变成陌生人 - 不要只生成普通人像 - 不要生成简单拼贴 - 不要让人群失去肖像轮廓 - 不要出现五官错位 - 不要让脸部结构模糊 - 不要出现夸张卡通风 - 不要做成低清晰度海报 - 不要出现脏乱背景 - 不要让小人全部长得一模一样 - 不要出现文字、水印、logo - 不要过度美化人物 - 不要改变人物年龄感和真实气质

title: "Black Myth" Guanyu poster
prompt: Epic dark-fantasy poster of {argument name="character name" default="Guan Yu"} reimagined in the style of a mythic action game hero, full-body low-angle composition, towering and dominant in the center, wearing elaborate ancient Chinese battle armor in aged gold and deep green with dragon and beast motifs, massive engraved shoulder guard shaped like a roaring creature, layered lamellar plates, ornate belt clasp, long black hair streaming violently in the wind, and a weathered green headscarf. The environment is a smoky infernal battlefield with storm clouds, drifting ash, glowing embers, molten red light near the ground, jagged rocks, and colossal shadowy statues or demonic forms emerging in the background. Color palette of burnished gold, ember orange, blood red, charcoal black, and deep jade green. Hyper-detailed cinematic lighting, dramatic rim light from the moon, high contrast, volumetric smoke, richly textured metal, cloth, and hair, ultra-detailed fantasy concept art, premium video game key art, vertical poster design. Include 4 visible text groups integrated like a movie/game poster: the top arched Chinese text around the moon, a mid-lower title line reading "黑神话", an oversized gold brush-calligraphy main title reading "关公", and a bottom tagline line in smaller Chinese characters with a circular emblem at the center.

The character should have fair skin, dark brown hair in a low bun, simplified faceless features, and wear {argument name="outfit" default="a white skirt suit with white high heels"}.
