title: Brand personality comic infographic
prompt:
Using the uploaded logo, create a highly detailed, comic-style infographic poster:

“What This Brand Feels Like”

GOAL:
Turn the brand into a living personality and visually explain how it behaves, speaks, and interacts with the world.
This must feel like a mix of: brand strategy + character design + comic storytelling.

---

CORE RULE:
Everything must come from the logo:
- colors
- style
- tone
- personality

No generic personality traits.

---

MAIN STRUCTURE:
Vertical 4:5 poster
Dense layout with multiple panels
Comic + infographic hybrid

---

TOP SECTION:
- Brand name
- Short personality statement (max 6 words)
Example: “Quiet confidence with sharp edges”

---

MAIN CHARACTER (VERY IMPORTANT):
Create a central character representing the brand:
- humanized version of the brand
- outfit reflects brand style
- posture + expression reflect personality

---

AROUND THE CHARACTER:
Create 6–8 comic panels showing how the brand behaves in different situations.

---

SCENARIO IDEAS:
- Talking to customers
- Handling competition
- Selling a product
- Social media presence
- Reacting to criticism
- Daily “brand life” moment

---

FOR EACH PANEL:
Include:
- short caption (max 6 words)
- speech bubble or internal thought
- clear visual action

---

TONE EXAMPLES:
Luxury brand: calm, confident, minimal speech
Playful brand: loud, chaotic, expressive
Tech brand: precise, logical, clean

---

PERSONALITY TRAITS SECTION:
Add small labeled blocks:
- Voice tone (e.g. calm, bold, playful)
- Energy level (low / medium / high)
- Social behavior (introvert / extrovert)
- Communication style

Use:
- icons
- short labels

---

DO / DON’T SECTION:
Add a split block:
DO:
- how the brand should act
DON’T:
- what breaks the identity

Keep:
- very short phrases

---

VISUAL ELEMENTS:
- speech bubbles
- icons
- arrows
- small reactions
- exaggerated comic expressions

---

STYLE:
- comic + editorial hybrid
- slightly exaggerated but still premium
- expressive but not childish

---

COLOR:
- strictly based on logo palette
- use color to reinforce personality

---

DEPTH:
- 20–40 visual elements
- multiple small panels
- layered composition

---

IMPORTANT RULES:
- must feel alive
- must feel specific
- no generic marketing words
- no empty areas
- keep text short but impactful

---

FINAL FEEL:
Like:
- a brand strategy turned into a character
- a visual storytelling board
- something people save and study

NOT:
- flat
- generic
- minimal

prompt: A soft, airy lifestyle editorial image with a warm spring cafe mood. Place a Japanese woman in her late 20s to 30s on the right half of the frame, seated at a light wooden table and holding an open hardcover book as if quietly reading. She has {argument name="hair color" default="medium brown"} hair styled half-up with gentle curls at the ends, small earrings, and a calm, refined presence. Dress her in a navy blazer over a white top for an elegant casual-office look. On the table in front of her, show exactly 3 tabletop items: 1 white coffee cup on a saucer near the center front, 1 small clear glass vase filled with pale yellow and white flowers at the lower right, and 1 open book in her hands. Use bright natural lighting, soft shadows, a high-key cream background, and a clean minimalist composition with lots of negative space. On the left side, add Japanese editorial typography in a delicate, hand-drawn style: a large headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="春の休日、カフェで読書。"}, a smaller vertical-style body copy block below it reading "やわらかな陽ざしと、ページをめくる音。ゆっくり流れる時間が、いちばんのごほうび。", and a handwritten English phrase reading {argument name="accent text" default="Spring days"}. Surround the layout with subtle sketch-like spring doodles in muted gray ink and pale pink accents. Include exactly 9 falling cherry blossom petals scattered across the page, 2 simple line-drawn birds flying near the upper right, 1 outlined window frame with cherry blossom branches in the top right corner, 1 line drawing of a steaming coffee cup at the lower left, 1 line drawing of an open book with a small vase and leaves near the lower middle-left, and a few tiny leaf doodles. The overall style should blend real photography with delicate hand-drawn editorial illustrations, evoking a calm, feminine Japanese magazine advertisement about reading at a cafe in spring.

prompt: Create a clean, premium Japanese corporate poster for a {argument name="company name" default="Arks"} video production company, in a minimalist editorial layout on an off-white background with lots of negative space. In the upper right, add a small stacked brand mark in thin uppercase letters: "VIDEO" on one line, "PRODUCTION" on the next, "COMPANY" on the third, with a small burnt-orange geometric accent nearby. Below the logo, add a vertical burnt-orange bar on the left and a large elegant Japanese headline in black Mincho-style serif: {argument name="headline text" default="4つの領域で、映像を磨く。"}. Directly underneath, add a smaller service line in Japanese with slash separators: "SNS運用 / ショートドラマ / MV制作 / AI映像". The main body is a 2 by 2 grid of exactly 4 service panels with thin light-gray divider lines. Each panel has a large black editorial number and a Japanese label. Panel 1 label: "SNS運用" with the number "01"; image shows a close-up hand holding a smartphone displaying social media analytics, on a desk with charts, a calendar sheet, a pen, and a coffee mug, in warm natural office lighting; caption below in Japanese: "企画・分析・運用を一つの流れで。" Panel 2 label: "ショートドラマ" with the number "02"; image shows exactly 2 Japanese high-school-age students in white shirts standing outdoors on a rooftop or balcony, one female and one male, side-profile composition, muted overcast daylight, cinematic shallow depth of field; caption below: "共感が残る、短編の物語設計。" Panel 3 label: "MV制作" with the number "03"; image shows a moody musician playing electric guitar in a dim studio, backlit by soft haze, with a camera monitor in the foreground showing the same performer; caption below: "アーティストの世界観を、映像で可視化。" Panel 4 label: "AI映像" with the number "04"; image shows a dark professional AI video-generation or image-editing software interface on a monitor, with a cinematic scene of a lone figure standing on rocks under dramatic clouds, plus thumbnail timeline images and side control panels; caption below: "技術を表現へ変える、次世代の映像制作。" At the bottom left, place a small three-line English slogan in uppercase: {argument name="tagline text" default="CREATE.\nCONNECT.\nLEAVE A MARK."} with a small burnt-orange line accent above it. At the bottom right, place the website {argument name="website" default="arks-vp.com"} in small serif text with a short black horizontal line beside it. Use a refined mix of bold modern sans-serif for the large logo and numbers, and elegant Japanese serif for headlines and labels. Color palette: black, charcoal, warm off-white, light gray rules, and restrained burnt-orange accents. The overall feel should be realistic, polished, contemporary, Japanese editorial advertising design, with accurate Japanese typography and natural image tones.

slug: 批量生产的真实感拼贴画-1_ff7dd6
title: Mass-produced realistic collages
prompt:
Goal: Create a surreal industrial Renaissance collage poster titled {argument name="headline text" default="MASS PRODUCED AUTHENTICITY"}, mixing classical sculpture, factory machinery, architectural blueprints, and obsolete computer error imagery into a critical art-print composition.

Canvas: Square poster, 1:1 aspect ratio, aged beige paper background with stains, faint grid lines, registration marks, technical drafting annotations, and a worn archival print texture. Use a muted palette of stone gray, dusty beige, charcoal black, rust orange, faded red, and small accents of Windows-95 blue.

Layout: The upper left contains the main typography: small technical labels reading “SERIES: MPA_001” and “DATE: 05.19.95”, then large elegant serif words “MASS PRODUCED” in dark gray, with the word “AUTHENTICITY” below in tall condensed distressed red-orange type. The left side also includes a small schematic caption block reading “THE ASSEMBLY LINE OF IDENTITY STANDARDIZED, REPLICATED, EMPTY.” followed by “FIG. 07A” and “DAVID PRODUCTION UNIT SCHEMATIC”. The right upper quadrant contains a detailed circular engineering blueprint diagram with measurements and the labels “SECTION A-A” and “SCALE 1:10”. The bottom left contains a small conveyor-belt plan drawing labeled like a technical manufacturing diagram.

Main scene: Across the lower half, show a long conveyor belt receding from left to right, carrying a row of identical classical marble bust heads inspired by Michelangelo’s David. There are exactly 10 visible bust heads arranged along the conveyor, all pale stone with curly Renaissance hair, repeated like factory products. Cover the front faces with exactly 7 opaque gray rectangular censorship blocks of different sizes, aligned over the bust faces: one small block at the far left, two medium blocks left-of-center, one very large vertical block in the center foreground, two medium blocks on the right, and one smaller block near the far right.

Central object: Behind the central bust, a huge pixelated white computer mouse cursor arrow rises diagonally upward, built like a heavy stone or concrete 3D object with dark beveled edges. It is crashing through cracked plaster and rubble, exposing tangled wires, circuit boards, metal components, and broken concrete beneath. Add flying debris and fracture lines around the impact point.

Foreground details: In the lower right foreground, place a rusty red industrial machine housing with chipped paint and black mechanical parts. Overlay a small retro Windows error dialog box tilted slightly, with a blue title bar reading “Error”, a red X icon, the message “Authenticity.exe has stopped working.”, and an “OK” button. On the rusty machine, add black stamped text reading “ERROR”, “CODE: 0x000404”, and “SYSTEM_FAILURE”. Include dark cables, gears, bolts, grime, and orange rust stains spilling into the bottom area.

Visual style: Surreal 404 Renaissance collage, brutalist industrial assemblage, archival blueprint poster, photomontage mixed with engraved technical drawing, distressed printmaking, high-detail textures, cracked stone, exposed electronics, analog paper grain, subtle halftone, museum-conservation beige background, cinematic yet flat editorial composition.

Constraints: Keep all visible text legible and integrated into the print. Use exactly 10 bust heads and exactly 7 gray censorship rectangles. Do not add extra characters, logos, watermarks, modern UI beyond the single retro error dialog, or bright saturated colors outside the small blue error title bar and rust-red typography/machinery.

title: Puzzle Bean Pixel Wind Infographic Poster
titleEn: Puzzle Bean Pixel Wind Infographic Poster
prompt:
生成一张 16:9 横版信息图海报。

主题：{argument name="主题" default="潘金莲"}

必须覆盖的知识点：
【知识点1】
【知识点2】
【知识点3】
【知识点4】
【知识点5】
【知识点6】
【知识点7】
【知识点8】

视觉风格定义：
这是一张“拼豆 / Perler beads / fuse beads / 像素珠阵列”风格的结构性平面信息图海报。画面由大量规则排列的圆形塑料拼豆构成，每一颗拼豆都具有清晰圆形边界、轻微中心凹点、均匀间距、低饱和塑料质感和稳定网格秩序。整体必须保持正视平面构图，像一张由拼豆拼成的公共文化信息图海报，而不是玩具摄影、3D模型、卡通插画或普通像素画。

核心构图：
将【主题】主体压缩为一个大尺度单色拼豆图像场，而不是完整写实物体、居中插画或图标集合。主体必须从画幅边缘涌入，跨越页面边界，并被出血裁切，像一个更大的拼豆媒介图像残片进入纸面。主体占据主要视觉重量，但不完整呈现；观众必须通过轮廓、方向、缺失区域、拼豆密度和局部纹理重建主题。

主体形态：
主体外缘呈现低分辨率拼豆台阶、方块断裂、硬切缺口、像素化锯齿轮廓、缺珠断面和被采样后的粗糙边界。禁止平滑剪影，禁止完整图标轮廓，禁止写实细节。主体内部只使用同一主题结构色的不同明度拼豆，形成低对比影像碎片、半调噪声、扫描颗粒、材料残影、档案纹理和局部密度变化。

背景与负空间：
背景使用高明度浅色拼豆底场，接近未印刷纸面、浅奶白塑料底板或淡灰白拼豆阵列。背景不是装饰底色，而是主动反向切入主体，形成大块空洞、曲折通道、安静文字窗口、阅读停顿区和知识点容器。空白必须像空气，也像刀口；它既提供呼吸感，也切割主体结构。大块浅色底与大块主题结构色必须互相侵入，不能简单上下分区，不能成为普通背景。

色彩系统：
采用严格的三层功能配色，不允许平均化配色。

第一层：浅色底场  
面积比例约 60%–70%。功能是呼吸、切割、停顿、承载文字窗口。颜色可为旧纸白、浅米白、冷灰白、淡蓝白或淡暖灰。

第二层：主题结构色  
面积比例约 25%–35%。功能是构成主体、制造空间压力、表达主题情绪和材料语义。颜色必须根据【主题】选择，例如冷主题可使用深蓝、墨绿、灰紫、石墨色；暖主题可使用赭红、土橙、棕黑、暗金色。结构色内部允许通过拼豆明度差表现颗粒密度和图像残影。

第三层：高对比信息色  
面积比例约 3%–6%。功能是标题、编号、时间、注释、机构信息、图例、脚注和关键知识点标记。信息色必须少量、锐利、明确，可使用红、黑、亮蓝、荧光橙或高纯度青色。信息色不能扩散为装饰色。

信息图系统：
将【知识点1】至【知识点8】全部转化为拼豆信息节点，不使用普通图标堆叠解释。每个知识点以以下形式之一呈现：
- 小型编号标签
- 微型注释框
- 拼豆图例块
- 坐标线
- 时间刻度
- 比例条
- 方向箭头
- 档案索引编号
- 局部纹理说明
- 边缘标记点

信息节点必须沿留白窗口、色场边界、切口节点、主体缺口、负空间通道和底部边缘分散布置。信息节点数量为 8 个，对应 8 个知识点。所有信息节点必须有层级关系：主标题最大，核心概念次级，知识点标签更小，脚注 and 编号最小。信息节点不能覆盖主体中心，不能破坏大色场结构。

阅读路线：
构建跳跃式阅读路径：上方小型标记 → 侧向主标题 → 主体边缘知识点 → 负空间注释窗口 → 底部脚注与图例。画面必须同时满足远距离识别和近距离阅读：远看是一个强烈的巨大拼豆图像残片，近看是一个精密、有秩序的知识信息系统。

字体与文字：
使用窄身现代无衬线字体、瑞士风格无衬线、方正清晰骨架字体或等宽元数据字体。字体笔画均匀，字距克制，层级精确。主标题像公共文化信息坐标，小字像档案元数据索引。文字必须排布在留白窗口、边界节点和底部信息栏中，不得压在主体中央。中文文字必须清晰、短句化、标签化，避免长段落。

拼豆材质：
所有视觉元素都由拼豆构成。拼豆表面为哑光塑料质感，带轻微制造不均、微弱颗粒、细小磨损和低对比表面差异。结构色区域内部可出现半调式拼豆密度变化、扫描输出感、旧纸不均匀感和专色叠印感。信息色拼豆必须边缘锐利、对比清楚、定位准确。

title: Japanese GPT Image2 Marketing Comics
prompt:
Goal: Create a square Japanese social-media comic infographic about trying GPT Image2 for making a campaign poster, with a cheerful office-work atmosphere and cute anime styling.

Canvas: 1:1 square image, bright pastel palette, soft daylight office background, white cloud-shaped panels outlined in blue, pink, purple, and green, with sparkles, arrows, doodles, stickers, and expressive reaction icons. The overall design should feel like a polished explanatory X/Twitter post image.

Main subject: A cute chibi/anime-style office woman with short wavy brown hair, white blouse, small gold accessories, and expressive poses, appearing repeatedly across the design. Keep faces anonymized/blank with a soft rectangular blur over each face. The same character appears exactly 7 times: 1) small at top left using a laptop, 2) upper center admiring a generated poster, 3) upper right giving a thumbs-up, 4) mid-left looking uncertain beside prompt instructions, 5) large right-side rear/side view seated at a desk looking at a monitor, 6) bottom left distressed with hands on head, 7) bottom right tucked in bed saying good night.

Layout: Place six numbered story steps in rounded cloud panels around a central desktop monitor. Use large circular step numbers with white numerals: step 1 in blue at top left, step 2 in blue at top center, step 3 in pink at top right, step 4 in purple at left middle, step 5 in purple at bottom left, and step 6 in green at bottom right. Connect the steps with thick colorful arrows, including a blue arrow from step 1 to step 2, a pink arrow to step 3, a purple downward arrow to step 5, and a dotted green path toward step 6.

Central object: A large computer monitor on a desk showing a design app interface labeled “GPT Image2” at the top. On the canvas inside the monitor is a skincare campaign poster for {argument name="brand name" default="Lumière"}, with Japanese headline text, product bottles, white flowers, green leaves, and gold circular benefit badges. Include a keyboard, mouse, coffee mug, notebook checklist, pen, small potted plant, and a tidy office desk. In the background, show a softly blurred modern office window with greenery.

Text content: Use Japanese text in the artwork. Step 1 headline: “AIで画像生成を試してみよう！” with a question mark and lightbulb doodle. Step 2 headline: “GPT Image2すごい” followed by a surprised emoji, and show a small generated campaign poster preview. Step 3 headline: “感動しました！” with a heart; include a checklist with exactly 4 green check items: “テーマ◎”, “雰囲気◎”, “訴求ポイント◎”, “ロゴも完璧!”. Step 4 headline: “他のAIは少し難しい” with a scribble icon; include a mini card titled “他社AIツール” with exactly 3 stacked instruction boxes: “プロンプトを詳細に入力”, “構成を細かく指定してください”, “ネガティブプロンプトも設定してください…”. Step 5 headline: “ポイントがどんどん減っていく…” with a crying/sweating emoji; include a vertical point meter titled “保有ポイント” listing exactly 5 values: “1000 pt”, “600 pt”, “230 pt”, a downward arrow, and “50 pt” in red. Step 6 headline: “明日またトライします” with a sparkle. Bottom-right bedtime bubble: “おやすみなさい また明日！” with a heart.

Poster details: The skincare ad should read {argument name="campaign headline" default="うるおい続く 私らしい毎日へ。"} and smaller copy “肌も心も、やさしく満たす。” Include exactly 3 gold benefit circles: “高保湿”, “敏感肌処方”, “うるおいキープ”. Show a clean logo mark of leaves above “Lumière / ルミエール”.

Desk details: The open notebook at the bottom center should be labeled “やることリスト” and include exactly 5 checkbox items, with several checked in red; the visible items should include “企画”, “ビジュアル”, “キャッチコピー”, and “予算確認”. Add small decorative point coins flying away near the distressed character.

Style constraints: Cute Japanese manga infographic, clean commercial design, rounded typography, thick white outlines around character cutouts, soft cel shading, high detail but readable at social-post size. Preserve the exact six-step count, the seven character appearances, and the visible Japanese labels. No watermark, no photorealism, no extra panels.

Canvas: Square 1:1 infographic, white background with teal borders and rounded cards, bold teal section headers, red emphasis text, simple flat vector icons. Overall style is clean, high-contrast, large readable Japanese typography, like a laminated how-to guide.

Main header: At the top, a dark teal banner with a circular 7-Eleven storefront icon on the left and a printer icon on the right. Center the large white headline {argument name="headline text" default="セブンで印刷する手順"}. Under it place a pale yellow rounded pill subtitle {argument name="subtitle text" default="この画像を見ながら操作すればOK！"}.

Section 1, top left card, title {argument name="section one title" default="① まず覚えること"}: Include exactly 4 teal bullet points and 1 yellow warning box. The bullets say, in Japanese, that there are 2 things to print, enter reservation numbers one at a time, the size is A4 black-and-white one copy each, and the expiration deadline is 2026/05/16 23:59. Emphasize the numbers 2, 1, A4, black-and-white, one copy each, and the date in red. The warning box contains a teal exclamation icon and text warning that printing becomes unavailable after the expiration date, so print early.

Section 2, top right card, title {argument name="section two title" default="② 予約番号"}: Show exactly 2 large reservation-number rows with teal circled numbers: row 1 is {argument name="first reservation number" default="ABCD1234"}, row 2 is {argument name="second reservation number" default="EFGH5678"}. Each row is inside a white rounded rectangle with teal outline. Add a red note below: print these two in order.

Section 3, middle full-width card, title in Japanese meaning store workflow: Show exactly 6 numbered vertical steps separated by thin teal lines, each with a teal circle number at the top. Step 1: go to 7-Eleven, with storefront icon. Step 2: on the multifunction copier screen choose “Net Print,” with copier touchscreen icon and pointing hand. Step 3: enter the reservation number, with keypad screen showing ABCD1234 and a pointing hand pressing confirm. Step 4: confirm A4 black-and-white and print, with settings panel and printer output icon. Step 5: after the first one finishes, enter the second reservation number the same way, with circular repeat arrows and text indicating print 1 then 2 in order. Step 6: insert money and receive the printout, with banknote, coins, downward arrow, paper sheet, and sparkle icons.

Section 4, lower card, title in Japanese meaning print contents: Show exactly 2 contents items. Item 1: teal circled 1, large text “A4 black-and-white 1 copy,” small paper icon. Item 2: teal circled 2, large text “A4 black-and-white 1 copy,” small paper icon. Separate the two items with a dotted teal divider.

Bottom help strip: Pale yellow rounded rectangle with two friendly elderly people icons on the left, faces intentionally blurred or simplified. Add a teal headline saying that if they are confused, they only need to look at these two numbers. Show exactly 2 large bordered boxes containing ABCD1234 and EFGH5678.

Constraints: Use exactly 4 major numbered sections plus the bottom help strip, exactly 2 reservation numbers, exactly 6 workflow steps, exactly 2 print-content items, exactly 4 bullet points in Section 1, and no extra logos except the simplified 7-Eleven storefront motif. Keep all Japanese text large, readable, and neatly aligned.

prompt:
设计一个现代、高端的 {argument name="app type" default="健身应用"} 着陆页及产品 UI，品牌名称为 {argument name="brand name" default="PulseFit"}。

创建一个简洁的 Web 设计模型，使其看起来像一个真实的 SaaS 健身平台及配套移动端应用。设计风格应体现高端感、激励性且易于使用，UI/UX 风格需对标顶级健康与健身应用。

包含内容：
- 首屏板块：包含醒目的标题、简短的副标题、强有力的行动号召（CTA）按钮以及应用预览
- 仪表盘 UI：展示每日活动、消耗卡路里、锻炼连续天数、心率、步数及进度环
- 锻炼计划卡片：涵盖力量、有氧、灵活性及恢复训练
- 营养追踪板块：包含宏量营养素分析及饮水量记录
- 进度图表与分析组件
- 教练/社区板块：包含个人资料卡片及用户评价
- 定价板块及应用商店下载引导
- 移动端应用界面：与 Web 设计并列展示，呈现统一的产品生态系统

风格导向：
- 时髦、极简、现代的界面
- 高端健身品牌美学
- 舒适的间距、清晰的层级、圆角卡片、柔和阴影
- 深色模式 UI，搭配电光蓝、霓虹绿或活力橙等充满能量的强调色
- 清晰的排版、真实的图表、精致的按钮、美观的引导页体验
- 高度细节化、符合 Dribbble 标准、具备初创公司水准的产品设计
- 真实的 UX 案例研究展示，非卡通或插画风格

构图：
- 完整的网站首页模型
- 在一个精致的展示中呈现多个 UI 板块
- 采用微透视或正视的产品展示视角
- 简洁的背景，带有微妙的渐变与专业灯光效果
- 超高细节、清晰的文字渲染、视觉平衡的布局

输出：
一个令人惊艳、逼真的健身应用网站及仪表盘 UI/UX 设计概念，看起来已达到可开发标准。

使其看起来像是一个针对高端初创公司的真实 Figma 产品设计演示。

title: Sand Monk 3D Character Profile Poster
prompt:
Goal: Create a cinematic vertical 3D character profile poster for {argument name="character name" default="沙僧"}, inspired by an epic dark-fantasy Journey to the West return theme.

Canvas: Portrait 3:4 poster, high-resolution, dramatic movie-poster composition with a thin antique gold rectangular border and worn parchment-metal texture around the edges.

Main subject: One imposing warrior-monk stands full body in the center, wading through a shallow stormy river. He is tall, broad, rugged, and dressed in layered tattered dark green and gray monk robes, wrapped belts, hanging pouches, rope ties, weathered boots, and a huge strand of black prayer beads around his neck. His face is intentionally covered by a plain centered brown square censor block, while a small ornate golden headpiece remains visible above it. His stance is powerful, one foot forward splashing water.

Weapon and props: The character thrusts one large crescent-bladed demon-subduing staff toward the viewer, breaking the frame with extreme foreshortening from the left foreground. The blade is ornate bronze-gold with engraved patterns and sharp curved hooks. In his other hand he carries one small dark wooden traveling chest. Count the main visible props exactly: 1 oversized crescent staff, 1 wooden chest, 1 large prayer-bead necklace, multiple belt pouches as costume detail.

Background: A vast mythic river landscape under storm clouds, mist, splashing water, rocks, and glowing golden energy currents. Add exactly 5 narrative vignette scenes embedded in swirling circular mist portals around the character: 1 upper-left river struggle scene with a monk-like figure in turbulent water, 1 upper-right escort scene with a master riding a white horse and attendants, 1 mid-right pilgrimage scene with two travelers walking across a barren riverbank, 1 lower-left demon-slaying battle scene in rocks and waves, and 1 far-right distant mountain-road scene suggesting the westward journey. Make the vignettes semi-transparent, painterly, and integrated into the smoky sky and water.

Text content and placement: Use vertical Chinese calligraphy and small annotation text as decorative poster typography. Include exactly 6 prominent text groups: 1 large gold brush-calligraphy title at lower left reading {argument name="main title text" default="沙僧"}; 1 small subtitle below it reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="流沙河护法 / 沉稳之心"}; 1 upper-left vertical heading reading {argument name="upper left label" default="流沙河"} with small supporting text; 1 upper-right vertical heading reading "保护师父" with small supporting text; 1 middle-right vertical heading reading "挑担牵行" with small supporting text; 1 lower-right vertical heading reading "西行之路" with small supporting text. Also include a lower-left vertical heading "降妖伏魔" near the battle vignette, styled as part of the poster annotations. Keep all Chinese text legible enough to read but aged and integrated into the design.

Visual style: Hyper-detailed 3D cinematic realism, dark fantasy Chinese mythological epic, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, smoky volumetric atmosphere, gold sparks, wet fabric, rippling water, highly detailed metal engravings, weathered cloth texture, shallow depth of field on the foreground weapon, moody gray-blue and antique gold palette.

Constraints: Do not add extra characters beyond the background vignette figures. Keep the central warrior dominant, weapon breaking out toward the viewer, face covered by the brown square, and maintain the exact poster-like layout with ornate border, gold calligraphy, and 5 mist-vignette scenes.

Show dirt tracks, scattered crates, utility details, and a paved gray yard inside the walls. A large orange fireball explosion is erupting inside the base near the right-center interior, with smoke and debris. Another smaller explosion is happening outside the walls at the upper left on a dirt road near 2 red ground vehicles or launchers, with black smoke rising. The shoreline curves around shallow blue-green water with sandy banks, rocky cliffs, and many palm trees, creating a tropical desert cove. In the water on the right side, depict 5 gray modern warships in formation, angled diagonally, each leaving white wakes as they move. Count 8 missiles total with bright flaming trails arcing from the ships toward the land and base defenses; one missile is striking the nearest ship-side target area with a bright blue-white impact flash over the waterline, while others arc toward the compound and shore. Include tiny infantry figures near the beach and walls, some fallen, to suggest an active assault. The centerpiece is one monumental piece of Chinese calligraphy formed as sculptural 3D architectural typography, reading {argument name="main Chinese character" default="北京"} as two large interconnected characters built entirely from miniature Beijing heritage landmarks and traditional decorative elements. The strokes are constructed like carved lacquer and wood architectural fragments in rich vermilion red, aged gold, jade green, turquoise blue, stone gray, and ivory, with exquisite relief detail, soft shadows, and a handcrafted collectible feel. Across the calligraphy, integrate iconic Beijing imagery: palace roofs with glazed tiles, temple pavilions, stairways, carved balustrades, watchtowers, a winding section of the Great Wall, ornamental clouds, guardian lion sculptures, small old trees, golden ginkgo branches and leaves, hanging red lanterns, a Beijing opera mask, a skewer of glossy candied hawthorn, the Temple of Heaven, and a plated roast duck tucked into one lower stroke. Add sparse typography around the main artwork in a sophisticated editorial layout: at upper left, a tiny emblem and the words "BEIJING CHINA", beneath it "2024" and "CITY CULTURE SERIES" in small thin serif capitals; at upper right, a vertical Chinese title reading "北京 一座城的壮阔史诗" with several smaller vertical lines of Chinese copy and a red seal stamp; at lower left, large elegant serif text reading {argument name="city name in English" default="BEIJING"} and beneath it {argument name="subtitle" default="ETERNAL GLORY"}, followed by smaller text "EXHIBITION POSTER", "NO.2024-001", and tiny heritage-themed footer copy; at lower right, tiny small-cap text reading {argument name="tagline" default="TIMELESS HERITAGE"} and "CULTURAL LEGACY OF A THOUSAND YEARS". Keep the overall style luxurious, poetic, highly detailed, and premium, blending Chinese traditional culture, architectural miniature art, and contemporary poster design.

title: Relationship Atlas Infographic
prompt:
Please generate a high-design character relationship map poster based on {argument name="theme" default="Demon Slayer"}. This image should not be a simple illustration, but a character relationship map that combines information visualization, narrative structure, poster design sense, and stylistic fidelity.

Please automatically complete the following:
- Identify the work and core settings corresponding to the theme
- Extract the most representative 6–12 key characters, not exceeding 15 if necessary
- Identify and display key character relationships, including blood ties, romance, friendship, alliances, hostility, master-disciple, etc.
- Automatically choose a composition method based on the work's characteristics, such as protagonist-centered, dual-core confrontation, faction-based, family tree, or chronological evolution
- Automatically refine the work's style DNA, including color, worldview symbols, textures, mood, typography, and representative elements
- Transform these stylistic elements into an overall visual design for the relationship map, rather than simply copying an official poster
- Use different colors, line types, and arrows to distinguish different relationships, ensuring clear lines and layers without clutter
- Make core characters most prominent, followed by important characters, and subordinate characters weakened to form a clear visual hierarchy
- Ensure every character name is legible, with identity or faction labels if necessary

The final product should satisfy:
- Immediate understanding of character hierarchy and key relationships
- Obvious alignment with the original work's temperament and setting
- Combines the clarity of an infographic with the premium design of a poster
- Unified, exquisite, complete, and suitable for social media sharing or poster display
- Avoids a cheap flowchart feel, messy piling, and information overload.

发髻高挽，佩戴复杂精美的 金饰发冠、珠链步摇、耳饰、璎珞、臂钏、腰饰，服饰华丽，衣纹流畅，线条细劲有力，富有飞天韵律与宫廷级壁画质感。衣袂、飘带、裙摆与袖口应形成富有节奏感的流动曲线，强化神圣升腾感与画面韵律。
用金结构要求：
画面需强化 结构性用金，不是零散点金，而是形成明确的奢华秩序：
主体角色的发冠、首饰、衣缘、袖口、腰封、飘带边线、裙摆纹样采用 描金、泥金、鎏金、金线刺绣、残损金箔痕迹；
核心神圣元素，如月轮 / 佛光 / 法轮 / 宝盖 / 莲台、云纹、莲花花瓣、宝相花、藻井纹饰、团花纹、边框装饰也应带有 清晰可见但克制高级的金色装饰；
整体呈现 金碧辉煌但不俗艳、富丽精工但不廉价 的效果，表现出历经千年风化后仍保有金碧辉煌余韵的 残损奢华感。

色彩以 赭红、朱砂、青绿、石青、石绿、土黄、象牙白 为主，辅以克制精致的 土金、鎏金。
整体色调要 浓郁、浑厚、古雅、贵气，避免轻飘糖水色。
背景可采用 
暗金矿物底色 氛围，如深邃石青天幕 / 温润古壁底色 / 暗金矿物底色与古壁肌理结合，衬托出主体的神圣与尊贵。
装饰元素要求：
画面可融入 飞天、莲花、宝相花、藻井、祥云、伎乐、团花纹、楼阁宫阙、法器、圣光圆轮、古典边框装饰 等典型敦煌视觉语言，但必须围绕主体集中分布，层级清晰，避免平均铺满全画面。
陪衬人物控制在 
1位 即可（善财童子），作为礼赞与陪衬，分布在主体周围或下方，形成朝向主体的仪式感动势。她们可陪衬动作，如持莲花 / 奏琵琶 / 吹笛 / 奉花 / 托灯 / 执幡，线条轻盈流动，与主体形成呼应，但不可喧宾夺主。
空间与构图要求：
构图中应保留适度的 云气空间、圣光留白、月光或天幕留白，让画面有呼吸感。
核心神圣元素需醒目、庄严、圆满，周围可有 鎏金光晕、圣光圆轮、细密金线轨迹，强化主题的神圣性。
远处可点缀远景元素，如月���楼阁 / 云中宫阙 / 佛国建筑 / 仙界天幕，但不可过多，以增强空间层次与仙界气息。
材质表现要求：
需强调古老石窟壁画与矿物颜料肌理：
可见 斑驳、裂纹、风化、轻微剥落、历史包浆、粉化边缘、古壁肌理；

Clock hands and numerals must be uniquely designed to fit the illustration instead of using standard designs.

If the uploaded illustration contains a character, place the same character naturally beneath or beside the wall clock, looking upward toward it with curiosity or admiration while preserving the original face, hairstyle, proportions, colors, clothing style, and personality. slug: 电影感线程归档搜索海报-8_73f197
title: Cinematic Thread Archive Search Poster
prompt:
Goal: Create a cinematic vertical tech poster about searching historical conversation threads by content and branch name in a developer app.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 composition, dark premium editorial style, deep navy-black background with subtle star-like dust and a warm golden beam of light entering from the upper right.

Main text: At the top center, large bold Chinese headline {argument name="headline text" default="按内容与分支搜历史线程"}. Below it, centered smaller gold subtitle {argument name="app version" default="Codex App 26.527"}. Add a tiny decorative divider line with a small diamond under the subtitle.

Main subject: In the lower half, show an old dark metal archive filing cabinet at a three-quarter angle, with one drawer pulled open toward the viewer. The drawer front has a brass label plate reading “THREAD ARCHIVE” and a curved brass handle. The cabinet surface should feel heavy, matte, slightly worn, and realistic, with shallow depth of field.

Drawer contents: Inside the open drawer, show exactly 4 prominent stacked paper thread cards, each like an archival index card with rounded corners, warm ivory paper, and a small dark chat-bubble icon at the left. The visible card texts are: 1) “导出功能支持哪些格式?” with branch tag “feature/export-csv”, 2) “新版 API 兼容性讨论” with branch tag “refactor/api-v2”, 3) “用户登录流程的边界情况” with branch tag “fix/login-edge”, 4) front glowing card “如何优化加载性能?” with branch tag {argument name="featured branch tag" default="feature/perf-opt"}. The front card should glow brightest, as if it has been found by search.

Floating UI elements: Add exactly 2 floating search-result elements to the right of the drawer: one glowing branch label reading “feature/perf-opt” connected by a dotted golden path from the front card, and one small outlined chat bubble containing three dots. Add exactly 4 branch tags attached to cards in the drawer, one per card, styled as thin rounded rectangles with a branch icon.

Lighting and mood: Use a warm golden particle trail and dust motes around the highlighted card and floating branch label, contrasting with the cool dark cabinet. Make the scene atmospheric, elegant, high-end, and slightly magical, like an archival search feature visualized as light finding the correct thread.

Visual style: Realistic 3D illustration mixed with refined product-marketing poster design, cinematic lighting, soft bloom, shallow depth of field, crisp typography, subtle grain, no people, no extra logos, no watermark. Keep all text legible and avoid adding additional labels beyond the specified headline, subtitle, card texts, branch tags, and drawer label.

titleEn: Portrait eating popcorn in the car at night
prompt: A cinematic vertical smartphone photo of a glamorous young woman sitting in the front passenger seat of a car at night, shot from slightly above chest level in a tight mid-shot. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair pulled back loosely with soft strands near the ears, and is wearing a fitted ribbed brown zip-front top or dress with a deep neckline, partially unzipped, creating a sleek nightlife look. Her face is mostly out of frame or obscured, keeping the focus on pose, outfit, and mood rather than identity. She holds 1 large black tub of caramel popcorn in her lap with one hand, while her other hand is raised lightly near her chin in a casual, candid pose. The setting is the interior of a car with 1 visible beige passenger seat, 1 visible door panel with window controls, and a side window showing blurred colorful city lights outside, suggesting nighttime urban traffic. Use warm low-key lighting from the front-left, realistic skin texture, glossy highlights on the collarbone and fabric, shallow depth of field, bokeh streetlights, photorealistic detail, intimate composition, luxury nightlife atmosphere, and a moody editorial aesthetic. Outfit and palette should stay in coordinated brown and neutral tones, with the popcorn sharply detailed and slightly glossy from caramel coating. Render as realistic photography, high contrast, soft shadows, vertical 9:16 framing.

title: Neon Bug Text Logo
prompt: Create a square 1:1 digital graphic on a pure black background featuring the lowercase word {argument name="main word" default="bug"} as the central subject. Use exactly 3 large rounded lowercase letters, thick and glossy, with a beveled 3D glass/plastic look: the left letter in electric cyan-blue, the middle letter blending deep blue to violet, and the right letter in hot magenta-pink. Add bright neon outlines, inner glow, reflective highlights, and subtle transparent depth inside each letter. Behind the word, place exactly 1 circular energy ring, incomplete and hand-drawn in feel, wrapping around the text with a blue arc on the left/top and a purple-magenta arc on the right/bottom. Add small glowing particles scattered around the ring and text, plus exactly 4 prominent starburst lens flares: one at the upper left of the first letter, one at the lower left edge, one near the top of the middle letter, and one bright pink flare on the upper right of the last letter. The overall style should be high-contrast cyber neon, luminous, crisp, centered, with no extra text, no border, and no watermark.

prompt: 一张未经修饰、抓拍的室内照片，由 21 世纪初的消费级数码相机或廉价胶片相机拍摄。画面展示了 一家三口其乐融融的中国家庭 在 2003 年左右位于 北京一间朴素公寓客厅 的场景。母亲、父亲和年幼的女儿（约 6 岁）被定格在一个杂乱而真实的居家环境中。母亲抬头看向镜头，神情惊喜且面带微笑；父亲正在尝试修理一台旧录像机；女儿则在花纹地毯上玩着一辆色彩鲜艳的玩具车。照片显然是随手抓拍的，光线来自右侧，是昏暗的自然窗光。构图偏离中心，略显模糊且带有颗粒感，色彩暗淡、发白，并泛着淡淡的黄色调。背景中有一台笨重的米色电视机，屏幕上显示着雪花点，墙上挂着 2003 年的挂历，架子上堆满了 VHS 录像带、装裱的家庭照片、布艺沙发，还有一株小植物。视角处于平视高度，但给人一种手持拍摄、略微晃动的感觉。焦点柔和，景深较浅，突出了这一自然的瞬间。使用旧款 Nikon Coolpix 或 Canon PowerShot 拍摄，画面可见数字噪点，角落处带有日期时间戳。这张照片捕捉了平凡日常生活的片段，女儿凌乱的头发和散落的玩具，营造出一种真实、如记忆般的感觉。

slug: 包装设计方案项目提示词-3_163d8b
title: Packaging Design Project Prompt
prompt:
请为【{argument name="产品名称" default="奶粉"}】生成一张“手绘包装提案板风格”的产品介绍海报。 

如果我提供了产品图片，请以该图片为主要参考，保留产品的核心外观特征、包装形态、颜色、材质、品牌识别和整体气质，并优先沿用产品图中的主色调与配色关系进行设计。
如果我没有提供产品图片，请根据【{argument name="产品名称" default="奶粉"}】自动生成符合该产品定位的产品外观与包装设计，并根据产品属性、品类特征和气质，自动搭配自然合理的主色、辅助色和背景色。

海报整体风格要求：
这不是普通电商详情页，也不是单纯棚拍海报，而是一张融合“产品成品图 + 包装设计草图 + 品牌概念开发过程”的创意提案板。整体呈现为高审美、高完成度的品牌设计展示图，像设计师正在展示一个包装概念方案。

画面要求：
- 竖版构图
- 使用统一且有品牌感的主色调背景，背景颜色根据产品本身自然决定，不固定为某一种颜色
- 配色应与产品属性协调：如果有参考图，优先继承参考图的主色和品牌色；如果没有参考图，则根据产品名称自动生成合理的色彩方案
- 画面中央放置一个最完整、最吸睛的产品主视觉，具有真实质感、立体光影和商业成品效果
- 产品周围加入多个辅助视觉元素：不同角度的包装草图、结构草图、局部造型探索、手持展示小稿、包装展开思路、品牌字样排版试验
- 加入自然随性的黑色或深色手绘线稿、箭头、圈画、符号、手写中文批注，让画面具有强烈“设计过程感”和“创意提案感”
- 成品图要相对精致真实，草图部分要相对随性灵动，形成“完成品 + 设计草图”的对比
- 版式看起来松弛自由，但整体要有秩序、有节奏、有视觉中心，体现高级平面设计感
- 可以适度加入与产品相关的小图形、小符号或趣味元素，增强品牌记忆点
- 最终效果应具有品牌感、创意感、过程感和视觉冲击力

配色原则：
- 不要固定黄色背景
- 要根据产品类型、材质、用途、消费感受和品牌气质自动选择主色调
- 背景色、产品色、文字色、草图线稿色应彼此协调
- 可以使用高饱和单色背景，也可以使用柔和统一色系背景，只要整体有品牌感和视觉冲击力
- 色彩应自然服务于产品，而不是喧宾夺主

风格关键词：
包装设计提案板、品牌概念开发、手绘草图、设计过程感、moodboard、创意评审稿、产品成品渲染、视觉实验、商业设计海报

请特别注意：
- 如果有参考产品图，优先遵循参考图，不要偏离产品本身
- 如果没有参考图，则根据产品名称自动生成合理的产品外观、包装和配色方案，并保持整体风格统一
- 画面重点是“产品介绍 + 创意设计过程展示”
- 不要做成普通电商详情页，不要做成促销海报，不要过度整齐呆板，不要缺少草图和手写批注，不要廉价感，不要低幼卡通感

slug: 国际米兰转会官宣海报-电影级球员加盟设计-7_6c53fc
title: Inter Milan Transfer Officer Announces Poster | Cinematic Grade Player Joining Design

prompt: 一张极具戏剧性的竖版足球转会官宣海报，主题为 {argument name="player name" default="Erling Haaland"} 加入 {argument name="club name" default="Inter Milan"}。设计采用深色、高对比度的黑色与电光蓝配色，呈现出粗犷的电影级体育海报风格。构图包含同一球员的 2 层肖像：上方左侧为一个超大的半身特写，侧脸向上仰望，留着利落的金色短发丸子头，两侧剃短；下方中心为一个半身动作肖像，身穿俱乐部标志性的蓝黑条纹主场球衣，单手食指向上做出胜利手势。人物需具备强壮的运动员体格、强烈的英雄气场，运用轮廓光、深邃阴影、细腻的皮肤纹理和亮泽的发丝高光。球衣胸前应包含白色赞助商文字标识、一个小型的白色钩状 Logo、圆形俱乐部徽章以及三色盾牌补丁。在球员身后，放置一个巨大的发光圆形国际米兰风格徽章图形作为背景。总共添加 3 个可见的俱乐部 Logo：右上角 1 个小 Logo，左下角 1 个大型旗帜 Logo，以及球衣上的 1 个徽章。底部中心融入现代足球场的夜景，明亮的泛光灯与蓝色的绘画烟雾及笔触效果交织在一起。画面中心横跨球员姓氏，采用巨大的粗犷手绘字体，部分被人物遮挡，右侧配有一个巨大的手写风格数字"9"。在设计周围添加 8 处文字元素：顶部中心小字"INTER MILAN"；左上方堆叠的球员姓名及蓝色"9"；左侧中部口号"NATO PER SEGNARE"；右侧垂直文字"I M INTER"；右侧中部口号"FORZA INTER PER SEMPRE"；右下方城市名"SAN SIRO"；右下方小字"MILANO ITALIA"；底部中心小字"1908"和"LA BENEAMATA"。此外，在左上方肖像附近添加 1 个白色的签名涂鸦。背景应为黑色颓废纹理、蓝色墨水溅射、划痕、烟雾和放射状光线的层叠拼贴，呈现出高级社交媒体体育海报的质感，超高细节、锐利、充满活力，随时可用于足球模因或球迷转会官宣。

In the center, a single chibi-like fairy woman is the star, floating toward the viewer in a dynamic forward-reaching pose with one oversized hand extended in forced perspective. She has short wavy auburn-brown hair, pointed elf ears, large iridescent translucent butterfly wings, a sparkling silver beret, a fitted white shimmering top, a short holographic metallic skirt, and glowing white shoes. Her face area is deliberately obscured by a centered square censor block in warm brown. Behind her, explosions of particles, sparks, comet streaks, and radiant lens-flare energy create a sense of destiny and impact. The composition is packed like a blockbuster teaser poster, with glowing Japanese typography and social-media-style callout panels arranged around the character. At the very top, large luminous Japanese text reads: 「そのひと言が、誰かの明日を燃やす。」. Across the upper left is 1 profile card panel showing a circular avatar, a Japanese display name with blue verification badge, handle, bio text, link, and follower count, styled like an X profile screenshot. On the left side there are 3 additional stacked callout panels: panel 1 says 「フォロワー 11,000+人 いつもありがとう！」 with a follower icon; panel 2 says 「今日のAI解説 生成AIってなに？ 初心者向けやさしく解説」 and includes a thumbnail card with small engagement counts; panel 3 says 「アイデア → 作品へ AI × 創造力で あなただけの物語を。」 with small creative tool icons. On the right side there are 5 glowing speech-bubble panels with icons, each angled slightly and rim-lit in orange: 1 「わかりやすい AI解説！ 神です…！」 with a heart icon, 2 「元気をもらえる！ いつも励み！」 with a smiley icon, 3 「作品づくりの勇気が出る！ 背中を押された！」 with a star icon, 4 「AIで好きが形になる！ アイデアが広がる！」 with a camera icon, 5 「制作の真価 プロの現場から学ぶ AI活用テクニック」 with a clapperboard icon. Across the lower middle, add a handwritten glowing phrase in blue-white: 「想いを カタチに。」. Below it, the giant main title in blazing molten brush-style Japanese lettering reads: 「未来は、つくれる。 タイムラインの 妖精アーヤ」, with an English subtitle underneath in small serif capitals: “FAIRY AYA OF THE TIMELINE”. Beneath the title, add dense film-credit style lines in Japanese, including creator/AI/video references, then a centered starring line: 「主演：妖精アーヤ」 with small wings. At the very bottom, place a huge release notice in bold glowing Japanese text: 「近日公開」, and to its right a rounded dark plaque with gold border that says: 「未来は、つくれる。」. Add a small butterfly emblem near the lower right. The whole image should feel like a magical viral social-media celebrity transformed into the lead of an epic fantasy film, with explosive contrast, richly textured particles, neon embers, glossy poster finish, and premium theatrical key art for {argument name="character name" default="妖精アーヤ"}.

title: Spiritual Buddhist Pure Land Scene
prompt:
西方极乐世界（又称西方净土、安乐国），是阿弥陀佛（无量寿佛）的佛土，核心特点是无有众苦、但受诸乐，与我们这个 “堪忍”（婆婆）世界形成鲜明对比。
在我们世界的西方，距离十万亿佛土之遥（《阿弥陀经》）。

佛主：教主阿弥陀佛（无量光、无量寿），常住说法；左右胁侍为观世音菩萨、大势至菩萨，合称 “西方三圣”。

国土环境：七宝庄严，完美无瑕
大地：黄金为地，平坦柔软、光明洁净，无山川沟壑、荆棘土石。
七宝池与八功德水：
遍地七宝池（金、银、琉璃、玻璃、砗磲、赤珠、玛瑙）。
池水具八功德：甘、冷、软、轻、清、香、饮时、饮已，能除烦恼、润身悦心。
池底金沙，阶道七宝，池中莲花大如车轮，青、黄、赤、白，各放光明。
建筑：七宝楼阁、宫殿、讲堂，浮空而起、随心大小，光明通透，胜过天界无数倍。
宝树与天乐：
七重行树、七重栏楯、七重罗网，皆四宝所成。
风吹宝树罗网，出微妙法音，如百千乐同时俱作，闻者自然生念佛、念法、念僧之心。
气候与天雨：无寒暑、无风雨，永远温和舒适；昼夜六时，天雨曼陀罗花，缤纷铺落，香气芬芳。
奇禽：白鹤、孔雀、鹦鹉、迦陵频伽等，皆佛变化所作，出和雅音，宣说佛法，令众生常生善念。

众生：无苦唯乐，寿命无量
往生方式：众生由七宝池莲花化生，非父母胎生，无生老病死之苦。
身形：紫磨金色身，相好庄严，与阿弥陀佛相似；具天眼、天耳、他心、宿命、神足五通，自在无碍。
寿命：无量无边阿僧祇劫，几乎永恒，无夭折衰老。
心性：皆是诸上善人，无贪嗔痴、无嫉妒争斗，人人慈悲平等、智慧清净，常闻佛法、不退菩提。
生活：衣食自然化现，不需劳作；清晨可赴他方十万亿佛土供养诸佛，食时即返，自在无碍。

时间与空间：无限永恒
时间：无昼夜、无年月，永恒安乐，世界无 “成住坏空” 之变。
空间：广大无边，十方众生尽往亦不拥挤；一微尘可纳三千大千世界，事事无碍。

prompt: 创作一张精致的小红书风格中国旅行信息图海报，采用柔和的水彩地图美学，方形格式，展示一条穿越中国的五天高铁旅行路线。左上角为醒目的毛笔书法标题：{argument name="headline text" default="五一出行计划"}。在其正下方，添加一条带有白色中文字符的绿色丝带副标题：{argument name="route text" default="广州→湖南→武汉→北京"}。在副标题下方添加一行较小的中文文字：“一路向北·发现中国之美”。背景为米色和浅鼠尾草绿色的中国中北部淡彩插画地图，带有淡淡的山脉纹理、柔和的河流以及角落处微妙的花卉装饰。一条垂直弯曲的铁路线从底部中心向上延伸至顶部中心，连接 4 个城市，并配有橙红色定位针和醒目的红色中文城市名称。从下到上依次为：广州、湖南、武汉、北京。沿途在轨道上放置白色小型高铁图标，并标注 3 个绿色旅行时间标签：“广州→湖南 高铁约 2.5 小时”、“湖南→武汉 高铁约 1.5 小时”以及“武汉→北京 高铁约 4.5 小时”。在每个城市附近，包含一个风景拼贴画或地标插画群：广州配以现代天际线和广州塔；湖南配以青山和人文景观；武汉配以黄鹤楼和历史建筑；北京配以紫禁城/皇家宫殿建筑。在城市插画附近添加小型风景标签，文字分别为“花城广州·美食之都”、“山水湖南·人文荟萃”、“江城武汉·英雄之城”和“中国首都·历史与现代交融”。在主标题下方，均匀排列 4 个极简图标徽章，并配有简短的中文标签：相机图标标注“精选景点”，火车图标标注“高铁直达”，行李箱图标标注“轻松出行”，星形图标标注“美食推荐”。在地图周围，放置 4 张圆角矩形行程卡片，配有绿色标题、奶油色背景和照片缩略图。每张卡片必须包含每日计划、一个推荐景点的星标部分，以及一个推荐美食的星标部分。4 张卡片分别为：1) 右上角卡片标题“北京｜2 天”，包含 2 行日期、4 个景点缩略图和 1 张美食照片；2) 右侧中间卡片标题“武汉｜1.5 天”，包含 2 行日期、4 个景点缩略图和 1 张美食照片；3) 左侧中间卡片标题“湖南｜2 天”，包含 2 行日期、4 个景点缩略图和 1 张美食照片；4) 左下角卡片标题“广州｜1 天”，包含 1 行日期、4 个景点缩略图和 1 张美食照片。行程文字填充采用实用的小红书风格中文旅行计划文案。在右下角，添加一个圆角备注面板，包含 2 个绿色标题的板块：“行程亮点”和“出行小贴士”。在“行程亮点”下，列出 4 个带有小图标标记的要点。在“出行小贴士”下，列出 4 个带有小图标标记的要点。在备注区域装饰一个小型行李插画，并以绿色手写风格斜体书写中文短语，例如“出发吧！去感受春天的风景”。在底部中心，放置一个小型圆角总结栏，标题为“行程总览”，包含 4 个带图标的总结项：总时长“总时长：约 6.5 天”、总里程“总里程：约 2100 公里”、推荐交通“推荐交通：高铁”以及最佳出行时间“最佳出行时间：4.29 - 5.5”。在左下角前景处，放置一列大型流线型白色高铁，呈对角线向上倾斜，作为视觉焦点部分重叠边框。在火车附近添加书法风格的结束语：“最美的风景在路上 最好的时光在五一”。使用优雅的橄榄绿、鼠尾草绿、米色和暖红色调，将中国传统旅行海报的魅力与现代信息图的清晰度相结合，确保排版清晰、阴影柔和、卡片圆润、照片插入自然，并保持整洁的编辑布局。

title: Vintage Rosemary Chronicles Grid
prompt:
Goal: Create a vintage botanical photo-chronicle contact sheet titled {argument name="headline text" default="The Slow Garden: A Rosemary Chronicle"}, documenting the life cycle of {argument name="plant name" default="rosemary"} from dry pot to harvest.

Canvas: Square 1:1 poster on warm aged parchment paper, subtle stains and speckles, soft cream background, thin dark-green panel borders, handwritten field-journal typography. Use a large decorative serif/calligraphy headline centered at the top.

Layout: Arrange exactly 12 photographic panels in a clean 4-column by 3-row grid. Each panel has a handwritten green stage label above it, a short uppercase camera-direction caption below it, and an italic poetic quote beneath the caption. Add small downward arrow marks along the far left and far right margins to suggest time passing.

Panel details, count exactly 12:
1. Stage label: "Dormancy". Image: a terracotta pot on a windowsill filled with cracked dry soil, no plant visible. Caption: "WIDE · OVERHEAD · FIXED CAMERA". Quote: "Winter's silence, the seed waits."
2. Stage label: "Dormancy". Image: macro view of a terracotta pot rim and dark soil with a single water droplet running down the clay side. Caption: "MACRO · SLOW MOTION DROP". Quote: "First drop, awakening memory."
3. Stage label: "Germination". Image: low-angle close photo of a pale tiny shoot emerging from dark soil. Caption: "LOW ANGLE · TIME-LAPSE FEEL". Quote: "Root first, shoot later."
4. Stage label: "Germination". Image: close-up of a small cotyledon seedling with two green leaves rising from soil, soft bokeh background. Caption: "CLOSE-UP · COTYLEDON FOCUS". Quote: "Breaking ground, it took seven days."
5. Stage label: "Growth". Image: macro of young rosemary leaves with rim light, dew-like texture on needle edges. Caption: "MACRO · LEAF EDGE RIM LIGHT". Quote: "Every leaf, a map of aroma."
6. Stage label: "Growth". Image: close-up of a human fingertip gently touching a tender rosemary sprig. Caption: "CLOSE-UP · FINGERTIP CONTACT". Quote: "A gentle touch, handful of fragrance."
7. Stage label: "Growth". Image: overhead photo of a woody rosemary branch with green branching needles. Caption: "OVERHEAD · BRANCHING STRUCTURE". Quote: "One year bone, two years flesh."
8. Stage label: "Flourishing". Image: medium shot of a rosemary plant in a terracotta pot with small purple-blue flowers and a bee approaching or hovering near the blooms. Caption: "MEDIUM SHOT · BEE ENTRANCE". Quote: "When flowers open, the whole garden arrives."
9. Stage label: "Flourishing". Image: wide shot of rosemary on a rustic wooden surface in golden sunlight, strong leaf shadows across the boards. Caption: "WIDE · LIGHT & SHADOW CONTRAST". Quote: "Dialogue of light and leaf, repeated daily."
10. Stage label: "Flourishing". Image: close-up of pruning shears cutting a rosemary stem while a hand holds the sprig. Caption: "CLOSE-UP · SCISSORS & STEM". Quote: "Pruning is not an end, it's another beginning."
11. Stage label: "Harvesting". Image: medium shot of a bundled rosemary bunch hanging upside down in a rustic shed or wooden room to dry. Caption: "MEDIUM SHOT · HANGING DRY". Quote: "Drying time, leave it to the wind."
12. Stage label: "Harvesting". Image: wide still-life composition with dried rosemary spilling from a small linen drawstring pouch beside a terracotta pot. Caption: "WIDE · STILL LIFE COMPOSITION". Quote: "Aroma sealed, awaiting the next awakening."

Visual style: Photorealistic macro garden photography mixed with hand-crafted editorial scrapbook design, shallow depth of field, soft natural window light, earthy terracotta browns, rosemary greens, muted purple blossoms, warm sunlight, gentle film grain, slightly imperfect handwritten annotations.

Constraints: Keep the grid aligned and readable, use exactly 12 panels and no extra panels, avoid modern UI elements, avoid watermarks, avoid logos, preserve the vintage botanical journal feeling. Make all visible text legible and in English.

title: Industrial Humanoid Robot Blueprint
prompt:
月面基地で運用される {argument name="ロボットの種類" default="humanoid robot"} の三面図を作成してください。
正面、側面、背面の3ビューを、同じ縮尺・同じデザインで、横並びに整理して表示してください。
背景は白またはごく薄いグレーで、資料用のクリーンな三面図にしてください。

デザインは、{argument name="デザインテイスト" default="シャープで情報量の多い日本のリアルロボット系メカデザイン"}。
細身すぎず、実用機らしい説得力があり、軍用と作業用の中間のような雰囲気。
ガンダムにはしないでください。
あくまでオリジナルの月面基地用ロボットにしてください。

ロボットの特徴：
・二足歩行の人型ロボット
・頭部は小さめで、精密機械らしいセンサーバイザーまたは単眼風センサー
・顔は人間的すぎず、無機質で知的
・肩、胸、腰、脚部にパネルラインや分割構造があり、精密感がある
・脚部はしっかりした関節構造で、月面移動に適した安定感を持つ
・腕はやや長めで、手は5本指マニピュレーター
・バックパックまたは背面ユニットを装備し、通信・電源・姿勢制御用の機能がありそうな構造
・過剰な武装は不要
・武器は持たせない
・月面基地での巡回、警備、補助作業、外部活動支援に使われる実用ロボット

デザインテイスト：
・{argument name="配色" default="白、ライトグレー、ダークグレーを基調"}
・差し色に控えめな赤またはオレンジ、少しだけ青系アクセント
・宇宙服や月面機材と調和する清潔感のある配色
・工業製品としての説得力
・エッジの効いたシルエット
・細かいディテール、精密な機構、パネルライン、注意表示などを少し入れる
・未来感はあるが、リアル寄りで地に足のついたメカ表現

三面図としての要件：
・正面、側面、背面を明確に分ける
・全身が見切れずに入る
・ポーズは直立のニュートラルポーズ
・各ビューで形状の違いが分かるようにする
・資料性重視
・余計な背景演出は不要
・爆発、アクション、煙など不要
・キャラクターではなく、設定資料のような見せ方

prompt:
Goal: Create a Pixar-style 3D animated storyboard sheet as one single image showing a warm, cozy home-office scene with a young woman and a chubby golden-orange cat interacting around a desk.

The room has sunlit windows, bookshelves, plants, desk lamp, laptop, wooden desk, and a ceramic mug.

Characters: A young adult woman with messy curly brown hair in a loose bun, wearing an oversized cream cable-knit sweater; her face is intentionally covered by a flat brown rectangular privacy block in every panel where it appears. A plump golden-orange British Shorthair-like cat with cream muzzle and belly, short legs, round face, folded-looking rounded ears, fluffy tail, and slightly grumpy but cute expressions. The cat is {argument name="cat color" default="golden-orange"}; the woman wears {argument name="sweater color" default="cream"}.

Panel layout, exactly six panels:
1. Top-left panel: Side view of the woman typing on a laptop at the desk while the orange cat stands on the desktop beside her, looking toward her hands. Warm sunlight from the window behind them; bookshelves in the background.
2. Top-right panel: The cat sits proudly on the laptop keyboard in front of the screen, facing forward with a smug expression, while the woman sits beside it with arms folded or resting on the table. A mug is visible on the right.
3. Middle-left panel: The woman gently lifts the cat under its front legs from the desk, holding it up at chest height. The cat dangles with a displeased, stiff posture; laptop and mug remain on the desk.
4. Middle-right panel: Tight dramatic close-up composition split by the panel crop: the woman’s face area at left is mostly hidden by a large vertical brown privacy rectangle, and the cat’s face fills the right side in an extreme close-up with narrowed eyes and an annoyed expression.
5. Bottom-left panel: Intimate close-up of the woman leaning close to the cat, nuzzling or kissing its head while holding it near her face. The cat’s eyes are closed, soft and resigned; the woman’s face is again obscured by a brown rectangular block.
6. Bottom-right panel: The cat is back on the wooden desk near the laptop and mug, reaching one paw toward or onto the mug with a mischievous grumpy stare, while the woman is partly visible at the right with her face covered by a brown rectangle.

Privacy blocks: Add exactly six flat opaque brown rectangular face-censor blocks: one on the woman’s face in each of the six panels, including one large vertical block in the middle-right close-up panel. Match the warm brown tone of the scene, with no blur or pixelation.

Constraints: Maintain the exact 2x3 storyboard grid and exactly six panels; keep all panels visually consistent as the same room, same woman, same cat, same desk setup. Do not add text, speech bubbles, extra panels, subtitles, or visible brand marks. Make the cat’s expression the main emotional focus, progressing from curious to smug, annoyed, affectionate, and mischievous.

title: Portrait of Suzhou Garden Qipao
prompt:
Authentic daily life photography, natural candid moment. A three-quarter length portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young woman"} mid-stride on a narrow wooden zigzag bridge (九曲桥) crossing a classical {argument name="location" default="Suzhou garden lotus pond"}. She is in a gentle walking pause — one foot slightly ahead, gaze turned downward toward the water. Large dark-green lotus leaves spread below, rain-beaded at their edges; the water between shows a pale sky reflection. An age-darkened low wooden balustrade runs at her right.
East Asian young woman in her early 20s. Almond-shaped eyes cast downward with a small thoughtful expression — neither smiling nor unsmiling, simply present and absorbed. Straight refined nose. Fair skin in the cool morning garden light. Elegant upswept chignon with two thin crossed hairpins at the crown, a small white flower tucked near the ear. Light elegant makeup — near-bare coverage, lips in a barely-tinted neutral. Skin subsurface scattering visible even in the cooler morning light, a faint internal warmth at the cheeks, specular micro-highlights subdued and soft, fine foundation powder grain perceptible.
She wears a sleeveless modern-improved qipao in {argument name="qipao color" default="pale sage-green"} — a muted, slightly dusty bamboo tone, not saturated — mandarin collar with pale grey-green frog closures, the skirt cut with a slightly more generous soft drape falling to mid-calf. Both hands are relaxed at her sides, the right near the balustrade. The wooden bridge planks are dark with age and moisture; the lotus pond fills the lower background, the round leaves layered in lush summer abundance. The far bank shows grey garden wall stone and the suggestion of weeping willow. Two or three stray hairs at her temple have been gently displaced by the water-garden air, their small curves irregular and soft.
Morning light is directional from the left — a cool-warm transition of early day, casting long gentle shadows across the bridge planks and catching the outer edges of lotus leaves below. Water surface reflections add a secondary scattered fill — pale and diffused — softening the shadow areas beneath the bridge rail and giving the scene a particularly gentle luminosity. The overall mood is peaceful and unhurried, the garden in a private morning moment. Subtle ISO 400 film grain in the shadow areas of the lotus pond and darker bridge wood tones, photographic noise texture not CG render smoothness. Aspect ratio 2:3. No watermark, no text overlay, not cartoon, not digitally painted, not illustration, not anime.

title: Floating Night Market
prompt:
Goal: Create a richly detailed fantasy concept art scene of a floating night market above the clouds, blending steampunk airships, sky docks, and colorful bazaar tents.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 composition, cinematic wide-angle view, high fantasy digital painting with painterly realism, deep perspective, dramatic scale, no text or watermark.

Setting and atmosphere: A vast aerial marketplace suspended among thick white clouds at twilight or night. The sky is dark navy and stormy overhead, with heavy rolling clouds, while a pale glowing horizon cuts across the middle distance. The mood should feel magical, bustling, and slightly mysterious, with warm lantern light contrasting against cool blue moonlit clouds.

Layout: Foreground and lower half filled with wooden market platforms, bridges, railings, stalls, hanging fabric canopies, and crowds. Midground opens into a cloud-filled gap with more floating docks and ships. Background shows distant clouds and flying vessels receding into haze.

Counted major elements: Include exactly 3 visible airships: 1 large oval zeppelin-like ship on the upper left with a dark wooden gondola and many rigging cables, 1 smaller distant airship centered in the background, and 1 very large balloon-and-gondola airship docked on the upper right with a round vertical envelope, ropes, masts, and a projecting gangway. Include exactly 5 main market areas: 1 lower-left stall cluster beneath dark blue striped canvas, 1 center-lower wooden dock with lanterns and figures, 1 right-lower covered bazaar with striped awnings and food stalls, 1 middle-left floating market platform in the clouds, and 1 upper-right docked platform beside the large airship. Include many small human figures as a dense crowd of merchants and shoppers, but keep them tiny and atmospheric rather than portrait-like.

Subject details: Wooden floating piers should appear suspended in the sky with no visible ground, supported by fantasy engineering and partly hidden by clouds. Stalls sell spices, fruits, fabrics, trinkets, baskets, and glowing objects. Add draped cloth awnings in deep blue, teal, red, orange, purple, and gold. Use numerous warm hanging lanterns and street lamps throughout the scene, especially along railings and stall fronts. Add ropes, pennant strings, crates, barrels, tables, ladders, poles, and rigging to increase detail.

Visual style: Epic fantasy illustration, highly detailed, atmospheric lighting, ornate steampunk airship design, warm golden lantern glow, cool blue shadows, volumetric clouds, cinematic depth, intricate market clutter, painterly brushwork, sharp focal detail in the lower market and softer distant background.

Customization: The scene should depict {argument name="market name" default="a floating night market above the clouds"} with {argument name="airship style" default="steampunk zeppelin airships"}, illuminated by {argument name="lighting mood" default="warm golden lanterns against a stormy blue night sky"}, with canopies in {argument name="canopy colors" default="deep blue, teal, red, orange, purple, and gold"}, and populated by {argument name="crowd type" default="tiny fantasy merchants, travelers, and shoppers"}.

Constraints: No modern buildings, no cars, no aircraft with wings, no readable signage, no sci-fi neon, no empty market; keep the image grand, dense, and vertical with the airships clearly above and behind the crowded bazaar.

title: Tim Cook MMO Group Boss Screen
titleEn: Tim Cook MMO Group Boss Screen
prompt: Create a cinematic fantasy MMO raid boss loading-screen-style illustration with a full custom game UI overlay. The scene is set at dusk in front of the glass cube Apple Store, with the glowing white Apple logo centered on the building facade. In the middle of the plaza stands a giant raid boss version of {argument name="boss name" default="Tim Cook"}, labeled as "The Architect," wearing a fitted black turtleneck, dark pants, and sneakers, holding a glowing smartphone in one hand and posing calmly with the other hand open. His face is intentionally blurred or anonymized. The overall tone is epic, satirical, and high-production, like a World of Warcraft raid encounter screen mixed with corporate tech parody. Around him, exactly 20 fantasy raiders in a semicircle battle formation face inward toward the boss, with varied races and silhouettes including armored warriors, rogues, mages, shamans, hunters, and orc-like and human-like characters. Several are casting bright spells in orange fire, blue lightning, green energy, and purple void magic. Include exactly 3 small robotic adds near the boss, each labeled "Supplier Add," with squat industrial bodies and Apple logos on their fronts. Also include 2 active encounter mechanic bubbles: one blue spherical shield labeled "Margin Shield" on the right side of the boss, and one purple circular dome labeled "Closed System" farther right with a humanoid enemy trapped inside. Build the image as a complete raid UI composition. Top left: a large expansion-style title reading "SIEGE OF THE INFINITE LOOP" with subtitle "20-MAN HORDE RAID." Far left: a vertical "RAID FRAMES" panel listing exactly 20 player names in numbered rows from 1 to 20 with colored health bars. Top center: a boss portrait frame with the boss name {argument name="boss name" default="Tim Cook"}, subtitle "The Architect," and a red health bar at 100%. Top right: a large encounter guide panel titled "ENCOUNTER: {argument name="boss name" default="TIM COOK"} – \"THE ARCHITECT\"" containing exactly 3 phases. Phase 1 title: "SUPPLY CHAIN DOMINANCE (100% – 70%)" with 3 abilities: "Logistics Surge – Summons waves of Supplier Adds.", "Margin Shield – Reduces incoming damage by 40% for 10 sec.", and "Quarterly Pressure – Stacking debuff, explodes if not dispelled." Phase 2 title: "ECOSYSTEM LOCK-IN (70% – 30%)" with 3 abilities: "Closed System – Isolates 3 players, puzzle to return.", "Subscription Drain – Raid-wide damage over time.", and "Device Sync – Stack in correct formations to avoid spikes." Phase 3 title: "ONE MORE THING (30% – 0%)" with 3 abilities: "Surprise Launch – Massive AoE burst every 20 sec.", "Reality Distortion Field – Reverses controls briefly.", and "Enrage: Market Collapse – Boss enrages at 3:00." Bottom right: a "POTENTIAL LOOT" panel listing exactly 4 items with rarity-colored text: "Executive Cloak of Efficiency (Epic)", "Keynote Blade (Epic)", "Ecosystem Ring (Epic)", and "Investor's Favor (Bonus – Hard Mode)." Below that, add a small red-black badge reading "HARD MODE" and the line "Activate \"Investor Call\" during the fight to" with the remaining text cut off or obscured. Bottom left: a "CHAT" box with 4 lines, including taunting boss dialogue and a player response, such as "{argument name="boss quote" default="Tim Cook yells: Innovation. Discipline. Excellence. That is how we win."}", "Tim Cook yells: Our ecosystem is unbreakable.", "Tim Cook yells: One more thing...", and "Lok'tarbrok: Lok'tar ogar!" Along the bottom center: a fantasy action bar with exactly 12 ability icons in ornate slots, some numbered, some showing cooldown text including "2m" and "1m". Use dramatic volumetric lighting, glossy reflections on the wet plaza, realistic environment rendering, highly detailed fantasy characters, exaggerated spell effects, dark vignette, sharp UI typography, and polished AAA game key art composition.

prompt:
Goal: Create a high-end dark luxury advertising demonstration graphic for an AI image editor, showing a cosmetic serum ad being decomposed into editable layers.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 banner, deep navy-black background with gold light streaks, cinematic glossy lighting, premium beauty-brand mood, ultra-detailed photorealistic product rendering.

Layout: On the left, show one complete vertical finished poster inside a thin gold border. In the center, place a large glowing gold arrow pointing from the finished poster toward the editable composition. Across the top center, add the title “{argument name="software title" default="Reve 2.0"}” in large elegant serif gold-white lettering, with the subtitle “AI画像をレイヤー編集” beneath it in white. On the center-right, show the enlarged source model image: a woman in a dark satin evening dress photographed from behind with a shiny shoulder, hair rim-lit by warm light, city night bokeh behind her, and a large soft rectangular face-obscuring block over her face. On the far right, display separated editable layer elements floating with blue dashed selection boxes and small square resize handles.

Left finished poster details: The poster advertises “{argument name="product name" default="Noxellia 3X"}” with the English sublabel “NIGHT REPAIR SERUM.” It contains exactly 1 female model, 1 dark blue serum bottle with gold dropper, 1 pale gold flower accent, 1 nighttime city skyline background, and Japanese ad copy in white and gold. Include the large central Japanese headline “翌朝、艶印象が変わる。” in ornate serif type, small top copy “一晩で、肌の修復力を最大化する,” mid copy “高濃度ナイトリペアセラム,” and bottom supporting text “通常の3倍濃度の独自成分を、1滴に凝縮。” The woman’s face in the poster is also covered by a soft rectangular blur/censor block.

Editable layer callouts: Show exactly 7 separate blue dashed selection rectangles with glowing cyan corner handles: 1 around the large central headline “翌朝、艶印象が変わる。”, 1 around the smaller central supporting sentence “通常の3倍濃度の独自成分を、1滴に凝縮。”, 1 around the top-right Japanese phrase “一晩で、肌の修復力を最大化する”, 1 around the right-side phrase “高濃度ナイトリペアセラム”, 1 around the isolated product bottle plus flower, 1 around a cropped city skyline strip, and 1 around a thin gold curved line near the bottom right.

Bottom feature row: Add exactly 3 gold icon-and-text feature blocks along the bottom of the central/right area: 1 droplet icon labeled “独自3倍濃度” with small explanatory Japanese copy, 1 crescent moon and stars icon labeled “夜の集中ケア” with small explanatory Japanese copy, and 1 bottle icon labeled “上質な所有感” with small explanatory Japanese copy.

Visual style: Luxury skincare advertising, black and midnight blue palette, champagne gold typography, sparkling lens flares, elegant serif Japanese type, glowing cyan UI handles, clean composition, realistic reflections on the serum bottle, glossy skin highlights, dramatic rim light, premium cosmetic campaign aesthetic.

Constraints: Keep all Japanese text legible and positioned as described, preserve the dark gold luxury look, use no watermarks or app chrome, make the layer boxes look like non-destructive editing overlays, and include exactly the counted elements and selection boxes.

title: Warring States vs Three Kingdoms crossover poster
titleEn: Warring States vs Three Kingdoms crossover poster
prompt:
A dramatic ultra-detailed vertical anime key visual poster showing a crossover war between Japan’s Sengoku era and China’s Three Kingdoms era, split exactly down the center by a glowing vertical beam of light. The left half is themed in crimson, magenta, ember orange, and cherry blossom pink, representing {argument name="left faction title" default="日本戦国"}; the right half is themed in jade green, teal, cyan, gold, and stormy blue, representing {argument name="right faction title" default="中国三国"}. At the center, large vertical Japanese calligraphy reads {argument name="center slogan" default="時空を越え、宿命が交錯する。"}. The composition is dense, cinematic, and symmetrical, like a premium game or movie crossover poster, with dozens of sparks, petals, glowing particles, motion streaks, and layered background architecture.

On the left side, depict 4 distinct Sengoku-themed warriors. At the top left, a stern samurai warlord in ornate black and deep red armor with gold trim, long dark hair tied high and blowing in the wind, shown in a powerful upper-body portrait facing inward; behind him are sakura blossoms, banners, and stacked Japanese castles illuminated with neon-magenta highlights. Mid-left, show 1 battle-hardened older general with wild silver hair, heavy layered armor, and a fierce glare, partially emerging from the fortress cityscape. Lower-left, show 1 aggressive crimson-clad warrior lunging forward with sweeping cloth, horned or antler-like helmet ornamentation, and dynamic red-black armor. At the bottom-left foreground, show 1 dominant swordsman in demonic samurai armor with a crescent-moon helmet crest and glowing red eyes, gripping a katana angled diagonally downward, surrounded by embers and petals. A vertical banner near the upper-left edge displays the Japanese text 日本戦国.

On the right side, depict 4 distinct Three Kingdoms-themed heroes. At the top right, show 1 regal strategist-emperor figure in elaborate blue, black, and gold ceremonial armor with a tall crown-like headdress, shown in upper-body profile facing inward; behind him rises a luminous spectral dragon made of water, cloud, and light. Mid-right, show 1 long-bearded green-robed general with a tall headpiece and lamellar armor, solemn and heroic, framed by neon-lit city structures and swirling magical energy. Slightly below center-right, show 1 elegant strategist-scholar holding an opened feather fan, wearing layered robes and gold ornaments, calm and calculating. At the lower-right edge, show 1 roaring armored warrior with a fierce expression and windblown hair. In the bottom-right foreground, make the dominant figure a green-and-gold armored hero extending a glowing jade-green sword toward the viewer, with flowing robes and luminous energy ribbons curling around the blade. A vertical banner near the upper-right edge displays the Chinese text 中国三国.

Blend historical East Asian war aesthetics with futuristic cyberpunk megacity elements: Japanese pagodas and fortresses on the left, neon skyscrapers and glowing urban lights across both halves, flying fortress silhouettes and distant airborne warships in the sky, magical lightning, smoke, and storm clouds overhead. The sky transitions from sunset violet and rose on the left to stormy turquoise and silver on the right. Use hyper-detailed painterly anime illustration, intricate armor textures, metallic reflections, volumetric lighting, high contrast, epic scale, and intense atmosphere.

At the bottom, add huge stylized title typography: on the left, massive fiery kanji 戦国 with the romanization SENGOKU beneath it; in the middle, a metallic gold VS; on the right, massive jade-glowing kanji 三国 with the romanization SANGOKU beneath it. Below that, add a smaller centered subtitle line reading SENGOKU VS SANGOKU, and beneath it a Japanese tagline: {argument name="bottom tagline" default="時空を超え、英雄たちの戦いが始まる。"}. Poster layout, polished commercial promotional art, extremely detailed, high-impact, collectible poster aesthetic.

title: Riding Dragon Scroll Scholar
prompt: An ancient Chinese ink-and-wash style portrait on aged tan parchment, composed like a classical hanging scroll. A scholarly East Asian man in flowing gray-blue robes sits side-saddle atop a long serpentine Chinese dragon emerging through swirling clouds. His face is intentionally obscured by a flat rectangular blur block in parchment-brown tones. He has short dark curly hair and wears layered traditional robes with ornate patterned trim, a dark sash belt, and two modern OpenAI knot emblems worked into the costume: one printed on the chest and one on a round hand fan he holds upright in his right hand. His left hand rests near the dragon's mane as if holding the creature steady. The dragon is large and detailed, with blue-green scales, a pale underbelly, reddish-brown mane and fin accents, antler-like horns, whiskers, bared teeth, and a fierce expressive face in the lower left foreground, while its body coils upward to the upper right. Surround the figures with mist, stylized clouds, and steep craggy mountain peaks fading into the background. Add a vertical column of black Chinese calligraphy at the upper left and 3 red seal stamps near the lower part of the inscription area. The palette is muted, dusty, and antique: parchment beige, faded teal, moss green, smoky gray, sepia, and rust. Overall feeling: mythical, scholarly, dignified, slightly surreal, blending classical Chinese scroll painting with subtle modern AI iconography. Highly detailed brushwork, weathered paper texture, elegant composition, no border, full-frame vertical artwork.

title: Q Clone Sticker Diary
prompt:
Create a high-quality “{argument name="style" default="chibi clone sticker diary photo"}” based on the uploaded real-life image. Preserve the original person’s identity, face, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, body proportions, pose, lighting, and background. Do not alter facial features or turn the subject into a full illustration—maintain a realistic photo look.
Analyze the scene as a {argument name="activity" default="fitness/running"} lifestyle moment. Add 5–8 chibi mini clones of the same person around the subject, designed in a consistent kawaii sticker style (big head, small body, large expressive eyes, clean digital finish). Each clone must clearly resemble the real person (same hair, outfit, colors).
Design each chibi with different {argument name="action theme" default="running-related actions"} and emotions: jogging, stretching, drinking water, feeling tired, cheering, giving thumbs up, celebrating completion. Ensure all poses are unique and contextually relevant.
Render each chibi as a sticker with white outlines, soft shadows, and a slightly floating effect. Arrange them around the subject and edges without covering the face or main body.
Add light hand-drawn doodles (hearts, sparkles, arrows, motion lines, circles) in white with subtle pink accents, keeping a clean scrapbook diary feel.
Include 5–8 short handwritten-style phrases matching a fitness mood (cute, energetic, encouraging). Use mostly white text with slight pink highlights and small decorative marks.
Composition: keep the real person as the central focus, surrounded by chibi stickers and doodles. The result should feel like a polished, playful, high-resolution social media lifestyle diary image—clean, balanced, and visually rich without clutter.

title: 3D Chinese historical figures archive poster
prompt:
Goal: Create a cinematic vertical historical figure archive poster about {argument name="character name" default="班超"}, showing a heroic ancient Chinese frontier general breaking out of a documentary-style infographic layout.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster, 768 x 1024 feel, sepia-gold and smoky gray historical palette, dramatic backlight, dust, battlefield haze, high-detail 3D realism mixed with museum exhibition graphics.

Main subject: One full-body ancient Chinese armored commander stands in the center foreground, low-angle heroic composition. He wears layered dark lamellar armor, engraved belt plates, leather boots, red-brown cloak blowing leftward, and a stern dignified expression. His left arm thrusts forward toward the viewer holding a tall wooden command tablet engraved with Chinese calligraphy; his right hand holds a vertical staff or ceremonial standard with a tassel and Chinese characters. Make the figure feel three-dimensional, as if stepping out of the flat poster frame.

Background: Ancient Western Regions frontier setting with rocky desert ground, mountains in the distance, mounted soldiers and caravan silhouettes on the left, and a large fortified city gate on the right with banners, scaffolding, guards, and the gate plaque reading in Chinese. Add a large weathered war banner in the upper right. The atmosphere should suggest expedition, diplomacy, military command, and westward expansion.

Left typography block: Place very large black brush-calligraphy title text {argument name="main title text" default="班超"} vertically on the upper left. Beneath it, add smaller vertical Chinese biographical text describing birthplace, role, and lifespan, including the years 32—102. Add a small red seal stamp below the biographical block.

Floating archive cards: Add exactly 8 translucent glass-like historical event cards around the character, each with thin gold borders, tiny corner rivets, Chinese text, and monochrome documentary mini-illustrations. Count and place them as follows: 1) top center card, labeled 01 and 73, about joining the army after abandoning the brush; 2) left-middle card, labeled 02 and 73, about mission to the Western Regions; 3) top right card, labeled 03 and 91, about pacifying the northern Xiongnu; 4) right-middle card, labeled 04 and 95, about suppressing rebellion; 5) lower-left-middle card, labeled 05 and 96, about establishing the Protectorate of the Western Regions; 6) bottom-left card, labeled 06, about governing for forty years and uniting many states; 7) lower-right-middle card, labeled 07, about opening the Silk Road; 8) bottom-right card, labeled 08 and 102, about returning to Luoyang in old age. Each card should include a small faded illustration of cavalry, officials, soldiers, maps, or caravans.

Bottom timeline: Add exactly 6 timeline milestones along the bottom edge with a thin gold horizontal line, small dots, and Chinese labels: 32 birth, 73 joining army and mission west, 91 northern Xiongnu, 95 suppressing rebellion, 96 setting up the Protectorate, 102 successful return to Luoyang. Keep the timeline legible but secondary.

Visual style: Epic Chinese historical 3D poster, ultra-detailed armor textures, cinematic volumetric lighting, dust particles, depth of field, parchment-like overlays, museum archive infographic design, gold linework, realistic fabric motion, dramatic perspective.

Constraints: Use exactly one central historical figure, exactly 8 floating event cards, and exactly 6 bottom timeline milestones. Keep all visible text in Chinese calligraphy or Chinese serif style, with no English labels in the poster. Avoid modern objects, neon colors, cartoons, watermarks, or extra characters dominating the central figure.

Each label should have a short descriptive caption underneath and a small circular thumbnail image below it. title: Games on a Rainy Day Q Comics

prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical Japanese 4-panel manga comic about a cute chibi girl becoming even more excited when a rainy sports day is postponed.

Canvas: Tall vertical comic page in full color, approximately 9:16, with a white outer margin and thick black panel borders. Use exactly 4 stacked horizontal panels of equal width, manga-style composition, energetic expressions, glossy digital coloring, bold outlines, dramatic speed lines, sparkles, and sound effects.

Main character: A single chibi elementary-school girl named {argument name="character name" default="purple-haired girl"}. She has long wavy lavender-purple hair, pale skin, round gray eyes that turn into sparkling star eyes when excited, rosy cheeks, and a small open mouth. She wears a pale pink short-sleeve blouse with buttons, a light beige skirt, white socks, and simple shoes. Her pose is usually fists clenched near her chest in excitement or surprise.

Panel 1: School sports day setup under stormy clouds. Show the girl standing large in the center of a school athletic field, smiling with clenched fists and sparkles around her. Background includes a school building, Japanese flag, strings of international flags, a clock, a flower-decorated sports day arch labeled 「運動会」, tents, cones, bags, and lunch boxes. Add a large vertical speech bubble on the right with 「今日は運動会！」. At the very top outside or above the first panel, add the headline: {argument name="headline text" default="雨が空ごとプールに変わっても、楽しみは10倍に跳ね上がる！"}.

Panel 2: Indoor announcement scene. Show a wall-mounted gray loudspeaker on the left, a taped white notice below it reading 「雨で延期」, and the girl on the right in close-up looking shocked with a sweat drop, clenched fist, and wide open mouth. Add a speech bubble on the right reading 「延期!?」. Use beige indoor wall tones and manga burst lines radiating from her face.

Panel 3: Torrential rain on the sports field. Show the athletic field transformed into a shallow flooded pool under heavy rain, lightning, dark storm clouds, and dramatic water splashes. The girl stands in the foreground with star-shaped eyes and an amazed open mouth, holding a spiral-bound calendar that reads 「運動会（新しい日）」 with a large red circled 「7」 and 「日後！」 underneath. Add two sound effects: blue 「ザーッ」 for heavy rain on the left and orange 「ゴロゴロ」 for thunder on the upper right. Add a vertical speech bubble on the right reading 「あと7日!?」.

Panel 4: Extreme close-up celebration. Fill the panel with the girl's happy face, sparkling star eyes, open smiling mouth, and clenched fists. Use a hot pink and red radial burst background filled with yellow sparkles. Add one jagged speech bubble on the left containing 「100倍!!」 in red and 「楽しみ」 in black, meaning the excitement is multiplied.

Text count and placement: Include exactly 1 headline, exactly 4 comic panels, exactly 4 speech bubbles, exactly 1 taped notice, exactly 1 calendar page, exactly 2 manga sound effects, and exactly 1 sports day arch label. Preserve all Japanese text exactly as written. Avoid adding extra dialogue, captions, logos, watermarks, or additional characters.

Visual style: Cute Japanese chibi manga, bright saturated colors, clean black line art, expressive faces, playful dramatic exaggeration, polished webcomic look, high readability of all Japanese text.
