Goal: Create a dark, high-end gallery index page for a curated preset library of research paper figure styles, titled {argument name="headline text" default="研究论文图示"}. The interface should look like a polished web app screenshot showcasing academic diagram thumbnails.

Bottom partially visible card 3: title begins “LLM pretraining data mixture and downstream splits”, thumbnail with stacked area/data mixture blocks. Bottom partially visible card 4: title begins “Representative multi-head attention patterns in a 16-layer Transformer”, thumbnail with heatmaps.

Keep thumbnails varied but consistently white-background scientific figures.

Constraints: Preserve the Chinese interface labels and card titles as written. Do not add people, photos, watermarks, browser address bars, or decorative clutter. title: Dunhuang Mural Art Template
prompt:
请以 {argument name="主题" default="飞天神女"} 为核心，创作一幅 敦煌壁画风的高端艺术画作。画面采用 {argument name="构图方式" default="以主体角色为唯一主视觉核心"}，表现其核心动作 / 情境的神圣瞬间。整体氛围应为 {argument name="整体氛围" default="神圣、庄严、华丽"}，具有博物馆级审美、文化厚度与收藏级艺术感。

主体形象要求：
主体角色应呈现出优雅庄严、修长华贵、神性强烈的气质，姿态舒展，具有鲜明的敦煌壁画式神圣性与仪式感。面容需静穆、圣洁、含蓄、不可侵犯，带有敦煌壁画中神女 / 菩萨 / 飞天式的庄严气质，而不是普通古风美女。
发髻高挽，佩戴复杂精美的 金饰发冠、珠链步摇、耳饰、璎珞、臂钏、腰饰，服饰华丽，衣纹流畅，线条细劲有力，富有飞天韵律与宫廷级壁画质感。衣袂、飘带、裙摆与袖口应形成富有节奏感的流动曲线，强化神圣升腾感与画面韵律。

用金结构要求：
画面需强化 结构性用金，不是零散点金，而是形成明确的奢华秩序：
主体角色的发冠、首饰、衣缘、袖口、腰封、飘带边线、裙摆纹样采用 描金、泥金、鎏金、金线刺绣、残损金箔痕迹；
核心神圣元素，如月轮 / 佛光 / 法轮 / 宝盖 / 莲台、云纹、莲花花瓣、宝相花、藻井纹饰、团花纹、边框装饰也应带有 清晰可见但克制高级的金色装饰；
整体呈现 金碧辉煌但不俗艳、富丽精工但不廉价 的效果，表现出历经千年风化后仍保有金碧辉煌余韵的 残损奢华感。

色彩要求：
色彩以 赭红、朱砂、青绿、石青、石绿、土黄、象牙白 为主，辅以克制精致的 土金、鎏金。
整体色调要 浓郁、浑厚、古雅、贵气，避免轻飘糖水色。
背景可采用 背景主色氛围，如深邃石青天幕 / 温润古壁底色 / 暗金矿物底色与古壁肌理结合，衬托出主体的神圣与尊贵。

装饰元素要求：
画面可融入 飞天、莲花、宝相花、藻井、祥云、伎乐、团花纹、楼阁宫阙、法器、圣光圆轮、古典边框装饰 等典型敦煌视觉语言，但必须围绕主体集中分布，层级清晰，避免平均铺满全画面。
陪衬人物控制在 陪衬人数位即可，作为礼赞与陪衬，分布在主体周围或下方，形成朝向主体的仪式感动势。她们可陪衬动作，如持莲花 / 奏琵琶 / 吹笛 / 奉花 / 托灯 / 执幡，线条轻盈流动，与主体形成呼应，但不可喧宾夺主。

空间与构图要求：
构图中应保留适度的 云气空间、圣光留白、月光或天幕留白，让画面有呼吸感。
核心神圣元素需醒目、庄严、圆满，周围可有 鎏金光晕、圣光圆轮、细密金线轨迹，强化主题的神圣性。
远处可点缀远景元素，如月宫楼阁 / 云中宫阙 / 佛国建筑 / 仙界天幕，但不可过多，以增强空间层次与仙界气息。

材质表现要求：
需强调古老石窟壁画与矿物颜料肌理：
可见 斑驳、裂纹、风化、轻微剥落、历史包浆、粉化边缘、古壁肌理；
同时保留局部 描金、残损金箔、磨蚀后的鎏金光泽，形成 “旧而贵、残而华、古而神圣” 的高级艺术质感。
整体要求：华丽、细腻、神秘、庄严、统一、收藏级、艺术化、高级感极强。

负面约束词：
避免现代国潮风，避免商业插画感，避免普通古风美女插画，避免动漫感，避免网红审美，避免塑料质感，避免廉价土豪金，避免金色过亮过俗，避免荧光色，避免过度饱和，避免人物过多，避免背景元素过满，避免装饰平均铺满全画面，避免碎花感过重，避免视觉主次不清，避免主体不突出，避免低级堆砌感，避免平庸感，避免轻浮感，避免现代服装感，避免摄影感，避免3D建模塑料感。

title: Urban Street Market Comic Portrait
prompt:
Use the uploaded portrait as the identity reference for the subject’s face, hairstyle, facial structure, and overall impression.

Create a high-quality lifestyle editorial portrait of the same person sitting outdoors beside a wooden easel displaying a colorful street-style caricature portrait of them.

The real person and the caricature must clearly resemble the same individual.

Scene:
- the person is seated on a simple wooden folding chair
- beside them is a wooden easel holding a large caricature drawing
- the setting is a sentimental urban art market
- include illustration booths, handmade craft stalls, sketch displays, posters, cozy creative shopfronts, and a few softly blurred pedestrians
- lively but not crowded
- bright soft daylight, warm natural tones, shallow depth of field
- realistic photography for the person and environment
- vertical composition showing both the person and the caricature clearly

Subject:
- preserve the uploaded person’s recognizable identity
- natural pose
- calm, relaxed, slightly amused expression
- stylish casual outfit that suits the subject
- clean editorial lifestyle photography
- do not force the same pose or expression for every subject

Caricature direction:
- the drawing on the easel must be a true observational street caricature, not a generic cute cartoon
- the caricature artist should exaggerate the subject’s actual most recognizable facial traits

- analyze the uploaded face and exaggerate only 2–4 distinctive features, such as eye shape, eyebrows, nose, lips, cheeks, jawline, chin, ears, hairstyle, or facial proportions
- each caricature should feel custom-made for that specific person
- avoid using the same default cute face for every person
- avoid generic big eyes plus tongue-out expression
- the caricature should be funny because it captures the person’s unique features, not because it uses a random silly pose

Caricature style:
- oversized head with smaller simplified body
- playful but recognizable facial proportions
- bold hand-drawn marker lines
- quick sketchy pen strokes
- colored pencil texture
- lively street-artist energy
- humorous but flattering
- witty, expressive, and personality-driven
- charming handmade imperfections
- colorful accent doodles may be added, but keep the focus on the face

Expression in the caricature:
- choose a natural funny expression that fits the person’s facial character
- possible expressions: raised eyebrow, shy smile, surprised eyes, confident smirk, awkward polite smile, exaggerated calm face, pouty lips, confused cute face, or gentle blank stare
- the expression should vary depending on the subject
- do not always use a tongue-out face
- do not always use the same wide-eyed cute expression

Caricature canvas:
- large vertical drawing board or canvas on a wooden easel
- the caricature should be clearly visible and occupy a major part of the image
- it should immediately read as a funny street caricature

prompt:
生成一张 9:16 竖版餐饮品牌宣传单页设计图。

品牌名称为{argument name="品牌名称" default="「霸王茶姬 CHAGEE」"}，餐饮品类为{argument name="品类" default="「新中式茶饮 / 奶茶」"}，主打产品为{argument name="产品" default="「原叶鲜奶茶」"}。整体视觉风格为新中式高级茶饮品牌风格，融合东方青花瓷纹样、宋式留白、现代商业广告排版和年轻潮流茶饮传播感。

画面整体以米白色、宣纸白、青花蓝、深海军蓝、少量品牌红色作为主色系统，形成干净、高级、东方、清爽、有质感的视觉氛围。背景使用淡雅的东方水墨山水、青花瓷纹理、茶树枝叶、云雾、细腻纸张肌理作为装饰，不要杂乱，不要廉价拼贴。

顶部左侧放置清晰的品牌识别区：品牌名与英文副标，旁边可有简洁圆形东方女性头像 Logo 图形。顶部右侧加入一句品牌气质短句，例如「好茶为底，制出东方味」。

画面中上部放置超大标题：
「伯牙绝弦」
「一杯好茶」
标题使用高级东方宋体 / 书法感标题字，笔画有力量，清晰醒目，具有新中式茶饮广告气质。标题下方加入副标题：
「原叶鲜奶茶 · 喝出自然香」
或「原叶茶底 · 鲜奶现制 · 茶香清爽」。

画面右侧或中部为主视觉产品区，放置一大一小两杯品牌风格茶饮产品。主杯为外带纸杯，杯身带有青花瓷风格纹样、蓝白东方图案、品牌识别标志和 CHAGEE 字样；旁边放置一杯透明杯装奶茶，顶部可有坚果碎、奶盖或茶香颗粒装饰。奶茶颜色自然顺滑，质感新鲜，杯壁有轻微冷凝水和高光，整体看起来真实、清爽、好喝、有食欲感。

产品旁边加入 3 个卖点图标模块，图标为简洁线性风格：
1. 原叶茶底：精选高山原叶茶
2. 新鲜牛乳：真奶无奶精
3. 现点现做：新鲜现萃好茶

画面底部设置优惠转化区域，采用干净的横向信息卡片：
左侧突出优惠信息：

Visual style: Modern Japanese startup / enterprise SaaS design, polished vector UI, minimal gradients, soft shadows, rounded cards, thin teal data lines, navy headings, plenty of whitespace. Use a stylized geometric N logo in teal and navy, with spaced uppercase wordmark {argument name="service name" default="NOVALITH"}. Slide count and layout details: Include exactly 9 slides:
1. Cover slide. Large NOVALITH logo centered above the headline 「データを、未来の意思決定に変える。」 and subheading 「中小企業のためのデータ予測プラットフォーム」. Decorative teal diagonal accents in the corners.
2. Data integration slide. Headline 「すべてのデータをひとつに統合」 with short subtext about automatically collecting and integrating scattered data. Center shows a stacked isometric database/platform cube with the N logo on top. Four connected input/output cards: 「データベース」, 「CSV / ファイル」, 「SaaS」, 「API」.
3. Forecasting slide. Headline 「高精度な予測で未来を先読み」. Large line chart card titled 「売上予測（12ヶ月）」 with legend 「実績」 and 「予測」, months along the x-axis, an upward teal trend line, and a floating KPI card reading 「予測値（来期）¥28,450,000」.
4. Risk detection slide. Headline 「リスクを事前に検知し迅速に対応」. Left chart card titled 「リスクスコアの推移」 showing a declining zigzag teal line with dates 4/1 to 4/29 and y-axis levels 高, 中, 低. Add a warning callout 「リスク上昇を検知」. Right side has exactly 3 feature rows with circular icons: anomaly detection, alert notification, and rapid response.
5. Dashboard slide. Headline 「ダッシュボードで全体を見える化」. Show a full SaaS dashboard screenshot: dark navy left sidebar with logo and exactly 6 menu items, and a main area with KPI cards, a donut chart, and a sales forecast line chart. Visible KPI examples include 「売上予測（今月）¥28,450,000」, 「需要予測（今月）15,782」, and 「リスクスコア 24/100」.
6. Automated report slide. Headline 「レポートを自動生成し共有もかんたん」. Center a white report card titled 「月次サマリーレポート」 with bullet points showing positive percentages such as +18.6% and +12.4%, a NOVALITH logo in the corner, a teal bar chart on the right, and a teal button labeled 「レポートをダウンロード」.
7. Security slide. Headline 「セキュアな環境で安心して利用」. Central shield-and-padlock illustration with floating security particles. Bottom has exactly 3 security feature icons and labels: 「暗号化通信（SSL/TLS）」, 「アクセス制御（権限分割）」, and 「定期バックアップ（自動）」.
8. Simple steps slide. Headline 「シンプルなステップですぐに始められる」. Show exactly 4 horizontally connected step cards with dotted arrows: step 1 database icon 「データを接続」, step 2 node/network icon 「モデルを選択」, step 3 play icon 「予測を実行」, step 4 bar-chart icon 「結果を確認・活用」. Each card includes a short explanatory line underneath.
9. Closing CTA slide. Headline 「さあ、データの力で未来をつくりましょう」 with subtext 「NOVALITHが、あなたのビジネスの成長をデータで支えます。」. Large centered logo and wordmark. Bottom has exactly 2 call-to-action buttons: filled teal button 「無料で試してみる　→」 and outlined button 「資料をダウンロード　↓」.

Constraints: Maintain consistent brand colors, logo, spacing, slide numbering, and diagonal teal corner motif across all 9 slides. The overall image should look like a single polished overview sheet of presentation thumbnails, not isolated full-screen slides. Avoid extra slides, extra buttons, stock photos, watermarks, or unrelated text.

title: Mumbai Vintage Travel Poster
prompt: Create a vintage Art Deco travel poster for {argument name="city name" default="Mumbai"}, {argument name="country name" default="India"}. Use a vertical 2:3 poster canvas with a thin double-line border and aged paper texture in warm ochre, sepia, and sunset gold. At the very top, place huge bold condensed serif lettering reading “MUMBAI” in dark teal, spanning almost the full width. Directly below it on the left, add widely spaced uppercase red letters reading “INDIA”. Beneath that, include a simple line-art rising sun icon, then an italic tagline reading “The City That Never Sleeps.” and a small decorative divider with one centered dot. Under the divider, add coordinates text reading {argument name="coordinates" default="19.0760° N, 72.8777° E"}. The lower two-thirds should show a cinematic sunset view of the Gateway of India on the waterfront, rendered in realistic vintage-poster style: the monument is large on the right-center with its arches and turrets visible, glowing orange sky and clouds behind it, sun low near the horizon, shimmering water with small boats, and a curving seaside road along Marine Drive in the foreground. Include exactly one black-and-yellow vintage taxi on the road in the lower foreground, small city skyline buildings on the left background, palm trees, street lamps, a stone seawall, and scattered tiny pedestrians near the monument. Keep the typography clean and legible, with nostalgic grain, slightly faded ink, subtle halftone texture, and no modern objects, logos, or extra text.

Include exactly 2 large cream-colored rounded clouds, one on the left and one on the right. In the foreground, show a row of rounded green trees, a blue river or canal with small white ripples, and a cream-and-green cartoon train entering from the lower right on curved tracks, also with a smiling kawaii face and rosy cheeks. Apply a vintage comic-book print texture with visible halftone dots, slightly rough ink edges, saturated colors, playful proportions, and no photorealism.

title: Faceless Phoenix Knight Queen
prompt: Create a dark epic fantasy full-body portrait of {argument name="character name" default="a faceless female knight queen"} standing powerfully on a rain-soaked gothic castle balcony at sunset. She has very long windblown {argument name="hair color" default="fiery red hair"}, with the face intentionally obscured by a smooth featureless shadowed mask/blurred blank face. She wears ornate blackened steel plate armor with gold filigree, sharp layered pauldrons, engraved chestplate, chain details, ruby-red roses and glowing ember accents, over a deep crimson embroidered gown and a long black cloak lined with gold floral patterns. In her right hand she holds a flaming longsword angled down toward the wet stone floor, emitting bright orange sparks and molten light; in her left arm she carries a large black kite shield decorated with intricate gold tracery, red roses, and a blazing golden phoenix emblem. The background shows a sprawling medieval city and distant mountains under dramatic storm clouds, heavy rain streaks, and a low golden sun breaking through clouds on the left; a tall gothic cathedral or castle tower rises on the right with one visible crimson banner bearing a gold heraldic bird. Use cinematic high-fantasy realism, ultra-detailed armor, dramatic rim lighting, wet reflective cobblestones, glowing embers, volumetric sunset rays, dark romantic color palette of black, burgundy, gold, and fire orange. Vertical 2:3 composition, low slightly upward heroic angle, centered figure, sharp focus on the knight, no text, no watermark.

prompt:
Use the uploaded image as the only {argument name="identity reference" default="identity reference"} and transform the subject into a character rendered in the official {argument name="anime series" default="Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba"} anime TV series style. The visual execution must strictly match the Demon Slayer aesthetic, featuring clean and crisp linework, high quality cel shading, and saturated yet balanced colors with a polished TV series anime finish. Do not include any manga style sketching, cross hatching, grayscale, or black and white rendering. The subject's identity must be fully preserved, including their clothing design, hairstyle and hair color, accessories, skin tone, facial expression, and pose, with no replacements or removals of any items.
The existing outfit should be subtly stylized with Demon Slayer Corps inspired detailing, such as sharper fabric folds, slightly reinforced layered textures, and clean anime fabric finishes, while keeping the original outfit clearly recognizable. The character must follow accurate Demon Slayer proportions, including a lean and agile body type, natural anime anatomy, expressive anime eyes with strong highlights, stylized brows, and simplified anime nose and mouth.
The composition is critical and must show the character fully from head to toe, with feet, legs, torso, arms, and head all visible. The framing should not crop any part of the body, and the camera distance must be wide enough to capture the entire figure, leaving a small amount of empty space above the head and below the feet so the character fits comfortably within the frame. The output must be a single full body illustration with the character centered against a {argument name="background" default="plain white background only"}, with no ground plane, shadows, scenery, props, weapons, objects, effects, aura, particles, motion lines, or environmental details. The final image should contain only the character, and must not include cropped framing, multiple characters, multi panel outputs, other anime styles such as Dragon Ball, Naruto, or One Piece, photorealism, painterly or textured rendering, or any background elements or objects.

title: Anime Typhoon Live News Reporter
prompt:
Goal: Create a dramatic live television news still of an anime typhoon report in Kobe, Japan, combining a realistic stormy waterfront background with a cute anime reporter composited in the foreground.

Canvas: 16:9 horizontal broadcast frame, photorealistic rainy seaside city scene at dusk or early evening, grey-blue storm lighting, wet reflective pavement, rough ocean waves, heavy rain streaks, strong wind, dark clouds, distant skyline and harbor towers.

Main subject: A cute blonde anime girl news reporter stands slightly right of center on a waterfront promenade beside a black metal railing. She has very long blonde hair blown violently to the left by the wind, pink flower hair accessories, a determined reporting pose, and one arm extended toward the stormy sea. She holds a black handheld microphone in her other hand. Her outfit is a pink idol-style ensemble: frilly pink jacket, bow details, pale blouse, pink plaid pleated skirt, ruffled trim, ribbons, and thigh accessory. Her face is intentionally covered by a centered square blur/censor block in a muted beige color.

Environment details: The promenade is soaked and reflective, lined with street lamps and wind-bent palm trees. Show exactly 5 prominent palm trees leaning in the wind along the waterfront. The ocean on the right is churning with whitecaps and spray. The city skyline appears through rain and mist, with high-rise buildings and a lit tower in the distance.

Broadcast graphics: Include exactly 4 on-screen TV overlay groups. 1) Top-left time/location stack: large white time {argument name="time display" default="7:42"}, smaller Japanese location text {argument name="location text" default="兵庫県・神戸市"}, and a white live-relay label {argument name="relay label" default="中継"}; add a short blue underline beneath the location. 2) Top-right typhoon alert banner: red-and-white Japanese breaking-news panel with the labels {argument name="typhoon headline" default="台風 情報　関西に最接近　暴風・高波に厳重警戒"} plus a red lower strip reading {argument name="broadcast place label" default="中継　兵庫県・神戸市"}. 3) Bottom-left weather radar box: a rectangular blue-framed rain-cloud radar map labeled 「雨雲レーダー」, with a vertical color scale on the right and small Japanese intensity labels 「強」「弱」 and 「現在」. 4) Bottom-right lower third: a blue slanted LIVE tag, white location bar reading 「神戸市中央区沿岸部」, and grey reporter credit bar reading 「記者：星川 さくら」.

Visual style: Realistic disaster-news photography for the background, high-quality anime character rendering for the reporter, cohesive broadcast composition, rain and motion effects, dramatic wind-blown hair and clothing, sharp TV news graphics, no watermark, no extra logos, no extra overlay groups.

prompt:

Canvas: Horizontal 16:9-ish social media banner, warm cream paper background with subtle fabric texture, rounded sticker-like shapes, soft shadows, red and dark teal color palette, high readability.

Main headline area: At the top, place a huge bold title reading “GPT Image 2” with “GPT Image” in dark teal and the number “2” in bright red, all with thick white sticker outlines and slight drop shadow. Below it, add a large Japanese headline reading “料理画像プロンプト32例”, with “料理画像” and “32” in red and the remaining text in dark teal, also outlined in white. Under the headline, add a dark teal rounded pill banner with white Japanese text: “写真・参考画像・オリキャラからレシピカードまで”.

Mascot and decorations: Add exactly 3 appearances of a cute beige stitched cat mascot with red round glasses and a small red wand: one large mascot standing at the upper right, one tiny mascot near the bottom of the first recipe card, and one large mascot on the right movie-poster card. Add exactly 2 small red yarn-tree decorations near the top left and top right, plus small golden sparkle icons around the headline.

Bottom layout: Create exactly 4 rounded rectangular showcase cards in a row across the lower half, separated by exactly 3 red triangular arrow markers pointing right between the cards. Each card has a dark teal label tab with white text at the top.

Card 1: Label tab “レシピカード”. Show a clean recipe card layout with a photo of tomato basil pasta on the left and Japanese recipe text on the right. The title should read “トマトとバジルのパスタ”, followed by a small ingredient list with bullet-like lines. Include the tiny mascot at the lower right of this card.

Card 2: Label tab “料理写真”. Show a warm professional food photograph of stacked pancakes topped with berries, whipped cream, mint, and syrup, centered in the card.

Card 3: Label tab “写真集ページ”. Show an open photo book spread with exactly 2 visible food photos: a salad on the left page and a stew or soup bowl on the right page, with small Japanese captions beneath each photo.

Card 4: Label tab “映画ポスター風”. Create a cinematic kitchen-poster style card with large Japanese copy “キッチンから、幸せを。” at the top left, a warm kitchen background, a pot of orange soup at the bottom, and the large cat mascot standing on the right.

Visual style: Bright, cute, polished Japanese blog-thumbnail design; realistic food photos inside craft-paper frames; sticker outlines, rounded corners, subtle shadows, soft beige background, clean hierarchy. Keep the composition dense but readable, with no extra cards, no extra arrows, and no watermark.

She has extremely long flowing hair that streams dramatically to the right, with two round twin buns on top of her head and long loose strands cascading past her legs. She wears a Japanese-style school uniform: a white button-up blouse, a dark navy sweater vest, a green ribbon bow at the collar, a charcoal pleated skirt, white knee-high socks, and brown loafers. Place her slightly left of center, facing slightly left, with her legs bent forward and one hand relaxed downward as if gently drifting in low gravity. The background is deep black outer space with a bright realistic Earth visible in the upper right quadrant, glowing blue and white. The lunar ground below is pale gray, dusty, and cratered, with scattered rocks, soft shadows, and a few small futuristic moon-base domes and antenna-like structures along the distant horizon. Use cool moonlight with subtle rim lighting around the hair and body, high detail in the hair strands and fabric folds, soft luminous anime shading, crisp linework, and a dreamy sci-fi atmosphere combining cute schoolgirl character art with realistic space scenery.

title: Elegant Fashion Magazine Cover
prompt:
인물참조 이미지 1, 이미지 2
[인물의 포즈 및 표정]

카메라 정면을 똑바로 응시하며 도도하고 매혹적인 눈빛을 보내고 있습니다. 마치 아기를 안은 듯 품에 안은 {argument name="꽃다발 색상" default="거대한 진홍색 장미 꽃다발"}을 양손으로 가볍게 가만히 감싸 쥔 채, 차분하면서도 신비롭고 아련한 분위기를 자아내고 있습니다.

[인물 의상]

고급스럽고 매트한 질감의 {argument name="의상 스타일" default="블랙 민소매 드레스"}를 입고 있습니다. 하의 스커트 부분은 풍성하고 부드러운 주름이 잡혀 있으며, 인물이 품에 안고 있는 화려한 레드 장미의 색상을 시각적으로 더욱 돋보이게 만듭니다.

[인물 헤어스타일 및 메이크업 디테일]

자연스러운 볼륨감이 살아있는 브라운 톤의 롱 웨이브 헤어스타일입니다. 굵은 웨이브의 앞머리 머리카락이 얼굴 라인을 따라 자연스럽게 흘러내리면서 한쪽 눈을 살짝 가립니다, 메이크업은 깨끗하고 하얀 피부 표현에 선명한 레드 립을 매트하게 발라 입술을 강조했습니다.

[조명 및 빛 방향]

인물의 좌측에서 강력하게 스며드는 자연광이 머리카락의 윤기와 어깨 라인을 부드럽게 감싸고 피부를 더 하얗게 보일만큼 강력하게 비추고 있습니다.

[질감과 색감 무드]

의상의 깊은 블랙, 장미의 강렬한 레드, 벨벳처럼 부드러운 장미 꽃잎의 질감과 깨끗한 피부 질감이 생생하게 대비되며 고혹적이고 클래식한 패션 화보의 무드를 연출합니다.

[필름 및 카메라 렌즈 심도, 앵글]

패션 매거진 커버를 위한 정면 눈높이 앵글의 세로형 뷰입니다. 인물의 상반신과 장미 꽃다발에 초점을 맞추고 주변 배경은 부드럽게 아웃포커싱 처리하여 피사체를 극적으로 돋보이게 만든 얕은 피사계 심도의 촬영입니다. 9:16비율의 카우보이 샷입니다.

[배경 요소 (옵션)]

유럽풍의 클래식한 야외 석조 계단과 푸른 식물이 담긴 화분이 있는 이국적인 건축물 배경입니다. 화면 상단에는 노란색과 주황색 그라데이션이 들어간 거대한 '{argument name="타이포그래피" default="BLANC"}' 타이포그래피가 배치되어 있습니다.

title: Indigo Dragon Sword Princess
prompt: Create a vertical 9:16 epic dark-fantasy anime illustration of {argument name="character name" default="a lone magical swordswoman"} standing on broken stone ruins inside an overgrown luminous cathedral garden. The composition contains exactly 2 main subjects: 1 young female warrior in the lower right foreground and 1 enormous mechanical dragon coiling around her from the left foreground into the upper background. She wears a layered gothic navy-black battle dress with a short skirt, flowing cape panels, ornate black-and-gold armor on her shoulders, arms, hands, thighs, knees, and tall boots, with long twin-tail {argument name="hair color" default="deep indigo"} hair whipping dramatically in the air; her face is covered by a soft square blur or featureless censored glow. She holds exactly 1 oversized translucent crystal greatsword angled from her hand down toward the bottom-left corner, glowing {argument name="sword color" default="violet purple"} with star-like facets and internal light. The dragon should be vast, serpentine, and biomechanical, made of dark blue-black armor plates, gears, filigree, cables, clawed forms, and warm orange molten light glowing through seams; its head looms beside the warrior, protective and menacing, with spiked crystalline horns and intricate mechanical details. Surround them with dense violet and white flowers, twisting vines, golden cathedral pillars, shattered arches, floating petals, sparks, and backlit dust, all illuminated by radiant warm sunlight pouring through the ruins. Use an extremely detailed Japanese fantasy concept-art style, ornate linework, maximalist decorative mechanical filigree, high contrast between deep ultramarine shadows and glowing gold highlights, cinematic rim lighting, dynamic low-angle perspective, sharp focus, painterly texture, no visible text, no watermark.

title: Cute Underwater Mermaid Puppy Game UI
titleEn: Cute Underwater Mermaid Puppy Game UI
prompt: A cute children’s 3D game screenshot in a bright underwater world, shown from a slightly elevated third-person view inside a colorful seaweed maze. The scene has a soft, glossy, toy-like look with rounded shapes, smooth clay-style materials, pastel-saturated colors, and cinematic god rays shining down through clear blue water. In the maze, a small mermaid puppy inspired by Coral from Paw Patrol stands near the lower-left quadrant, smiling with a friendly heroic expression. She has a light tan puppy face, big expressive eyes, pink-purple mermaid-themed accessories, and a small mermaid tail, designed in an adorable family-friendly animated style. Near her on the sandy seabed is a visible pair of scissors, the hidden-object target. The maze walls are made of dense green and teal seaweed with rounded pebble borders, creating winding paths across the center of the scene. The seabed is pale golden sand with caustic light patterns, scattered tiny shells and stones, and many floating air bubbles. Around the maze are whimsical coral-rock formations in blue, purple, and turquoise, including 1 shell-shaped treasure alcove on the left with a starfish above it and 1 large open pink clam shell with a pearl on the right. On the right side of the play area are 2 turtles: 1 larger light-green turtle and 1 smaller brown-green turtle, plus 3 separate clumps of upright sea plants in the open sand. Add a translucent white cross-shaped path marker or objective indicator over the center of the maze. Present it as a polished mobile game interface framed by a rounded rectangular screen. Include 6 UI elements total: top left a pill-shaped white label with the Chinese text “找剪刀”, next to it a white rounded counter reading “0/3”, top right a circular white pause button with a pause icon, and along the bottom center 3 white rounded instruction buttons labeled “方向键 / WASD”, “空格 / 回车：剪刀”, and “Esc 回地图”. The overall mood is comforting, playful, magical, and reassuring, like an educational hide-and-seek mini-game for a sick child, with high-end casual game art and a clean app-store-quality presentation.

slug: 电影时代3d排版雕塑网格-8_63e7ea
title: Cinematic Age 3D Typography Sculpture Grid
prompt:
在纯白色的工作室背景上创建一个整洁的 2x2 网格，展示 4 个大型 3D 排版雕塑，每个字符均完全由不同时代的电影制作设备构建而成。这四个字形精确为 4 个字符：左上角字母 A，右上角数字 5，左下角字母 X，右下角数字 9。每个字符应正对前方，位于各自象限的中心，清晰可辨，但由密集的逼真电影工具和片场道具堆叠而成，具有可信的遮挡关系、重量感和结构逻辑。使用高端 Cinema 4D 产品可视化技术，采用微妙的环境光遮蔽、柔和的三点式工作室布光（顶部配有柔光箱）、清晰的阴影、逼真的材质以及独立的构图。

prompt: Create a full-body tokusatsu-style enemy kaijin monster suit that looks like a humanoid made from a vintage car, standing in a dynamic studio character render on a plain white background. The villain should be centered, facing forward in a powerful action pose with one clawed hand reaching toward the viewer and the other arm bent outward. The torso is the front half of an old sedan: silver hood and fenders as chest armor, large chrome grille in the center, two round headlights, bumper pieces, dark windshield panels forming the upper shoulders, and worn red flame-like paint streaks over chipped silver metal. The head is a sinister car-themed skull helmet above the hood, with glowing red eyes, a vertical chrome grille mouth, angular cheek spikes, side fins, and a red mohawk-like fin on top. The arms are armored with car body panels and end in sharp silver talons; add red-and-silver spiked cuffs, with exactly 5 claws visible on the forward left hand and exactly 4 claws visible on the right hand. The legs are black ribbed mechanical suit material with silver knee armor, red flame-painted shin guards, chunky monster boots, and metallic toe claws. title: Elegant Japanese Divorce Legal Services LP First Screen Design
titleEn: Elegant Japanese Divorce Legal Services LP First Screen Design
prompt: Create a polished Japanese landing page hero image for a fictional divorce-law firm, designed like a high-conversion listing ad LP. Use a soft, elegant, feminine legal-brand aesthetic with a white background, blush pink accents, light gray dividers, and subtle botanical line art. The layout is a single wide desktop web hero split into two main columns: text-heavy content on the left and a lifestyle photo on the right. In the upper left, place the law firm logo and name: a delicate scripted monogram “D” with leaf ornament, followed by the Japanese office name and small English subtitle, shown as {argument name="firm name" default="法律事務所D"} and “LAW OFFICE D”. At the top right, include 2 rounded contact boxes: the first is a white phone box with a small phone icon and “24h”, short Japanese support text above, and the large phone number {argument name="phone number" default="0120-456-789"}; the second is a pink email consultation button with an envelope icon and Japanese text indicating 24-hour reception. The main headline on the left is a large Japanese serif/mincho-style statement in 3 lines: “もう一人で悩まないで。” then “新しい一歩を、” in pink, then “一緒に考えます。” mixing black and pink emphasis. Below it, add a short supporting paragraph in Japanese about supporting clients with divorce-related worries and helping find the best solution, with one phrase highlighted in pink. On the right side, show a bright, airy photo of a Japanese woman in her 30s with short dark brown hair, wearing a loose white top, seated indoors on a sofa by a window, resting her face lightly on one hand and looking thoughtful; her face is obscured by a large rectangular blur block for privacy. Near her shoulder, place a pale pink circular badge with Japanese text saying that many female lawyers are on staff and consultations can be made with peace of mind. Across the lower middle, place 4 evenly spaced rounded white feature cards with thin borders and pink line icons. Card 1 shows a speech-bubble icon and text for “初回相談 60分無料” with a smaller line saying online consultation is also available. Card 2 shows a heart-in-hands icon and text about handling children’s issues carefully, with a smaller line mentioning custody and visitation. Card 3 shows stacked coins with a yen symbol and text about relieving anxiety over fees with a clear pricing structure, plus a smaller line about installment consultation. Card 4 shows a padlock icon and text about privacy protection and strict confidentiality, with a smaller line encouraging safe consultation. At the bottom, add a large curved pink-and-white call-to-action band spanning the width. On the left side of this band, include a circular phone icon, small Japanese text encouraging casual consultation and 24/365 reception, then the large repeated phone number {argument name="phone number" default="0120-456-789"}, and beneath it smaller reception hours text. On the right side of the band, place a large pink rounded email button with envelope icon and Japanese text saying email consultation is available 24 hours. Along the very bottom, place 3 slim footer-style trust points separated horizontally: one about focusing on divorce consultation for women, one about consultations from family and friends also welcome, and one about nationwide and online consultations. Use refined Japanese typography, spacious layout, soft shadows, premium legal-advertising design, and realistic web-LP composition. Keep all visible text in Japanese except the small English subtitle “LAW OFFICE D”.

title: Childhood and Present Self Encounter
prompt: 请基于我上传的清晰个人照片，生成一张“童年的我 与 现在的我 同框对视”的情感摄影作品。请严格保留我现在照片中的真实身份特征，包括：脸型、五官比例、眉眼结构、鼻子、嘴唇、下颌线、肤色、年龄感、发际线、发型特征和整体气质。不要把我变成另一个人，不要欧美化，不要网红化，不要过度美颜，不要生成 AI 假脸。整张图必须让人一眼看出：左边和右边是同一个人的不同人生阶段。画面构图：生成一张 4:5 竖版、真实摄影感的人像照片。画面中有两个人物，坐在同一个简洁影棚空间内，彼此对视，形成温柔的情感交流。左侧：童年版本的我。右侧：现在的我（成年版本，面容必须与我上传的照片匹配）。两人都采用自然坐姿，画面简洁，构图稳定，重点突出两个人之间的眼神交流和情绪连接。左侧人物：童年版本的我。请根据我现在的长相，合理生成一个童年时期的我，年龄大约 7 岁。需要保留与现在相呼应的身份特征，让人看得出是“小时候的我”，包括五官轮廓、眼神气质、脸型特征的延续感。要求：带着天真、自然、温暖的微笑；头微微转向右侧，看着成年版的我；穿着 浅灰色 T 恤 和 蓝色牛仔裤；头顶上方清晰写着：“1999”。右侧人物：现在的我。右侧是现在的我，必须严格参考我上传照片中的真实长相。要求：成年人物形象自然真实；坐着，身体微微朝向左侧；双手自然托着下巴；带着平静、温柔、克制的微笑；眼神看向左边童年的自己，呈现一种温柔注视、像在和过去的自己对话的感觉；穿着 白色 T 恤 和 蓝色牛仔裤；头顶上方清晰写着：“2026”。场景与背景：场景是纯净、柔和的专业工作室背景；背景颜色建议为：浅灰、暖灰、米灰或奶油灰；背景要简洁干净，没有杂物、没有家具、没有复杂装饰；让画面看起来像真实摄影棚拍摄，而不是海报设计。光线氛围：使用柔和、温暖、电影感的布光；光线均匀、自然，面部有轻微立体感和柔和阴影；整体氛围温柔、安静、治愈、有时间流动感；画面情绪重点是：童年的自己与现在的自己之间的温柔对视。风格要求：整体风格为：专业人像摄影、极简情感摄影、真实、自然、克制、高质量写实风格、聚焦人物情绪与两个版本之间的视觉交流。重要限制：不要改变我的核心长相；不要把童年版本做成陌生小孩；不要卡通风，不要插画风，不要 AI 塑料皮肤；不要夸张妆容，不要过度磨皮；不要复杂背景，不要多余人物；不要错误手部，不要多余手指；不要文字乱码；除了顶部年份 “1999” 和 “2026” 外，不要出现其他文字。最终输出：输出一张 4:5 竖版、高度真实、温暖、极简、电影感的摄影作品。左边是童年的我，右边是现在的我，两人坐着彼此对视，像一张关于时间、成长与自我和解的真实摄影照片。

title: Realistic overhead portrait of a woman holding a strawberry
titleEn: Realistic overhead portrait of a woman holding a strawberry
prompt:
[인물] 이미지 1, 이미지 2, 비율 {argument name="비율" default="2:3"}, 리얼리스틱

[인물의 포즈 및 표정]
고전적인 패턴의 소파(Sofa) 위에서 옆으로 누워 편안하게 휴식을 취하고 있는 포즈입니다. 눈을 지그시 감은 채 몽환적이고 평온한 표정을 짓고 있으며, 오른손은 얼굴 바로 앞에 편안하게 놓여 있고, 왼손으로는 작고 신선한 딸기 한 알을 조심스럽게 집어 얼굴 가까이에 대고 향을 맡는 듯한 우아한 몸짓을 하고 있습니다. 

[포즈 디테일] 
전체 자세: 소파에 옆으로 누운 자세 (Side-lying / Lateral recumbent pose)
몸 방향: 오른쪽 측면이 소파닿음, 상체가 살짝 앞으로 기울어진 3/4 전면

머리 & 목
머리: 오른쪽 측면으로 소파에 눕힘, 얼굴은 같은 방향을 보고 있음. 
목: 자연스럽게 이완된 상태, 경추 중립 포지션

오른팔 (얼굴 아래 팔)
어깨: 바닥 방향으로 눌린 상태 (내회전)
팔꿈치: 약 90도로 굽힘, 팔꿈치는 몸 앞쪽 바닥에 위치
손목: 살짝 굽혀져 손등이 바닥에 놓여 손바닥이 위를 향해, 인물 얼굴 앞에 자연스럽게 놓임. 

손가락: 자연스럽게 살짝 굽어진 상태 
왼팔 (앞으로 뻗은 팔)
어깨: 앞쪽으로 약 30~40도 전방 굴곡
팔꿈치: 약 120도 가볍게 굽힘

손목: 손바닥이 위를 향해 살짝 회전된 수퍼네이션 (supination)
손가락: 엄지,검지·중지로 딸기를 하나를 가볍게 집는 핀치 그립 (Pinch grip)  
손톱: 길고 붉은 파스텔 핑크톤 네일아트, 손끝에서 약 1.5cm 돌출 

어깨 & 흉부
어깨선: 오른쪽이 바닥, 90도 수직. 
쇄골: 왼쪽 쇄골이 카메라에 노출되어 명확히 보임

[인물 의상] 
어깨 라인이 얇은 끈으로 된 미니멀하고 가벼운 {argument name="의상" default="화이트 슬립 나시 원피스"}를 입고 있습니다. 가녀린 어깨와 팔 라인이 자연스럽게 드러나며, 전체적으로 인물의 순수하면서도 매혹적인 분위기를 극대화하는 심플한 의상입니다.

[인물 헤어스타일 및 메이크업 디테일]

slug: 奢华面部和谐度分析报告-5_a6c55f
title: Luxury Facial Harmony Analysis Report
prompt:
Goal: Create a luxury editorial "Facial Beauty Analysis" face-symmetry report for {argument name="subject gender" default="female"}, styled like a premium beauty lab scan with gold measurement landmarks over a grayscale portrait.

Canvas: Landscape 4:3 report layout, clean white background with subtle paper texture, thin gold divider lines, black-and-gold luxury branding. Add a tall black rounded-corner sidebar on the left, a large central portrait-analysis area, and a right results column.

Layout: Use exactly three main vertical zones. Left sidebar takes about 22% width, center portrait report takes about 48% width, right analytics column takes about 30% width. Add a thin black footer bar across the bottom with gold text.

Left sidebar content: Large stacked gold serif title "FACIAL BEAUTY ANALYSIS". Small subtitle "SCIENCE. SYMMETRY. HARMONY.". An "OVERVIEW" section with a short paragraph explaining that the report analyzes facial features based on symmetry, proportion, and harmony research. A "YOUR MODEL" section with exactly 5 rows: ID "FB-2024-05-18", GENDER "Female", AGE RANGE "20-30", FACE SHAPE "Oval", SKIN TONE "Light". At the bottom, place an elegant monogram logo "FB" and the label "FACIAL BEAUTY LAB".

Center content: Top heading "YOUR FACIAL HARMONY REPORT". Show a front-facing grayscale portrait of a woman with dark hair pulled back, neutral expression, soft studio lighting, and a high-fashion clinical look. Cover the central facial area with a plain medium-gray rectangular privacy mask while leaving the hair outline, ears, neck, and shoulders visible. Overlay fine gold facial-analysis guide lines around the visible head: a vertical centerline, horizontal thirds labeled exactly 3 times as "1/3", lower neck/shoulder proportion ticks labeled exactly 5 times as "1/5", small gold landmark dots, and delicate dotted measurement rules. Below the portrait, add a "FACIAL PROPORTIONS" section with exactly 5 compact metric cards: FACE LENGTH 1.00, FOREHEAD 1.03, MIDFACE 1.00, LOWER FACE 0.97, FACE WIDTH 1.01. Include the note "Ideal proportion value: 1.00".

Right column content: Top card titled "HARMONY SCORE" with a gold semicircle gauge from 0 to 100 and large score {argument name="harmony score" default="91.2"}; below it, show "OUTSTANDING" and a short sentence saying the facial features are highly harmonious and well-balanced. Middle card titled "KEY METRICS" with exactly 7 rows, each with a small gold line icon, label, and score: Facial Symmetry 94, Proportions 90, Eye Position 92, Nose Proportion 90, Lips Symmetry 88, Chin & Jawline 89, Overall Harmony 91. Bottom card titled "ANALYSIS INSIGHTS" with a concise paragraph about excellent balance and proportion, and exactly 3 small icon captions: Balanced Symmetry, Well-Proportioned Features, High Aesthetic Potential.

Footer: Full-width black strip with centered gold serif quote "BEAUTY IS MEASURED IN HARMONY, NOT PERFECTION." with small decorative star marks.

Visual style: Luxury beauty-tech report, refined serif typography, minimal sans-serif labels, monochrome portrait, metallic gold accents, thin rules, clean margins, editorial medical-aesthetic design. Use {argument name="accent color" default="metallic gold"} for lines, icons, gauge, and headings. Keep text crisp and readable, no extra sections, no watermark.

title: Anime Suspense Movie Poster
prompt: A dramatic Japanese movie poster in a polished anime-cinematic style, vertical one-sheet composition, set at night over a glowing futuristic Tokyo and Gunma-themed cityscape filled with blue holographic HUD graphics, star-like particles, and surveillance interface overlays. The poster features 5 visible character elements: 1 dominant oversized close-up of a mysterious woman occupying the entire upper-right background, shown in profile with long dark hair and a huge elegant white wide-brim hat with a dark ribbon, her expression serious and unreadable; 3 teenage students grouped in the left-center foreground wearing Japanese school uniforms with dark blazers, white shirts, and red striped ties — one tall messy-haired boy in the middle, one girl with a black ponytail on the left turned partly away, and one short-haired girl on the right facing forward; and 1 smaller supporting figure in the lower-right corner, a pale-haired violinist in a heavy fur-trimmed winter coat playing the violin. Add a luminous holographic map of Japan across the lower middle with a red target reticle centered over Gunma, plus coordinate and data callouts. Include visible English interface text in small red and blue typography such as “OPERATION AKATSUKI,” “THE BONDS NEVER DIES,” “IN PROGRESS,” “TARGET: AKATSUKI CITY,” “AKATSUKI CITY,” “GUNMA PREFECTURE,” “JAPAN,” and coordinate strings. The skyline on the left should include a Tokyo Tower-like landmark glowing orange-red. Use intense blue, black, silver, and crimson lighting, wet glossy highlights, drifting snow or ash particles, layered depth, and high-contrast painterly detail. At the bottom, create a large bold Japanese title in metallic red, white, and blue: {argument name="headline text" default="私立 あかつき学園"}, with a large metallic silver English subtitle beneath it: {argument name="tagline" default="THE BONDS NEVER DIES"}. Add small Japanese credit lines above the release date, including faux director, screenplay, character design, and cast credits, and place a centered release line at the very bottom reading {argument name="release date" default="12.20 ROADSHOW"}. The overall mood should feel like a high-budget suspense drama, youth ensemble mystery, and techno-thriller anime film poster.

title: 12-frame spear Sakuga storyboard script
prompt:
Goal: Create a monochrome anime action storyboard sheet for an animation fight sequence, full of rough sakuga energy: gestural, dynamic, and readable, like a choreography bible for animators. The subject is {argument name="character name" default="a long-haired robed spear warrior"} performing a spear-and-water combat ritual across exactly 12 panels.

Canvas: Wide horizontal storyboard board, 16:9 ratio, divided into an exact 3x4 grid with thick black panel borders. Each panel has a black number badge in the upper-left corner, numbered 01 through 12, with hand-lettered uppercase titles and small color-coded annotation notes.

Visual style: Grayscale ink-and-pencil concept art with loose sketch lines, dramatic motion blur, wind-torn cloth, flying hair, splashing water, ruined coastal towers, hanging lanterns, birds in the sky, and cinematic camera angles. Keep the art mostly black, white, and gray, but overlay clear colored animator annotations: red for camera movement, blue for body mechanics, green for weapon arc, orange for impact or lantern reaction, and purple for timing or hold beats. Annotation arrows should be hand-drawn, bright, and readable.

Layout and panel content: Include exactly 12 storyboard panels:

01 — SPEAR PLANT REVEAL: The warrior stands upright on flooded stone, spear planted vertically into the water. Distant towers and seabirds behind. Red arrows show a low front wide camera move, blue notes show still stance, green arrow shows spear vertical, purple rings at the feet show stillness.

02 — TIDE BREATH: Medium side shot. The warrior extends the spear horizontally while cloth and hair flow in the wind. Red note: medium side. Blue arrows: arms rise, inhale. Green arrow: spear lifts parallel. Purple timing mark: breath hold.

03 — FIRST SWEEP CUT: Dynamic tracking-wide shot of the warrior lunging into a wide sweeping spear cut, water exploding at the feet. Red annotation: tracking wide. Blue arrows: hip rotation, low sweep. Green arc sweeps left to right across the panel. Purple note: release.

04 — SPIRAL ENTRY: Overhead or high-angle spin view. The warrior rotates in a 360-degree spiral, robes forming circular motion. Red note: orbit follow. Blue: spin 360. Green: spear orbital loop. Purple: snap at top.

05 — SALTWATER STEP: Ground-tracking shot. The warrior steps forward through shallow seawater, spear trailing outward, ripples spreading. Red: ground tracking. Blue: cross step forward. Green: water ripples outward. Purple: weight shift.

06 — PILLAR VAULT: High-angle follow shot as the warrior vaults or leaps near a tall broken pillar. Red: high angle follow. Blue: upward vault, body extend. Green: spear trails below. Purple: airborne beat.

07 — DOWNWARD PLUNGE: Front low push-in. The warrior drives the spear downward into the ground or water, creating a violent burst. Red: front low push-in. Blue: two-hand strike descend. Green: spear vertical down. Orange: impact burst. Purple: hit snap.

08 — BLADE SPIN RECOVER: Wide side view recovery stance. The warrior pivots low while the spear loops tightly around the body. Red: wide side view. Blue: behind-back loop, recover stance. Green: tight spear loop. Purple: reset breath.

09 — LANTERN PASS: Rear three-quarter composition with the warrior passing under hanging lanterns, spear extended across the frame. Red: rear 3/4. Blue: tip graze precise line. Green: spear tip path. Orange: lanterns sway, chain reaction. Purple: soft snap.

10 — TIDE SILHOUETTE: Extreme low wide shot. The warrior poses dramatically on a broken stone platform against a towering wave. Red: extreme low wide. Blue: full body pose. Green: spear overhead arc. Purple: hero pause.

11 — ROBES-TO-WATER CUT: Tracking front shot. The warrior slashes downward through water, robes whipping into the motion. Red: tracking front. Blue: slide descend steps. Green: robes trail through water. Purple: controlled flow decay.

12 — RITE UNFINISHED: Wide hero shot at sunset or pale dawn. The warrior stands facing the horizon, spear leveled forward, ocean ruins and a glowing sun in the distance. Red: wide hero shot. Blue: stand and level forward. Green: spear leveled at horizon. Purple: forward intent.

Text content: Use hand-lettered English titles exactly as listed for all 12 panels. Add small colored notes inside each panel, matching the listed red, blue, green, orange, and purple annotations. Optional main design emphasis: {argument name="motion emphasis" default="water-spear choreography with readable animation planning arrows"}.

Constraints: Exactly 12 panels in a 3x4 grid, no extra panels. Preserve the locked annotation color key: red camera, blue body, green weapon arc, orange impact, purple timing. Keep the image mostly monochrome with only the annotation colors vivid. Avoid polished clean lineart; keep it rough, energetic, cinematic, and storyboard-like.

小型编号标签 - 微型注释框 - 拼豆图例块 - 坐标线 - 时间刻度 - 比例条 - 方向箭头 - 档案索引编号 - 局部纹理说明 - 边缘标记点 信息节点必须沿留白窗口、色场边界、切口节点、主体缺口、负空间通道和底部边缘分散布置。信息节点数量为 8 个，对应 8 个知识点。所有信息节点必须有层级关系：主标题最大，核心概念次级，知识点标签更小，脚注和编号最小。信息节点不能覆盖主体中心，不能破坏大色场结构。 阅读路线： 构建跳跃式阅读路径：上方小型标记 → 侧向主标题 → 主体边缘知识点 → 负空间注释窗口 → 底部脚注与图例。画面必须同时满足远距离识别和近距离阅读：远看是一个强烈的巨大拼豆图像残片，近看是一个精密、有秩序的知识信息系统。 字体与文字： 使用窄身现代无衬线字体、瑞士风格无衬线、方正清晰骨架字体或等宽元数据字体。字体笔画均匀，字距克制，层级精确。主标题像公共文化信息坐标，小字像档案元数据索引。文字必须排布在留白窗口、边界节点和底部信息栏中，不得压在主体中央。中文文字必须清晰、短句化、标签化，避免长段落。 主题转译规则： 不要直接用题材默认图标解释【主题】。必须把主题中的时间、地点、功能、人物关系、数据关系、因果关系或抽象概念转译为： - 拼豆色场密度 - 缺珠区域走向 - 边缘压力 - 负空间形状 - 信息节点位置 - 编号系统 - 局部纹理差异 - 拼豆明度层级 - 图例色块关系 拼豆材质： 所有视觉元素都由拼豆构成。拼豆表面为哑光塑料质感，带轻微制造不均、微弱颗粒、细小磨损和低对比表面差异。结构色区域内部可出现半调式拼豆密度变化、扫描输出感、旧纸不均匀感和专色叠印感。信息色拼豆必须边缘锐利、对比清楚、定位准确。 画面气质： 整体应像一张由拼豆重构的结构性公共文化信息海报。它不是可爱手工图，也不是儿童玩具风，而是克制、理性、现代、档案化、信息密集但秩序清晰的视觉系统。画面要有博物馆展览海报、研究机构信息图、公共文化导视和实验性平面设计的气质。 构图硬性要求： - 16:9 横版 - 正视平面视角 - 拼豆圆形颗粒清晰可见 - 主体从画幅边缘进入 - 主体被页面边界裁切 - 大块结构色与大块空白互相侵入 - 外轮廓呈拼豆像素台阶 - 至少 8 个知识点信息节点 - 远看有巨大图形冲击 - 近看有精密信息秩序 - 空白区域必须参与叙事和切割 - 信息色只能用于关键文字和标记 禁止内容： 禁止完整写实物体。 禁止居中主体插画。 禁止可爱卡通风。 禁止普通像素画。 禁止 3D 玩具摄影。 禁止景深虚化。 禁止真实相机拍摄感。 禁止强投影。 禁止发光特效。 禁止金属高光。 禁止复杂装饰背景。 禁止图标堆叠式信息图。 禁止平均分配颜色。 禁止文字覆盖主体中心。 禁止无意义信息噪声。 禁止把知识点变成随机装饰。 禁止过度拟物化。 禁止真实照片拼贴。 禁止渐变炫光。 禁止赛博霓虹背景。 禁止柔和插画风。 禁止水彩、油画、厚涂、3D渲染风。 最终效果： 画面应呈现为一张高级拼豆风格结构性信息图海报。【主题】不是被直接画出来，而是被压缩成巨大的拼豆色场、像素化珠阵边缘、缺珠空洞、负空间刀口、编号节点、档案注释和颗粒秩序。观众远距离看到强烈的抽象主题冲击，近距离能够沿信息节点阅读完整知识结构。 主题：潘金莲

title: Y2K Futuristic Scream Desktop

The sky is a swirling expressionist vortex of luminous purple, pink, orange, and blue strokes, like liquid fiber-optic trails. Text inside should read: “THE SCREAM.EXE”, “artist: edvard munch”, “year: 1893”, “remixed in: 3000”, “resolution: 1024x1280”, “color mode: neon rgb”, “size: 1.42 mb”, “status: existential”. title: Abyssal Jellyfish Premium Customization Project
prompt:
Goal: Create a high-fashion menswear concept board inspired by {argument name="inspiration source" default="deep sea jellyfish"}, combining a central couture runway look with fashion design research panels, technical tailoring sketches, material tests, color studies, and handwritten atelier annotations.

Canvas: Portrait-oriented editorial fashion board on warm off-white archival paper, approximately 4:5 ratio, with faint grid marks, thin drafting lines, crop marks, pin-registration marks, subtle paper grain, and a luxury atelier mood. Use black, deep navy, icy cyan, translucent blue, silver, and white.

Main subject: Place one full-body male model centered and slightly forward, wearing {argument name="collection look name" default="Look 07 - Abyssalis"}. The face should be softly blurred or obscured, while the outfit remains sharp. The garment is futuristic couture menswear: a glossy black structured long coat or suit base with a high stand collar, layered liquid-black tailoring, wide sculptural shoulders, transparent jellyfish-like cape panels, flowing organza veils, fine dangling filament strands, reflective wet-look surfaces, and scattered bioluminescent cyan-blue bead lights. The silhouette should feel like a deep-sea creature translated into formal tailoring, with long translucent tentacle ribbons trailing from shoulders, sleeves, and hem to the floor. Add black boots visible beneath the layered coat.

Left research column: Include exactly 8 stacked research sections with small labels and visual materials:
1. Header reading “INSPIRATION : DEEP SEA JELLYFISH” with subheading “BIOLUMINESCENT STRUCTURE.”
2. “ANATOMI STUDY” section with exactly 2 jellyfish anatomy sketches, one blue-toned and one monochrome line sketch, plus small handwritten notes about a transparent bell, gelatinous structure, and radial symmetry.
3. “TENTACLE DYNAMICS” section with exactly 1 side-view jellyfish drawing showing long streaming tentacles, annotated with fluid motion, graceful undulation, and movement.
4. “BIOLUMINESCENCE ANALYSIS” section with exactly 2 glowing jellyfish reference images and exactly 5 vertical color bars beside them, from black and deep navy through teal to pale icy blue.
5. “MATERIAL EXPERIMENTS” section with exactly 3 square translucent material samples, annotated as fine membrane, iridescent organza, sheer tulle, liquid satin, and fiber optic thread.
6. “COLOR PALETTE” section with exactly 7 rectangular swatches: black, midnight navy, dark blue, teal, cyan, pale blue, and nearly white translucent blue, annotated as deep sea, ice blue, bioluminescent, and pearl white.
7. “FABRIC SWATCHES & TESTS” section with exactly 5 overlapping physical swatches in black vinyl/satin and translucent blue organza, some with glowing blue thread or bead-like highlights.
8. “LIGHT REACTION TEST” section with exactly 1 small dark photo panel showing bright blue fiber-optic streaks, plus a note about reaction, bioluminescent thread, subtle glow, and in darkness. At the bottom include atelier notes reading “ATELIER NOTES,” “PROJECT : ABYSSALIS,” “LOOK : 07,” “SEASON : SS27,” and “DEVELOPMENT STAGE : 4,” followed by a designer signature line.

Right technical column: Include exactly 6 design-development sections:
1. Top heading “TECHNICAL TAILORING SKETCH” with subheading “LOOK 07 - ABYSSALIS,” showing exactly 2 tall technical fashion sketches, front and back views, of the same long translucent layered coat.
2. A bullet-note block with exactly 5 bullets: bioluminescent tailoring; transparent marine layering; liquid silhouette engineering; floating organza extension; deep-sea inspired main couture; fluid structural movement.
3. A construction-detail area with exactly 4 smaller line drawings: structured inner coat with enlarged organic hood; transparent layered cape with floating silhouette; tentacle extensions as sheer organza; flowing wide-leg pants with liquid cut lines.
4. “EMBELLISHMENT MAP” section with exactly 1 front torso sketch covered in blue dot placements and exactly 3 legend dots labeled high density, medium density, and low density; add a note for fiber optic embroidery placement.
5. “DETAIL & TEXTURE CLOSE-UP” section with exactly 3 rectangular close-up images showing black glossy fabric with blue glowing bead lines, transparent crinkled organza, and watery translucent blue membrane texture.
6. Sparse handwritten annotations around the sketches, using elegant thin cursive, while keeping the text secondary and not overcrowded.

Visual style: Photorealistic central model blended with delicate pencil fashion sketches, scientific specimen diagrams, luxury couture board presentation, translucent layering, iridescent highlights, cyan bioluminescent specks, black liquid satin, and fine technical drafting aesthetics. The board should feel like an elite fashion house concept sheet for futuristic couture menswear, directly inspired by deep-sea jellyfish anatomy.

Text constraints: Use the visible English headings and atelier labels as described. Keep typography small, refined, and editorial; mix uppercase serif labels with handwritten cursive notes. Do not add logos, watermarks, extra models, or unrelated sea creatures. The final image should read as one complete fashion concept board for {argument name="garment theme" default="bioluminescent jellyfish couture menswear"}.

The neon outline color should be {argument name="neon outline color" default="electric lime green"}.

Constraints: Make the text perfectly readable as “PIXEL BOUNCER.” Do not add extra words, logos, watermarks, captions, borders, or UI elements. Keep the background pure black outside the glowing letterforms. Ensure every letter contains a unique cinematic portrait crop while maintaining one consistent character identity.

titleEn: Ink-style poster in honor of Zheng Qian
prompt: Create a vintage editorial poster on aged rice paper celebrating {argument name="artist name" default="CHEN UEN"}, designed like a museum infographic mixed with Chinese ink wash illustration and calligraphy. The format is a single vertically oriented poster with a weathered parchment background, ink splatters, faded handwritten annotations, red seal stamps, and a scholarly, archival atmosphere. At the very top, place large black Chinese calligraphy for the name 鄭問, followed by a slash and the romanized name {argument name="romanized name" default="CHEN UEN"} in large serif capitals, with a small red seal beside it. Under the title, add the subtitle {argument name="subtitle text" default="The Taiwanese Master Who Turned Comics into Ink-Born Epic"} in elegant reddish-brown serif text. In the center, feature a dramatic painterly scene of 1 seated male artist in a loose white shirt at a desk, holding a brush over paper, his face intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur. Behind him, surround him with a swirling halo-like storm of monochrome ink-brush warriors and historical figures: exact count 9 visible character figures, including armored generals, swordsmen, and mounted riders, emerging from explosive black brushwork and smoke-like ink textures. On the left side, create a vertical section titled “Life & Milestones” with a black brushstroke header and smaller Chinese subtitle text. List exactly 6 timeline entries with red year markers and bilingual captions: 1958 born in Taiwan, 1983 Warrior Panther, 1989 Abi Sword, 1990 Heroes of the Eastern Zhou, 1991 Japan Cartoonists Association Award, 2017 legacy continues. Below that, add a small section titled “Ink in Detail” containing exactly 4 boxed brush studies labeled with short English captions: Dry brush texture, Ink wash gradient, Splatter energy, Bold contour line. On the right side, create a vertical section titled “Visual Method” with a black brushstroke header and smaller Chinese subtitle text. Include exactly 5 stacked boxed studies with image-and-caption layout: Brush as blade, Ink as atmosphere, Anatomy as fate, History as theatre, Speed lines become calligraphy. In the lower center, create a section titled “Major Works Constellation” with a dark brushstroke heading. Arrange exactly 5 circular work nodes around a central ink ring with Chinese calligraphy inside. Label the 5 nodes: Abi Sword, Heroes of the Eastern Zhou, Assassin Biographies, Magical Super Asia, Game character design legacy. Each circle contains a distinct monochrome or muted-color ink illustration, with subtle connecting marks like a constellation diagram. At the lower right, add a section titled “Studio Notes” containing exactly 6 visible objects: 4 hanging calligraphy brushes, 1 ink bowl, and 1 painter’s palette with blue and red pigment; beneath them place a sketchbook page with light pencil figure studies. Across the bottom, add a wide section titled “Why He Matters” with a black brushstroke header and smaller Chinese subtitle text, followed by a paragraph of serif body text in English describing his importance to comics, painting, calligraphy, cinema, and epic storytelling. Use a restrained palette of sepia, black ink, off-white paper, muted gray, with small accents of deep red and occasional blue. The whole image should feel like a refined cultural tribute poster, dense but balanced, highly detailed, painterly, and authentic to Chinese ink aesthetics.

prompt:

Keep the boy and dog as the recognizable subjects from the reference, preserving their relative pose and closeness, but render each panel in the requested style with matching backgrounds, linework, colors, and character proportions. Add a bold style title/logo at the top of each panel.

Panel styles and visible labels, exactly 12:
1. Studio Ghibli — label: “STUDIO GHIBLI”, soft hand-painted pastoral anime look.
2. Pixar — label: “PIXAR”, polished 3D family-animation look.
3. Dragon Ball — label: “DRAGON BALL”, dynamic shonen action look with speed lines and rocky landscape.
4. One Piece — label: “ONE PIECE”, nautical adventure anime look with ship elements.
5. Naruto — label: “NARUTO”, ninja anime look with village rooftops and headband styling.
6. Doraemon — label: “ドラえもん”, bright suburban children’s anime look.
7. Sazae-san — label: “サザエさん”, classic Japanese family anime look.
8. Lilo & Stitch — label: “Lilo & Stitch”, tropical island animation look.
9. Pokémon — label: “POKÉMON”, colorful trainer-and-companion adventure look.
10. Demon Slayer — label: “鬼滅の刃”, dramatic dark fantasy anime look with glowing particles.
11. Crayon Shin-chan — label: “クレヨンしんちゃん”, simple rounded children’s anime look.
12. Minecraft — label: “MINECRAFT”, blocky voxel game style.

Customizable text: Use {argument name="first style label" default="STUDIO GHIBLI"}, {argument name="second style label" default="PIXAR"}, {argument name="third style label" default="DRAGON BALL"}, {argument name="ninth style label" default="POKÉMON"}, and {argument name="twelfth style label" default="MINECRAFT"} where those panel titles appear.

Constraints: Do not add extra panels or extra labels. Preserve the reference subjects in every panel, including the boy with the dog, while changing only the art style, environment details, and franchise-inspired visual language. Keep the collage clean, colorful, and poster-like.

title: Pink Mech Idol Wedding Dress Blueprint

prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical anime bridal fashion character sheet for {argument name="character name" default="Roboco-san"}, a cybernetic idol bride in a soft pink mecha-themed wedding dress, presented as a luxury magazine design board titled {argument name="headline text" default="WEDDING DRESS Collection"}.

Canvas: Portrait 3:4 composition, pale blush-pink border with ornate thin lines, rose motifs, delicate filigree corners, glossy high-resolution anime illustration. Use a dreamy cathedral wedding atmosphere with stained-glass windows, sheer curtains, sparkling floor reflections, floating petals, soft bloom lighting, and a romantic pink-white color palette.

Main layout: Split the page into two major columns. The left column is a large full-body hero illustration taking about half the canvas width. The right column is a detailed fashion-spec panel with title, description text, and multiple labeled inset views. Add a bottom information strip spanning the page.

Hero illustration: Show one full-body anime bride with very long {argument name="hair color" default="brown to rose-pink gradient hair"}, flowing waist-length twin-tail-like hair strands, a pink rose flower crown, translucent veil, and a gentle bridal pose holding a large bouquet. Her face should be softly obscured or simplified with no sharp facial detail. She wears a white and blush-pink asymmetrical wedding dress with a corset bodice, heart-shaped neckline, off-shoulder puff sleeves, layered ruffled skirt, translucent overskirt, pink ribbons, rose decorations, pearl-like trim, silver mechanical accents, and one visible cybernetic/mecha leg. Include high-heeled platform bridal shoes with pink roses and ankle straps. Bouquet should be round and dense with pink roses, white filler flowers, green leaves, and long trailing pink ribbons.

Visible text and typography: Use elegant serif and script typography in dusty rose. Large title on the right reads “WEDDING DRESS” with “Collection” below in cursive. Include smaller English text “Roboco-san Bridal Style 2024” and Japanese-style descriptive body copy as decorative filler. Add vertical Japanese quote on the left side of the hero illustration: {argument name="side quote" default="キミとなら、未来もずっと幸せでいられる気がするの……♡"}. Add bottom center quote: {argument name="bottom quote" default="キミの隣で、ずっと笑っていられますように。"}. Add bottom-left name label “Roboco-san” and “Bridal Style 2024”.

Right-side fashion panels: Include exactly 10 labeled inset panels. The first row has 3 full-body turnaround panels labeled “FRONT”, “SIDE”, and “BACK”. Below them are 7 detail panels labeled “BOUQUET”, “SHOULDER & BODICE”, “MECHA LEG”, “SHOES”, “BACK STYLE”, and “RIBBON DETAIL”, with the “SHOES” section split into two small shoe close-up images inside one labeled panel. The detail panels show close-ups of the bouquet, corset bust and shoulders, robotic leg joint, bridal platform heels, rear hair-and-dress silhouette, and a large pink bow with roses.

Bottom-left design information: Add a framed “Design Point” card containing exactly 4 Japanese bullet-style lines with small pink flower/star bullets. Below it add a “Color Palette” row with exactly 5 rectangular swatches labeled “Rose Pink”, “Blush Pink”, “Pearl White”, “Silver”, and “Light Rose”.

Bottom-right stats card: Add a small framed profile box with exactly 3 lines: “Height: 152cm”, “Birthday: 5 / 23”, and “Favorite: …” as tiny decorative text. Add small rose icons around the bottom strip.

Style constraints: Keep everything cohesive in pastel pink, pearl white, silver, and light rose. Use ornate bridal catalog aesthetics, clean panel borders, soft glitter, highly detailed lace and ruffles, delicate cybernetic parts, and no dark or harsh colors. The image should feel like an official idol wedding dress collection sheet rather than a simple portrait.

title: World famous puppet show scene
prompt:
提供された画像をキャラクターの基準リファレンスとして使用すること。

参照画像のキャラクターを主人公とした、

「{argument name="番組のテーマ" default="実在しない世界的に有名なパペット番組のワンシーン"}」

を描くこと。

これはキャラクター設定資料ではない。

これはポスターではない。

これはキービジュアルではない。

これは実際にテレビ放送された架空のパペット番組の劇中シーンである。

その番組は数十年にわたり世界中で放送され続け、

複数世代に愛された伝説的な長寿番組である。

世界各国で親しまれ、

多くの人々が

「子供の頃に見て育った」

と語るほど高い知名度を持つ作品である。

現在描かれているのは、

その長い歴史の中でも特に印象的なエピソードの一場面である。

キャラクターはアニメキャラクターではなく、

テレビ番組用に制作された高品質なパペットとして表現すること。

着ぐるみではない。

布、 フェルト、 フォーム素材、 樹脂製の目、 縫製された口元、 内部骨格、 関節構造などを持つ、

本格的な操演パペットとして制作されていること。

頭部、 手、 腕などには操演用ロッドや操作機構が自然に存在していてもよい。

必要に応じて操り糸を使用してもよい。

参照画像の顔立ち、 髪型、 耳、 衣装、 色彩設計、 性格的特徴を維持しながら、

パペットとして自然に再解釈すること。

画面内には実写の人間出演者が存在すること。

人間出演者の人種、 国籍、 文化圏、 性別、 年齢は固定しない。

番組内容に応じて自然に決定すること。

人間出演者は司会者、 先生、 研究者、 冒険家、 店員、 発明家、 近所の住人など、

番組世界の登場人物として存在すること。

キャラクターと人間出演者は自然に会話していること。

キャラクターは人間より小柄なため、

椅子、 木箱、 机、 ベンチ、 カウンター、 ステージセットなどを利用して、

自然に人間と目線が合う高さになっていること。

背景は大型テレビスタジオ内に構築された番組専用セットであること。

街並み、 公園、 図書館、 研究所、 商店街、 宇宙船、 港町、 異世界都市、 ファンタジーの村など、

物語に応じた魅力的な舞台を構築すること。

背景は実在の建築物ではなく、

職人たちが制作した大型セットであることが伝わること。

豊富な小道具。

手作り感のある装飾。

親しみやすいデザイン。

温かみのある色彩。

作り込まれた舞台装置。

番組を象徴するような特徴的なセットデザイン。

キャラクターは物語の途中であること。

冒険中。

事件発生中。

探索中。

追跡中。

祝賀会。

感動的な再会。

作戦会議。

失敗した実験。

料理中。

工作中。

問題解決中など、

視聴者が前後の物語を想像できる状況を描写すること。

照明は温かく自然であること。

舞台照明らしい柔らかな陰影。

少し古いテレビ番組を思わせる優しいライティング。

児童文学のような空気感。

家族向け作品らしい安心感。

ノスタルジー。

親しみやすさ。

世界中で長年愛され続けた名作番組の雰囲気。

画面内に文字、 ロゴ、 字幕、 タイトル、 クレジット、 テロップは表示しないこと。

高品質な実写映像。

高品質なパペット造形。

高品質な舞台セット。

豊富な小物描写。

奥行きのある構図。

映画のワンシーンのような演出。

静止画の一瞬から、

視聴者がその番組の長い歴史と物語を感じ取れることを重視すること。

title: Mystic Ruins Platform Game Screenshot
prompt:
Goal: Create a polished 2D side-scrolling platformer concept screenshot for a fantasy game level called {argument name="level title" default="MYSTIC RUINS"}, showing a playable prototype scene with HUD elements overlaid.

Canvas: Wide cinematic 24:9 game screenshot, approximately 1200×450 px. Use a layered parallax composition with strong depth: dark foreground silhouettes, midground playable platforms, and a misty glowing background. No borders or watermark.

Scene: A magical ancient forest ruin at sunset/night, with warm orange, magenta, purple, and deep navy lighting. The environment is dense with gnarled trees, hanging vines, moss, floating dust/fireflies, crumbling stone arches, waterfalls in the distance, and oversized bioluminescent mushrooms glowing pink, violet, and amber. The mood is cozy, mysterious, adventurous, and high-fantasy.

Layout and counted scene elements: Include exactly 4 main walkable platforms: 1 large dark mossy ledge on the upper left with a giant glowing purple-pink mushroom on it, 1 central moss-covered platform where the hero stands, 1 elevated upper-right ruined stone platform with a broken stone column and hanging lantern, and 1 lower-right mossy platform with glowing mushrooms. Add distant ruined arches and cliffs in the background, but keep them non-playable and atmospheric. Place the hero slightly left of center on the central platform.

Hero character: A small cute anthropomorphic fox adventurer, chibi proportions, orange fur, cream muzzle and tail tip, wearing a small brown adventurer outfit with boots, belt, scarf or capelet, and holding a warm glowing lantern. The character should face right in an idle pose, readable as a playable sprite against the environment.

HUD and text content: Top left HUD has the label “HEALTH” in small pale-gold pixel/fantasy UI text, with exactly 3 glowing heart icons underneath. Below that show “LIVES 03”. Bottom left HUD has the label “ABILITIES” and exactly 2 square ability icons: one dash/slash icon and one lantern/light icon. Top right HUD shows a small gold coin icon followed by “128”, and below it “SCORE 02450”. Bottom right shows the level title “{argument name="level title" default="MYSTIC RUINS"}” in widely spaced white-gold capitals with a thin decorative line beneath it.

Visual style: High-quality painterly 2D game art, whimsical platformer concept art, soft bloom, volumetric mist, cinematic rim lighting, sharp readable silhouettes, detailed foliage and moss, glowing particles, warm lantern light, vibrant fantasy color grading, suitable for a playable 2D platformer prototype.

Constraints: Keep the image as a single gameplay screenshot, not a menu or poster. Make all HUD text clean and legible. Do not add extra hearts, ability icons, characters, enemies, dialogue boxes, logos, or watermarks.

prompt:

Layout: Place one dominant U.S. infantry soldier in the left foreground, waist-up to knees, charging through shallow surf toward the viewer. His face is deliberately hidden by one flat opaque dark-brown square censor block centered over the face. Put the large headline “D-DAY” across the upper right in huge dark navy serif capital letters. Beneath it, add a thin horizontal rule with a small centered star, then the subtitle “ALLIED INVASION OF NORMANDY, JUNE 6, 1944” in condensed uppercase lettering.

Subject details: The foreground soldier wears a wet olive drab uniform, netted M1 helmet, webbing straps, ammunition pouches, backpack straps, and a U.S. flag patch on his upper right sleeve. He grips a long rifle diagonally downward across his body. Make his clothing soaked, muddy, and reflective with splashes of seawater around his legs. The background shows a Normandy beach landing: exactly 2 landing craft with open ramps on the left and middle distance, exactly 14 visible infantry figures moving through the water and across the beach, exactly 7 aircraft silhouettes in the smoky sky, exactly 3 large explosion plumes near the shoreline, and exactly 2 Czech hedgehog anti-tank obstacles in the right foreground.

Environment: Rough gray surf, beach obstacles, distant cliffs and fortifications, smoke columns, artillery bursts, and chaotic battlefield haze. The scene should feel heroic, somber, and historically documentary rather than glamorous.

Text content: Use {argument name="headline text" default="D-DAY"} as the main title and “ALLIED INVASION OF NORMANDY, {argument name="date line" default="JUNE 6, 1944"}” as the subtitle. Keep the typography distressed, ink-worn, and integrated into the aged poster texture.

Constraints: No modern objects, no clean digital gloss, no extra text, no watermark, no logos, no gore, and keep the soldier’s face fully obscured by the brown square.

title: Kijiro Cat Rider Movie Poster
prompt:
Goal: Create a richly detailed fictional Japanese animated movie poster about an adventurous anthropomorphic cat traveling by motorcycle, with a nostalgic hand-painted anime fantasy style.

Canvas: Vertical theatrical poster, 3:4 aspect ratio, warm cinematic composition, full-bleed illustration with layered Japanese typography. Use a soft teal-blue sky, golden sunlight, muted browns, cream highlights, and painterly film-grain texture.

Main subject: Center a brave tabby cat rider named {argument name="character name" default="Kijiro"}, shown as a cute but heroic anthropomorphic cat with green eyes, striped fur, large upright ears, and a calm determined expression. The cat wears vintage aviator goggles on its head, a leather helmet strap, blue scarf and windblown cape, rugged blue travel clothes, brown gloves, belts, pouches, knee guards, boots, and small adventurer gear. The cat rides a large vintage blue motorcycle toward the viewer at a low angle; include a big round headlamp, chrome forks, front fender, engine details, handlebars, leather saddlebags, and weathered scratches.

Background: A sweeping coastal road curves along cliffs beside a deep blue sea. Add white flowers and greenery in the lower right foreground, distant islands and waves on the left, and a tall fantasy castle city on a hill in the right background. The sky is bright blue with dramatic cream clouds and drifting petals or paper-like flecks, creating a sense of wind and travel.

Layout and text: Make the design look like a Japanese theatrical poster. Include exactly 4 small rectangular preview stills stacked vertically along the lower-left side: 1 close-up portrait of the goggled cat, 1 sunset castle landscape, 1 coastal road landscape, and 1 dark side-profile cat portrait. Add a laurel-award block in the upper left with small Japanese festival-style text. Add vertical Japanese tagline text on the upper right. Add a large cream Japanese title across the lower center: {argument name="main title text" default="キジ郎の旅"}. Beneath it add the subtitle {argument name="subtitle text" default="風と記憶の向こうへ"}. Add a small synopsis line in Japanese near the bottom center and dense tiny production credits along the bottom edge. Add a release line reading {argument name="release text" default="2025年・春　旅立ちの季節にロードショー"} and a small fictional website in the bottom right.

Visible Japanese copy to include: upper-left tagline “見えない風が、彼をどこかへ運んでいく。”; upper-left award text “長編アニメーション映画 / 幻想映画祭出品 /（架空）”; right vertical tagline “誰にも縛られず、ただ、風のままに。”; synopsis “孤高のライダー、キジ郎。その旅は、出会いと別れ、そして“本当の自由”を知る物語。”

Visual style: Detailed 2D anime poster illustration, reminiscent of classic hand-painted adventure animation and fantasy road movies, intricate linework, textured watercolor-gouache shading, cinematic lighting, charming animal character design, aged paper grain, elegant Japanese typography, no photorealism.

Constraints: Keep all text integrated as poster typography, avoid modern UI elements, avoid logos or real studio names, do not add extra characters, and keep the motorcycle, cat, castle, ocean road, flowers, and exactly 4 preview stills clearly visible.

Goal: Create a detailed vertical fantasy character sheet for {argument name="character name" default="Arpeggio (アルペジオ)"}, a humanized instrument spirit based on {argument name="instrument name" default="Wishbass 11 String Fanned Fret Bass"}. The sheet should look like a premium illustrated game-design reference page with sepia parchment paper, thin dark brown borders, elegant serif typography, and Japanese-inspired layout styling.

Canvas: Portrait orientation, approximately 3:4 ratio, aged cream paper background with a thin double-line frame and small corner ornaments. Use warm browns, walnut wood tones, black leather, muted red accents, and gold highlights. The overall style is painterly anime / fantasy concept art, highly detailed, refined, and print-ready.

Main subject: A tall androgynous young male character, early twenties, 182 cm impression, standing full-body on the left-center of the page while holding an enormous multi-string bass guitar upright like a sacred artifact. He has long messy {argument name="hair color" default="chestnut brown hair with reddish streaks"}, layered strands, loose waves, and a mysterious soft-blurred facial area with no detailed facial features. Outfit: sleeveless dark open vest, layered necklaces, leather wrist wraps, fingerless gloves, asymmetric belts, flowing dark cloth strips, black trousers, high boots, and wooden instrument-like armor panels. The character is calm, poetic, and solitary, as if listening to the resonance of wood. The bass is oversized, with 11 visible strings, fanned frets, a natural multi-tone wood body, dark fretboard, tuning pegs along an elongated headstock, and a rich luthier-crafted look.

Layout: Top left contains a large elegant title reading Arpeggio, with a smaller subtitle naming the instrument and a character sheet label. Down the left side beside the character, place a vertical poetic tagline in Japanese-style arrangement meaning: resonance connects, sound tells stories. Right side contains three stacked information panels. Bottom third contains expression portraits, standing-pose variations, notes, logo, and color palette.

Right-side panels: Include exactly 3 boxed panels. Panel 1 is Basic Information with 8 rows: name, species, gender, age, height, birthday, affiliation, and role. Panel 2 is Profile with a paragraph describing a spirit born from the Wishbass instrument, quiet and introverted, speaking through resonance and music. Panel 3 is Instrument Data with front and side views of the bass plus technical bullet points and a small tonal-range meter.

Instrument data details: Show exactly 2 instrument diagrams in the panel: one front view and one thin side view. Add concise specs: 11 strings, fanned fret scale, multi-wood body, through-neck or laminated neck construction, custom pickup, wide range, clear low tones, rich harmonics, and unique wood resonance. Include one horizontal tone-image bar labeled from low to high, with warm brown-to-gold coloring.

Lower sections: Include exactly 4 expression bust portraits in a row, each with the same blurred facial area and hair/outfit consistency. Label them as: normal, faint smile, performing, serious. To the right, include exactly 2 standing variation miniatures: stage outfit holding the giant bass dynamically, and casual artisan/workshop outfit standing with the bass. At bottom left, include a related settings / notes box with short lore bullets. At bottom center, include a simple Wishbass logo mark with a large W and small leather-and-bass-design text. At bottom right, include exactly 5 color swatches labeled by motif: walnut, maple, padauk, dark brown, and gold.

Text style: The page may use Japanese-style headings and compact annotation blocks, but keep the visible design clean and legible. Use elegant serif Latin text for the main title and small neat Japanese-style body text blocks for authenticity. Do not overcrowd the sheet beyond the described panels.

Constraints: Exactly 1 main full-body character, exactly 1 oversized 11-string bass held by the character, exactly 3 right-side information panels, exactly 2 instrument diagrams, exactly 4 expression portraits, exactly 2 standing variation miniatures, and exactly 5 color swatches. No modern UI, no sci-fi neon, no photographic realism, no watermark, no extra characters.

title: Pombero Folklore Character Set
prompt:
Goal: Create a dark fantasy creature-design character sheet for {argument name="character name" default="Pombero"}, alias {argument name="alias" default="Shadow of the Monte"}, presented as a professional concept-art turnaround on a clean off-white background.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 presentation sheet, museum-white paper texture, realistic high-detail digital painting with muted earthy colors, fine ink-like labels, thin divider lines, and a polished production-design layout.

Main subject: A short, muscular nocturnal forest spirit inspired by Paraguayan rural folklore. He has rough scarred bark-like skin, dirty bare feet, long clawed fingers, a hunched primal posture, and a faceless or obscured shadowed head under a ragged straw hat. His outfit is made from layered dry leaves, bark strips, vines, feathers, shredded fabric, rope ties, a shoulder mantle, ragged skirt-like wrappings, ankle bindings, and a round tobacco pouch at the waist. The mood is silent, elusive, territorial, cunning, and feral rather than heroic.

Layout: Place one large full-body hero figure on the left, occupying about one third of the canvas, standing barefoot with one arm extended and the other hanging, covered in ragged leaf-and-bark camouflage. At the top left, add the large title “{argument name="title text" default="POMBERO"}” and beneath it the subtitle “Alias: Shadow of the Monte”. Across the upper middle show exactly 4 labeled turnaround poses: “NEUTRAL FRONT VIEW”, “BACK VIEW”, “SIDE PROFILE”, and “SECONDARY ATTITUDE”. The secondary attitude pose should show him kneeling with one knee raised, holding a smoking hand-rolled tobacco roll.

Facial / expression studies: Under the turnaround row, include exactly 6 square portrait-study panels labeled, left to right: “SLY MENACE”, “EERIE CALM”, “PREDATORY FOCUS”, “CUNNING AMUSEMENT”, “WATCHFUL SILENCE”, and “WRATH”. Each portrait is mostly hidden in shadow beneath the hat, emphasizing a silent gaze rather than readable human features.

Details row: Along the lower center, include exactly 6 close-up detail panels labeled, left to right: “HAND & TOBACCO ROLL”, “TOBACCO POUCH”, “SHOULDER WRAP DETAIL”, “WAIST DETAILS”, “FOOT & ANKLE”, and “SKIN & SCAR DETAIL”. Show gnarled fingers gripping tobacco, a round leather pouch, tangled leaf wrappings, rope knots, cracked dirty feet, and scarred bark-like skin texture.

Right-side notes and props: On the right, add an “IDENTITY NOTES” text block with the following readable content: Role: Nocturnal forest spirit. Traits: silent, cunning, territorial, primal, elusive, feared. Core theme: Paraguayan rural folklore, night, superstition, nature, fear, respect. Signature feature: silent feet and piercing gaze. Below the attitude pose, add exactly 1 key prop section titled “KEY PROP – RITUAL TOBACCO”, showing a large hand-rolled tobacco bundle tied with fiber beside dry leaves, with a caption explaining that hand-rolled tobacco is his offering, companion, and mark of his presence.

Bottom-right studies: Include exactly 4 black silhouette thumbnails titled “SILHOUETTE STUDY”, showing different readable poses of the same ragged, hat-wearing creature. Include exactly 7 vertical color swatches titled “COLOR PALETTE”, labeled left to right: “BARK GRAY”, “MONTE GREEN”, “TOBACCO BROWN”, “EARTH UMBER”, “DRY LEAF BEIGE”, “NIGHT CHARCOAL”, and “BLACK”.

Visual style: Hyper-detailed cinematic creature concept art, earthy brown-gray-green palette, photorealistic anatomy mixed with folklore monster design, weathered textures, subtle shadows under each figure, crisp labels, thin black rules, organized like a studio character design board. Avoid bright colors, cute proportions, modern clothing, weapons, logos, watermarks, or extra panels beyond the specified counts.
