title: Luxury 4K AI Video Contest Poster
prompt:
Goal: Create a luxurious vertical Japanese contest poster for a 4K AI video competition about food side dishes that go well with rice, with a dramatic premium restaurant atmosphere.

Canvas: Vertical poster, approximately 2:3 aspect ratio, dark black-brown background with subtle wood texture, warm spotlighting, rising steam, and thin ornate gold Art Deco corner borders around the full poster.

Main visual: On the upper right, show a black iron rice pot filled with glossy freshly cooked white rice, with thick steam rising. A wooden rice paddle enters from the right holding a mound of rice. On the lower right, show a small dark ceramic bowl filled with white rice on a wooden table. Add another close-up translucent rice-and-chopsticks image behind the lower information panel. The food should look photorealistic, appetizing, warm, and moist.

Typography and style: Use elegant Japanese serif typography, mostly metallic gold for headings and white/cream for body text. Make the design feel like a premium competition announcement, with thin gold rules, decorative frames, laurel ornaments, and subtle parchment panels. Keep all Japanese text sharp and readable.

Top headline text: Large gold headline on the upper left: 「4K AI動画」, followed by 「コンテスト開催!!」. Below it, smaller label 「テーマ」 and the theme line in large gold: 「『ご飯に合うおかず』」. Add a short note beneath in white: 「面白そうなので、個人で開催しちゃいます✨」.

Prize section: Create one framed gold-on-black prize block with exactly 3 prize elements: 1) large main prize text 「賞金総額 1万円」 with gold laurel leaves around the large 「1万円」, 2) right-side text 「最優秀賞：4,000円」 and below it 「(Amazonギフト) 1名」, 3) right-side text 「優秀賞：1,000円」 and below it 「(Amazonギフト) 6名」.

Schedule section: Create a dark framed box with a small calendar icon and the heading 「コンテスト日程」. Include exactly 2 bullet points: 「応募期間：5月31日〜6月5日の23:59」 and 「結果発表：6月7日予定」.

Requirements and judging panel: Create a wide cream parchment panel divided into two columns. Left column heading with an edit/checklist icon: 「提出要件」. Include exactly 8 bullet points: 「テーマはご飯に合うおかず（ご飯に乗せる系もOK）」, 「AIで生成した動画」, 「4K動画（後からアップスケールして4Kにしても良い）」, 「長さは3〜15秒が目安」, 「実在する商品を使うことは禁止」, 「オリジナル作品であること（著作権違反禁止）」, 「商店街オリジナル、または権利処理済素材を使用」, 「センシティブ、または不適切な内容は禁止」, and add the final line 「1人何回でも投稿可能」 as the last bullet if space allows while keeping the panel readable. Right column heading with an eye icon: 「審査基準」. Include the main criterion in large type: 「『いかに美味しそうに見えるか』」 and the note: 「これは美味しそう、と私が思った作品が受賞します」.

Submission section: Near the bottom, create a dark framed box with a paper-airplane icon and heading 「提出方法」. Add the instruction: 「私の固定プロフィールポストを引用する形で投稿してください」.

Footer: Add a final centered gold message at the very bottom: 「皆さまの美味しそうな作品を楽しみにしています！」.

Customizable text slots: Use {argument name="headline text" default="4K AI動画 コンテスト開催!!"}, {argument name="theme text" default="『ご飯に合うおかず』"}, {argument name="total prize" default="1万円"}, {argument name="application period" default="5月31日〜6月5日の23:59"}, and {argument name="result date" default="6月7日予定"}.

Constraints: Preserve the exact premium gold-and-black poster style, photorealistic rice imagery, vertical layout, ornate border, and readable Japanese text. Do not add people, logos, watermarks, QR codes, or extra sections.

title: Cute Father's Day Instagram Cover
prompt:
Goal: Create a cute square Instagram carousel cover post for {argument name="audience" default="育児垢ママへ"}, encouraging moms to prepare early for Father’s Day. Use a warm hand-drawn Canva-like style with Japanese lettering.

Canvas: Square 1:1 vertical social media post, cream/off-white paper background with a thin rounded pink border inset from the edges. Soft pastel palette: blush pink, warm brown, peach, cream, and light orange. Pencil-crayon texture, watercolor shading, rounded friendly shapes.

Layout: At the top center, place a pink ribbon banner with stitched details containing the text 「育児垢ママへ」 in dark brown handwritten Japanese. Beneath it, add the main headline in very large dark brown brush lettering across two lines: 「父の日、」 and 「まだ早いと思った？」. To the right of the headline, add a white cloud speech bubble outlined in pink with the text 「6月21日だよ」. Below the headline, place a wide rounded coral-pink pill-shaped callout bar with white handwritten text and small radiating accent marks: 「仕込むなら今がベスト」.

Main illustration: Bottom half shows a cheerful mother and two children rendered as adorable squirrel-like characters, centered and sitting together. Count exactly 3 characters: 1 mother in the middle with orange hair in a high bun, squirrel ears, pink cardigan, holding a pink smartphone with a small heart on the back; 1 small girl on the left with orange pigtails, a pink bow, pink top, smiling and leaning in; 1 small child on the right with squirrel ears, striped cream-and-yellow shirt, large fluffy orange squirrel tail behind them, smiling toward the phone. All have round faces, rosy cheeks, big glossy eyes, tiny noses, and happy open mouths.

Decorative elements: Add exactly 8 pink heart/sparkle decorations around the poster: 1 large heart near the top left, 2 sparkles near the top right, 1 heart on the left above the memo, 2 small hearts/sparkles around the left-middle area, 1 small heart to the right of the characters, and 1 sparkle on the far right. Keep them light and hand-drawn.

Bottom details: In the bottom-left corner, place a tilted white memo card taped with pink washi tape. It must include a small heart and the word “memo” in pink, plus Japanese text in dark brown: 「育児垢ママ向け」 on one line and 「投稿スケジュール」 on the next. Along the bottom center, add exactly 10 small carousel progress dots: the first dot filled coral pink, the remaining 9 outlined or pale. In the bottom-right corner, add a large coral-pink stitched circle badge containing the white number {argument name="slide number" default="1"}.

Text content to preserve exactly: 「育児垢ママへ」, 「父の日、まだ早いと思った？」, 「6月21日だよ」, 「仕込むなら今がベスト」, 「memo」, 「育児垢ママ向け」, 「投稿スケジュール」, and {argument name="slide number" default="1"}.

Constraints: Make the typography look hand-lettered, not like a standard font. Keep the design soft, cute, approachable, and readable on Instagram. Avoid photorealism, hard shadows, clutter, extra characters, extra carousel dots, watermarks, or logos.

title: ASMR YouTuber thumbnail
prompt:
Goal: Create a glossy YouTube thumbnail-style image for an ASMR streamer niche, combining a realistic cozy creator photo with large Japanese title graphics and neon social-media icons.

Canvas: Horizontal 16:9 thumbnail, 1152×768 style composition, cinematic shallow depth of field, cool blue and purple lighting with soft pink highlights.

Main subject: A young female ASMR YouTuber sits on the right half of the frame in a cozy bedroom or streaming room, wearing an off-shoulder lavender knit sweater and black in-ear monitors. Her face is intentionally covered by a large flat rectangular privacy block in muted brown, centered over the face from forehead to chin. She holds a large black condenser microphone with silver mesh grille close to her mouth, mounted in a black shock mount on a stand. Her visible hands have neat pale nails. The mood is intimate, calm, and whisper-stream themed.

Background: Soft-focus bedroom/studio with curtains, shelves, small plants, fairy lights, and a bed or sofa. Use blue-purple ambient lighting throughout, with pink bokeh lights in the center background. Add a glowing mushroom-shaped table lamp at the bottom right and white-and-lavender headphones partially visible beside it.

Layout: Put the creator and microphone on the right, and place a large translucent rounded rectangle title panel across the lower-left to center-left. The panel has a blue-to-purple gradient glassmorphism look. On the far left of the panel, include one large circular gradient badge containing the number “1.” in bold white. To the right of the badge, place the main headline in bold rounded white lettering: “ASMR・配信・” on the first line and “YouTuber” on the second line. Beneath it, add a smaller white pill-shaped label containing “ささやき・会話・配信向け” in blue-to-pink text.

Visible text: Use exactly 3 text blocks: 1) “1.” inside the circle badge, 2) main headline “{argument name="headline text" default="ASMR・配信・YouTuber"}”, 3) subtitle “{argument name="subtitle text" default="ささやき・会話・配信向け"}”. Keep all text crisp, readable, and faithful to the Japanese characters.

Decorative elements: Include exactly 7 neon/social graphic elements around the scene: 1) glowing cloud outline in the upper left, 2) white neon microphone icon below the cloud, 3) white neon chat bubble with three dots beside it, 4) glowing play-button outline in the upper right, 5) audio waveform line along the lower left, 6) one white music-note icon near the bottom center, 7) multiple small sparkle stars scattered near the icons and right edge as a single sparkle cluster style. Use purple, white, and pink neon glow.

Visual style: Realistic photo base with overlaid clean vector graphics, modern creator-economy thumbnail design, soft bloom, high contrast, glossy gradients, rounded typography, dreamy ASMR atmosphere, no watermark, no extra logos, no extra text. Use {argument name="main color palette" default="lavender, blue, purple, and soft pink"} lighting and emphasize {argument name="content niche" default="ASMR streaming and YouTuber prompts"}.

She wears a fitted long-sleeve cropped top in {argument name="top color" default="warm rust brown"}, high-waisted light blue distressed wide-leg jeans with several ripped areas, and chunky brown platform slide sandals. Add a few pink flowers on the left and fern leaves entering the frame at the bottom right. The overall look should feel like a polished lifestyle influencer outfit photo, realistic smartphone photography, slightly elevated exposure, crisp detail, flattering natural light, vertical composition.

title: Japanese Classroom Short Video Screenshot
prompt:
Goal: Create a realistic vertical smartphone social-media video screenshot of an after-school classroom scene, styled like a Japanese short-video app post.

Canvas: 9:16 vertical image, 675×1125 style composition, natural daylight, realistic phone-camera look, slight wide-angle perspective, high detail, no illustration style.

Main scene: In a Japanese high school classroom after school, show exactly 2 foreground teenage girls in summer uniforms. The central girl is fully visible from head to mid-thigh, looking directly at the camera with a shy smile, holding a beige smartphone with small cute stickers partly covering her mouth. She has straight {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} shoulder-length hair with thin bangs, soft natural makeup, and large expressive eyes. Her left hand holds the strap of a navy shoulder bag. The second girl stands cropped on the right edge, visible from half of her face down to her skirt, smiling gently toward the camera.

Uniform and accessories: Both girls wear crisp white short-sleeve button-up shirts, navy-and-green plaid pleated skirts, and navy striped ribbon bow ties. The central girl carries a glossy navy school bag covered with exactly 8 visible plush keychains and charms: 1 large cream teddy bear, 1 smaller white teddy bear, 1 cream bear with pink bow, 1 fluffy white animal charm, 1 lavender plush charm, 1 pink plush charm, 1 small beige tag charm, and 1 metal chain charm.

Background: A busy classroom with wooden desks and chairs, chalkboard on the back right, tall windows on the left with bright daylight. Include exactly 6 background students in white shirts: 2 seated at desks near the left foreground with backs/side views, 1 standing or leaning near the windows, 2 seated near the middle-back, and 1 seated near the chalkboard. Keep them softly out of focus compared with the foreground girls.

App overlay layout: Add a short-video app interface overlay on top of the photo. Right-side vertical action bar with exactly 5 stacked elements: 1 circular profile thumbnail with a pink plus badge, 1 white heart icon with count “3.2万”, 1 white speech-bubble icon with count “162”, 1 white share arrow icon with count “392”, and 1 small circular spinning-record thumbnail at the bottom. Bottom-left caption area contains the username and post text in white Japanese text: “@{argument name="username" default="yui._.daily"} ・ 3時間前”, then “{argument name="caption text" default="放課後の教室ってなんか特別だよね🧸"}”, then “{argument name="hashtags" default="#jk #放課後 #クラスメイト #日常"}”, then a music line with a musical note icon: “オリジナル楽曲 - yui._.daily”. Bottom black comment bar contains placeholder text “すてきなコメントを書く...” plus exactly 2 icons on the right: an @ symbol and a smiley face.

Visual style: Photorealistic Japanese teen lifestyle snapshot, warm natural lighting, clean skin texture, realistic fabric folds, accurate hands and fingers, believable classroom depth, subtle social-media compression, candid but polished.

Constraints: Preserve the exact counts of foreground girls, background students, plush charms, and overlay elements. Keep the image wholesome and non-explicit. Do not add extra people in the foreground, do not add watermarks, and avoid distorted text or broken hands.

prompt:
Goal: Create an ultra-minimalist abstract poster showing exactly 6 iconic world landmarks as delicate pastel pigment-dust illustrations, as if each landmark is partially deconstructed and dissolving into colorful powder.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 white canvas, clean gallery-print layout, lots of empty white space, no border, no title, no captions, no watermark.

Subject details: Include exactly these 6 discrete landmark illustrations: 1) top-left: {argument name="first landmark" default="Eiffel Tower"}, tall iron lattice silhouette with an arched base; 2) top-right: {argument name="second landmark" default="Statue of Liberty"}, raised torch and crown clearly recognizable; 3) middle-left: {argument name="third landmark" default="Big Ben clock tower"}, Gothic tower with visible clock face; 4) middle-right: {argument name="fourth landmark" default="Sydney Opera House"}, low horizontal harbor silhouette with multiple sail-like shells; 5) bottom-left: {argument name="fifth landmark" default="Burj Khalifa"}, very tall tapering skyscraper with a thin spire and faint surrounding skyline; 6) bottom-right: Tokyo Tower, red lattice broadcast tower with a pointed antenna.

title: Anime Sci-Fi Character Setting Collection
prompt:

Canvas: Vertical poster, 2:3 aspect ratio, high resolution. White central background with a lavender left border and bright cyan geometric accents at the top and bottom. Use thin pale-gray framing lines, small triangles, dots, diamonds, and tech-interface decorations scattered around the page.

Main subject: One full-body anime girl dominates the left and center of the poster. She has {argument name="hair color" default="deep violet-purple"} long twin-tail hair with curled ends, side bangs, glossy highlights, and small cyan hair accessories. She has large purple eyes and a calm, slightly serious expression. A black-and-cyan halo floats above her head. She stands in a confident contrapposto pose, holding a purple smartphone in her left hand while her right hand rests near her waist. Outfit: black blazer with white lapels, white shirt, cyan necktie, short black pleated skirt, oversized white-and-cyan futuristic jacket draped around her shoulders, black gloves, black thigh-high tights, chunky black shoes, and a white utility pouch attached at her hip. Include crisp cel-shaded anime rendering, glossy highlights, clean line art, and a premium character-design-sheet finish.

Layout and visible elements: Use exactly 1 main full-body character illustration. Add exactly 1 large schedule/profile card in the upper right with a cyan header and exactly 5 horizontal table rows. The card title should resemble a character scanning/status panel and include mostly decorative pseudo-text. Add exactly 4 stacked rounded-rectangle portrait thumbnails down the right side, each showing a close crop of the same character with her halo and purple hair; the face area may be softly obscured or simplified like censored preview tiles. Add exactly 1 square logo panel near the center-right containing a large cyan stylized number-like emblem resembling “77”. Add exactly 1 paragraph block of tiny gray placeholder profile text beneath the logo. Add exactly 1 small chibi version of the character near the lower middle, lying or leaning forward with a grumpy expression, a small speech bubble, halo above, and a small keyboard or rectangular board beside her. Add exactly 1 large name label near the bottom reading {argument name="display name text" default="Yuuka Kinaye"} in widely spaced pale purple letters, with small decorative ID numbers underneath. Add exactly 1 bottom cyan-and-lavender footer bar with short pseudo-Japanese labels and a small purple emblem.

Text content: The upper-right heading should read approximately {argument name="header text" default="CHARACUR SCIANNINGT5 YUUKA"} with a smaller decorative line of pseudo-Japanese text below it. The schedule card should have a cyan header containing the character name and a status/date-like field, then 5 rows with left-side pseudo labels and right-side times: 19:30, 18:30, 18:30, 18:30, 18:30. Keep most small text intentionally nonsensical, faint, and UI-like rather than fully readable.

Visual style: Modern anime character sheet, Blue Archive-inspired sci-fi school uniform aesthetic, white/lavender/cyan palette, clean vector UI overlays, soft shadows under cards, high-detail polished illustration, sharp cel shading, attractive character design, no photorealism.

Constraints: Keep the page uncluttered but information-rich. Preserve the exact counts: 1 full-body character, 1 schedule card with 5 rows, 4 right-side portrait thumbnails, 1 logo panel, 1 chibi illustration, 1 bottom footer bar. Do not add extra characters, weapons, scenery, or readable branding.

title: Minimalist Studio Editorial Grid
prompt:
请基于我上传的清晰人物照片，生成一张「暖色极简影棚时尚写真九宫格拼图」。

请严格保留照片中人物的真实身份特征，包括脸型、五官比例、眉眼结构、鼻子、嘴唇、下颌线、肤色、年龄感、发际线、发型特征和整体气质。不要把人物变成另一个人，不要过度美颜，不要网红化，不要生成 AI 假脸。最终九张图里必须是同一个成年人，只是在同一套影棚写真中呈现不同构图、姿势和局部细节。

画面形式：
生成一张 3x3 九宫格时尚写真拼贴图，比例 4:5。九张照片像一本杂志内页的 editorial moodboard，也像摄影师拍摄后整理出来的 contact sheet。每一格都是同一个人物在同一套影棚场景里的不同画面，包括面部特写、半身照、侧脸照、肩颈局部、腰部局部、背影、上半身动态和三分之二身构图。

人物设定：
一位成年东亚女性，气质自然、干净、柔和、时尚，有一线城市女性的审美感。整体感觉是优雅、松弛、有女性魅力，但必须高级、克制、自然，不要低俗，不要过度性感，不要影楼风，不要网红滤镜。

发型妆容：
保留原照片中的真实发型基础，可以稍微整理得更蓬松、有空气感和自然光泽。头发可以自然披散，略微凌乱，有轻微风吹感。妆容干净淡雅，皮肤有自然光泽，保留真实皮肤纹理，不要浓妆，不要夸张眼妆，不要塑料皮肤。

穿搭：
人物穿白色修身短款背心、白色针织背心、白色一字肩上衣或白色罗纹无袖上衣，下装为浅蓝色宽松牛仔裤。搭配极简细项链、细手链或小耳饰。整体穿搭干净、轻盈、时尚，像韩国 / 日本 / 中国一线城市流行的极简女性写真风格。服装要自然贴合身体，但不要过度暴露，不要色情化。

场景：
干净的室内影棚，背景是暖米色、奶油色或浅驼色墙面。没有杂物、没有家具、没有文字、没有 logo。整体环境极简、温暖、柔和，像高级时尚杂志拍摄现场。

光线：
柔和暖色影棚光，光线从侧前方或上方柔和照射，皮肤有轻微奶油质感和自然高光。阴影要轻柔，不要硬闪光，不要强烈反差。整体有温暖、梦幻、电影感的氛围。

九宫格内容：

第 1 格：
面部近景特写，人物头部轻微侧转，头发自然垂落在脸侧，有一点风吹感。眼神看向镜头或略微偏离镜头，表情安静、自信、柔和。

第 2 格：
侧面半身照，人物站立，身体侧向镜头，一只手自然抬起整理头发，闭眼或轻轻低头，姿态优雅放松。突出侧脸、肩颈和上半身线条。

第 3 格：
肩颈和锁骨局部细节图，只拍到下巴、颈部、肩线、白色上衣和细项链，不需要完整露脸。画面高级、克制、有杂志局部特写感。

第 4 格：
柔和情绪面部特写，人物闭眼或半闭眼，头发自然扫过脸部，表情放松，画面有轻微柔焦和暖色光感。

第 5 格：
半身时尚写真，人物一只手自然放在锁骨附近或轻轻搭在胸前上方，另一只手自然下垂。动作要优雅，不要做夸张手势，表情安静、有氛围感。

第 6 格：
三分之二身或接近全身照，人物穿白色短款背心和浅蓝牛仔裤，双手自然举起或伸展，姿态像摄影棚中自然舒展身体。画面要时尚、干净、轻盈。

第 7 格：

title: Japanese movie banner in the rain
titleEn: Japanese movie banner in the rain
prompt: Create an emotional Japanese movie trailer banner poster in a tall vertical composition, cinematic anime illustration style, set on a rainy nighttime city street in Japan filled with wet asphalt reflections, neon shop signs, and softly blurred high-rise buildings receding into the distance. In the center foreground, show 1 young anime girl in side profile facing left, standing alone under 1 transparent plastic umbrella with visible raindrops. She has long dark purple hair tied in a high ponytail, a slightly melancholic expression, and wears an oversized teal hoodie layered under a loose pink-and-teal plaid jacket. The mood is lonely, wistful, and dramatic, like a heartfelt live-action Japanese film advertisement reimagined as anime key art. Use cool blue and cyan tones with pink neon accents, glossy rain reflections, shallow depth of field, soft atmospheric haze, and subtle rim lighting from street signs. Add large handwritten white Japanese title text at the top reading {argument name="title text" default="AIの涙"}, with 1 smaller white subtitle line beneath it reading {argument name="tagline text" default="彼女は、なぜ泣いたのか。"}. At the bottom, add 1 bold white release line reading {argument name="release text" default="2024年秋 全国ロードショー"}. Keep the character as the emotional focal point, framed mid-shot from about waist up, umbrella arcing over her head, with the empty rain-soaked street behind her emphasizing isolation and cinematic sadness.

title: Holographic Kamen Knight SSR Card
prompt: A hyper-detailed premium holographic trading card illustration of {argument name="hero name" default="Kamen Rider 1"}, designed like an ultra-rare tokusatsu collectible card with a vertical full-frame ornate border. The central figure is a classic masked hero in a dynamic forward-reaching pose, filling most of the composition from thighs up, with one gloved hand thrust toward the viewer and the other hand holding a smaller version of the same card. He wears a dark green armored chest, black suit, silver segmented gloves and forearms, a red scarf streaming dramatically to the right, a red belt with a large circular red buckle, and a metallic insect-like helmet with 2 long silver antennae and 2 oversized faceted crimson compound eyes. Behind him is a chaotic apocalyptic city battle scene at night with ruined buildings, smoke, sparks, streaking explosions, and a star-filled cosmic sky. Include exactly 10 smaller rider figures in the background and corners: 2 flying in the upper right sky, 1 climbing or leaping on the mid-left ruins, 3 mid-background combat figures across the center-right, 2 small figures in the lower right, 1 blue-accented figure in the lower left, and 1 partially visible figure near the far left edge. The art style is gritty, painterly, metallic, and cinematic, with dense glitter particles, rainbow foil reflections, gold filigree linework, and prism-like holographic highlights across the entire image. The card frame should be lavish black, gold, and iridescent foil with collectible-game styling. At the top center place the text "MASKED RIDER" above large serif text "{argument name="title text" default="KAMEN RIDER"}" and a huge gold number "{argument name="card number" default="1"}". In the top left place a circular emblem showing the masked rider face. In the top right place a large badge reading "{argument name="rarity" default="SSR"}" with 5 gold stars beneath it. In the bottom left place a panel reading "CARD TYPE" and "CHARACTER". At the bottom center place the text "KAMEN RIDER 1" with "仮面ライダー1号" below it, and a barcode-like strip with the text "RIDER LEGEND 1971". In the bottom right add a large gold cursive autograph reading "{argument name="signature" default="NickZag"}". Make the whole card feel like an ultra-premium chase card, dramatic perspective, extreme detail, sharp contrast, glowing embers, shattered-city energy, and luxurious holographic foil texture.

prompt: 一幅充满情绪感的绘本风格数字绘画，描绘了一个瘦小的忧郁孩童，蜷缩在阴暗灰色房间里的一张木凳上，身旁是一扇布满雨痕的大窗户。孩童有着 深褐色 凌乱蓬松的头发、一双巨大且富有表现力的眼睛、苍白的皮肤和几点雀斑，表情忧虑而孤独，双手紧紧抱着膝盖。他们穿着超大号的 带有橙色小补丁或花朵图案的柔和蓝灰色睡衣 和柔软破旧的拖鞋。窗外是凄凉的雨中城市街道，可见 4 栋倾斜的老建筑、4 棵被风吹弯的树、一条湿滑蜿蜒的道路，以及戏剧性翻滚的乌云，整体采用夸张的扭曲透视手法绘制。构图将孩童置于左侧，窗外景色占据右侧，营造出一种孤立与忧郁的氛围。采用具有手绘质感的绘画风格，保留明显的粗糙笔触，色调为低饱和度的蓝灰色，配以柔和的炭笔阴影，湿润玻璃上有细微的高光，孩童的衣物上仅有淡淡的暖色点缀。呈现出类似于暗黑奇幻风格的儿童绘本艺术感，私密、电影感、雨天的忧伤，高细节，方形构图。

title: Museum Paper Art Anime Portrait
prompt: Create a vertical museum-gallery scene showing {argument name="character name" default="an original anime-style girl"} as an ultra-detailed three-dimensional paper craft artwork bursting out from a large white shadow-box frame mounted on a wall. The artwork is a single oversized framed portrait: 1 young girl figure, 1 deep rectangular white frame, 1 small museum visitor standing at the lower right for scale, and 1 plain square privacy-like block covering the center of the girl’s face. The girl has {argument name="hair color" default="soft ash-brown"} long wavy hair made from layered cut paper strips, delicate anime proportions, a sleeveless cream dress with many folded paper ruffles, a pale blue ribbon tie, and a small bracelet. Surround her with intricate paper flowers, translucent petals, pale blue leaves, curling ribbon strips, and layered floral cutouts that extend beyond the frame, creating the feeling that the paper artwork is coming alive and spilling into the room. Use {argument name="accent color" default="pale sky blue"} accents among mostly ivory, beige, cream, and light blush tones. The setting is a quiet contemporary art museum with a high wall, wooden floor, soft natural sunlight from an upper-right skylight, long shadows, and a lone visitor in a black coat looking up at the piece. Visual style: photorealistic museum installation mixed with refined anime illustration, extremely precise paper-cut texture, visible folded edges, layered cardstock depth, delicate shadows, translucent vellum-like pieces, elegant pastel color grading, cinematic lighting, high detail, whimsical yet realistic. Composition: centered giant paper portrait occupying most of the image, visitor small in the bottom-right corner, frame slightly protruding from the wall, flowers and ribbons extending outward in shallow relief. Constraints: no text, no watermark, no extra people, keep the square face block plain and centered, maintain a vertical 4:5 aspect ratio.

title: Fantasy Mushroom Forest Project
prompt:
Goal: Create a wide cinematic fantasy adventure storyboard sheet showing a single continuous action sequence starring {argument name="character name" default="a tiny child adventurer"} in a vast enchanted mushroom forest.

Canvas: Horizontal 16:9 image, one illustration divided into exactly 12 storyboard panels arranged in a 4-column by 3-row grid. Use thin black borders between panels. Place a small white cut number in the upper-left corner of every panel, numbered exactly 1 through 12.

Visual style: Painterly high-detail fantasy concept art with a Ghibli-like sense of wonder, dynamic cinematic compositions, soft dappled sunlight, atmospheric depth, swirling spores, vines, branches, moss, oversized mushrooms, warm orange and cool blue color contrast, visible brush texture, adventurous and whimsical mood.

Main subject: A small wide-eyed child adventurer wearing {argument name="cloak color" default="a bright blue hooded cloak"}, rugged boots, and a large woven basket backpack filled with acorns, berries, leaves, and forest trinkets. The child carries or discovers {argument name="magical object" default="a glowing purple mushroom"}. The scale should make the child look tiny among gigantic mushrooms and forest plants.

Panel sequence: Include exactly 12 discrete panels with these numbered actions:
1. Rear view of the hooded child climbing across an enormous orange-spotted mushroom cap, basket backpack visible, surrounded by towering mushrooms and forest debris.
2. Close cinematic view from under foliage as the child peeks over a huge blue mushroom cap, curious face visible, soft light filtering through leaves.
3. The child reaches toward a glowing purple mushroom nestled among roots, acorns, vines, and tiny plants.
4. Close-up of the child carefully lifting or holding the glowing purple mushroom with both hands, face full of wonder.
5. The child crouches near the giant blue mushroom while the purple mushroom glows brightly in the foreground, branches and oversized fungi framing the scene.
6. Full-body action shot of the child running across a large orange mushroom cap, basket bouncing, adventurous expression.
7. Extreme close-up of one boot landing hard on the mushroom cap, kicking up spores, dust, and textured debris.
8. Dynamic midair leap between giant mushrooms, the child clutching the glowing purple mushroom while vines and branches sweep past.
9. The child swings through the forest on a thick vine or rope, one boot forward, basket backpack visible, dramatic motion and depth.
10. Wide shot of the child running away across a narrow wooden suspension bridge high in the mushroom forest canopy.
11. Long shot of the child standing triumphantly on a huge orange mushroom cap above the forest, small against a sweeping magical landscape.
12. Final close/medium shot of the child seated or resting on an orange-spotted mushroom cap, looking back toward the viewer, holding the glowing purple mushroom, with open sky and a distant enchanted forest behind.

Constraints: Keep the storyboard as one coherent image, not 12 separate files. Maintain consistent character, outfit, backpack, and magical object across all panels. No speech bubbles, no captions besides the white panel numbers, no logos, no watermark.

prompt: Create a cinematic visual titled: “THE PEOPLE WE BECOME.” The image should depict multiple stages of one human life existing simultaneously inside a single interconnected environment shaped by memory, growth and emotional transition. Avoid the feeling of: - a motivational poster, - a staircase timeline, - or separate portraits pasted together. Instead, the world itself should evolve naturally between life phases as if memories are physically blending into one another. The composition follows a winding stone pathway moving through different emotional spaces connected seamlessly across the image. At the bottom of the frame: A newborn sleeps inside a softly lit woven cradle near a dim bedside lamp. The atmosphere feels warm, silent and untouched. Nearby: - folded baby blankets, - soft shadows, - wooden toys, - faint moonlight through curtains, - dust particles drifting in warm air. The pathway slowly transitions into early childhood. A young child runs barefoot through a living room filled with scattered crayons, comic books, paper airplanes and half-built toy structures. Late-afternoon sunlight pours through large windows and reflects softly across wooden floors. The environment gradually changes again without hard separation. The next version appears around age 13: sitting alone on a rooftop during light rainfall wearing headphones and holding a notebook. Distant city lights blur softly behind him while unfinished sketches scatter beside him. The atmosphere becomes quieter and emotionally uncertain. Further along the path: A university-age version studies late at night at a cluttered desk illuminated only by a warm desk lamp and laptop screen. Around him: - highlighted textbooks, - coffee cups, - handwritten notes, - exhaustion, - ambition, - and isolation. Rain reflects softly across the apartment window behind him. At the highest point of the composition: An older version stands quietly overlooking a sunrise city skyline from a hillside path above the city. He looks calm rather than triumphant. His clothing is simple and grounded: rolled sleeves, slightly tired posture, hands in pockets, wind moving softly through his shirt. He should visibly feel like the same person shaped by every previous version. The transitions between life stages should contain subtle symbolic continuity: - flowers growing through cracks in concrete, - notebook pages blending into city architecture, - rainwater reflections becoming skyline lights, - old drawings faintly appearing on apartment walls, - childhood objects partially hidden inside later environments. Typography should remain minimal and restrained. Small serif text placed naturally near each stage: “Wonder.” “Becoming.” “Doubt.” “Discipline.” “Perspective.” No motivational quotes. No oversized typography. Lighting should evolve emotionally throughout the image: - warm soft childhood tones, - cooler rainy teenage atmosphere, - isolated tungsten lighting during study years, - balanced sunrise light in adulthood. The realism should feel grounded: - believable facial continuity across ages, - natural environmental texture, - subtle lens softness, - realistic lighting behavior, - physically believable spaces, - quiet cinematic atmosphere. The image should feel intimate and reflective rather than grand or overly dramatic. Mood: memory, identity, growth, loneliness, ambition, emotional evolution and the quiet passage of time.

prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical Japanese promotional comparison poster for an article about why generating a school swimsuit is difficult in GPT Image 2, showing a before/after visual test report.

Canvas: Portrait 4:5 layout, clean editorial blog-thumbnail design, white background with pale blue watercolor splashes and subtle pool-water motifs near the top corners. Use elegant dark navy Japanese serif typography.

Main layout: Two large side-by-side photo panels separated by a thin white vertical divider. Use exactly 2 comparison images: left panel labeled as failure, right panel labeled as improvement. At the top-left of the image area, place a rounded red pill label reading 「失敗」. At the top-right, place a rounded blue pill label reading 「改善」.

Left photo panel: A realistic full-body poolside photo of an adult woman in a navy one-piece competitive racing swimsuit, standing at an indoor or stadium-like competition pool. Make it look like a sports meet or swimming competition: spectator stands, scoreboard, lane ropes, starting block, and official competition atmosphere. Her face should be intentionally obscured with a rectangular blur/mosaic block. The pose is upright and athletic, emphasizing that the generation became too much like a competitive swimmer.

Background includes blue pool water, lane ropes, pool deck, low school-building architecture, and greenery. Her face should also be intentionally obscured with a rectangular blur/mosaic block. The mood is casual school daily life rather than sports advertising.

Footer: Centered Japanese text in dark navy: 「11万閲覧の裏側を note にまとめました」 with the word “note” in bright blue. Under it, add a small line of text: 「競泳選手化 → 学校の日常へ」 with the arrow in red. Use a faint divider line above the small text.

Use {argument name="room type" default="small Chinese apartment dining room"}, {argument name="number of people" default="3"}, {argument name="censor style" default="opaque rectangular pixelated blur blocks"}, {argument name="main clothing color" default="pink and gray"}, and {argument name="camera style" default="tilted low-resolution phone snapshot"}. On the right side, feature a large aged human skull in profile, highly detailed, weathered, and partially overlaid with circles, target marks, sigils, thin grid lines, and red diagram annotations. Near the upper center, place a mysterious woman with long dark hair and pale skin, wearing a low-cut black garment, posed sensually with one hand raised near her face; behind her head, add a large dim red halo ring. On the left upper quadrant, include the draped back or shoulder of a pale classical-statue-like figure, ghostly and fragmentary. In the lower middle-right, place a dark-skinned ritual figure or priestess wearing layered beads, necklaces, and ceremonial adornment, partially obscured by texture and collage interference. In the lower right, show one worn cloth doll or voodoo-style rag figure hanging or suspended, with visible seams and outstretched limbs. In the bottom center, depict a rainy night street scene with 1 lone trench-coated figure walking away under dim lights and 1 car parked or idling on the wet road, reflections glowing red on the pavement. In the lower left, add a faceted black pyramid or crystal-like geometric form emerging from darkness. Scatter exactly 7 visible Latin text blocks throughout the design, styled as aged serif typography and cryptic inscriptions: "IN SOMNIIS VERITAS; IN DESIDERIIS, PERDITIO.", "ANIMA SINE FINE VAGAT, IN UMBRIS SUI IPSIUS INVENTA.", "PASSIO EST CLAVISTRA", "EGO SUM QUI NUNQUAM FUI.", "III FRAGMENTUM INFINITUM.", "COR AMAT; MENS DUBITAT; ANIMA LACERATUR.", and "IN VINO VERITAS IN SANGUINE REDEMPTIO". title: Anime Concert Interview Magazine Spread Page Design | AI SUPERLIVE 2026

prompt: 一款极具视觉冲击力的动漫宣传访谈海报，设计为未来感现场音乐活动的精美杂志双页跨页。场景展示了一个座无虚席的夜间演唱会现场，观众挥舞着霓虹黄、蓝、紫色的荧光棒，背景是巨大的发光舞台、激光束、光斑、烟雾，以及一个巨大的三角形播放图标屏幕，上面写着"AI SUPERLIVE SUMMER 2026"。前景中央是两位动漫风格的女主持人，以戏剧性的侧后方视角呈现，两人都望向舞台。左侧角色为 {argument name="left character name" default="ソラ"}，身穿带有黑色和酸橙绿点缀的深色超大款连帽夹克，佩戴标有"06"的大型酸橙绿耳机，头顶举着一支亮黄色的荧光棒；她的脸部被一个矩形隐私遮挡块部分遮盖。右侧角色为 {argument name="right character name" default="ナギ"}，留着银白色短波波头，皮肤白皙，身穿浅色超大款连帽外套，在舞台灯光的柔和映照下，胸前握着一支蓝白色的发光指挥棒，侧脸表情动人，注视着演出。运用电影级的轮廓光、饱和度丰富的紫蓝色演唱会色调、反光织物高光，以及精致的动漫渲染，呈现出高级的编辑广告质感。排版仿照日本专题访谈风格，包含密集的文字覆盖、半透明深色面板、细霓虹黄边框以及醒目的无衬线字体。包含 8 个独特的文本块：左上角 1 个小型标题标签，写着"/ SPECIAL INTERVIEW /"；左上方 1 个大型日文标题，写着"この夏、AIと音楽の未来がステージで輝く！"；右上角 1 个活动 Logo 块，写着"AI SUPERLIVE SUMMER 2026"和"2026.7.18 SAT @ FUTURE ARENA ODAIBA"；左侧堆叠 3 个以"Q."开头的黄色边框问答面板；右侧堆叠 3 个以"Q."开头的黄色边框问答面板；以及人物附近标有"ソラ"和"ナギ"的 2 个角色介绍名称框。在底部左侧和中央添加一行醒目的日文结束语："AIと音楽が響き合う、新しい夏がはじまる。 一緒に、未来を体験しよう！"。右下角包含一个重复活动名称和日期的页脚块，以及一个可见的二维码和标注官方网站的小字说明。整体风格融合了高端日本活动传单、访谈文章和主视觉图的特色，充满活力、未来感、情感张力与节日氛围。

title: Epic narrative travel poster
prompt:
【收藏级旅行史诗海报 · 通用元提示词】

根据我上传的多张人物照片，自动生成一张收藏级史诗叙事旅行海报。

默认第一张附图作为主剪影轮廓参考，优先提取人物的侧脸、身体姿态、头发轮廓、服装轮廓与整体气质，形成画面主体剪影。

其余附图作为真实照片拼贴素材使用，必须尽量保留原照片中的人物形象、姿态、服装、发型、配饰、光影与动作瞬间，不要重新生成陌生人物，不要擅自更换性别、年龄、脸型、发型、穿搭、配饰或体态。

人物一致性要求：所有出现的人物都必须来自上传图片中的同一人物或同一组人物。模型需要从图片中自动提取人物特征，包括五官结构、脸型、发型、肤色、身材比例、穿搭风格、配饰、姿态与气质。不得将人物美化成完全不同的脸，不得随机生成新人物。

旅行目的地：{argument name="目的地" default="昆明"}

请根据填写的城市或景点，自动生成对应的旅行视觉世界，包括该地的标志性自然景观、城市地标、街道氛围、建筑风格、文化符号、季节气候、代表性色彩、交通方式与旅行记忆物件。

画面结构采用“主剪影轮廓 + 真实照片拼贴 + 双重曝光叙事”的方式。

第一张附图的人物轮廓作为大型主视觉，剪影内部自然生长出目的地的完整旅行叙事世界。其余附图以照片拼贴形式嵌入剪影内部或画面周围，形成多个旅行瞬间节点。拼贴边缘可以用水彩、纸张颗粒、轻雾、光斑、胶片划痕、手账贴纸等方式柔和融合，但人物本身必须清晰可辨，不能被过度重绘。

空间层次需要清楚：

近景是上传照片中的人物真实瞬间、行走、停留、回望、互动、背影或特写。

中景是目的地街道、桥梁、建筑、花海、车站、湖边、市集、山路、海岸等旅行场景。

远景是城市天际线、山水轮廓、天空、云层、日落、晨雾或星光。

整体要像一张被收藏起来的旅行记忆地图，带有“人在路上，世界在身体里展开”的感觉。

风格为电影级旅行收藏海报、双重曝光叙事、真实照片拼贴、轻水彩肌理融合。画面要高级、克制、诗意、有空气感和记忆感。使用柔和空气透视、轻雾化过渡、纸张颗粒、边缘飞白、大面积留白、自然光影。

色彩根据目的地自动适配，控制在2到5种主色内，保持统一高级。可以提取上传照片中的服装色、环境色作为辅助色，使人物与目的地自然融合。

文字系统使用中英文结合：

主标题：{argument name="城市名" default="昆明"} + 对应英文名
副标题：自动提炼该目的地的旅行气质
短句：生成一句中文旅行短句和一句英文旅行短句
信息元素：可加入中英双语路牌、地图、邮戳、车票、相机、手写注释等旅行符号

文字必须融入画面设计，像海报的一部分，不要像后期硬贴上去。

输出比例：3:4 或 4:5
输出质感：高清、收藏级、电影海报级、旅行记忆拼贴感

title: ChatGPT Game Asset Generation Screenshot
prompt:
Goal: Create a realistic screenshot of a ChatGPT-style web conversation showing an image-generation result for game assets, with Japanese UI text and four generated asset thumbnails.

Canvas: Landscape browser/app screenshot, approximately 797×750 px, white background, clean minimal interface, cropped so only the assistant response area and the bottom row of images are visible.

Layout: At the top center, place one rounded light-gray user message bubble containing {argument name="user request text" default="image genでゲームで使えそうなアセットの画像を4枚を個別で生成して それぞれを3D化してみて！"}. Below it, left aligned, show a small gray status line reading 「25m 50s作業しました 〉」 followed by a thin horizontal divider. Under that, create an assistant response in Japanese with file lists and blue clickable file links.

Text content: Include the assistant paragraph 「できました。4枚のゲーム向けアセット画像を生成して、それぞれPixal3DでGLB化まで通しました。」 Then the label 「画像:」 followed by exactly 4 bullet links with small image/file icons: 1) mana_crystal_alpha.png, 2) treasure_chest_alpha.png, 3) energy_turret_alpha.png, 4) mushroom_house_alpha.png. Then the label 「3D化したGLB:」 followed by exactly 4 bullet links with document icons: 1) mana_crystal.glb, 2) treasure_chest.glb, 3) energy_turret.glb, 4) mushroom_house.glb. Then add the closing Japanese sentence 「生成したのは、魔法クリスタル、宝箱、SFエネルギータレット、きのこ家です。背景はクロマキーから透明化して、3D化に渡しています。」

Bottom image strip: Show exactly 4 rounded-square thumbnail cards in one horizontal row, each about 178×178 px with small gaps. Thumbnail 1 has a vivid green chroma-key background and a stylized fantasy {argument name="asset one" default="blue mana crystal obelisk on a dark stone base"}. Thumbnail 2 has a vivid green chroma-key background and a {argument name="asset two" default="wooden treasure chest with dark metal bands, gold lock, and red jewel"}. Thumbnail 3 has a vivid green chroma-key background and a {argument name="asset three" default="gray sci-fi energy turret with blue glowing core and cannon barrel"}. Thumbnail 4 has a bright magenta chroma-key background and a {argument name="asset four" default="cute mushroom house with red spotted cap roof, wooden door, and warm windows"}. All four assets are polished 3D game-art icons with transparent-cutout style lighting, centered and isolated.

Visual style: Modern ChatGPT interface screenshot, Japanese typography, black body text, blue link text, small monochrome icons, generous margins, subtle divider lines. The asset thumbnails should look like high-quality mobile game props rendered in colorful semi-realistic 3D.

Constraints: Include exactly 8 file links total, exactly 4 PNG links and exactly 4 GLB links, and exactly 4 asset thumbnail images. Do not add extra panels, watermarks, browser chrome, avatars, or unrelated UI controls.

title: Vintage Pomegranate Growth Diagram
prompt:
Create a highly detailed vintage scientific botanical infographic poster on warm ivory paper, styled like a 19th-century natural history atlas plate with modern clean layout refinement. The main subject is a full pomegranate plant, labeled {argument name="plant name" default="石榴"} / {argument name="latin name" default="Punica granatum"}, shown centered from crown to roots in a full vertical cutaway-style presentation. Depict a slender woody trunk with many branches, glossy green leaves, several orange-red blossoms, unopened buds, young fruits, mature fruits, one large split-open pomegranate exposing dense ruby seeds, and a fully visible sprawling root system underground. Use delicate watercolor and ink rendering, realistic botanical anatomy, precise linework, subtle sepia shadows, fine leader lines, arrows, and small numbered callout circles. Overall poster title at upper left: {argument name="headline text" default="植物生命路径剖面"} with English subtitle directly below: {argument name="subtitle text" default="BOTANICAL GROWTH ATLAS"}. Add a short introductory bilingual-style text block beneath the title. The composition is a tall 9:16 educational poster with the plant occupying the center and explanatory diagrams surrounding it.

Include exactly 8 numbered educational sections around the plant, each with visible Chinese title and smaller English translation, arranged atlas-style:
1. Seed Architecture — a large cutaway seed diagram with labeled internal parts and a smaller cellular cross-section inset.
2. Germination Mechanism — a left-side sequence of exactly 5 stages showing seed swelling, cracking, sprouting, radicle emergence, and early seedling.
3. Root System + Substrate Intelligence — a large exposed root mass at lower left with exactly 2 circular magnified root-detail insets showing branching structures and root-hair/network texture.
4. Stem, Leaf & Vascular System — a right-middle section with exactly 2 anatomical circular cross-sections and exactly 1 separate leaf illustration, with labels for xylem, phloem, epidermis, and related tissues.
5. Photosynthesis + Energy Conversion — a lower-right biology panel with exactly 3 green microstructure diagrams, including leaf tissue/cell-like sections, plus a simple chemical flow line indicating CO2 + H2O to sugars and O2.
6. Bud Formation + Blooming — an upper-right flowering section with exactly 2 large flower anatomy diagrams, one side view and one longitudinal cutaway, with labeled stamens, petals, ovary, and pollen structures.
7. Pollination + Fruiting Pathway — a right-side development strip with exactly 5 fruit development stages from bud to mature pomegranate, accompanied by a pollination inset featuring a bee approaching a flower.
8. Fruit Maturation + Seed Cycle — a bottom-right lifecycle section with exactly 3 fruit illustrations showing whole fruit, cracked fruit, and opened fruit with scattered seeds, plus exactly 3 seedling progression drawings.

Along the very bottom edge, include a long chronological growth strip with exactly 19 small step illustrations, each numbered in sequence from 1 to 19, showing the plant life cycle from dormant seed through germination, root growth, seedling emergence, sapling development, flowering, fruit set, ripening, seed release, and cycle renewal. Add a small environmental factors panel at lower left with icon-like indicators for light, temperature, water, nutrients, and air. Use bilingual labeling throughout, with Chinese headings more prominent and English translations in smaller serif text. Aesthetic should feel scholarly, elegant, museum-quality, and information-dense, with refined antique typography, muted beige background, realistic reds and greens, and a clean balanced atlas layout.

title: Cinematic Exhibition Room Portrait
prompt:
Use my reference photo to preserve the exact facial features, hairstyle, bangs, facial proportions, skin tone, body posture, and overall silhouette with high identity consistency.

Cinematic portrait of a woman standing alone inside a dark exhibition room. She wears a vintage white shirt layered with a {argument name="jacket color" default="soft pink"} outer jacket and a black vintage-textured skirt. Minimal makeup. Front-profile pose with her body facing the camera, relaxed posture, one shoulder slightly lowered, hands gently adjusting her hair. Calm, mysterious expression with an intellectual and elegant aura.

She is positioned in the lower center of the frame, surrounded by darkness. A single dramatic diagonal spotlight cuts across the scene from the upper right to the lower left, illuminating only half of her body while the rest fades into shadow. Behind her is a {argument name="mural style" default="colorful vintage Japanese mural wall"} filled with retro cartoon illustrations and traditional artistic details.

Foreground shadows naturally frame the composition like torn darkness, creating a moody museum atmosphere with lonely artistic energy and a contemplative cinematic mood. Realistic photography with subtle film grain, analog texture, muted blacks, and vibrant mural accents.

Camera angle: eye-level shot, medium-close portrait framing, subject captured at approximately a 70-degree side profile angle, slight distance from the subject for environmental storytelling, centered cinematic composition.

Camera settings: cinematic low-light photography, shallow depth of field, realistic shadow falloff, Kodak Portra film color grading.

Lighting: {argument name="lighting source" default="harsh focused spotlight from the upper right"} creating a strong diagonal beam and deep high-contrast shadows, minimal ambient light, rich blacks, soft warm highlights along the face and glasses edges.

Vibe: mysterious, artistic, museum-core aesthetic, intelligent quiet energy, melancholic cinematic atmosphere, indie film still, luxury editorial photography, solitary nighttime mood, understated elegance.

Style: ultra-realistic cinematic photography, analog grain, editorial fashion portrait, natural skin texture, subtle imperfections, realistic color science, masterpiece quality.

Negative prompt: anime, smiling, overexposed lighting, extra limbs, bad anatomy, overly colorful outfit, cyberpunk neon, blurry face, low quality, distorted hands, unrealistic skin, HDR overload, exaggerated makeup, busy composition, duplicate person.

Its back is lined with a row of sharp dorsal spines, and its massive body curves across the entire background, emphasizing scale and power. In front of the dragon stands {argument name="character name" default="a dragon knight queen"}, a tall armored woman in ornate red, black, and gold battle attire, facing forward in a heroic stance. She has {argument name="hair color" default="red"} hair styled long and flowing, partially tied up, and wears elaborate engraved plate armor with decorated pauldrons, gauntlets, a fitted breastplate, and a long layered gown-like armored skirt with intricate gold filigree. A rich crimson cape drapes behind her and catches the wind. She holds 1 unsheathed sword lowered at her side, while a second blade or dagger is visible at her waist, giving the composition exactly 2 visible weapons. The palette is dominated by scarlet, burgundy, copper, and antique gold, with dramatic sunlight, detailed textures, ultra-fine scales, polished metal, and flowing fabric. Composition is epic and centered, low-angle, full-body warrior in the foreground with the dragon’s head filling the left side and its coiled body arcing across the upper and right background. Style: ultra-detailed fantasy concept art, majestic, heroic, painterly realism, sharp focus, high contrast, volumetric light, premium game key art quality.

title: Star Witch Costume Design

Goal: Create an ornate anime fantasy character outfit design sheet for a celestial witch or astral mage, showing a full magical costume and its accessories with a luxurious navy, gold, ivory, and sapphire palette.

Canvas: Wide horizontal fashion reference sheet on warm beige parchment paper, highly detailed 2D illustration, clean line art, delicate gold filigree, elegant gothic-lolita fantasy styling, no realistic photography.

Layout: Arrange exactly 5 main visible elements across the sheet: 1 seated young witch character on the left wearing the full outfit, 1 front-facing full outfit mannequin in the center, 1 circular astrolabe or celestial chart accessory at the upper right, 1 matching pair of thigh-high boots on the far right, and 1 dangling jewel ornament at the lower right. Add small decorative stars, moons, pendants, chains, and constellation motifs floating around the design.

Subject details: The character is a delicate anime girl with {argument name="hair color" default="soft wavy lavender-pink hair"}, pale skin, a calm mysterious expression, and large eyes partly hidden by an enormous pointed witch hat. The outfit theme is {argument name="costume theme" default="celestial star mage"}. slug: 幼儿蜡笔画风格办公室自拍-5_3085e9
title: Toddler Crayon Style Office Selfie
prompt: Using the two provided office selfie references, transform the scene into a square 1:1 drawing that looks like it was made by a child about 3 years old with crayons on white drawing paper. Use the references only for the composition, person/object placement, broad color choices, and background balance; do not recreate anything photorealistically. Keep the woman seated close to the camera in the office, with dark brown hair, a white blouse, the desk and monitor on the left, office shelves/files and coworkers in the background, and the overall selfie-like framing. Render everything as an enthusiastic toddler crayon drawing: rough scribbly outlines, uneven proportions, simple shapes, messy coloring outside the lines, visible wax texture, naive perspective, and incomplete details. Preserve the face-obscuring square as a flat skin-tone block over the face. Make the pose closer to REFERENCE_0, without the peace-sign hand from REFERENCE_1. Keep the palette simple and crayon-like, with white paper visible, no realistic lighting, no polished illustration style, no text, no watermark.

slug: 日式云感鞋垫电商广告图-高转化率设计-2_1c0e34
title: Japanese Cloud-Sensation Insole Ad | High Conversion Design
titleEn: Japanese Cloud-Sensation Insole Ad | High Conversion Design
prompt: 制作一张高转化率的日式电商鞋垫方形广告图，风格参考 Rakuten 乐天市场的首页横幅。背景采用明亮的天蓝色渐变，点缀柔和的白云，设计风格简洁、高级且充满活力。中央为醒目的白色粗体书法衬线字大标题，带有蓝色光晕：“雲インソール”。上方配有一个蓝色文字的白色圆角胶囊标签：“履いた瞬間ふわっ！”。主标题下方为较小的白色手写风格副标题：“まるで雲の上を歩くような心地よさ”。展示共 4 个鞋垫产品视图：左下角前景处由真人手持一只竖立的白色泡沫鞋垫，展示其鹅卵石般的泡棉纹理及细小透气孔；中央立着一只灰色织物面鞋垫；右下角堆叠放置两只倾斜的白色鞋垫，强调其厚实的缓冲感与底部纹理。左上角添加一个带有皇冠和月桂叶的大型金色奖章，内含日文“第1位”，并配有写着“楽天ランキング”的红色丝带。右上角添加一个垂直的金色丝带徽章，写有日文“累計販売数 10万足 突破!”。左侧放置 4 个垂直堆叠的白色圆角图标框，上方配有蓝色手写小标题“こんなお悩みに!”，内含简单的蓝色线条图标及标签：1“足の疲れ”、2“衝撃吸収”、3“長時間の立ち仕事”、4“ウォーキング スポーツに”。右侧放置 2 个带有蓝色边框的白色功能框，配有蓝灰色图标：上方框文字为“衝撃吸収 疲れにくい”（配步行者图标），下方框文字为“通気性◎ ムレにくい”（配气流线条图标）。右下角添加一个大型白色云朵状标注，内含醒目的蓝色日文“極上の クッション感”及一个小巧的蓝色云朵图标。底部中央放置一个蓝色小圆角标签“選べるサイズ”，下方标注大号蓝色尺码文字：“23.0cm〜29.0cm”。采用清晰的产品摄影布光，呈现柔和阴影、光泽高光与生动的对比度，打造专为即时转化而优化的精美电商广告构图。

title: Clay Animation Style Social Media Banner
titleEn: Clay Animation Style Social Media Banner
prompt: Create a wide 2:1 social media banner in a handcrafted claymation stop-motion style. Canvas size about 984×440 px, with a warm pastel yellow clay background and soft cinematic shadows. Center the composition around one huge raised clay fist emerging from behind a dark charcoal rounded rectangle strip across the bottom third. Behind the fist place one large red folded ribbon/banner shape spreading left and right, and one blue spiky burst shape directly behind the fist. At the top, add one oversized bold white 3D clay headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="懦夫救世!"}, with rounded puffy edges, slight red shadowing, and one red clay star used as the dot/accent near the final exclamation area. Add exactly one circular profile avatar at the lower left overlapping the dark bottom strip: a cute beige clay character with large googly eyes holding a small microphone, framed by a dark ring. Add exactly one rounded black button at the lower right with a thin light outline and small white Chinese text reading {argument name="button text" default="编辑个人资料"}. Use soft polymer-clay texture everywhere, visible fingerprints, rounded handmade edges, macaroon warm colors, shallow depth of field, and realistic stop-motion lighting. Keep the layout clean and graphic, with exactly 5 main visible components: the white headline, the red ribbon, the central fist, the left circular avatar, and the right edit-profile button. No photorealistic skin, no flat vector look, no extra characters, no watermark.

title: Fake Apple CEO appointment poster
prompt: A sleek, photorealistic Chinese tech-announcement poster in Apple advertising style, vertical 4:5 composition, with a dramatic dusk-to-night gradient sky in deep navy blue fading lighter near the horizon. Center the upper body of a middle-aged East Asian man in the foreground, wearing a minimalist black button-up shirt over a black undershirt, standing confidently with a calm executive posture in front of Apple Park’s curved glass architecture. His face is mostly front-facing and slightly turned, with short black hair and thin dark eyeglasses, styled like a serious corporate portrait. Behind him on the right side, place a large glowing white Apple logo floating against the sky. At the very top center, include a small white Apple logo with the Chinese line “Apple 新篇章 由此开启” in a refined thin sans-serif layout. In the top right corner, add large bold red Chinese text: “AI生成”. Across the upper-middle area, place a huge bold white Chinese headline: “罗永浩 接任 Apple CEO”. Directly below it, add a smaller spaced-out white Chinese slogan: “用 工 匠 精 神 ， 让 世 界 再 次 惊 叹”. On the left middle area, add a quoted statement block in dark text with an oversized opening quotation mark, reading: “我不是来改变 Apple， 而是让 Apple 重拾改变世界的勇气。” and beneath it a handwritten-style signature “罗永浩”. Across the lower middle, overlay a translucent dark horizontal feature bar containing exactly 4 icon-and-text columns with thin white line icons: 1) a hammer icon with the title “工匠精神” and subtitle “极致产品主义”, 2) a speech bubble icon with the title “用户至上” and subtitle “体验细节控”, 3) a light bulb icon with the title “创新驱动” and subtitle “重新定义未来”, 4) a heart outline icon with the title “真诚沟通” and subtitle “打造人的科技”. At the very bottom center, add large white English text: “Think Different. Think Again.”, and below it smaller Chinese text: “现在，交给罗永浩。” with another handwritten signature underneath. Use luxury tech keynote poster aesthetics, cinematic soft lighting, glossy reflections on the building, high contrast, clean typography, premium Apple-inspired branding, polished commercial realism.

slug: 动漫少女伸手触碰猫咪-3_56de44
title: Anime Girl Reaching Out to Touch Cat
titleEn: Anime Girl Reaching Out to Touch Cat
prompt: Create a wide, minimalist anime illustration in a soft Niji-style watercolor look: a {argument name="character type" default="quiet teenage girl"} crouches low on the left side of the canvas, facing right, gently extending one hand toward a sitting {argument name="animal" default="black cat"} on the right. The girl has short dark bobbed hair with straight bangs, pale skin, a calm slightly shy expression, and small hoop earrings. She wears an oversized dark olive hoodie, a dark plaid pleated skirt, white fishnet tights, chunky black platform shoes with laces, and a large soft guitar case strapped diagonally across her back, rising behind her head. Her pose is compact and balanced on the balls of her feet, knees bent, one arm resting forward and the other reaching delicately toward the cat. The cat sits upright, tail stretched along the ground, looking at her hand with a quiet curious expression; its inner ears have a subtle pink accent. Use a pale cream background with faint blue-gray watercolor clouds, lots of negative space, delicate thin linework, muted navy and olive shadows, gentle pastel lighting, and a dreamy hand-painted texture. Keep the composition horizontal and cinematic, with the girl occupying the left third and the cat in the right third, separated by open air and a tender moment of almost-touching. No text, no borders, no photorealism.

prompt:
# 混沌としたメモ書き・記号の集合体からキャラクター���顔を浮かび上がらせるアート

---

## スタイル
- 白い紙の上に黒インクで描かれた大量の手書きメモ、数式、記号、ランダムな線。
- 紙いっぱいに散らばる書き殴り風のカオス。
- 所々に{argument name="アクセント色" default="赤インク"}の強調（ライン、塗り潰し、マーカー風の塊）。
- アナログのノート落書きのような質感。

---

## 構図
- ランダムなメモや記号が全体を覆い尽くす。
- 黒インクの線や文字の密度が「キャラクターの顔」の位置に集中する。
- 結果として、混沌の中から「与えられたキャラクターの顔のシルエット・表情」がうっすら浮かび上がる。
- 顔は写実的ではなく、カオスの断片が集まって形を成す。

---

## 色彩
- モノクロ（黒・白）を主体に構成。
- {argument name="アクセント色" default="赤インク"}をアクセントとして散発的に配置。
- 彩度は抑えめ、アナログの紙とインク感を重視。

---

## 表現要素
- 読めるようで読めない文字列、日本語や英数字が混在。
- 数式記号、矢印、点、斜線、クロス、ドリップ（インクの飛び散り）。
- キャラクターの顔の目や髪の輪���は、メモや記号の配置の「余白」や「濃淡」で浮かび上がる。

---

## 禁止事項
- 顔を直接的に描き込む写実ポートレート。
- デジタル処理的で整然とした幾何学模様。
- カラフルな彩色や過飽和表現。
- ロゴ、透かし、人工的なCG感。

---

## Definition of Done (DoD)
- 全体は「混沌としたメモ・記号の集合体」として成立している。  
- 与えられたキャラクターの顔が、混沌の濃淡・配置から自然に浮かび上がる。  
- 色はモノクロ＋{argument name="アクセント色" default="赤アクセント"}のみ。  
- 紙とインクの手描き的質感を保持している。

The bottom has small destination typography, icons, coordinates, and a short Japanese text block.

Letter A contains a white lighthouse on a stone pier with sailboats and sea. Letter S contains Akashi Castle, green pine trees, stone walls, and a small bridge over water. Letter H contains a modern station and high-rise city buildings, including a sign reading “JR Akashi Station”. Letter I contains an orange sunset sky, the bridge in the background, and a large clock monument on a brick base.

Add an anchor icon and coordinates: “34.6513° N, 134.9855° E”. Bottom left small lighthouse icon with English slogan: {argument name="slogan" default="GATEWAY TO KOBE. BRIDGE TO TOMORROW. prompt:
Goal: Create a delicate 12-panel zodiac character collection poster featuring twelve cute anime-style girls, one for each Western zodiac sign, in a soft watercolor storybook aesthetic.

Canvas: Vertical poster in a 3-column by 4-row grid, with exactly 12 equal square panels separated by thin white gutters. Use a pale cream paper background with subtle watercolor texture, gentle fading edges, and no text labels.

Visual style: Dreamy Japanese kawaii illustration, soft pastel palette, translucent watercolor washes, pencil-like sketch lines, airy composition, tiny sparkles, floral accents, plush animals, magical props, and a hand-painted children’s book feeling. Characters should have tiny closed or sleepy eyes, soft blush, small mouths, oversized wavy hair, frilly dresses or fantasy outfits, and peaceful poses. Keep the entire image light, gentle, and slightly hazy, with no harsh contrast.

Subject details: Depict exactly 12 zodiac-themed girls, one per panel, arranged left to right, top to bottom:
1. Aries: a peach-orange curly-haired girl with small ram horns, surrounded by warm orange brushstrokes, holding a fluffy lamb-like plush or companion.
2. Taurus: a brown-haired girl with bull horns, sitting among roses and soft cream flowers, holding a dessert or cake, with a cozy teddy-like animal nearby.
3. Gemini: two twin girls standing close together, one pink-haired and one blue-haired, surrounded by small floating cards or papers and sunflowers.
4. Cancer: a blue-haired girl under a coral-pink crab-shaped hood or umbrella, hugging a pillow, with several tiny orange crabs around her.
5. Leo: a golden-blonde girl wearing a small crown, holding a wand or scepter, with a cute lion plush beside her, warm yellow-orange tones.
6. Virgo: a brown curly-haired girl in a neat scholar or botanist outfit, sitting at a desk with an open botanical book, small jars, flowers, and tidy shelves behind her.
7. Libra: a lavender-haired girl holding golden balance scales, wearing a pale flowing dress, with delicate flowers and a small white bird nearby.
8. Scorpio: a dark purple-haired girl in a gothic floral outfit, surrounded by black-purple flowers and scorpion-tail shapes, elegant and mysterious but still cute.
9. Sagittarius: an orange-haired archer girl with a bow and arrow, wearing a light green skirt, with small wings or feather details and a tiny animal companion.
10. Capricorn: a gray-brown curly-haired mountain-goat girl with curved goat horns, wearing earthy layered clothes and a backpack, standing near rocks or mountains with a small goat companion.
11. Aquarius: a pale blue-haired girl pouring water from a vessel, surrounded by blue ribbons, bubbles, and swirling water shapes, wearing a white and blue flowing outfit.
12. Pisces: a blue-haired ocean girl with starfish and sea ornaments in her hair, holding or surrounded by two pastel fish, with watery translucent blue waves.

Customization: The collection theme is {argument name="zodiac theme" default="Western zodiac signs as cute anime girls"}. The art style is {argument name="art style" default="soft pastel watercolor kawaii anime illustration"}. The character mood is {argument name="character mood" default="sleepy, gentle, dreamy, and innocent"}. The palette is {argument name="color palette" default="pale peach, cream, lavender, sky blue, soft gold, and rose pink"}. The layout is {argument name="layout" default="3 columns by 4 rows with 12 square panels"}.

Constraints: Include exactly 12 panels and exactly the 12 listed zodiac characters. Do not add text, logos, captions, watermarks, realistic faces, photorealism, or dark dramatic lighting. Maintain consistent chibi-inspired proportions and the same watercolor texture across all panels.

title: Comparison of advertisements for skincare products in Japan

prompt: Create a side-by-side comparison image showing 2 vertical Japanese skincare advertisement banners on a dark charcoal background, each banner framed as a clean smartphone-style ad mockup with a white and icy blue beauty aesthetic. The left banner should look elegant and visually polished but less sales-driven: a soft backlit close-up of a woman with wet-looking dark hair and luminous bare skin, her face partially obscured by a centered rectangular blur block, pale blue water textures, floating droplets, a white-and-silver sunscreen tube labeled {argument name="product name" default="VITA LUMIÈRE"} near the lower right, refined Japanese serif and sans-serif typography, and a large blue rounded CTA button at the bottom. Include the headline in Japanese: 「透明ツヤ肌をつくる ビタミンC×日焼け止めクリーム」, small supporting copy above and below, 3 circular benefit icons near the lower middle, the handwritten-style subcopy 「まるでスキンケア！つけるたび、素肌がうるおう。」, and a bottom CTA button reading 「今すぐ透明ツヤ肌を体感する」. title: Muscle Lobster Spinach Comics
prompt: A vintage single-panel comic illustration in a mid-century newspaper-cartoon style, showing an anthropomorphic red lobster standing on a wooden dock by the sea and posing like a bodybuilder. The lobster is the only character and fills most of the frame, facing slightly left with an angry, proud expression, narrowed eyes, long curved antennae, whisker-like mouth feelers, huge exaggerated claws, an enormous hyper-muscular torso, oversized biceps, thick chest, and a sharply defined six-pack and obliques. One claw is raised in a flexing pose near a large speech bubble. The speech bubble in the upper left contains exactly this hand-lettered text in bold black comic lettering: “I YAM WHAT I YAM! and I YAM RIPPED!” with “RIPPED!” emphasized larger and underlined. At the lobster’s feet, slightly left of center, place 1 opened can labeled “SPINACH” with green spinach visible inside and the lid peeled back. The dock includes 1 wooden mooring post wrapped with rope on the far left. In the background, show calm blue water, a bright blue sky, and 4 fluffy white clouds spread across the top area. On the far right background across the water, include 1 small cannery or factory building on pilings with a sign reading “SPINACH” and 2 smokestacks, one releasing a puff of gray smoke. Render it with flat comic colors, bold black outlines, slightly aged paper texture, light ink imperfections, and a humorous parody tone reminiscent of 1930s–1950s Popeye-era animation art.

slug: 手绘风格旅行日记插画-9_f96ddc
title: Illustration of travel diary in hand-painted style
titleEn: Illustration of travel diary in hand-painted style
prompt:
请绘制一张色彩鲜艳、竖版（9:16）手绘风格的《{argument name="城市名" default="北京"}旅行手账插画》，画风仿佛由一位充满好奇心的孩子用蜡笔创作，整体使用柔和温暖的浅色背景（如浅黄色），搭配红色、蓝色、绿色等明亮色调，营造温馨、童趣、满满旅行气息的氛围。

一、主画面：手账式旅行路线

在插画中央绘制一条“蜿蜒曲折的旅行路线”，路线用箭头 + 虚线连接多个地点，由 {argument name="天数" default="1"} 日行程自动生成推荐景点：

示例格式（自动替换为{argument name="城市名" default="北京"}相关）：

- “第 1 站：{景点 1 推荐 + 简短趣味描述}”
- “第 2 站：{景点 2 推荐 + 简短趣味描述}”
- “第 3 站：{景点 3 推荐 + 简短趣味描述}”
- …
- “最终站：{当地招牌美食/纪念品 + 温馨结束语}”

> 旅程站点数量随天数自动生成：
> 若用户未输入天数，则按默认 1 日 / 精华线路生成。

---

二、周围趣味元素（全部根据城市自动替换）

在路线周围加入大量充满童趣的小元素，例如：

- 可爱的旅行角色：
  “拿着当地特色小吃的小朋友”、
  “背着旅行包的冒险小孩”等。

- 当地标志性建筑的童趣 Q 版手绘：
  如 “{城市地标1}”、“{城市地标2}”、“{城市地标3}”。

- 有趣的提示牌：
  “小心迷路！”、“注意人流！”、“前方好吃的！”（可根据城市语境调整）。

- 贴纸式小标语：
  “{argument name="城市名" default="北京"}旅行记忆已解锁！”
  “{argument name="城市名" default="北京"}美食大冒险！”
  “下一站去哪儿？”

- 当地美食的可爱小图标：
  如 “{城市美食1}”、“{城市美食2}”、“{城市美食3}”。

- 感叹句（保持童真风）：
  “原来{argument name="城市名" default="北京"}这么好玩！”
  “我要再来一次！”

---

三、整体风格要求

- 手绘蜡笔风 / 儿童旅行日志风格
- 色彩鲜艳、构图饱满但温暖
- 强调旅行的欢乐与探索感
- 所有文字采用可爱的手写字体
- 让整个画面像一本童趣满满的旅行手账页面

title: Oriental Aesthetic Ink Poster
prompt:
新中式水墨山水海报，竖版9:16构图，东方极简美学风格，
大面积留白，整体色调为春日清晨氛围（青绿色、雾蓝、淡灰、浅墨），低饱和、清透柔和，高级质感。
画面主体为奇峻巍峨的群山，从中间平静湖面的两侧拔地而起，占据左右两侧画面，
山体以水墨晕染表现，浓淡干湿变化丰富，局部融入淡青绿色渲染，体现春意生机。
山峰被湿润轻柔的晨雾包裹，雾气层层递进，与浅青蓝天空自然融合，形成空气透视与空间纵深。

湖面如镜面般平静，呈现微青绿色调，倒映山体与天空，反射略带柔焦与雾化扩散效果，增强春日湿润与梦幻氛围。
中景一艘带弧形篷顶的小木舟缓慢漂浮，船桨轻触水面形成细腻涟漪，水纹自然扩散，整体保持极静状态。

船上为一位红衣渔女，体量较小（远景比例），人物简化处理为水墨剪影 + 轻微设色，
身着低饱和朱砂红传统服饰（非鲜艳红），颜色略被雾气柔化，
人物面部不刻画细节，仅保留轮廓与姿态（如轻扶船篷或执桨），
红色在水面形成淡淡倒影，作为画面唯一暖色视觉焦点。

岸边点缀疏林与春季新生植被，采用淡墨 + 淡青绿点染，虚实结合，增强节奏与生命气息。

少量飞鸟在远空掠过，轻盈疏散分布，增强空间层次与灵动感。

画面顶部居中竖排书法：“{argument name="标题" default="东方美学"}”，采用传统手写行书或行草风格（王羲之笔意），
笔触自然起伏、提按分明，带飞白与墨韵扩散效果，避免字体感。
书法颜色为深墨青或柔和墨黑，与整体画面统一。
整体风格：水墨 + 现代极简设计融合，春日禅意、空灵湿润、宁静氛围，
冷暖对比克制，电影感光影，高级艺术海报质感，8K超清细节。

title: Pixar style project layout
prompt:
Create a cinematic storyboard page in a 2x3 grid (6 panels) in a single image, {argument name="style" default="3D Pixar-like style"}, soft warm lighting, based on the {argument name="theme" default="Gugu Gaga kigurumi universe"}. This page is “Share Your Light – Part 1” and should feel self-contained for a 15 second short. Consistent characters across all panels: 

- Gugu Gaga Penguin: tiny chibi child in a black penguin mascot suit with white belly, yellow feet, yellow beak hood, short messy dark hair, blue hair clip, collar ring and diagonal strap.

- Sunny Chick: tiny chibi child in a round yellow chick suit with tiny orange beak, short curly orange hair, sunflower hairpin.

Include simple speech bubbles with the exact dialogue in quotes. No other text on the page.

Panel 1 (top left) – Opening loneliness:
Evening in a small cozy playground at sunset, soft orange light. Wide shot. Gugu Penguin sits alone at the edge of a sandbox, shoulders slumped, penguin feet dangling, a small dim glowing lantern toy beside them. Background slightly blurred with empty swings. Speech bubble from Gugu: “My light is so small… no one even notices me.”

Panel 2 (top middle) – Closer sadness:
Medium shot closer on Gugu. The lantern glow is weak on their suit. Gugu looks at their own reflection in the lantern, eyes watery. Background still mostly empty. Speech bubble from Gugu: “Maybe I should just hide it.”

Panel 3 (top right) – First contact:
Same playground, medium two-shot. Sunny Chick waddles into frame from the side holding a tiny paper star garland, looking kind and curious. Gugu glances up, surprised. Warm colors, sunset behind them. Speech bubble from Sunny: “Hey… I noticed. Your light got me here.”

Panel 4 (bottom left) – Sitting together:
Two-shot of Gugu and Sunny now sitting together on the sandbox edge, the lantern between them glowing softly on their kigurumi suits. Background park lights starting to appear as little bokeh dots. Sunny’s body language open and friendly. Speech bubble from Gugu: “Really? It doesn’t feel like much.”

Panel 5 (bottom middle) – Soft reassurance:
Slightly closer on Sunny and Gugu. Sunny leans in, smiling gently, one wing-like arm gesturing toward the lantern. Lantern glow a little brighter. Speech bubble from Sunny: “It was bright enough for me to find you.”

Panel 6 (bottom right) – Part 1 hook:
Medium close two-shot, the lantern centered between their faces. Gugu looks uncertain but hopeful. Sunny’s eyes shining in the warm light. Background faded. Speech bubble from Gugu: “But what if it’s not enough to help anyone?” No other text; leave the emotional question hanging at the end of Part 1.

prompt:
[GPT-image2 Structural Prompt: {argument name="主题" default="The Dark Godfather"}]

### 1. Identity Transformation (核心人像迁移)
- Base Identity: Take the facial structure from [Reference Image].
- Modifications: Age the face by {argument name="年龄增加" default="30 years"}, adding deep-seated wisdom lines and weathered, leathery skin texture. Maintain the stoic, unshakable gaze of a high-status leader.

- Light Source: A single, harsh Vertical Top-Lighting (垂直顶光) from directly overhead. 
- Shadow Mapping: This lighting must create cavernous shadows in the eye sockets, making the eyes almost invisible in mystery. It should cast a sharp, long shadow under the nose and chin, highlighting the skull's bone structure for a "silent authority" look.

### 3. Scene & Composition (场景与构图)
- Subject: The man is seated in a classic high-backed black leather chair. He is slowly and rhythmically stroking a {argument name="宠物" default="dark, sleek cat"} on his lap.

- Background: A pitch-black, minimalist study. Only a faint, out-of-focus silhouette of a mahogany desk is visible.
- Camera: 85mm lens, f/1.8, medium shot, slight low-angle perspective.

### 4. Color & Texture (色彩与质感)
- Palette: Desaturated color grading. Deep tobacco browns, obsidian blacks, and sharp amber highlights (#B08D6A / #1A120B).
- Texture: 35mm film grain, Subsurface Scattering (SSS) for realistic skin highlights, PBR texture mapping (no plastic feel).

### 5. Negative Constraints (负面约束)
- NO smiling, NO looking at the camera directly, NO youthful skin, NO flat lighting, NO bright backgrounds, NO vibrant colors, NO digital smoothness.

title: Brainrot Lecture Hall Projector
prompt: A realistic photograph taken from the audience in a dimly lit university lecture hall, looking over the backs of the heads of three students in the foreground towards a large projector screen. The projector screen displays a layout split into three distinct vertical panels. The left panel shows vertical {argument name="left game" default="Subway Surfers gameplay"}, featuring a character running on train tracks collecting gold coins with UI elements like a score of "001022". The wide center panel displays an academic presentation slide titled "{argument name="slide topic" default="9.3: Infinite Geometric Series"}". The slide contains math text: "Example 3: Find the sum of the infinite geometric series. 1/3 - 1/9 + 1/27 - 1/81 + ... Solution: The series is geometric with a = 1/3 and r = -1/3. Since |r| < 1, the infinite geometric series converges. S = a / (1 - r) = (1/3) / (1 - (-1/3)) = (1/3) / (4/3) = 1/4. The sum of the series is 1/4." The slide footer reads "{argument name="professor name" default="Dr. Larson"}", "{argument name="course name" default="Calculus II"}", "11/14/2024", and "7 / 35". The right panel shows vertical {argument name="right game" default="Minecraft parkour gameplay"}, featuring floating wooden blocks over a grassy landscape with a TikTok watermark at the bottom right. The room has a drop ceiling and blackboards visible behind the screen edges.

title: Anime NYC Adventure Poster
prompt:
Goal: Create a bold illustrated travel poster for {argument name="city" default="New York City"} with an anime street-fashion heroine towering over a rainy nighttime Manhattan street, mixing photoreal urban landmarks with comic sticker doodles and punchy typography.

Canvas: Vertical poster, 2:3 aspect ratio, high-resolution, full-bleed. Dark blue dusk sky fading into warm city lights and wet reflective pavement. Energetic youth-culture advertising composition.

Layout: Left third is dominated by a stacked headline in huge condensed uppercase block letters. Center background shows the Empire State Building lit up, with Manhattan skyscrapers behind it. Right half features a full-body anime girl standing in an exaggerated low-angle heroic pose, one foot very large in the foreground. Bottom and side areas are filled with sticker-like NYC icons and doodles.

Main text: Large headline at upper left reads exactly: “YOUR NEW YORK ADVENTURE STARTS HERE”. Use white for “YOUR,” “ADVENTURE,” and “HERE,” yellow for “NEW YORK,” and hot pink for “STARTS.” Below it, handwritten script reads exactly: “Ride the subway. Hit the streets. Taste the city.” with “subway” in cyan and “city” in hot pink. Add small sticker text blocks reading exactly: “NYC IT HITS DIFFERENT,” “NYC ♥ ALL DAY. EVERY DAY. LIVE IT. LOVE IT.,” and “BIG DREAMS BIGGER CITY.” Add a round subway badge near the Empire State Building reading “NEW YORK CITY” around the rim, a large “7” in the center, and “SUBWAY” underneath.

Character details: The main character is one young anime woman, cheerful and confident, with {argument name="hair color" default="bright cyan-blue hair with magenta-pink tips"}, short bob haircut, big expressive eyes, and a small smile. She waves with her raised right hand and holds a steaming hot dog in her left hand. Outfit: oversized yellow-and-black bomber jacket with patches and graffiti marks, black cropped top, black baggy cargo pants with zipper details and pink “Brooklyn” graffiti on one leg, layered necklaces, earrings, rings, and chunky cream high-top sneakers with pink heart and black accents. Jacket includes visible pink “NYC” lettering and yellow graphic patches.

Counted visual elements: Include exactly 1 main anime girl, 1 Empire State Building, 1 steaming hot dog in her hand, 1 oversized foreground hot dog sticker at bottom left, 1 yellow taxi sticker riding a blue wave, 1 small pizza-slice sticker near the upper right, 1 large pizza-slice sticker on the right, 1 Chrysler Building doodle, 1 bearded pigeon with sunglasses and a cap at bottom right, 1 pink heart doodle above the girl, 1 yellow star near the left center, 2 pink star stickers, and 1 pink heart sticker near the “NYC it hits different” label.

Visual style: Hybrid anime illustration and gritty urban poster design; saturated cyan, yellow, hot pink, black, and cream palette; thick black ink outlines; halftone texture; hand-drawn sticker borders; subtle film grain; splattered ink and small bird silhouettes. City background should feel cinematic and semi-realistic, while the character and stickers are crisp comic/anime art.

Atmosphere: Adventurous, playful, iconic, and aspirational, like a modern NYC tourism poster for young travelers. Wet streets reflect taxi lights and skyline glow. Add steam from the hot dog and tiny radiating lines around the heart doodle.

Constraints: Keep all visible text legible and spelled correctly. Do not add logos, watermarks, QR codes, or extra paragraphs of text. Preserve the exact poster hierarchy: headline on left, character on right, Empire State Building centered behind, sticker collage around the bottom and sides.
