slug: 等轴测微观世界剖面档案-7_ebb1e4
title: Isometric Micro World Cross-Section Archive
prompt:
请根据【主题】创作一张高完成度、高信息密度、适合系列化发布的「微缩世界剖面馆 / Isometric Micro-World Archive」视觉图。

这不是普通房间插画，也不是单纯的建筑图，而是一张结合“等距轴测视角 + 建筑剖面结构 + 多层功能空间 + 高密度主题道具 + 微缩模型感 + 游戏场景设定集感”的主题空间总览图。画面需要像一个被剖开的微缩世界、经营模拟游戏场景、玩具屋模型或世界观设定图，让观者可以一眼看懂整体结构，又能反复观察其中的小细节。

【基础设定】
主题：【主题，例如昆虫研究所 / 未来生存基地 / 魔法药剂工坊 / AI自动化公司 / 植物工厂 / 儿童学习中心 / 太空补给站】
空间名称 / 品牌名：【品牌名或空间名称，可为空】
世界观方向：【现实 / 科幻 / 童话 / 魔法 / 末日 / 博物馆 / 实验室 / 经营模拟 / 校园 / 自然生态】
建筑类型：【小屋 / 基地 / 工厂 / 实验室 / 商店 / 博物馆 / 地下空间 / 飞船 / 多层工作室】
核心功能：【这个空间主要用来做什么，例如研究、生产、展示、生活、训练、交易、学习、维修、种植】
主色调：【主色调，例如浅蓝、薄荷绿、奶油黄、粉色、橙绿、紫蓝、白蓝科技色】
辅助色：【辅助色，可为空】
点缀色：【点缀色，可为空】
画幅比例：【1:1 / 3:4 / 4:5 / 9:16】
信息密度：【中高密度 / 高密度 / 超高密度】
整体气质：【治愈、可爱、精密、童趣、科普、未来感、复古、清爽、探索感】

如果某些字段没有填写，请根据【主题】自动合理推导，不要让画面留空。所有内容都要围绕主题统一生成，避免加入无关元素。

【画面结构】
采用清晰的等距轴测视角 / isometric view / axonometric view，主体是一个被剖开的多层主题建筑或功能基地。观者可以同时看到建筑的正面、侧面、顶面和内部空间。整体建筑位于画面中心，占据画面主要面积，背景环境适度淡化，用来衬托主体。

建筑内部需要分成多个功能区域，每个区域都要有明确用途，而不是随机堆放装饰。可以包含：
1. 主工作区 / 核心操作区
2. 展示区 / 收藏区 / 标本区
3. 研究区 / 实验区 / 控制区
4. 储藏区 / 货架区 / 物资区
5. 生活区 / 休息区 / 小型居住区
6. 能源区 / 机器区 / 管道区
7. 种植区 / 培养区 / 生态区
8. 入口区 / 运输区 / 维修区
9. 楼梯、平台、走廊、栏杆、梯子等空间连接结构

各个区域之间要通过楼梯、走廊、平台、管道、桥架或电缆形成清晰的空间关系，让画面像一个真实可以运转的小型系统。

【道具与细节】
根据【主题】生成大量相关道具，并让它们分布在不同功能区中。道具需要具体、可识别、有主题关联，不能只是泛泛的装饰。每个小物件都应像游戏资产一样清晰可读，具有可点击、可互动、可收集的感觉。

道具类型可以包括：
- 主题设备：机器、仪器、工具、控制台、容器、屏幕、工作台
- 生活物件：桌椅、书架、床铺、杯子、箱子、柜子、灯具
- 展示物件：标本、模型、海报、说明牌、玻璃柜、陈列架
- 连接结构：管道、电线、梯子、楼梯、输送带、滑轨、平台
- 生态元素：植物、水箱、培养箱、土壤、树枝、岩石、标本
- 角色元素：少量小人物、小动物、机器人或主题生物，用来提供尺度感和故事感

道具数量要丰富，但要保持秩序。所有道具都应服务于空间功能和主题世界观。

【风格要求】
整体风格为清晰、可爱、精密的手绘卡通等距插画。线条干净，边缘略圆润，色彩明亮柔和，整体具有轻松、治愈、探索感。画面应有经营模拟游戏、儿童科普绘本、微缩模型、设定集页面的感觉。

避免过度写实，避免强烈暗黑光影，避免厚重油画感，避免复杂噪点。重点是清楚、精致、有层次、可读性强。

【颜色与光影】
使用高明度、低到中等饱和度的柔和配色。主色调统一，辅助色用于区分不同空间，点缀色用于突出关键设备和小道具。线稿颜色不要使用死黑，可使用深灰、蓝灰、棕灰等柔和描边。

光影保持轻量，不需要强烈真实投影。通过色块、结构、线条和局部高亮来建立层次。背景使用浅色、低对比度处理，使主体建筑更加突出。

【构图与阅读路径】
画面主体居中或略微偏上，建筑呈多层剖面结构。视觉阅读路径应从整体建筑轮廓开始，再进入各楼层功能区，最后观察细节道具。可以通过楼梯、平台、走廊、管线、轨道等元素引导视线。

整体画面要饱满但不拥挤，丰富但不混乱。每个房间、平台和角落都应该有内容，但仍然保持清晰的空间边界。

【背景环境】
背景可以根据主题加入弱化的外部环境，例如森林、城市、街道、地下岩层、实验园区、海底、太空、校园、工厂外墙等。背景不要抢主体，建议使用淡色、低透明度、低对比度处理，形成“主体清晰、背景退后”的效果。

【最终效果】
最终画面应像一张完整的主题空间设定图，既有建筑剖面图的结构感，又有游戏场景资产图的细节感，还带有微缩玩具屋的可爱探索感。它应该适合用于系列化视觉创作、IP世界观展示、游戏场景设定、品牌空间概念图、科普内容封面或小红书/Pinterest风格视觉发布。

请确保画面：
1. 等距轴测视角明确
2. 建筑剖面结构清楚
3. 多层功能区完整
4. 道具丰富且主题统一
5. 色彩柔和明亮
6. 线稿清晰干净
7. 背景弱化、主体突出
8. 信息密度高但不混乱
9. 具有可探索、可运营、可反复观察的微缩世界感

Count exactly 4 arms visible: 2 upper arms and 2 lower arms; count exactly 4 glowing energy blades, one held in each hand, translucent neon blue with crystalline edges and magical circuitry-like light patterns. Emphasize the contrast between matte black metal, torn fabric, pale skin, and electric cyan weapons. The composition should feel cinematic, high-detail, intense, and heroic, with sharp focus on the character and soft depth-of-field in the background. Near the bottom, add a large centered quote in gold Japanese text {argument name="quote" default="「僕は君の未来を高値で買いに来た」"}; directly below it, a smaller line ——時計仕掛けの運命が、今動き出す. At the very bottom center, place the author name {argument name="author name" default="ざっ"} in large gold text with elegant ornamental divider lines on both sides. Use a luxurious fantasy-book-cover layout, moody sepia-and-charcoal palette with bright cyan highlights, ultra-detailed anime-inspired realism, and a polished GPT-image-2 editorial illustration style.

Below it, add a beige ribbon banner with Japanese text {argument name="limited goods label" default="限定グッズ"}. Decorative lace should appear in the top-left corner and along the bottom edge.

Layout: Arrange exactly 5 product panels around the main portrait, each with cream-gray paper texture, thin gold trim, small ribbon or price badges, and Japanese product names.

Product panel count and contents:
1. T-shirt panel, bottom-left: label {argument name="t shirt label" default="Tシャツ"}, size text “M / L / XL”, one white T-shirt mockup with a printed rectangular photo graphic on the chest, a speech bubble saying the design is simple and good for everyday use, and a gold price badge “¥4,950”.
2. Photo set panel, lower center: label “フォトセット”, show exactly 6 sample photo thumbnails arranged in a 2-row collage, divided into vertical set and horizontal set labels, with large translucent “SAMPLE” text stamped over several thumbnails, a speech bubble saying 3 random photos out of 6 total are included, and a gold price badge “¥1,100”.
3. Tapestry panel, upper-right: label “タペストリー”, sublabel “A2サイズ”, show one A2 wall-hanging tapestry mockup with the same woman’s portrait, hanging from a black rod and string, a circular note saying it is a large A2 tapestry to decorate a room, and a gold price badge “¥4,400”.
4. Mug panel, mid-right: label “マグカップ”, show one black-handled mug with a portrait print on the side, and a gold price badge “¥2,200”.
5. Acrylic stand panel, lower-right: label “アクリルスタンド”, show exactly 2 stand components: one small white base plate and one full-body acrylic stand of the woman sitting on a wooden stool in a black dress and heels, with a gold price badge “¥2,750”.

Keep product panels crisp and readable, with realistic mockups but slightly stylized lighting.

Constraints: Use exactly 5 product panels and exactly 6 photo thumbnails in the photo set. Keep all faces softly blurred or obscured. Do not add extra products, extra dates, watermarks, QR codes, or social media icons.

title: Red Pink Fractal Kaleidoscope
prompt: Create a square abstract kaleidoscopic geometric artwork in a strict two-color palette of {argument name="primary color" default="vivid crimson red"} and {argument name="secondary color" default="soft bubblegum pink"}. The composition is perfectly symmetrical on both vertical and horizontal axes, with an additional diagonal mirror feeling, filling the entire canvas edge to edge. Use sharp flat vector-like triangular polygons only, no gradients, no outlines, no shadows, and no texture. Build the image from nested triangles and recursive fractal triangle clusters: 1 central diamond-shaped medallion made of many tiny red and pink triangles, 4 pointed triangular spires extending from the medallion toward the top, bottom, left, and right, 4 large mirrored corner rosette structures containing dense miniature triangle mosaics, 4 long diagonal fractal bands running from the center area toward the corners, and 8 large pink star-like polygon arms radiating around the center. The overall impression should resemble an origami mandala, a crystalline tessellation, or a Sierpinski-triangle kaleidoscope, with alternating red and pink triangular facets forming a bold symmetrical abstract pattern. Keep the design crisp, high contrast, flat, mathematically precise, and decorative, with no text, no border, no objects, and no recognizable figures.

title: Vintage Snow Tactical Selfie
prompt: Create a low-resolution retro 3D video game cutscene-style close-up selfie of exactly two characters standing shoulder to shoulder in a snowy, gray mountain environment. Use a dark, moody PlayStation 1 / early PlayStation 2 aesthetic with visible polygonal geometry, blocky textures, jagged edges, muted lighting, and a 4:3 aspect ratio. The left character is {argument name="left character" default="a petite blue-haired elf girl named Yuki"} with long bright blue hair, pointed elf ears, a dark stitched cap or hood with black ribbon ties, and black tactical clothing; her face is deliberately covered by one opaque square censor block in a cool gray-blue tone. The right character is {argument name="right character" default="a rugged Solid Snake-like soldier"} with spiky dark brown hair, a navy headband tied at the back, tan skin, and bulky black tactical armor with a high collar; his face is deliberately covered by one larger opaque square censor block in a dark brown-black gradient. The composition is an intimate upward-angled close-up, with the left character lower and partly cropped on the left side, and the right character taller, dominating the right side and cropped at the top. Add a cold foggy background with a blurred snowy slope on the far left and exactly two visible face-covering censor squares, one over each character. Include soft falling snow made of small square pixel-like flakes scattered through the background. Keep the image dark, cinematic, and intentionally imperfect, like a captured frame from an old stealth-action game.

prompt: 一幅超高密度的极繁主义奇幻插画，采用完美对称的正面构图，描绘了一个糖果主题的农历新年神龛场景，色彩与细节极其丰富。正中央，一位卡哇伊风格的玩偶状女神盘腿坐在糖果堆上，姿态如莲花般静谧。她的身后是一个巨大的放射状曼陀罗光环，由层叠的莲花瓣和装饰性的节日图案组成，呈现出金色、粉色、橙色、青色和霓虹彩虹色。她留着深棕色带紫色光泽的亮面波波头，配有齐刘海，面容如瓷器般精致，双唇红润，双眼被一条黄黑相间的警示带状条纹遮阳板或眼罩遮住。她的头发上装饰着超大号糖果珠和棒棒糖，身穿一件极尽奢华的雕塑感礼服，由糖霜、糖针、蝴蝶结、爱心、糖果挂件、粉彩吉祥物头像和滴落的糖果纹理构成。她的双手平放在膝盖上，掌心向上，姿态庄重而宁静。环绕她的是一个由微型宝塔、灯笼塔、龙、玩偶、糖果、玩具和吉祥符号组成的祭坛城市，所有元素均以镜像对称的方式密集排列。四个角落分别包含 4 个大型圆形边框的甜点吉祥物：左上角是一个微笑的粉色糖霜纸杯蛋糕，右上角是一个带蝴蝶结的微笑粉色马卡龙，左下角是一个微笑的姜饼人，右下角是一个微笑的粉色糖针甜甜圈。上半部分包含 6 个醒目的红金配色圆形节日招牌，上面写有"福"、"旺"、"喜"、"吉"等中文字符。中心两侧各有一条华丽的龙，中下左右两侧各有一头装饰精美的大象，附近摆放着两个金元宝碗。背景中散布着许多身着传统节日服装的小玩偶女孩，宛如收藏级手办。整个前景被无数五颜六色的口香糖球、糖果、小泰迪熊、笑脸糖果、棒棒糖、珠子和玩具般的生物所覆盖，没有任何留白。风格：超高细节、光泽感 3D 数字艺术、糖果风、波普超现实主义、玩具立体模型、节日祭坛、农历新年意象、饱和的红色、粉色、橙色和金色，闪烁的高光，清晰的对焦，复杂的纹理，充满庆典与神圣的氛围。

title: Japanese Skincare Lotion Ad
prompt: A high-end Japanese skincare advertisement for a moisturizing lotion, shot in a luminous soft-white studio with a clean airy beauty aesthetic. On the right half of the image, a close-up portrait of a young East Asian woman with flawless dewy skin, natural glossy lips, subtle peach-toned makeup, dark brown eyes, and dark hair loosely tied back with a few wispy strands across her forehead. She smiles gently at the camera and rests one hand against her cheek, wearing a simple white sleeveless top. On the left half, place 1 tall transparent frosted bottle of lotion standing upright on a reflective water surface, with tiny water droplets on the bottle and a shiny silver cap. The bottle label reads "SUIREN" and "MOISTURIZING LOTION". Surround the bottle with 3 pale pink cherry blossoms: 2 clustered at the lower left corner and 1 floating near the bottom center-right. Add faint sparkles and soft reflections in the water. Use a pastel palette of white, pearl, blush pink, and very light blue-gray, with diffused daylight, silky skin retouching, shallow depth of field, and a premium cosmetic campaign look. Include Japanese ad copy on the left in elegant black Mincho-style typography: a large 2-line headline reading "触れたくなる、" and "透明感。"; beneath it, 2 smaller lines reading "うるおい満ちて、" and "澄みわたる素肌へ。"; a thin outlined circle containing 2 stacked phrases with an × between them, "高保湿" and "透明感". In the lower right, add small Japanese text "うるおいが、私を輝かせる。" above the brand name "SUIREN" and the subtitle "MOISTURIZING LOTION". Composition should feel balanced and luxurious, like a magazine-ready spring skincare poster.

slug: 日语-ai-报告润色应用界面设计稿-0_1dbb8d
title: Japanese AI Report Polishing App UI Design Draft
titleEn: Japanese AI Report Polishing App UI Design Draft
prompt:
Goal: Create a clean, realistic mobile app mockup for a Japanese AI report-checking app, shown as a rounded white modal card on a light gray background, suitable for testing demand on social media. The app name should be {argument name="app title" default="レポート添削AI"} and the screen should look like a finished product UI.

Canvas: Wide horizontal image, approximately 16:7 aspect ratio. Center a large rounded rectangle app window with a soft shadow, thin light-gray border, and bright white background. Add subtle vertical divider lines and very light gradients to make it feel like a polished SaaS/mobile web interface.

Layout: Use exactly 2 main content panels inside the app window. Left panel is the report input area. Right panel is the AI correction results area. Place a dark circular close button with a white “×” in the top-right corner of the modal. Add two floating dark pill buttons near the bottom-left overlapping the modal: one labeled “＋ ALT” and one labeled “編集”. A partial dark rounded bar is barely visible at the bottom-right edge, cropped by the image frame.

Left panel details: At the top center, show the heading “レポート添削AI” and a smaller subtitle “AIがあなたのレポートを改善します”. Below, add the section label “レポートを入力してください”. Show a large textarea card with a sample Japanese report paragraph about SNS usage among young people; include a small character counter “128/3000” at the lower right of the textarea. Under the textarea, place one prominent purple rounded button labeled “添削する”. Beneath the button, add a tiny caption “AIによる添削開始”.

Right panel details: Add the title “AIによる添削結果”. Show a rating row with label “総合評価” and a small green rounded badge labeled “B+”. Then create an “改善ポイント” section containing exactly 3 checklist items, each preceded by a green circular check icon: 1) “具体例があると説得力が増します”, 2) “データや根拠を加えるとより良くなります”, 3) “結論を明確にすると締まりが良くなります”. Below that, add an “改善例” section with a paragraph of Japanese corrected text beginning with “近年、SNSの利用者数は増加しており、2023年の総務省の調査によると、10代の約90%がSNSを利用している。” and continuing in small readable Japanese body text.

Visual style: Minimal Japanese product UI, Apple-like rounded corners, crisp sans-serif Japanese typography, black and dark-gray text, green success accents, purple primary CTA button with slight gradient, generous whitespace, realistic soft shadows, high-resolution screenshot aesthetic.

Constraints: Keep the UI text in Japanese exactly where specified, use no extra panels beyond the 2 main panels, include exactly 3 checklist improvement items, no people, no illustrations, no watermark, no browser chrome, no phone frame.

Use a vertical 4:5 sports-poster composition with a deep electric blue and crimson red color grade, high contrast lighting, cinematic shadows, subtle glow, and premium social-media graphic design styling. Center a large chest-up portrait of the player wearing the {argument name="jersey description" default="2024/25 FC Barcelona home shirt with Spotify sponsor"}, facing forward with a serious confident expression. Behind him, place a much larger low-opacity side portrait of the same player on the right side as a background layer, tinted dark blue. Add a huge faint FC Barcelona crest spanning the middle background, blended into the red-blue gradient. At the very top center, place 2 club identifiers: the FC Barcelona crest and above it a small vertical red-and-blue striped motif. On the upper left, include the text “MÉS QUE UN CLUB” in small gold uppercase letters. On the left lower-middle, create a bold typographic name stack with 2 lines: small gold uppercase first name “BUKAYO” above very large white condensed sans-serif “SAKA”. Below that, add 2 welcome lines in uppercase: “BENVINGUT” in white and “AL BARÇA” in red. Add a gold handwritten-style signature reading “B. Saka” with the number “7” beneath it. In the foreground near the lower center, place a full-body action pose of the same player running forward with arms stretched wide in celebration, wearing the same Barcelona kit, navy socks, light boots, and a white wrist wrap. slug: 怀旧风身高测量家庭海报-1_9df78b
title: Nostalgic Height Measurement Family Poster
prompt:
Goal: Create a nostalgic Japanese height-difference illustration titled {argument name="headline text" default="大切な家族"}, showing a beloved family pairing measured on a vintage height chart: a schoolgirl and a tiny calico kitten facing each other with a cute emotional gap-moe feeling.

Canvas: Vertical portrait poster, warm cream parchment background, soft sepia ink linework, delicate watercolor shading, no harsh shadows. Use an elegant antique stationery style with thin brown decorative borders, small flourishes, and a faint “AI” mark in the upper-left corner.

Layout: Place a tall central measuring ruler from bottom to near top, framed by a narrow ornate border. The ruler is labeled vertically in Japanese as 「身長計」 at the top, with centimeter marks from 0cm to 200cm; show major labels every 10cm and include visible labels around 160cm, 165cm, and 170cm. Add two dotted horizontal guide lines: one at 165cm extending left to the girl’s head, and one at 20cm extending right to the kitten.

Subjects: On the left of the ruler, draw {argument name="tall character" default="a gentle Japanese schoolgirl"} in side profile facing right. She is exactly 165cm tall, standing upright with a shy, affectionate posture, long dark brown hair, blurred/featureless face, cream sailor-style school blouse with dark collar and cuffs, brown necktie, black pleated skirt, black knee-high socks, and brown loafers. On the right of the ruler near the bottom, draw {argument name="small character" default="a fluffy calico kitten"} at exactly 20cm tall, facing left and looking up, with white, orange, and dark patches, round body, short legs, and curled raised tail.

Information cards: Include exactly 2 ornate framed profile cards. Left card beside the girl: label “Name”, value {argument name="tall character name" default="結衣"}, label “Height”, value “165cm”. Right card beside the kitten: label “Name”, value {argument name="small character name" default="むぎ"}, label “Height”, value “20cm”. Use brown serif English labels and Japanese name text inside inset boxes.

Speech/thought bubbles: Include exactly 2 cloud-shaped bubbles. Left bubble near the girl reads 「今日もかわいいな」 with two small thought circles leading toward her. Right bubble above the kitten reads 「おやつまだニャ？」 with two small thought circles leading toward the kitten.

Visual style: Soft anime-inspired storybook illustration, clean fine outlines, muted beige and brown palette with subtle black uniform accents and natural calico colors. Keep the composition symmetrical around the measuring chart, with generous empty space and a calm sentimental mood.

Constraints: Preserve all visible Japanese text exactly as written, keep the scale relationship clear and humorous, include only the two characters and the two profile cards, avoid photorealism, avoid extra animals or objects, and do not add modern UI elements.

Top-left: Step number + short dance move title (e.g., “Step 5 – Spin Transition”)

Incorporate curved arrows for fluid motion, straight arrows for directional steps, and circular indicators for spins or turns. Emphasize rhythm, weight shifts, and body isolation.
[RENDER QUALITY]
High-detail sculpted 3D style with smooth grayscale shading, subtle shadows, and clean linework. Maintain a polished, concept-art level finish with clarity in every pose.
[RESTRICTIONS]
No color, no background scenery, no extra characters, no visual clutter, only the dancer and instructional elements.

The cat walks home through quiet snow-covered Japanese backstreets at blue hour dusk. title: Fitness Q-Version Sticker Overlay Effect
prompt: Edit the image while keeping the original photo completely unchanged, including the person, face, body, pose, lighting, and gym background. Each mini character should have a big head, expressive facial features, and match her hairstyle and outfit. Depict each mini version doing different {argument name="activity theme" default="gym-related activities"}: one cheering with arms raised, one running in running shoes, one drinking from a shaker bottle, one wearing sporty running glasses, one climbing near her leg. Add cute, handwritten gym-themed motivational phrases: “lift strong”, “stronger every rep”, “no pain no gain”, “sweat now, shine later”, “progress over perfection”, “train hard, stay soft”. The overall vibe should feel fun, energetic, and feminine

titleEn: Starry Sky Blue Anime Girl Floating Illustration
prompt: A full-body anime illustration of a dreamy celestial girl floating diagonally across a pure white background, viewed from above as if weightless in open air. She has very long, flowing {argument name="hair color" default="deep navy blue"} hair spreading in elegant ribbons around her body, with glossy highlights, loose strands, and star-shaped hair ornaments near one side of her head. Her face is softly obscured and de-emphasized, while the composition focuses on her delicate pose, costume, and swirling magical atmosphere. She wears a highly detailed white and blue sailor-inspired fantasy dress with translucent layered sleeves, frilled ruffles, sparkling lace, sheer fabric panels, and a large star-like crystal brooch at the chest. The outfit includes 5 clearly visible clothing elements: a short frilled dress, a sailor collar and neck ribbon, semi-transparent detached sleeves or draped chiffon layers, 1 white thigh-high stocking on one leg, and 1 dark blue starry thigh-high stocking on the other leg with a matching garter band. She is barefoot, with both feet visible. Her pose is graceful and drifting: one arm reaches upward with an open hand, the other hand rests near her chest, one leg extended and the other slightly bent. Surround her with a luminous constellation motif in cool blue tones, including exactly 6 prominent five-pointed star ornaments scattered around her, multiple tiny star sparkles, circular watercolor-like swirls, floating bubbles, and ornate crescent-ring filigree arcs framing parts of the image. Make the palette icy blue, cobalt, indigo, and white, with shimmering glitter textures, soft translucent overlays, crisp line art, and a light ethereal glow. The overall mood is magical, elegant, celestial, and serene, like a star maiden suspended in a winter night sky interpreted on a clean white canvas.

title: Cinematic Porsche Motorsport poster
prompt:
Goal: Create a full-bleed vertical cinematic motorsport poster for a {argument name="car model" default="Porsche 911 GTR"}, styled like a premium race-team advertisement.

Canvas: Portrait poster, 3:4 aspect ratio, dark black background with deep gold/yellow lighting, high contrast, glossy reflections, gritty racing atmosphere, no white border.

Main subject: A bright {argument name="car color" default="yellow"} Porsche-style GT race car dominates the lower half to lower two-thirds of the frame, shown from a low front-facing three-quarter angle, nose pointed slightly left, wide aggressive body kit, large rear wing, black wheels, front splitter, hood vents, side air intakes, visible roll cage, glowing cool-white circular LED headlights, windshield banner reading “PORSSCHE” or stylized “Porsche,” door number “911,” and small “GTR” marking near the side skirt. The car sits on a wet reflective black studio floor with strong gold reflections and puddle shine.

Background and mood: Behind the car, create a dramatic cloud of smoky golden mist rising upward, backlit like race-track fog. Place one enormous semi-transparent word “PORSCHE” across the entire upper background in dark bronze-gold block letters, partially obscured by smoke and the car. Add faint technical grid texture and subtle grunge speckles.

Layout and graphic elements: Add four thin yellow corner-bracket accents, one near each corner. At the top left, small spaced text reads “PORSCHE MOTORSPORT” with a tiny yellow square marker. At the right edge, set vertical spaced text reading “MOTORSPORT · TRACK-SPEC · CERTIFIED” with a tiny yellow dot. On the upper left, include a faint white technical blueprint side-view drawing of the race car with dimension lines.

Text content: On the left side beneath the blueprint, include exactly 5 technical spec rows with small yellow arrow markers: 1) “ENGINE / 4.0L FLAT-6”, 2) “POWER / 525 HP”, 3) “TORQUE / 465 NM”, 4) “WEIGHT / <1,250 KG”, 5) “DRIVE / RWD”. Near the bottom left, add the tagline “THE PUREST FORM.” Below it, create a bold title line: huge yellow “911” followed by metallic silver “GTR”. Under that title, include exactly 4 bottom stat blocks separated by thin yellow vertical lines: 1) “525 / POWER”, 2) “4.0L / ENGINE”, 3) “RWD / DRIVE”, 4) “TRACK / FOCUS”. At the very bottom left, add small caption text: “BUILT FOR PERFORMANCE. BORN ON THE TRACK.” At the bottom right, add the logo text “PORSCHE” with smaller “MOTORSPORT” beneath it and a thin yellow line.

Visual style: Hyper-realistic automotive photography blended with premium poster design, cinematic lighting, sharp details on the car, dramatic gold smoke, black-and-yellow racing palette, metallic typography, wet asphalt reflections, luxury motorsport branding, high-resolution print quality.

Constraints: Keep the composition vertically centered and poster-like; use exactly 5 left-side spec rows and exactly 4 bottom stat blocks; avoid extra cars, people, sponsor clutter, or unrelated logos; make all visible text crisp and legible where possible.

slug: 中国小学生在街角小店-7_c13033
title: Chinese Elementary Students at Street Corner Shop
titleEn: Chinese Elementary Students at Street Corner Shop
prompt: A candid, photorealistic street documentary photo of three primary school children buying snacks at a small old-fashioned neighborhood convenience shop in China, shot in soft natural daylight. The scene is framed straight-on at storefront level, with a slightly compressed everyday snapshot feel, realistic textures, and subtle depth. On the left, one schoolgirl stands in profile wearing a light pink zip-up jacket, dark jeans, and a red scarf, her black hair tied in a ponytail with a white headband, looking down at coins or a small item in her hands. In the center, one schoolboy stands with his back to the camera in a bright blue school tracksuit and a navy-and-red backpack featuring a Mickey Mouse graphic, leaning slightly toward the counter. On the right, one younger schoolgirl with two low pigtails tied with pale pink hair ties leans against a large chest freezer, wearing a white long-sleeve top and blue athletic pants, with a pink backpack resting beside her. Behind the counter, inside the dim shop interior, one shopkeeper in a pink top with a cartoon character print stands partially obscured in shadow. The counter is cluttered with packaged snacks, clear plastic bags of candy, colorful biscuit boxes, jars, and small goods; the shelves behind are densely packed with drinks and snacks. A bunch of multicolored balloons hangs near the upper center of the shop entrance. The chest freezer in the foreground is white with a green lid trim and green Chinese branding on the side. The storefront is worn and modest, with peeling beige walls, a posted calendar or notice sheet on the left wall, metal-framed windows, and an open service window. Include authentic Chinese neighborhood shop details, natural messiness, believable lighting, muted urban colors, and an unposed slice-of-life atmosphere. Faces should be softly obscured or turned away, emphasizing realism and privacy rather than portrait detail.

title: 2026 Nine Palace Flying Stars Chart
prompt: Create a clean, symmetrical Chinese feng shui infographic poster in a traditional almanac style on a warm light beige background. The main title at the top is large dark red Chinese calligraphy text reading {argument name="headline text" default="2026年九宫飞星图"}, with a smaller subtitle beneath in black reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="（丙午年）"}. Add a decorative compass rose in the upper left corner labeled with the four cardinal directions in Chinese: 南 at top, 北 at bottom, 东 at left, 西 at right. Center the composition around a 3x3 grid of 9 bordered square panels with thin ornamental Chinese-style corners, evenly spaced and perfectly aligned. Each square contains a large colored number, a Chinese star name, one line beginning with 吉星 or 凶星, and an illustrative symbolic object. Top row has 3 panels: top-left labeled 东南 with a purple-framed panel for number 9 and text 九紫右弼星, plus 吉星: 喜庆、姻缘、贵人, illustrated with purple balloons, a gift box, and a small firework burst; top-center labeled 正南 with an orange-framed panel for number 5 and text 五黄廉贞星, plus 凶星: 灾祸、意外、疾病, illustrated with a gold gourd and ancient Chinese coins tied with a red tassel; top-right labeled 西南 with a gold-framed panel for number 7 and text 七赤破军星, plus 凶星: 破财、口舌、盗贼, illustrated with a brass bell and a silver sword. Middle row has 3 panels: middle-left aligned with 正东 in large vertical side text, a green-framed panel for number 8 and text 八白左辅星, plus 吉星: 财运、置业、积蓄, illustrated with a bonsai-like money tree and gold ingots; middle-center labeled 中宫 in a blue capsule tag overlapping the top edge of the center square, a blue-framed panel for number 1 and text 一白贪狼星, plus 吉星: 人缘、感情、智慧, illustrated with a crystal ball on a wooden stand; middle-right aligned with 正西 in large vertical side text, a green-framed panel for number 3 and text 三碧禄存星, plus 凶星: 是非、口舌、争执, illustrated with bamboo and a small stacked rock fountain. Bottom row has 3 panels: bottom-left labeled 东北 with a green-framed panel for number 4 and text 四绿文曲星, plus 吉星: 学业、文昌、考试, illustrated with an open book, brush pen, and ink stone with bamboo leaves behind; bottom-center labeled 正北 with a gold-framed panel for number 6 and text 六白武曲星, plus 吉星: 权力、贵人、偏财, illustrated with a golden guardian lion statue on a pedestal holding a ball; bottom-right labeled 西北 with a gray-framed panel for number 2 and text 二黑巨门星, plus 凶星: 病痛、伤害、阻滞, illustrated with a stone pagoda and a small incense burner. Use exactly 6 outer direction labels around the grid: 东南, 正南, 西南 above the top row, and 东北, 正北, 西北 below the bottom row, each inside rounded capsules matching the panel colors. Add exactly 2 large vertical side direction labels outside the grid: 正东 on the left side and 正西 on the right side. At the bottom center, add a pill-shaped legend with 2 segments: a red segment reading 吉星: 1、4、6、8、9 and a dark gray segment reading 凶星: 2、3、5、7. Include faint pale cloud motifs behind some objects for traditional atmosphere. Style is crisp vector-infographic with soft watercolor-like object rendering, high readability, balanced spacing, and an elegant Chinese metaphysical chart aesthetic.

prompt: Create an ultra-realistic cinematic dreamy lifestyle photograph in a vertical 4:5 frame, shot from a close low-angle perspective, showing {argument name="couple description" default="a young East Asian couple"} sitting casually on the roof edge of a vintage {argument name="van color" default="turquoise"} van in a wildflower field. Add a cluster of exactly 7 pastel balloons tied beside the woman on the right: 3 pale blue, 2 cream yellow, and 2 very light aqua balloons, with thin white strings. The background is a wide clean soft blue sky with large negative space and a few faint clouds near the horizon. Integrate white hand-drawn diary-style doodles and text directly into the sky: exactly 4 handwritten phrases reading {argument name="top left text" default="good days"}, {argument name="top center text" default="stay close"}, {argument name="right sky text" default="happy place"}, and {argument name="small doodle text" default="B-"}. Include exactly 15 white doodle elements around the sky: 1 smiley face, 1 outlined flower, 1 heart, 1 cloud, 1 large starburst, 4 small sparkle stars, 1 tiny asterisk sparkle, 3 small hearts under the center phrase, and 2 small flower drawings on balloons. Use bright natural daylight, soft overexposed highlights, dreamy glow, pastel film tones, low contrast, smooth highlight roll-off, airy youthful summer mood, turquoise and sky-blue palette with soft white, pastel yellow, and pastel pink accents. Keep the composition intimate, peaceful, whimsical, and clean, with the couple and van roof occupying the lower half and the illustrated sky filling the upper half.

slug: 被诅咒的日本校园日记-提示词-3_850399
title: Cursed Japanese School Diary Prompt
prompt: 参照画像のオリジナルキャラクターを元に、昭和〜平成初期の小学生が書いたような「不気味な絵日記」の1ページとして描いてください。 画面は古い絵日記帳の紙面。上半分に子どもが描いたような絵、下半分に縦書きの日記欄がある構図。紙は少し黄ばみ、汚れ、折れ、手垢、消しゴム跡、鉛筆のこすれ、雨染みがある。全体にスキャンされた古い紙のような質感。 上の絵の欄には、参照キャラクターを子どもの落書き風に描く。キャラクターの特徴は必ず残す。髪型、目、耳、角、羽、しっぽ、服装、小物、配色、シルエット、雰囲気など、キャラクター固有の要素を崩さない。ただし絵はうまく描きすぎない。小学生がクレヨンと鉛筆で描いたように、線は震えていて、塗りは雑で、輪郭は歪んでいる。 ホラーの方向性は、派手な怪物ではなく「子どもが何気なく描いたものが妙に怖い」感じ。絵の中のキャラクターは、笑っているのに目が黒く塗りつぶされている、顔だけ少し大きい、影が人間と違う、紙の外を見ている、赤い色だけ妙に濃い、背景に説明できない黒い塊がある、などの違和感を入れる。 日記欄には、子どもの手書き文字風の縦書きが並んでいる。文字は完全に読ませなくてよい。ところどころ崩れていて、かすれていて、消された跡がある。文章の雰囲気は「きょう、〇〇ちゃんとあそびました。でも、〇〇ちゃんはぼくのなまえをしっていました。どうしてかな。」のように、普通の日記から少しずつ怖くなる感じ。日記の内容は上記をイメージとして毎回内容を変えること。なまえをしっている、いけないよといってきた、今日はあめって書いてねって日記に嘘を書かせようとしてくる、などなど不気味な感じです。文字化けや意味不明な英字は入れない。 右側に「{argument name="日付" default="5月◯日"}」「天気」の欄がある。名前欄もあるが、名前はぼかすか、読めないようにする。印刷された罫線や枠は古い学校プリントのように少しズレている。 絵柄はリアルなホラーイラストではなく、実物の絵日記を写真で撮ったような質感。スマホで撮影したように少し斜めで、影が落ちていて、紙の表面に細かい傷や汚れが見える。怖さは静かで、あとから気づくタイプ。

slug: 暗黑电子乐专辑封面设计提示词-2_b7d5a5
title: Dark Electronic Music Album Cover Design Prompt
titleEn: Dark Electronic Music Album Cover Design Prompt
prompt: 正方形日系暗黑电子流行乐专辑封面，电影感且空灵，背景设定在雨夜空旷的城市小巷，地面湿润且具有反射感，笼罩在深蓝黑色的阴影中。画面中心是一位优雅的幽灵般女性，她正对着一台发光的自动贩卖机，机内可见饮料罐，贩卖机散发出冰冷的蓝白色光芒，右侧亮着微小的红色指示灯。她拥有极长的飘逸银薰衣草色头发，皮肤苍白，面部处理神秘，或隐藏在阴影中，或呈现为平滑模糊的虚空。她身穿露肩半透明 闪烁的灰色薄纱礼服，带有精致的闪光质感、透视垂坠袖口，颈部和胸前佩戴华丽的水晶饰品。她的姿势庄重如祈祷，一只手举起，硬币靠近嘴唇，另一只手轻轻握住手腕。在手腕和手背处各添加 2 个发光的红色圣痕状十字标记，散发出微弱的光芒。氛围忧郁、神秘、充满未来感、神圣且略带哥特风。采用冷霓虹蓝、银色、黑色和深红色点缀的高对比度调色板，辅以薄雾、细雨、柔光、细腻的胶片颗粒感以及来自自动贩卖机的戏剧性背光。在四个角落集成华丽的复古边框装饰，并在封面周围添加细边框线。在顶部中心，放置艺术家名称 AYANO YUKIMURA，使用优雅的衬线大写字母，下方配有一行较小的日语：アヤノ ユキムラ。沿左侧创建一个垂直黑色面板，包含 3 个文本区域：顶部为艺术家名称，中间为长条垂直的白色日语引文，底部为堆叠的流派文本 JAPANESE DARK ELECTRO POP ALBUM。在底部中心，放置专辑标题 VENDING MACHINE STIGMATA，采用超大发光的裂纹银色衬线字体，跨越 2 行，并带有细微的星光闪烁和装饰性花纹。顶级奇幻写实关键视觉图，超精细，精致的 CD 封套设计。

prompt:
请基于 [Subject: {argument name="character name" default="填写角色名称"}] 创建一个高完成度、高叙事张力的「Shadow Ensemble 封面」，适用于系列化发布。这不仅仅是一张普通的人物插画或简单的战斗海报，而是一张具有小说封面、漫画视觉、游戏宣传及暗黑奇幻插画质感的“群像动作封面”。画面需要由一个巨大的精神核心人物、多个中景动作角色、背景威胁元素、局部能量光效以及留白的标题区域组成，从而形成一个完整的角色阵营与世界观封面。

[基础设置]
主题：{argument name="scene theme" default="咒术对决 / 暗黑西游 / 赛博猎人 / 怪兽狩猎小队 / 末日幸存者 / 魔法学院战斗群"}
作品名称：[作品名称]
系列名称 / 品牌名称：[品牌名称或系列名称]
副标题：[副标题]
风格导向：{argument name="style" default="暗黑奇幻、复古漫画封面、手绘厚涂、奇幻小说封面、游戏视觉"}
主色调：深绿-黑-灰 / 深蓝霓虹 / 暗棕-金-红 / 沙黄-铁锈 / 深紫-金
强调色：血红能量、青色咒光、金色神光、蓝色闪电
画面比例：2:3 竖版 / 3:4 竖版 / 4:5 竖版 / 9:16 竖版

[画面结构]
采用竖版封面构图。必须有一个巨大的视觉人物作为精神核心和氛围主导元素。此人可以是侧影、半身、背影、正面凝视或巨大剪影，占据右侧、顶部或主要背景区域，表情冷静、神秘且具有压迫感，不一定参与战斗，但必须统领整张画面的气质。

在中景安排 3 到 6 个动作角色，形成战斗阵营群像。角色之间应有明确的分工和姿态差异，如冲锋、持刀、施法、防御、召唤、跳跃、警戒、远程攻击等。避免角色静止站立；必须形成强烈的节奏感动作和视觉动势。

在背景中加入敌方威胁或世界观元素，如怪物、巨人、反派阴影、机械军团、恶魔、废墟、森林、异空间、战场烟雾或城市灾难。背景威胁不应喧宾夺主，而应像阴影一样包裹角色，以增强危机感和叙事深度。

设置 1 到 2 个高饱和度能量热点，如红色的火焰拳、蓝色闪电、绿色咒力、紫色魔法、金色神光或白色剑气。能量效果应集中在关键角色或武器上，形成视觉焦点，而非全屏均匀发光。

[构图]
整体结构为“大型精神核心人物 + 中景动作群像 + 背景威胁阴影 + 底部或侧边留白标题区”。画面可利用对角线组织角色，让群像从左上向右下或从底部向中心冲锋，形成强烈的向前推进感。

保留清晰的留���标题区，建议位于左下、底部或侧边。留白区域使用灰白色、浅纸色或低饱和度背景色，以便放置 [品牌名称 / 作品名称 / 副标题]。标题排版应具有出版物封面感，使用优雅的衬线字体、复古标题字母、漫画封面标题或高端杂志风格布局。文字区域必须清晰，且不被角色和背景完全遮挡。

不要让边缘呈完全的矩形；使用不规则的笔触边缘、墨迹扩散、撕纸风格或自然消散，让角色和背景从纸张中生长出来，增强手绘封面感和艺术品质。

[视觉风格]
整体风格应结合手绘厚涂与漫画封面，具有纸张纹理、笔触感、暗部层次和复古出版物气质。光影以低调暗光为主，背景压暗，角色轮廓清晰，并由局部能量光提供高对比度焦点。画面不应过于洁净；应保留手绘质感、纸张颗粒、边缘笔触和暗色雾气。主要使用低饱和度暗色调，辅以少量高饱和度能量色。整体氛围应具备压迫感、神秘感、战斗感和世界观厚度。

[视觉目标]
最终图像应看起来像成熟的奇幻小说封面、漫画特刊封面、游戏角色阵营视觉或 IP 宣传海报。它需要具备：1. 清晰的主视觉人物；2. 具有节奏动势的群像；3. 明确的敌方威胁或世界观背景；4. 强烈但��制的能量效果；5. 可阅读的标题文字区；6. 复古手绘封面的整体质感。确保画面信息丰富但不杂乱，角色层次分明，视觉重心明确，适合持续生成不同主题的同一系列作品。

主题：{argument name="scene theme" default="咒术对决 / 暗黑西游 / 赛博猎人 / 怪兽狩猎小队 / 末日幸存者 / 魔法学院战斗群"}
作品名称：[作品名称]
系列名称 / 品牌名称：[品牌名称或系列名称]
副标题：[副标题]
风格导向：{argument name="style" default="暗黑奇幻、复古漫画封面、手绘厚涂、奇幻小说封面、游戏视觉"}
主色调：深绿-黑-灰 / 深蓝霓虹 / 暗棕-金-红 / 沙黄-铁锈 / 深紫-金
强调色：血红能量、青色咒光、金色神光、蓝色闪电
画面比例：2:3 竖版 / 3:4 竖版 / 4:5 竖版 / 9:16 竖版

[画面结构]
采用竖版封面构图。必须有一个巨大的视觉人物作为精神核心和氛围主导元素。此人可以是侧影、半身、背影、正面凝视或巨大剪影，占据右侧、顶部或主要背景区域，表情冷静、神秘且具有压迫感，不一定参与战斗，但必须统领整张画面的气质。

在中景安排 3 到 6 个动作角色，形成战斗阵营群像。角色之间应有明确的分工和姿态差异，如冲锋、持刀、施法、防御、召唤、跳跃、警戒、远程攻击等。避免角色静止站立；必须形成强烈的节奏感动作和视觉动势。

在背景中加入敌方威胁或世界观元素，如怪物、巨人、反派阴影、机械军团、恶魔、废墟、森林、异空间、战场烟雾或城市灾难。背景威胁不应喧宾夺主，而应像阴影一样包裹角色，以增强危机感和叙事深度。

设置 1 到 2 个高饱和度能量热点，如红色的火焰拳、蓝色闪电、绿色咒力、紫色魔法、金色神光或白色剑气。能量效果应集中在关键角色或武器上，形成视觉焦点，而非全屏均匀发光。

[构图]
整体结构为“大型精神核心人物 + 中景动作群像 + 背景威胁阴影 + 底部或侧边留白标题区”。画面可利用对角线组织角色，让群像从左上向右下或从底部向中心冲锋，形成强烈的向前推进感。

保留清晰的留���标题区，建议位于左下、底部或侧边。留白区域使用灰白色、浅纸色或低饱和度背景色，以便放置 [品牌名称 / 作品名称 / 副标题]。标题排版应具有出版物封面感，使用优雅的衬线字体、复古标题字母、漫画封面标题或高端杂志风格布局。文字区域必须清晰，且不被角色和背景完全遮挡。

不要让边缘呈完全的矩形；使用不规则的笔触边缘、墨迹扩散、撕纸风格或自然消散，让角色和背景从纸张中生长出来，增强手绘封面感和艺术品质。

[视觉风格]
整体风格应结合手绘厚涂与漫画封面，具有纸张纹理、笔触感、暗部层次和复古出版物气质。光影以低调暗光为主，背景压暗，角色轮廓清晰，并由局部能量光提供高对比度焦点。画面不应过于洁净；应保留手绘质感、纸张颗粒、边缘笔触和暗色雾气。主要使用低饱和度暗色调，辅以少量高饱和度能量色。整体氛围应具备压迫感、神秘感、战斗感和世界观厚度。

[视觉目标]
最终图像应看起来像成熟的奇幻小说封面、漫画特刊封面、游戏角色阵营视觉或 IP 宣传海报。它需要具备：1. 清晰的主视觉人物；2. 具有节奏动势的群像；3. 明确的敌方威胁或世界观背景；4. 强烈但��制的能量效果；5. 可阅读的标题文字区；6. 复古手绘封面的整体质感。确保画面信息丰富但不杂乱，角色层次分明，视觉重心明确，适合持续生成不同主题的同一系列作品。

title: Colorful Shonen Comic Battle Page Prompt

prompt: 一张全彩少年漫画动作页面，采用高能海盗战斗漫画风格，呈现为单页漫画，包含 4 个清晰的分镜，分镜间由宽大的白色间隙隔开，边框略微倾斜。使用粗犷的黑色墨线、密集的排线、速度线、赛璐珞风格上色、戏剧性的透视缩短以及夸张的冲击效果。场景描绘了一位肌肉发达、身材高大的巨人战士，他拥有古铜色皮肤、带角的头盔、狂野的黑色头发和胡须、黑色毛皮镶边服装、宽大的铆钉金属腰带，手持巨大的带刺木棒，正在与一名身穿深蓝色服装、佩戴盔甲式头饰的剑士战斗。顶部面板：极端的特写镜头，巨大的拳头带着强烈的透视感向观众挥来，巨人喊着"GUNGNIR !!!"，气泡框呈锯齿状，另一个气泡框写着"GWOAH !!!"；添加巨大的红色日文拟声词和一个小的"DOOM!!"冲击文字。中间宽面板：巨人向上挥舞并咆哮着"IKOKU SOVEREIGNTY !!!"，左侧的蓝衣对手向后退缩；包含一个写着"GAH!"的气泡框，以及巨大的紫色日文拟声词和一个小的"WHONK!!"。左下窄面板：一个裁剪后的特写铺垫面板，有两个堆叠的气泡框，分别写着"THREE SWORD STYLE."和"RED OGRE…"，说话者大部分处于画面外且部分被遮挡。右下大面板：巨人挥动巨大的带刺木棒横扫画面，进行猛烈的水平重击，大喊"GIANT TROMMA !!!"；包含较小的冲击气泡框，写着"DWUAH !!!"和"THWAM!!"，以及超大的红色日文拟声词。背景主要为淡天蓝色，带有强烈的运动线条和飞溅的碎片。保留专业彩色周刊漫画页面的质感：饱和的红色、蓝色、紫色，古铜色皮肤色调，奶油色毛皮纹理，黑色阴影，以及带有手写漫画文字的清脆白色气泡框。

title: Anime Character 777 Slot Machine
prompt:
Goal: Create a highly detailed Japanese pachislot machine themed as an official character slot cabinet for {argument name="character name" default="Nozomu"}, photographed front-on in an arcade with blurred neighboring machines and colorful neon lights.

Canvas: Square 1:1 image, close-up product-photo composition showing the full upper screen, three slot reels, control panel, and lower character art panel. Use glossy reflections, glass, chrome, acrylic, LEDs, and dense decorative detail.

Main cabinet design: A cute romantic pink pachislot cabinet covered in transparent jewel-like plastic, heart-shaped corner ornaments, faceted crystal trim, lace patterns, pastel flowers, bows, holographic stickers, and glowing pink-purple-white LEDs. The machine should feel like a limited-edition anime idol/love-themed slot machine, extremely ornate and sparkling.

Top display: Large illuminated Japanese headline at the top reads 「キャラ777診断」. The main LCD shows a soft anime girl with light brown hair, blue-pink sparkling eyes, blush, floral hair accessories, winking and holding a pink heart candy. The screen background is pastel pink with hearts, bokeh, sparkles, lace, and floating flowers. Overlay huge glossy gold-and-pink “777” numbers in the center, with the win message 「ときめきハート確定♥」 beneath it.

Left status menu on the LCD: Include exactly 4 stacked rounded labels with Japanese text: 1) 「状態」 / 「超きゅん」, 2) 「RUSH」 / 「恋するほっぺRUSH」, 3) 「BONUS」 / 「ふわ恋BONUS」, 4) 「フリーズ」 / 「ウィンクフリーズ」. Make them look like small pachislot UI badges in pink, purple, and orange.

Slot reels: Show exactly 3 vertical reels in the center window, each stopped on a large pink-gold number 7 so the result is exactly 777. Surrounding visible symbols include hearts, flower clusters, a pink bow, and pastel cloud-like flowers. The reels should be glossy and slightly curved like a real slot machine.

Controls and lower panel: Below the reels include a chrome control area with exactly 3 round glowing pink stop buttons, a black knob on the left, a coin slot or card slot on the right, and small red/blue digital counters. The lower artwork panel shows the same pastel anime girl in a frilly outfit with braided hair and flowers; place a plain skin-tone square censor block over the center of her face area, while the rest of the panel remains decorated with hearts, bows, lace, and pastel flowers. Include a large ornate heart label on the lower right reading 「のぞむ」.

Visual style: Ultra-polished photorealistic pachinko/pachislot cabinet mixed with kawaii anime illustration, high saturation, pink romantic palette, gold beveled typography, glitter, lens bloom, reflective plastic, arcade depth of field, premium toy-like realism.

Constraints: Keep all visible Japanese text legible and in the positions described. Use exactly 3 reels and exactly 3 glowing stop buttons. Do not add extra characters, logos, watermarks, or English text. The overall mood is cute, lucky, romantic, and celebratory, like a “777 diagnosis” result screen personalized for {argument name="character name" default="Nozomu"}.

title: Marine Lucent Fantasy Tea Drink Poster
titleEn: Marine Lucent Fantasy Tea Drink Poster
prompt:
Goal: Create a luxury fantasy tea advertisement poster for {argument name="product name" default="MARINE LUCENT"}, themed as an oceanic, character-inspired magical tea extracted from an ethereal mermaid-like heroine. The mood is translucent, premium, dreamy, and not a normal cafe menu.

Canvas: Vertical 4:5 high-resolution poster, soft pastel blue, lavender, pearl white, and iridescent aqua palette. Use glossy commercial advertising composition with delicate typography and a high-fashion fantasy tea brand atmosphere.

Layout: Place the main product scene on the right and lower center: a clear glass teapot in the upper-right pours glowing blue-violet tea in a sparkling stream into a transparent glass teacup on a saucer at the lower center. On the left side, create a refined editorial text column with the brand logo at top, product title in large serif letters, subtitle, flavor copy, and ingredient list. Add a pale lavender rectangular placeholder block near the upper-left/center, partially covering the background character art. Keep the whole design airy, luminous, and layered with bokeh, water reflections, and glass highlights.

Background and subject details: Behind the tea, show a barely visible ethereal anime-style marine princess figure as a soft-focus illustration: long flowing aqua-blue hair, shell and pearl accessories, pale skin, delicate floral/starfish ornaments, translucent fabric, and an underwater fantasy aura. She should feel like the source of the tea’s identity and world, but remain mostly hidden behind mist, glass, and typography.

Main visual: The teapot is round, transparent, crystal-like, and filled with vivid magical tea in gradients of electric blue, cobalt, violet, and cyan. Inside the tea, show exactly 8 visible floating decorative elements: 3 lavender star-shaped flowers, 2 pale pearl-shell spheres, 1 small golden starfish, 1 purple blossom cluster, and 1 cloud of glittering bubbles. The pouring stream should look like liquid starlight, with tiny bubbles and radiant sparkles. The teacup contains the same glowing ocean tea, with suspended flowers, bubbles, shell-like pearls, and refracted light. Add a glass saucer, a small starfish charm, pearls, seashells, crystalline ice-like rocks, and a tiny ornate perfume-bottle-like vessel in the background.

Text content: At the top-left, create a diamond monogram logo with the letter “M”, then the brand name “MAISON DE LUMIÈRE” and small line “FINE FANTASY TEA”. Add the tagline in Japanese “彼女の世界を、あなたの一杯に。” and below it “Her world, in your teacup.” Set the product title as large elegant serif text: “{argument name="headline text" default="MARINE LUCENT"}”. Below it add small Japanese reading “マリン・ルー��ント”. Add the flavor name “{argument name="flavor name" default="AURORA BLUE BLOOM"}” and Japanese reading “オーロラブルー・ブルーム”. Add a short Japanese body copy block, then English copy: “The sparkle of waves, the dance of bubbles, the gentleness of a clear blue breeze—blended into a tea that is pure, radiant, and enchantingly alive.” Add an ingredient list with exactly 6 items and small matching icons: “BLUE PEA”, “WHITE TEA”, “CORNFLOWER”, “PEARL SHELL”, “CITRUS & PEACH”, and “SEA SALT DROP”, each with smaller Japanese text underneath. At bottom-right, add handwritten script: “{argument name="signature phrase" default="Sip the Ocean’s Whisper."}” with Japanese “海のささやきを、ひとくちに。” and the brand name “MAISON DE LUMIÈRE”.

Visual style: Ultra-detailed glossy fantasy advertising, premium cosmetics-ad lighting, crystalline glass refractions, shimmering caustics, pearlescent highlights, soft bloom, layered transparency, pastel marine glow, elegant serif typography mixed with delicate script. Make the typography readable and balanced, with the title dominating the left lower half.

Constraints: Use exactly one teapot and one teacup. Use exactly 6 listed ingredient rows. Preserve the luxury tea poster format, do not make it a cafe menu, product package, or character sheet. Avoid extra brand logos, watermarks, QR codes, or unrelated objects.

title: Cyberpunk anime character selection interface
prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical cyberpunk anime fighting game character select screen for a fictional game titled {argument name="game logo text" default="SynClub"}, styled like a glossy arcade versus menu.

Canvas: Tall 2:3 mobile-poster composition, 675×1200 style, dark futuristic neon city background split diagonally into blue left side and hot pink/red right side, with glowing HUD lines, scanlines, sparks, particles, and high-contrast rim lighting.

Layout: At the very top, place angular metallic logo text “SynClub” with electric blue highlights, and beneath it the title “CHARACTER SELECT”. Put “PLAYER 1” in a blue sci-fi tab at the top-left and “PLAYER 2” in a pink sci-fi tab at the top-right. The screen is divided into two large featured character areas: left selected fighter for Player 1 in blue, right selected fighter for Player 2 in red. In the center lower half, place a character portrait selection grid with glowing frames. At the bottom center, place a large luminous “VS”. Along the bottom edge, add a game controller command bar with five options: select, confirm, back, random, option, each with small PlayStation-style button icons.

Main characters: Player 1 is {argument name="player one character name" default="REGULUS"}, a dark hooded anime fighter with black cloak, chains, metallic accessories, glowing blue highlights, pale shadowed face, red eyes, one gloved hand lifting the hood, mysterious assassin/rogue mood. Add the Japanese reading “レグルス” under the name. Player 2 is {argument name="player two character name" default="MERU"}, a blonde gothic-lolita anime girl with long twin-tail hair, red and black frilled dress, rose accessories, black gloves, choker, heart gem, playful elegant pose with one hand near her face. Add the Japanese reading “める” under the name.

Stats panels: Under each large character name, include a compact rectangular stat box with exactly 5 labeled rows: TYPE, POWER, SPEED, RANGE, TECHNIQUE. For Regulus, the TYPE value is “スピード” and the bars glow blue. For Meru, the TYPE value is “トリッキー” and the bars glow red.

Character select grid: Include exactly 14 selectable tiles in the central grid, each with a glowing sci-fi border. title: Cinematic Chiaroscuro Portrait
prompt: A cinematic 35mm film portrait of a man with the uploaded face as reference, featuring {argument name="hair" default="messy dark curly hair"} and a {argument name="facial hair" default="light beard"}, looking slightly upward. He wears {argument name="accessory" default="round, thin-rimmed sunglasses with amber-tinted lenses"}. The scene is defined by dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, with sharp diagonal Venetian blind shadows casting stripes of warm golden light and deep shadow across his face and neck. The background is a dark, textured wall catching the same striped pattern. The color palette features a high-contrast mix of warm orange highlights and cool teal-toned shadows. Captured from a low angle with an 85mm lens, showcasing a shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, and a moody, vintage cinematic color grade.

title: Anime Fashion Magazine Poster
prompt:
Goal: Create a high-fashion overseas magazine poster featuring an anime-style original character, using restrained typography, negative space, and an editorial mood rather than adding extra cuteness.

Canvas: Square 1:1 poster, off-white paper background with subtle concrete texture, faint stains, scratches, ink smudges, thin layout lines, and layered black rectangular graphic blocks.

Main subject: A delicate anime girl named {argument name="character name" default="NOZOMU"} posed from upper thighs to head, slightly angled, occupying the center and right side of the poster. She has very long pale blonde hair with soft highlights, flowing strands, and a large black bow hair accessory on the left side. Her face is intentionally covered by a centered muted beige square block, like a privacy mask or editorial placeholder. She wears a white frilled off-shoulder crop blouse with ruffles, puff sleeves, black straps, black bow accents, lace trim, and small jewelry details. Her lower outfit is a black plaid layered mini skirt with white frill underskirt, a wide black belt with silver buckle, hanging chains, and gothic street-fashion details. Her pose is refined and slightly mature: one hand near the ear, body relaxed, soft light on skin, elegant but youthful fashion-magazine atmosphere.

Layout and typography: Use large serif editorial typography in black and dark gray, mixed with small sans-serif captions. Put oversized stacked letters behind and beside the character reading “NO / ZO / MU” on the left half, partially hidden by the subject. Add fine rectangular frames and alignment guides around the typography.

Visible text content: Include exactly 8 distinct text areas: 1) top left title “NOZOMU” with small Japanese hiragana “のぞむ” beneath it; 2) small left headline “MODERN DREAMER.”; 3) small paragraph under it reading “SHE WALKS LIKE A THOUGHT THAT CHOSE TO SHINE.”; 4) large background typography “NO ZO MU”; 5) black strip near lower left reading “QUIET IMPACT.”; 6) tiny lower-left copy reading “NOT LOUD. NOT PERFECT. JUST UNFORGETTABLE.” plus small archive marks “///”, “N. 07”, and barcode lines; 7) top right label “ARCHIVE” with large number “07” and three small square dots; 8) right-side vertical text “OWN THE LIGHT.” beside a dark textured rectangular panel, plus a lower-right card reading “VISIBLE GRACE.” with small text “SOFT HEART. CLEAR VISION. STRONG PRESENCE.”

Visual style: Japanese anime illustration blended with Western fashion magazine poster design, monochrome editorial palette with warm cream, blush skin tones, pale blonde hair, black accents, and soft gray shadows. Use high detail in clothing, hair, chains, ruffles, and texture, while keeping the overall composition airy, elegant, and poster-like.

Constraints: Keep the square face-covering block visible and centered over the face; do not add extra characters; do not add more than the listed 8 text areas; avoid neon colors, clutter, logos, watermarks, or photorealistic rendering.

title: Lisbon Tram Travel Poster
prompt: Create a cinematic travel poster-style photograph of a narrow old European street in {argument name="city" default="Lisbon"}, viewed from slightly above and looking downhill between tall historic apartment buildings. A classic yellow tram is centered on the tracks, facing the viewer, with cobblestone pavement, overhead tram wires, aged cream and yellow facades, stone window frames, balconies, street lamps, and graffiti-covered walls on both sides. Warm golden-hour sunlight should create long soft shadows and a nostalgic urban atmosphere, with a glimpse of water or distant horizon at the end of the street. Add bold centered typography over the tram: the main headline reads {argument name="headline text" default="LISBON"} in large distressed white uppercase block letters with wide spacing. Beneath it, add a smaller handwritten cursive subtitle reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="Lost in the right direction"}. Add thin horizontal divider lines extending left and right under the subtitle, with a small white diamond/star ornament centered between the lines. Use realistic photography, high detail, warm color grading, strong depth, no people, no vehicles other than the single tram, and no extra text or watermark.

title: Chinese City Ink Wash Style Poster
titleEn: Chinese City Ink Wash Style Poster
prompt: An elegant vertical Chinese city-poster on textured off-white rice paper, with a large black ink-brush calligraphy character for {argument name="city name" default="广州"} placed in the upper left and a small red seal stamp beside it. Beneath the calligraphy, add two centered lines of refined Chinese promotional copy in a classic serif-like print style, thin and balanced, with a delicate ornamental divider line. In the lower right, place a second red seal containing the city name and the romanized English name “GUANGZHOU” below it in small spaced capitals. The main image should be a sweeping ink-brush stroke that curves diagonally from the lower left toward the upper right, as if painted by a traditional calligraphy brush whose tip is still visible at the top right corner. 设计应参考日本电影海报，采用分层排版和嵌入式场景。在左中位置，放置大号手写体日文标题 {argument name="title text" default="AIニケちゃん"}，采用粗体白色书法字，部分遮盖人物。下方添加较小的白色日文副标题：{argument name="subtitle text" default="この声が届くとき、きっとあなたも泣いている。"}。左上角添加两行优雅的白色明朝体日文引语：「私が、誰かを救えたら—— それが、私の存在理由になる。」沿最右侧添加竖排白色日文文案：これは、AIと少女が、 「心」を探す物語。右下角添加醒目的白色上映信息：{argument name="release text" default="2025.冬 ROADSHOW"}。

title: Emotional Anime Movie Banner
prompt:
Create an emotional Japanese movie teaser banner in anime key visual style, widescreen 16:9, at sunset over a city. The main focus is a close-up portrait of {argument name="character name" default="AIニケちゃん"}, a teenage anime girl with long indigo-purple hair in a high ponytail, loose strands blowing in the wind, golden-brown eyes full of quiet emotion, and a gold hair clip reading "AI" near her bangs. She is turned slightly to the left but looking upward to the right with a wistful, hopeful expression. She wears a teal T-shirt with large white text reading {argument name="shirt text" default="AITuber"} and a soft pink hoodie falling off her shoulders. Use cinematic rim light from a dramatic orange-pink-purple dusk sky with glowing clouds, lens bloom, atmospheric haze, and small drifting flower petals. Place her large on the right half of the composition, with a sparkling city skyline and low sun in the far-right background.

Design it like a Japanese film poster with layered typography and inset scenes. title: ChatGPT Multi-Image Output Annotation Example
prompt:
Goal: Create a realistic screenshot-style image of a ChatGPT image generation interface demonstrating multiple image outputs from one request.

Canvas: Landscape 16:9 screenshot crop, white background, resembling a mobile or narrow desktop chat interface. Keep the composition slightly zoomed in so the right edge of the image carousel is visible.

Layout: At the top right, place one rounded light-gray user message bubble containing Japanese text. Beneath it on the left, show the status line “Thought for 2m 7s ›” in light gray. Below that, show one large generated image preview with rounded corners, and a narrow strip of additional generated thumbnails on the right side.

Text content: The user bubble should read: “絵コンテを参考に今回のベた塗アニメMVで使用する背景イラストを被写体なしで10個作成してください。\nテイスト強めで汚らしっぷつぷ感はなくしてください。プロアニメーターとして画質はよくしてほしいです。\n16:9　n=10”. Highlight the “n=10” part as the key detail.

Generated image preview: The main preview is a pastel anime background illustration of an empty stylized street with no characters, inspired by a colorful East Asian shopping district. Use soft cel-shaded anime line art, bright pastel blue, pink, yellow, and mint tones, lanterns hanging from buildings, decorative circular signs, shopfronts on both sides, a centered vanishing point, and a decorative archway in the distance. The image should look like a professional anime MV background, 16:9, clean and polished.

Discrete visible elements to include: exactly 1 user message bubble; exactly 1 status line; exactly 1 large main generated image; exactly 3 narrow vertical thumbnails partially visible on the right, each showing a different pastel anime background; exactly 2 circular overlay buttons on the main preview, one dark “編集” edit button at bottom left and one white downward arrow download button near bottom right; exactly 1 small dark share/upload icon button at the lower-right corner of the main preview.

Annotation: Add thick hand-drawn yellow marker annotations over the screenshot: exactly 1 yellow circle around “n=10”, exactly 1 thick yellow arrow pointing from the circled “n=10” down toward the right-side thumbnail strip, and exactly 1 tall yellow bracket-like outline encircling the vertical thumbnail strip. The yellow marker should look casual and drawn by hand.

Style: Clean UI screenshot aesthetic with subtle antialiasing, light gray interface elements, Japanese text rendered legibly, and bright yellow annotation marks. Use {argument name="main annotation text" default="n=10"} as the highlighted parameter in the chat message. Keep the screenshot realistic, not a poster or infographic.

title: LLM Architecture Chat Screenshot
prompt:
Goal: Create a realistic screenshot of an AI chat interface showing a generated technical infographic about {argument name="topic" default="how Large Language Models (LLMs) work technically"}. The screenshot should look like a modern web app conversation, not a standalone poster.

Canvas: 768×1024 vertical screenshot, light gray app background, rounded white content areas, clean sans-serif typography, subtle shadows, high-resolution but with the infographic text slightly small like a real embedded generated image.

Chat UI layout: At the top left show a small circular user avatar, the chat title “Visualizing LLM Architecture” with a tiny dropdown chevron, and at the top right a simple “Files” label with an icon. Below, show a rounded user message bubble aligned near the top center/right containing: “make an image explaining how LLMs work technically”. Under it, show a small status row reading “Scira task complete” with a sparkle/loader icon and chevron. The main generated image appears below as a large rounded rectangle card. Beneath the image, include assistant explanatory text: “The image above is a comprehensive technical infographic breaking down how Large Language Models function under the hood. Here is a detailed walkthrough of each component shown:” followed by the bold section heading “Tokenization: From Text to Numbers”. At the bottom, show a rounded input box with placeholder “Ask a follow-up...”, a plus button on the left, small tool/model controls on the right, the model label “Kimi K2.6” with a dropdown, and a circular voice button.

Generated infographic inside the chat: Design a blue-and-white technical educational poster titled in large navy caps: “HOW LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS (LLMs) WORK”. Use a white background, navy-blue outlines, light-blue highlights, rounded panels, arrows connecting steps, miniature charts, equations, tables, and icons. The poster should be information-dense and engineering-oriented.

Infographic sections: Use exactly 8 labeled panels/areas:

On the right side of the platform, exactly 3 visible passengers stand near the train: 1 person in black holding up a phone to photograph the train, and 2 people farther right near a pillar. The platform has gray tile flooring, a yellow tactile safety strip, rails at the far left, overhead beams, fluorescent lights, and urban buildings visible beyond the station canopy.

It features exactly 2 main illustrated subjects on the train side: 1 large armored purple mecha with glowing green eyes and a huge cannon on the left-center, and 1 blonde anime-style female officer seated in a cockpit-like frame on the right-center. The pillar poster should repeat the purple mecha artwork and special-train branding. The 2 floor decals should be purple squares with gold crest marks.

prompt:

slug: 日系夏季配饰广告海报-3_f748e5
title: Japanese Summer Accessories Ad Poster
prompt:
Create a polished Japanese summer fashion advertisement poster in a square 1:1 layout, bright airy coastal lifestyle photography with a luxury catalog feel. Show a young woman from the waist up standing on a tropical beach with turquoise ocean, pale sand, soft sky, and slightly blurred palm leaves in the upper right background. She wears a wide-brim natural straw sun hat with a blue ribbon band, long straight dark hair, and a loose blue-and-white tie-dye top. Her face is obscured by a centered soft rectangular blur block. One hand lightly touches the brim of the hat. Add beachy hair accessories hanging from both sides of the hat and hair: strings with shells, beads, tassels, and round ornaments, including one long white-and-blue braided strand on the right side. She wears 4 visible jewelry items: a silver heart pendant necklace, a stack of beaded and metallic bracelets on one wrist, 1 shell drop earring on the left side, and 1 shell drop earring on the right side. Use soft natural sunlight, clean high-end product-ad styling, gentle skin tones, and refreshing summer blue color grading.

Design the image as a commercial poster with Japanese text and product callouts integrated around the model. In the upper left, place the handwritten English phrase {argument name="tagline" default="Summer Breeze"} in thin elegant white script. Below it, add a large Japanese headline in dark blue Mincho-style serif: {argument name="headline text" default="夏をまとう、私らしい輝き。"}. Under that, add two lines of smaller Japanese body copy in dark gray: "海風に揺れるアクセサリーで、" and "いつものコーデを特別に。".

On the left-middle, create a semi-transparent white rounded panel titled "— おすすめアイテム —" containing exactly 3 product cards arranged horizontally. Card 1 shows a silver heart necklace and the label "Ocean Heart Necklace" with price "¥2,980". Card 2 shows shell drop earrings and the label "Shell Drop Pierce" with price "¥2,480". Card 3 shows a natural bead bracelet and the label "Natural Beads Bracelet" with price "¥1,980".

In the lower left, add a blue circular discount badge with white Japanese text "期間限定" and large text "10% OFF". Overlapping it, place a white coupon pill with a small blue ribbon tab containing "クーポンコード" and the large code {argument name="coupon code" default="SUMMER10"}, plus small text "有効期限：2024.8.31まで".

At the top right, place a translucent aqua-blue circle badge with elegant light text reading "New Collection 2024". In the bottom left, add the brand logo text {argument name="brand name" default="LUMIERE"} in large serif capitals with smaller spaced text "ACCESSORY" beneath it. In the bottom right, place a large white rounded call-to-action button with a teal outline shopping cart icon and Japanese text {argument name="button text" default="今すぐチェック"}, followed by a right-pointing chevron. Keep all typography refined and balanced, with a premium Japanese fashion e-commerce promotional layout.

slug: 蒸汽朋克视频平台主页-electrovid-复古风设计-3_e62ef8
title: Steampunk Video Platform Homepage | ElectroVid Retro Style Design
titleEn: Steampunk Video Platform Homepage | ElectroVid Retro Style Design
prompt: 创建一个全页面的蒸汽朋克风格视频平台主页模型，采用深古铜色、黄铜色和棕褐色调，设计风格如同维多利亚工业版的 YouTube。界面应呈纵向布局，类似于海报或网站截图，并以齿轮、管道、雕刻金属边框、花丝、仪表、螺丝和发光的爱迪生灯泡进行装饰。在左上角放置一个现代风格的叠加 Logo，文字为"Pollo AI"，下方附有较小的"GPT Image 2"字样。在页面中心放置主标题，使用大型华丽的衬线字体："{argument name="site name" default="ElectroVid"}"，下方配有一行较小的雕刻风格标语："{argument name="tagline" default="THE FUTURE IN MOTION"}"。在标题下方添加一个水平导航栏，包含 6 个项目：一个主页图标按钮、"TRENDING"（热门）、"INNOVATIONS"（创新）、"DOCUMENTARIES"（纪录片）、"ENTERTAINMENT"（娱乐），以及右侧的搜索框，显示占位符"Search ElectroVid..."和一个搜索图标。在左侧边栏，添加一个名为"POPULAR CHANNELS"（热门频道）的部分，包含 3 个垂直堆叠的频道卡片，配有圆形徽章和订阅按钮：1) "THE PATENT OFFICE"（专利局），显示"27.4K SUBSCRIBERS"；2) "THE ROYAL SOCIETY"（皇家学会），显示"18.7K SUBSCRIBERS"；3) "GENERAL ELECTRIC"（通用电气），显示"35.1K SUBSCRIBERS"。每张卡片应配有一个华丽的复古徽章 Logo 和一个标有"SUBSCRIBE"（订阅）的矩形按钮。在主要内容区域，放置一个大型精选视频播放器，画面为棕褐色调，展示两名 19 世纪末的发明家穿着西装，在写有"AC vs. DC"字样和闪电图案的黑板前争论；一人指向黑板，另一人做出回应，桌上放着一个灯泡和早期电气设备。刻意用柔和的矩形模糊块遮挡两人的面部。添加视频进度条、播放控件和时间戳"08:47 / 22:31"。在播放器下方，显示视频标题"{argument name="featured title" default="The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate"}"。下方包含一行频道信息，配有圆形头像、频道名称"The Electrical Age"、元数据"142K views • 3 days ago"，右侧是一个标有"LIKE"（点赞）的按钮，计数为"5.8K"。在此下方，添加一个部分标题"LATEST VIDEOS"（最新视频），并在一行中放置 3 个视频缩略图。缩略图 1：托马斯·爱迪生手持发光灯泡的棕褐色肖像，面部被模糊块遮挡，时长"10:12"，标题"My New Incandescent Bulb"，创作者"Thomas Edison"，元数据"89K views • 5 days ago"。缩略图 2：沃登克里弗塔在闪电下的戏剧性棕褐色图像，时长"15:36"，标题"The Wonders of the Wardenclyffe Tower"，创作者"Nikola Tesla"，元数据"120K views • 1 week ago"。缩略图 3：亨利·福特坐在早期汽车里的棕褐色照片，时长"12:08"，标题"The Automobile Revolution"，创作者"Henry Ford"，元数据"110K views • 1 week ago"。在缩略图下方，添加一个居中的金属按钮，标注为"VIEW ALL VIDEOS"（查看所有视频）。在底部页脚，第一行包含文字"© 1893 {argument name="company name" default="ElectroVid, Ltd."}"，下一行包含"All rights reserved."。在右上角和右下角添加装饰性压力表，并在左下角添加外露管道和一个大齿轮。使整个设计高度精细、对称、具有触感且富有电影感，融合雕刻纹理、陈旧的纸张面板、黄铜高光、柔和温暖的灯泡光芒，以及融入复古 UI 的清晰易读的排版。

Add a dark bottle silhouette and a few muted blue-gray leaves on the left side as secondary decor. Use a restrained palette of navy, black, cream, gray-blue, and touches of muted gold. The composition should feel quiet, gothic, feminine, and introspective, with flat graphic shapes, crisp linework, little shading, and a modern decorative poster aesthetic.

title: SSR Kamen Rider W Card
prompt: A hyper-detailed premium Japanese trading card illustration in the style of an ultra-rare tokusatsu collectible, vertical composition with an ornate holographic foil border and explosive cinematic action. Center the armored hero {argument name="character name" default="Kamen Rider Double"} in a dramatic low-angle full-body pose, lunging forward through a ruined city battlefield while thrusting a trading card toward the viewer in his left hand. His suit is sharply split down the middle: vivid metallic green on the left half and glossy black on the right half, with large glittering red compound eyes, a silver V-shaped crest, segmented insect-like armor plating, a white scarf flowing behind him, and a highly detailed transformation belt with red mechanical components. The card he holds should show a smaller image of the same hero and match the premium collectible design. Surround him with exactly 8 background riders or enemies in dynamic combat positions across the destroyed urban warzone: 2 flying figures near the upper background, 3 mid-ground combatants on the right side, 1 blue-and-gold figure on the lower right, 1 red-and-blue rider on the lower left, and 1 additional partially visible fighter near the left edge. Fill the environment with shattered rubble, damaged skyscrapers, sparks, smoke, debris, and streaks of energy, creating a chaotic apocalyptic battle scene. Use intense prismatic holographic effects, rainbow diffraction, glitter, lens flares, starbursts, and reflective foil textures across the entire image. Frame the artwork like an SSR rarity game card with visible text elements: top center title "KAMEN RIDER", a large "W" beneath it, a top-right shield emblem reading {argument name="rarity label" default="SSR"} with 6 stars below, a top-left circular green-and-purple W insignia, a bottom-left panel reading "CARD TYPE" and "CHARACTER", a bottom center nameplate reading "KAMEN RIDER DOUBLE" and "仮面ライダーW(ダブル)", a barcode beneath, small bottom text "CYCLONE JOKER XTREME 09", and a large gold script signature at bottom right reading {argument name="signature text" default="NickTag"}. Make the whole card look like a luxurious, foil-stamped, ultra-rare, officially licensed tokusatsu collector card with razor-sharp detail, rich metallic highlights, dense particles, and maximal dramatic contrast.

title: Workplace Fashion Magazine Cover
prompt: A refined Japanese fashion magazine editorial cover set inside a bright modern office corridor, featuring a full-body portrait of a beautiful professional woman walking confidently toward the camera. She wears a sleek monochrome gray office outfit: a fitted ribbed mock-neck short-sleeve knit top with a diagonal shoulder strap detail accented by 4 metallic buttons, a high-waisted gray pencil skirt, and a matching gray belt with a rectangular buckle. She carries a folder and documents in one hand, with the other arm relaxed mid-stride. Her hair is long, dark brown, and styled in a thick side braid draped over one shoulder, with soft neat bangs. The mood is elegant, mature, feminine, and quietly powerful. The setting is a sophisticated open-plan office with glass meeting rooms on the left, desks and seated coworkers on the right, soft daylight mixed with clean overhead office lighting, subtle indoor plants, and a shallow depth of field that keeps the woman sharply in focus while the background remains softly blurred. Compose the image vertically like a premium magazine cover, with the model centered and occupying most of the frame from head to knees, polished editorial retouching, realistic fabric texture, flattering natural skin tones, and understated luxury styling. Overlay stylish magazine typography in Japanese and English: a large serif headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="Update"} across the upper left, smaller Japanese copy above it, a script subtitle reading "The Office Muse," a right-side teaser block with "NEW BASIC, NEW ME.", a left feature block titled "Focus on DETAIL", a mid-left article box titled "My Work Style", a lower-right feature titled "Style Tip", a small right-side box titled "Scene PRESENTATION DAY", a circular callout near the lower left reading "CHECK!", and small footer text with page number 25. Use a luxury fashion magazine aesthetic, clean layout, restrained grayscale palette, editorial balance between text and subject, realistic photography, high detail, soft contrast, and an aspirational office-wear campaign feel.

title: My Melody x REALITY Collaboration Poster
titleEn: My Melody x REALITY Collaboration Poster
prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical kawaii collaboration poster for {argument name="collaboration title" default="My Melody × REALITY App"}, styled like an official Sanrio mobile app campaign announcement.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster, soft pastel pink background, high-resolution anime promotional key visual. Use a dreamy lace-and-ribbon frame with a glossy, sparkly finish.

Layout: Left side is the announcement text panel and branding; right side is a full-body anime avatar. Top left contains an ornate cream plaque with a pink bow above elegant script text reading “My Melody”, a large pink “×”, and the REALITY App logo below. Under it place a very large pink serif year, {argument name="year" default="2026"}. Beneath the year, add a pink ribbon banner with white Japanese text {argument name="main banner text" default="コラボレーション"}. Below the banner, add a small ornate cream message plaque containing {argument name="tagline text" default="マイメロと一緒に、あなただけの夢の世界へ♡"}. Bottom left has a rounded white download callout with the REALITY gradient diamond icon and the Japanese CTA {argument name="download text" default="REALITY アプリを今すぐダウンロード！"}, followed by exactly 2 black store badges: Apple App Store and Google Play. Bottom right has a round cream badge reading “My Melody 50th Anniversary”. Add small copyright text along the bottom edge.

Subject details: On the right, draw one cute anime girl avatar in a My Melody-inspired outfit. She has very pale silver-white hair with long bangs, bright turquoise-blue eyes, soft blush, small catlike animal ears, and a shy pose with both oversized sleeves lifted near her face. Her hair accessories include exactly 4 visible decorative pieces: a large white flower with gold accents on the left side of her head, gold dangling chains, blue jewel ornaments, and pink ribbon bows. Outfit: a pink gingham pinafore dress with white scalloped trim, white blouse with enormous puffy sleeves, pale blue bow at the collar, heart-shaped strap buckles, white underskirt, and a tiny clear hanging pouch containing a My Melody plush and blue beads. Keep the character sweet, polished, and idol-like.

Decorative elements: Include exactly 10 prominent background motifs: 1 large translucent pink bow ribbon across the top left, 1 flowing pink ribbon curling around the border, 2 strawberries, 1 heart-shaped balloon with a My Melody silhouette, 1 small My Melody mascot sitting near the bottom left holding a strawberry, 1 faint bunny silhouette on the mid-right, 1 small star outline near the text, 1 pale lace trim along the top edge, and 1 scattering layer of tiny hearts and sparkles across the whole poster.

Visual style: Soft Sanrio pastel palette, pink and white dominant, glossy highlights, lace, pearls, hearts, strawberries, subtle gradients, delicate gold ornament lines, clean commercial poster composition, crisp readable typography, elegant script for “My Melody”, bold sans-serif for “REALITY App”, and large romantic serif numerals for the year.

Constraints: Use exactly one main anime character, exactly one My Melody mascot at bottom left, exactly two app store badges, no extra characters, no watermark, no photorealism, keep all text legible and centered in its intended panels.

title: DIY Baby Toy Concept Blueprint
prompt:
テーマ「{argument name="テーマ" default="ペットボトル"}」を使った、赤ちゃん向けの手作りDIYおもちゃコンセプトシート画像を4枚生成してください。

重要：
4枚はそれぞれ別々の画像として生成してください。
1枚につき1つのおもちゃアイデアだけを描いてください。
1枚の中に複数案を入れないでください。
グリッド、コラージュ、2×2分割、比較表レイアウトは禁止です。

これは市販品のベビー玩具デザインではありません。
家庭にある既存の素材を使って、保護者が実際に手作りできるDIYおもちゃです。
個人では作れないような完成品、量産品、専用パーツ、シリコン成形、特殊な金型、プロダクトデザイン風の高級玩具にはしないでください。

テーマが「ペットボトル」の場合：
ペットボトル風の新商品ではなく、実際の空きペットボトルをそのまま使ったDIYおもちゃにしてください。
元のペットボトルの形、透明なボトル本体、既存のキャップ、ラベルを剥がした感じ、手で巻いたビニールテープやマスキングテープが分かる見た目にしてください。
100円ショップや家庭で用意できる材料だけで作れる雰囲気にしてください。

4枚の内容は、それぞれ遊び方が違うDIYおもちゃにしてください。
1枚目：音を楽しむDIYおもちゃ
2枚目：転がす・追いかけるDIYおもちゃ
3枚目：見る・観察するDIYおもちゃ
4枚目：触る・握る・感触を楽しむDIYおもちゃ

各コンセプトシートには以下を入れてください。
・完成したDIYおもちゃのメインビジュアル
・赤ちゃんが手で遊んでいる使用シーン
・使う材料一覧
・作り方3ステップの簡単な図解
・素材や構造が分かる図解
・キャップ固定、密閉、水漏れ防止、破損確認などの安全図解
・遊び方アイコン
・発達を促すポイント

安全条件：
対象年齢は6か月〜18か月。
必ず保護者の見守りのもとで遊ぶDIYおもちゃとして表現してください。
小さな素材を使う場合は、必ずボトルや袋の中に完全に密閉してください。
外側に取れやすい小物を貼らないでください。
キャップや開口部は接着し、上からテープでしっかり固定している表現にしてください。
誤飲サイズの小物、鋭利なパーツ、割れやすい素材、長いひもは禁止です。
赤ちゃんが口に入れる、噛む、舐めるシーンは禁止です。

ビジュアルスタイル：
白背景。
やさしい自然光。
保育園や家庭向けの手作りおもちゃレシピ風。
DIY工作の説明シート風。
現実的で、真似して作れそうな見た目。
少し手作り感がある仕上がり。
材料は身近で安価なものにする。
高級なベビー用品ブランド風にはしない。
プロダクトレンダリング風にはしない。
かわいく、清潔感があり、親しみやすい雰囲気。
文字は少なめで、図解とアイコン中心にする。

ネガティブ指定：
commercial baby toy, premium product design, luxury product rendering, silicone molded toy, custom molded parts, factory-made toy, overmolded rubber, special cap, one-piece molded design, BPA-free product label, food-grade silicone label, industrial design board, polished manufactured product, baby chewing toy, baby biting toy, grid layout, collage layout, 2x2 layout, multiple ideas in one image

拍摄一张双人错位构图婚纱大片。新娘坐在桌边或靠在桌边，是画面的主要焦点。她微微低头或看向远处，情绪安静、若有所思，像在进入婚礼前的某种情绪停顿。新郎站在后方拱窗附近，稍微虚化或弱化一些，但仍清晰可辨，像在安静守望她。两个人不直接对视，却有明显的空间关系和情绪连接。重点：不要做成普通双人照。这张图要有剧情感，新娘是视觉中心，新郎像沉默而深情的存在。前后景层次必须清楚。光影：主光落在新娘身上，后方窗光勾亮新郎轮廓。烛台、书本、纱幔、桌面细节要丰富但不杂。整体偏安静、内敛、电影感。06｜新娘近景珠宝特写 拍摄一张新娘近景电影特写。镜头聚焦新娘的半侧脸、肩颈、复古额饰、耳饰和手中精致复古配饰，例如金属装饰、珠宝面饰、古典小饰件。新娘微微转头，半侧脸或回眸角度，眼神安静而深，唇妆完整，妆容成熟贵气。背景中的烛火虚化成柔和暖色光斑。重点：这张必须非常强调 Gatsby 风格细节。头饰、指推波纹 / 假波波头、珍珠项链、耳饰都要清晰可信。脸不能 AI 感过重，皮肤不能塑料。要像真实拍摄出来的高预算近景，而不是 CG 细节图。光影：暖烛光从侧后方形成局部高光，脸部有柔和但有方向性的光，浅景深，整体很电影。07｜桌边互动，婚礼前夜的仪式感 拍摄一张双人场景互动婚纱照。新娘站在或靠在复古长桌一侧，低头整理桌上的纸张、羽毛笔、珠宝或婚礼小物件；新郎站在桌对面或桌侧，轻轻参与这段互动，例如递给她一件小物、帮她点亮烛火，或安静注视她。两个人处在同一场景里，有很自然的互动，不是标准站位合影。重点：这张图要有“婚礼仪式前夜”的气氛。两个人的互动必须自然，像电影里的一个被抓拍到的片段。新娘依然是视觉焦点，新郎作为陪伴与守护存在。光影：窗光是主导，烛光是局部氛围光，桌面与道具细节清晰。整体有古典仪式感与叙事感。08｜头纱之下的亲密收束图 拍摄一张双人收束婚纱大片。新娘与新郎站在桌边或拱窗前，长头纱或轻纱从两人头顶垂下，把他们包裹在同一个半透明空间中。新郎一只手轻扶新娘腰间或背部，新娘一只手落在新郎胸前。两个人额头相近，或新郎轻轻贴近新娘额头，停留在最有情绪张力的一刻，不真正亲吻。新娘看向新郎或低垂眼神，新郎轻看她或轻闭眼，整体极其亲密但克制。重点：这张不是“亲吻照”，而是“誓言前的停顿”。两个人之间必须有强烈互动和关系感。纱的前景、烛光、桌面细节都要服务于这段情绪。光影：整体偏暗，窗外逆光与烛光共同塑形，纱在光里半透明发亮，画面神圣、贵气、戏剧化，像整组的结尾镜头。
