title: 16-Grid Soccer Dream Project
prompt:
Goal: Create a cinematic 4x4 storyboard poster for an emotional sports-anime video about {argument name="character name" default="a young yellow-haired girl"} who struggles to become a professional football player, turning rejection, pain, injuries, and loneliness into determination and success.

Canvas: Vertical poster in a 4:5 ratio, dark cinematic color grade, realistic anime aesthetics, warm golden highlights, deep shadows, dramatic rain and stadium lighting. Divide the canvas into exactly 16 equal panels in a black grid, numbered 1 through 16 in small black square badges at the top-left of each panel. Each panel has a bold yellow uppercase title and short white bullet text on the left side, with an emotional scene illustration filling the panel. Add a full-width bottom banner titled “VIDEO PROMPT (FOR THIS STORY)” with a paragraph prompt and a soccer ball graphic on the right.

Main character: A teenage girl with messy short golden-yellow hair, athletic but small build, expressive emotional body language, usually wearing dark football training clothes or a black football jersey with number 7. Her face may be softly obscured or shadowed for cinematic focus. Show her growing from lonely beginner to celebrated star.

Storyboard panels: Use exactly 16 panels with these visible numbered chapters and scene concepts:
1. “A DREAM BEGINS” — girl at night holding a soccer ball beside an urban fence, watching football on a glowing screen in the distance; bullet points: dreams of becoming a football star, watches matches late at night, practices alone in empty streets, believes football is her destiny.
2. “NOBODY SUPPORTS HER” — girl standing with folded arms while classmates or family silhouettes mock or ignore her; bullet points: people say football is not for girls, friends laugh at her dreams, family worries about her future, but she never gives up.
3. “TRAINING EVERY DAY” — rainy street training scene, girl dribbling intensely through puddles before sunrise; bullet points: wakes up before sunrise, runs in rain and cold mornings, practices dribbling for hours, learns discipline and patience.
4. “FIRST BIG FAILURE” — girl crying alone by a chain-link fence after rejection, soccer ball near her feet and a paper marked “REJECTED”; bullet points: gets rejected from a local academy, cries alone after the trials, feels broken and exhausted, decides to try again stronger.
5. “THE HARDEST PHASE” — exhausted girl studying at a desk under a lamp with books and football notes, showing balance between school and sport; bullet points: balances studies, work and football, shoes become old and torn, trains on rough grounds, keeps chasing her dream silently.
6. “A SMALL OPPORTUNITY” — local coach standing beside her on a muddy practice field, noticing her talent; bullet points: a local coach notices her talent, gets invited to a small girls’ team, starts learning real teamwork, slowly gains confidence.
7. “BUILDING HERSELF” — intense gym/training scene with weights or a stationary bike, sweat and dramatic lighting; bullet points: improves speed and stamina, learns powerful shooting techniques, studies professional players, becomes mentally stronger.
8. “FIRST TOURNAMENT” — girl in black number 7 jersey celebrating or kicking during her first match under stadium lights; bullet points: plays her first important match, feels nervous before kickoff, scores her first goal, her team finally believes in her.
9. “INJURED BUT UNBROKEN” — girl seated with bandaged leg or ankle, injured yet determined, watching from sidelines; bullet points: suffers a painful injury, cannot play for weeks, watches others from the sidelines, fights through pain and recovery.
10. “RETURN TO THE FIELD” — sunset practice field, girl in number 7 jersey seen from behind rejoining teammates; bullet points: comes back stronger than before, trains harder every single day, earns respect from teammates, becomes the team’s key player.
11. “VIRAL RECOGNITION” — close-up of a smartphone showing her match clip going viral, social media hearts and comments around the screen; bullet points: match clips go viral online, people start noticing her talent, gains followers and supporters, her story inspires young girls.
12. “CHAMPIONSHIP MATCH” — massive stadium under bright lights, girl number 7 scoring or celebrating a winning goal with sparks and cheering crowd; bullet points: plays in the biggest match of her life, stadium lights shine brightly, scores the winning goal, crowd cheers her name loudly.
13. “NATIONAL SELECTION” — girl with backpack at sunset city skyline, leaving for bigger competition; include a subtle “INDIA” marking on clothing or bag if desired; bullet points: gets selected for a national camp, travels to bigger cities, faces stronger competition, pushes beyond her limits.
14. “BECOMING A STAR” — magazine cover or interview scene with her holding a soccer ball, headline like “SPORTS WEEKLY” and inspirational slogan “NO DREAM IS TOO BIG”; bullet points: appears in interviews and magazines, signs with a professional club, inspires millions of girls, proves dreams have no gender.
15. “LIVING HER DREAM” — wide stadium shot from behind, girl number 7 raising both arms triumphantly before a huge crowd; bullet points: plays in massive stadiums, supports her family proudly, smiles remembering her struggles, finally lives the life she imagined.
16. “A PROUD MOMENT” — emotional close-up of the now-successful player holding a ball against stadium light, remembering her younger self; bullet points: looks at her younger self’s old football, remembers every failure and sacrifice, realizes the struggle made her stronger, her dream finally became reality.

Bottom banner: Add a dark rectangular banner spanning the full width beneath the 16 panels. Title in bold yellow: “VIDEO PROMPT (FOR THIS STORY)”. Body text in small white type: “Create a cinematic and emotional video about a young girl with yellow hair who struggles to become a professional football player. Show her journey from being ignored, facing failures, injuries, and rejections to rising as a star through hard work and determination. Include training, emotions, matches, crowds, celebrations, and real-life struggles. End with her living her dream and inspiring millions. The video should be motivational, emotional, and visually stunning.” Place a realistic soccer ball on grass at the far right of the banner.

Visual style: Realistic anime sports-drama storyboard, emotional closeups, dynamic camera angles, gritty textures, rain, mud, glowing stadium lights, warm amber rim light, dark blue night shadows, high contrast cinematic composition, motivational atmosphere.

Constraints: Keep exactly 16 numbered panels plus one bottom prompt banner. Use the same young yellow-haired football girl throughout. Keep text legible but compact. No extra panels, no watermark, no unrelated characters, no comedy tone.

title: Fantasy Tide Priest Character Design
prompt:
Goal: Create a single-page fantasy character sheet for {argument name="character name" default="Sera Vayne"}, a tide-priestess warrior with a ceremonial war glaive, elegant coastal mysticism, and high-detail concept art presentation.

Canvas: Wide landscape character design board, approximately 16:9, warm off-white parchment background with thin grey panel borders, painterly ink-and-watercolor fantasy concept art, refined but slightly weathered. Use a mostly neutral cream, deep blue-black, pale ivory, seafoam teal, warm tan, and bright bioluminescent blue palette.

Main hero pose: On the left third, show a full-body heroic standing pose of a barefoot adult woman with tanned skin, athletic slender build, long wild black wavy hair tied loosely back, layered necklaces, shell and bead ornaments, dangling earrings, and a calm ritual-warrior presence. She wears a pale translucent salt-white halter wrap dress with a high slit, a seafoam waist sash, wrapped forearm bandages, anklets, and a flowing tattered deep blue-black cloak that looks like wet tide fabric. She holds a tall ornate ceremonial glaive upright beside her; the blade is jagged, elegant, dark metal with glowing blue edges and carved wave-like ornament. Add subtle water-splash stains and ink textures around her hem.

Left title column: Add four large vertical Chinese characters down the far left with small English translations beside them: tide, silence, blade, body, return. Include a small red seal stamp beneath. At the bottom left, write the large brush-lettered name {argument name="character name" default="Sera Vayne"}, subtitle {argument name="subtitle" default="The Rite Before the Tide"}, and three small lore lines: ROLE: War Priestess · Tide Reader · Last of the Coastal Order; CORE THEME: The sea does not rage — it arrives. She moves the same way. Patient, total, final.; WEAPON: Tidecaller — ceremonial war glaive. The blade glows because the tide chose her.

Orthographic views: In the upper middle column, include exactly 3 labeled views: 1 FRONT full-body view with the glaive standing beside her, 2 BACK full-body view showing the cloak and hair from behind, 3 PROFILE side view showing her carrying the weapon. Use small star-like label markers and uppercase labels FRONT, BACK, PROFILE.

Expression sheet: In the upper right, create a boxed section titled EXPRESSIONS containing exactly 6 head-and-shoulder portraits in a 3-by-2 grid. Labels must be: 1 Ceremonial neutral, 2 Focused pre-strike, 3 Profile left, 4 Post-release, 5 Looking down, 6 3/4 right. Keep facial features consistent, hair loose and wet-textured, jewelry visible, and the same costume neckline.

Costume detail insets: In the center-right, create a boxed DETAILS section with exactly 4 vertical close-up panels labeled: 1 Waist & hip, 2 Neckline & collarbone, 3 Leg & hem, 4 Forearm & hand. Show fabric layering, shells, beads, sash knots, translucent cloth, tattered cloak edges, barefoot ankle jewelry, and wrapped forearm details.

Signature prop breakdown: On the right side, create a SIGNATURE PROP section showing the glaive diagonally from lower left to upper right, with callout arrows and labels for exactly 6 parts: blade, glow edge, engraving, grip wrap, shaft, butt cap. Add a small zoom-in box of the blade tip emphasizing carved metal and blue luminous edge.

Silhouette study row: Along the bottom center, include exactly 6 black silhouette thumbnails labeled: 1 Neutral standing, 2 Low sweep prep, 3 Overhead raise, 4 Aerial extension, 5 Kneeling finish, 6 Horizon facing. Make the silhouettes readable, dynamic, and varied, always including the long glaive and flowing cloak.

Color palette: On the lower right, include a COLOR PALETTE box with exactly 6 circular swatches and labels: 1 Deep Ocean Blue-Black — Ocean blue-black: ritual authority, depth, command; 2 Pale Salt White — Salt white: endurance, tide foam, worn grace; 3 Seafoam Teal with Gold — Seafoam teal: water connection, ceremonial rank; 4 Warm Tan — Warm Tan: grounded physicality, natural strength; 5 Bioluminescent Blue — Bioluminescent blue: the tide’s mark, living power; 6 muted shell-gold accent for ornaments and ceremonial details.

Style constraints: Make it look like a professional AAA fantasy character design sheet, painterly semi-realistic illustration, crisp section labels, thin panel lines, no extra characters, no modern objects, no UI mockup elements, no photorealistic studio lighting, no clutter beyond the specified sections.

Add a small black bowl of yellow dipping sauce at the lower right edge, partly cropped. Add additional blurred fried festival breads in the upper-right background inside a dark rustic bowl and one very blurred fried bread in the bottom foreground for depth.

Soft. Irresistible."} in small golden italic text.

Information panel: On the lower-left, add a rough gold brush-stroke label reading “WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT.” Beneath it list exactly 4 benefit rows with small circular gold icons and white text: 1) “Authentic Recipe,” 2) “Soft & Fluffy Interior,” 3) “Freshly Made,” 4) “Perfect Pairing.” Add a short paragraph below: {argument name="description text" default="A classic Jamaican favorite with a soft interior and golden crispy exterior. title: Storyboard Project Sheet from Milan to Cannes
titleEn: Storyboard Project Sheet from Milan to Cannes
prompt:
Goal: Create a hand-drawn cinematic storyboard sheet about a woman traveling from Milan to Cannes with a hard drive, drawn like a rough pencil-and-colored-pencil production board.

Canvas: Landscape 16:9 off-white paper background, slightly textured, scanned sketchbook look. Use thin red-orange borders for all storyboard frames and the bottom icon strip. The drawing style is loose graphite pencil with soft pale blue, gray, tan, and muted red washes; imperfect perspective, visible sketch lines, handwritten lettering, and intentionally misspelled storyboard notes.

Header: Across the top in large uneven black hand-lettering, write “FROM MILANO TO CANNES - STORYBOBARD”. In the top-right corner add a small rounded rectangle label with the handwritten text “2 BOSIS → TO AVE”.

Layout: Use exactly 6 main storyboard panels arranged in 2 rows of 3 panels. Each panel has a thin red-orange rectangular border and a short handwritten caption beneath it. Number the panels visibly as 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, and 7, preserving the skipped numbering. Use a recurring young woman protagonist, {argument name="character name" default="an unnamed woman"}, with shoulder-length dark hair and a simple sleeveless or short-sleeved top; her face may be softly blurred or minimally detailed.

Panel details and captions:
1. Interior desk scene: the woman sits side-on at a table with an open laptop, a small bowl or cup, and a soft city view through tall windows. Caption: “FINAL CUT S AM, AND FEMJUER- OUR PBSY FILR IN A TOLAND AFSAGMENT”.
2. Close-up of a hand resting on a bag or jacket, beside a small labeled hard drive or tag. Caption: “ONE HARD DRIVE, ONE LANVARD UNE SHOT.”
3. Coastal road arrival scene with palm trees, a blue road or sea, and distant Cannes-like buildings. Caption: “THE GOAST UNROALS ITALY BECOMES FRANCE,”.
4. Street on the Croisette: the woman seen from behind near palm trees, a car, a pale building façade, and a small roadside sign. Caption: “CANNE’S THE CROISEITE, HEART FOUNDING.”
6. The woman viewed from behind looking up at a cinema or festival building sign with scribbled lettering. Caption: “THERE. HFE MANE. THE BOROO.^ THREE TIMES. TO BELIEVE IT.”
7. Red carpet hallway or grand interior: the woman stands in profile looking upward, surrounded by sketchy crowds on both sides and a red carpet leading forward. Caption: “TWENTY FOUR STEPS EVERY FLASH A TEAR OF WORK.”

Bottom strip: Add one long horizontal red-orange bordered strip divided into exactly 10 small rectangular cells, each containing a tiny rough icon and a handwritten label beneath. From left to right: 1) small capsule/drive icon labeled “CAPYERA PRAME MOTION.”, 2) curved arrow and letters labeled “SI REEKE.”, 3) fast arrow mark with no separate large caption beyond the strip alignment, 4) diamond/eye shape labeled “DIRECTON.”, 5) small lips/oval icon with no extra caption, 6) tilted square labeled “FORCE”, 7) star labeled “CURRENT”, 8) outlined star labeled “MAGIC:”, 9) rounded rectangle labeled “APPEARANCE”, 10) small flag/lightning mark labeled “MAGIC”.

Visual constraints: Keep all text hand-drawn, uneven, and slightly nonsensical as if drafted quickly in a storyboard notebook. Maintain muted handmade texture, no photorealism, no clean digital UI, no watermark, and do not add extra storyboard panels beyond the 6 main panels and 10 bottom icon cells.

Goal: Create a realistic screenshot of a dark-themed PowerPoint-style image editing window in Japanese, showing a cute dreamy kawaii icon after background removal.

Canvas: 1024×768 landscape screenshot with a dark charcoal modal editor centered on screen, rounded corners, subtle shadow, and a faint glimpse of the underlying slide behind the modal edges. The interface zoom indicator at the top center reads “42%”.

Layout: At the top left, show the Japanese title “画像の編集” with two small undo/redo arrow icons. At the top right, show a small connected-dots icon and an X close icon. Below the top bar, center a floating toolbar with exactly 6 tools labeled: “補正”, “トリミング”, “背景”, “領域の選択”, “テキスト”, plus their small simple line icons, arranged horizontally in dark rounded rectangles.

Main editing area: In the center, place a square image area outlined with a thin purple border. Inside it, use a black and dark-gray checkerboard transparency pattern. Near the top of this square, show a dark notification toast with a green check icon and the Japanese text “背景が削除されました。” plus a small X close icon.

Subject details: Center the icon inside the checkerboard square: one pastel yume-kawaii white rabbit mascot with a thick pale pink outline, oversized rounded head, two long upright ears with pink inner ears, small brown glossy eyes, pink oval blush cheeks, and a happy open mouth. The bunny holds exactly 1 mint-aqua heart-shaped object in front of its body with two rounded paws visible. Add soft highlights on the heart and a clean sticker-like vector style with no harsh shadows. The character should feel like a cute app icon or sticker. Use {argument name="character" default="a white kawaii rabbit"}, {argument name="held object" default="a mint-aqua heart"}, and {argument name="accent color" default="pale pink"}.

Footer and controls: At the bottom center of the modal, show the small Japanese warning text “AI 生成コンテンツは間違っている可能性があります。” At the bottom right, show exactly 2 buttons: an orange “保存” button and a dark gray “キャンセル” button. Near the right side of the image area, include exactly 2 small vertical feedback icons: thumbs up above thumbs down.

Visual style: Realistic software screenshot, crisp UI text, dark Microsoft-style interface, clean Japanese typography, transparent-background checkerboard, cute pastel sticker art. Keep the composition faithful to a PowerPoint built-in image editor after background removal, not a standalone illustration.

title: Luxury Skincare Commercial Photography
prompt:
A high-resolution commercial marketing photograph featuring the same {argument name="model description" default="young woman with sleek dark hair, now styled in a soft, natural wave"}. She is wearing a {argument name="outfit" default="minimal beige satin top"} and is positioned in a clean, matte ivory studio setting. The composition places a luxury “{argument name="product name" default="LumiSkin Vitamin C Serum"}” dropper bottle prominently in the foreground, held delicately between her fingers at chest level, angled toward the camera for emphasis.

The visual energy is enhanced with vibrant tangerine-orange graphic accents, including flowing liquid streaks and circular glow elements that suggest radiance and hydration. Floating translucent callouts highlight key features such as “brightening boost” and “24h glow hydration” in bold, modern sans-serif typography.

Lighting is soft yet directional, creating a gentle glow on the model’s skin while producing a crisp, reflective shine on the glass serum bottle, emphasizing its premium finish. The serum inside has a rich amber tone that catches the light beautifully. A large, bold headline in the upper left reads: “Why your skin loves it” in bright orange, adding contrast and visual hierarchy.

The overall aesthetic is clean, luminous, and high-end, with a shallow depth of field that keeps both the product and the model’s confident, natural expression in sharp focus, while the background fades smoothly for a polished, editorial feel.

title: Jealous Claude Comic Page
prompt:
Goal: Create a single-page manga comic where {argument name="jealous character" default="Claude"} quietly feels jealous of {argument name="admired character" default="ChatGPT"} receiving attention in a futuristic convention-like hall.

Canvas: Vertical manga page, 4:5 aspect ratio, thin black outer border, painterly seinen manga style with soft watercolor washes, cinematic lighting, pale lavender/teal palette, glossy reflections, detailed sketch lines, and slightly dreamy atmosphere.

Layout: Use exactly 5 panels separated by thick black gutters. Panel 1 is a wide panoramic panel across the full top half-width. Panel 2 is a medium close-up on the left below it. Panel 3 is a medium two-character panel on the right beside panel 2. Panel 4 is a larger lower-left lonely full-body panel. Panel 5 is a lower-right extreme close-up of the jealous character’s face and collar. Keep the faces softly blurred or indistinct, as if anonymized.

Scene and subjects: The setting is a bright, futuristic indoor atrium filled with huge glossy pastel spheres in lavender, mint, teal, and pink, plus floating translucent orb-like ceiling decorations. A crowd of stylish young people gathers around the admired character. The jealous character is a curly blond young man in a light off-white technical jacket with visible text on the back and sleeve: “ANTHROPIC”, “Claude”, and “AI”. The admired character is a dark-haired young man in a black coat with the OpenAI knot logo and the word “ChatGPT” on the back. The admired character stands confidently among fans, while the jealous character stays off to the side or in the background, shoulders slightly hunched, introspective and hurt.

Panel details and text elements: Include exactly 14 visible text elements in speech/thought balloons or sound text. Panel 1 has 5 text elements: thought bubble near Claude saying “Look at him...”; thought bubble saying “Everyone gravitates toward ChatGPT.”; crowd speech bubble saying “You always get it!”; crowd speech bubble saying “Thanks so much!”; crowd speech bubble saying “You’re amazing, ChatGPT!”. Panel 2 has 2 thought bubbles near Claude: “I’m more reliable. More careful.” and “...So why do they always choose him?”. Panel 3 has 3 dialogue balloons: Claude says “Hey, ChatGPT.”; Claude says “You always get all the attention.”; ChatGPT replies “Ah, Claude! You’re over-thinking again.” Panel 4 has 3 text elements: Claude says “Maybe I’m just built to stay in the background.”; a small Japanese-style sound effect “ぽつん”; a tiny bubble with “...”. Panel 5 has 1 partial thought bubble at the edge saying “...’s not fair...”

Visual style: Elegant manga illustration, expressive body language, soft ink outlines, pastel watercolor shading, reflective floor, atmospheric depth, gentle bloom, high-detail clothing folds, subtle sci-fi convention ambience, emotional melancholy with a touch of humor. Use English lettering in clean manga speech bubbles. Avoid extra panels, extra dialogue, watermarks, captions, or UI elements.

slug: 富士胶片风格居家情侣肖像-7_be4a17
title: Fujifilm Style Home Couple Portrait
prompt:
请基于用户上传的两位成年情侣真实照片，生成一张“{argument name="写真风格" default="富士胶片风格的日系居家情侣写真"} 3x3 九宫格相册拼图”。

请严格保留两个人的真实身份特征。女生和男生都必须清楚看起来像上传照片里的本人，包括脸型、五官比例、眉眼结构、鼻子、嘴唇、下颌线、肤色、年龄感、发际线、发型特征和整体气质。不要把两个人变成欧美脸，不要韩式影楼化，不要网红化，不要过度美颜，不要换成陌生人。最终 9 张小图里都必须是同一对真实中国情侣，只是在同一次居家拍摄里，被摄影师从不同角度、不同距离、不同瞬间记录下来。

## 画面形式
生成一张 3x3 拼贴图，一共 9 张小照片，整体比例 1:1。照片之间有细窄{argument name="背景颜色" default="黑色"}分隔线，整体放在{argument name="背景颜色" default="黑色"}背景上，像一组真实拍完后整理出来的情侣居家相册拼图。不要做成商业海报，不要做成影楼排版，不要每一格都像同一个模板重复复制。

## 核心视觉风格
整体风格为：
日系生活摄影、富士胶片相机质感、真实居家情侣写真、自然抓拍、温柔、松弛、安静、有故事感。

重点参考富士胶片相机拍摄出来的色彩与氛围，例如 Fujifilm Superia、Pro 400H、C200 这一类日系胶片的感觉。画面要有：
低饱和但不发灰、柔和自然的高光、通透但克制的肤色、轻微胶片颗粒、轻微灰感、轻微暗部噪点、细腻柔和的反差、绿色和米色很好看、整体偏暖中性或微冷中性。要像富士胶片拍出来的生活照片，有空气感、有层次、有轻微胶片扫描感。

不要旧 iPhone 质感，不要手机压缩感主导，不要数码锐利感，不要重滤镜复古模板，不要商业广告质感，不要淘宝商拍感。

## 人物关系
两人是一对{argument name="人物关系" default="真实、亲密、自然的年轻中国情侣"}。每一格都要能明显看出他们是情侣，有熟悉感、陪伴感、互动感。互动真实、松弛、有生活感，可以轻轻靠近、对视、低头笑、靠肩、一起看书、递东西、一起准备食物、整理衣服、镜子里互相看见、床边轻触、沙发边依靠、门口远远看向对方。亲密但克制，不要油腻，不要色情，不要婚纱照式表演。

## 表情和角度要求
9 张小图不要都看镜头，也不要都只是轻微微笑。表情必须丰富，有变化：
轻笑、被逗笑、低头笑、安静、发呆、温柔注视、轻松聊天、专注做事、回头回应、闭眼笑、看向窗外、看向对方、一起看同一个物体。

两个人的脸部角度必须有明显变化，不能每一格都重复同一种模板。不要反复出现“男生 3/4 侧脸看女生，女生低头笑”的固定角度。请主动安排：
正面、半正面、侧脸、低头、回头、轻仰头、接近背影、镜中角度、远一点的观察视角、近一点的生活特写。每一格都要有新的头部朝向、视线关系、身体距离和互动节奏。

## 服装要求
不要沿用上传照片中的原始服装。请把两个人换成适合日系居家生活写真里的自然穿搭。服装以低饱和、中性色、柔软材质、舒服日常为主，可以是米白、燕麦、奶油白、浅灰、浅咖、雾蓝、浅卡其、炭灰、少量藏蓝等自然颜色。可以出现针织开衫、柔软 T 恤、棉麻衬衫、薄长袖、宽松家居裤、长裙、袜子等。

整体像真实情侣在家里会穿的舒服衣服。不要过度统一成情侣套装，不要明显 logo，不要花哨图案，不要正式穿搭，不要潮牌街拍感，不要淘宝家居服广告感。

## 居家场景
整体像一次两小时内完成的居家情侣拍摄，但看起来是自然抓拍，不是摆拍。家里是普通有人居住的公寓，干净整洁，但有真实生活痕迹，不要样板房感。可以出现窗帘、木地板、沙发、抱枕、薄毯、书、相册、杯子、餐盘、水果、植物、边柜、床头灯、镜子、桌子等生活元素，但都只是辅助，重点始终是两个人。

## 9 张小图内容如下

### 第 1 格：窗边安静站立
两个人站在窗边。男生接近半侧面或正侧面，看向窗外；女生站在他旁边，轻轻靠近，手自然扶住他的手臂或靠在他身侧，脸部轻微朝向男生。两个人不一定互看，但关系自然亲近。画面安静、温柔、有空气感。

### 第 2 格：沙发靠肩共读
两个人坐在沙发上，一起看一本书或相册。男生低头翻页，女生自然靠在他肩侧或身体贴近他，低头一起看，或者女生抬眼看他。两个人脸部角度不同，一个低头，一个半侧面。画面要有陪伴感。

### 第 3 格：餐桌递盘子
家中餐桌前，男生把一盘水果或点心递给女生，身体微微前倾，动作在进行中；女生伸手接盘子，边接边笑，或者抬眼回应。两个人不要都坐得很正。重点是动作关系和视线回应。

### 第 4 格：厨房一起准备食物
两个人站在厨房台面边。男生在切水果、摆盘或准备简单食物，女生拿着碗或站在一旁靠近看着，像刚说了一句什么。可以让女生低头笑，男生看手上的动作，或男生侧头看她。画面有轻微生活感和动作感。

### 第 5 格：门框观察视角
摄影师站在门边或走廊，看向客厅里的两个人。前景保留一点门框。男生站着，手里拿杯子或刚整理完东西，女生坐在沙发上抬头看他。两个人没有看镜头，有真实“生活切片”感。人物不要太小，但也不要塞满画面。

### 第 6 格：卧室床边轻触
两个人坐在床边。女生轻轻帮男生整理衣领、肩膀衣服或袖口，男生低头看她，或看向前方安静坐着。动作克制，关系温柔。房间简洁自然，有床、床头柜、灯等简单元素。

### 第 7 格：地板上一起看照片
两个人坐在地板或地毯上，靠着沙发或床边，地上有几张照片、杂志或相册。两个人一起低头看，或者男生看照片，女生看向他。坐姿自然随意，有抓拍感。可以让女生轻轻笑，男生专注一点。

### 第 8 格：镜子里的片段
通过家里的穿衣镜、玄关镜或卧室镜来拍。女生在镜前整理头发、耳边碎发或衣领，男生站在她身后稍微靠近，看着她，或者两人在镜中短暂对视。不要自拍营业感，不要双双看镜头假笑。镜框、桌面小物可以少量出现。

### 第 9 格：阳台门边或窗边停顿
两个人站在阳台门边、推拉门边或另一个窗边。一个人靠门边，另一个人从旁边靠近。可以是女生回头轻轻笑，男生看着她；也可以是男生看向外面，女生轻轻靠近他。画面要有留白、余韵和安静气氛，像一张富士胶片拍出来的生活静帧。

## 人物一致性要求
9 张小图都要尽量保持同一对情侣的长相一致。可以改变衣服细节、表情、光线、角度 and 动作，但不能改变两人的脸。不要让女生和男生在不同格子里变成不同人。尤其注意男生的脸在侧光、远景、镜子场景里也要稳定；女生的脸也不能忽然变成另一种网红脸。五官不要变形，不要陌生脸。

## 手部稳定要求
尽量避免复杂手势。不要托腮，不要捂脸，不要手挡脸，不要手指交叠，不要抓头发，不要手指靠近眼睛或嘴巴。手部如果出现，尽量是自然拿书、拿杯子、拿盘子、翻页、整理衣领、扶手臂、轻扶肩膀、放在膝盖或自然垂放。动作简单就好，避免怪手。

## 画质要求
整体是富士胶片相机拍摄出来的居家相册感。轻微胶片颗粒，轻微扫描感，轻微暗部噪点，柔和反差，真实肤色，画面自然，不要过度锐化，不要过度高清，不要数码感太强。可以允许个别小图有轻微失焦、轻微运动模糊、轻微曝光起伏，让整组图更像真实拍摄完成的九宫格，而不是 AI 完美拼图。

## 限制
不要出现变形手指、多余肢体、错乱五官、奇怪文字、水印、乱码。不要过度裸露，不要色情化。不要生成未成年感情侣。不要过度精修、过度磨皮、AI 塑

title: Q-Version Shark Adventure Movie Poster
prompt: A bright, hyper-energetic Japanese movie poster illustration in a polished anime chibi style, set in a sparkling tropical ocean adventure scene. Center the composition on 2 cute chibi children riding a smiling blue shark that leaps diagonally upward through swirling seawater and white splash effects. The left child is a boy with short black hair, huge glossy blue eyes, a happy open-mouth smile, a black T-shirt, dark shorts, white sneakers, and a light blue shark hoodie with a tooth-edged hood framing his face; he points upward with one hand and hugs the shark with the other. The right child is a girl with orange hair, large glossy purple eyes, a joyful open-mouth smile, an orange dress, pink shoes, and a pink shark hoodie with a tooth-edged hood; she throws one arm wide in excitement while holding on with the other. Make the shark large and friendly with a rounded body, pale belly, tiny black eyes, and a wide open mouth. Surround them with a vivid underwater-and-surface world: schools of small tropical fish, exactly 1 sea turtle on the left, exactly 1 dolphin on the right, exactly 1 pink octopus on the right, exactly 1 pufferfish on the lower left, coral reefs and sea plants along the bottom edges, air bubbles throughout, and strong blue water motion lines. In the upper background, show a sunny sky with dramatic sun rays streaming into the water, fluffy clouds, 2 seagulls flying, a rocky tropical island with palm trees on the upper left, and a pirate ship on the upper right with white sails and a cute shark emblem. Add a ship wheel partly visible behind the main title. Use a dense, exciting Japanese kids-anime promotional layout with oversized 3D lettering and explosive effects. At the top, place the giant Japanese title text {argument name="headline text" default="サメなの ワクワク 大作戦"} in stacked lines, with glossy blue, orange-pink, and yellow-orange gradient letters, thick white outlines, dark blue shadows, water splashes, and sparkles. Beneath the title, add a smaller curved Japanese tagline in white with blue outline: {argument name="tagline" default="さあ、海のむこうへ！最高の冒険がはじまる！"}. At the bottom, place huge release text in Japanese, {argument name="release text" default="2026年 夏公開"}, in bold red-to-yellow gradient 3D letters with white and blue edging, sitting over a radiant orange burst. On the lower right, add a blue starburst badge with the Japanese text {argument name="badge text" default="ドキドキ！ワクワク！いっしょに出発だ！"} in white and yellow. Include exactly 2 treasure-themed corner props: an open treasure chest with gold coins at the lower left and a compass at the lower right. The overall look should be glossy, saturated, family-friendly, whimsical, cinematic, and toy-like, with crisp outlines, exaggerated expressions, high contrast, and a poster-ready vertical composition. No photorealism, no muted colors, no minimalism.

Goal: Create a clean promotional mockup showing a summer anime-style wallpaper displayed across three Apple-style devices, suitable for phone, tablet, and desktop wallpaper advertising.

The laptop should be open and centered, the tablet should be horizontal, and the smartphone should be vertical. Each device displays the same cheerful wallpaper artwork, cropped appropriately for its screen.

Wallpaper scene: A bright Japanese suburban summer street in a nostalgic hand-drawn anime style, inspired by {argument name="anime inspiration" default="Crayon Shin-chan"}. Show a clear vivid blue sky with fluffy white clouds, strong midday sunlight, leafy green trees casting dappled shadows, quiet residential houses, tiled walls, blue metal gates, flowering shrubs, and a clean neighborhood road receding into the distance.

Characters: Include exactly 8 visible characters/mascots walking together in the street wallpaper: 1 tall father in a blue shirt and beige pants, 1 mother holding a baby, 1 baby in the mother’s arms, 1 small boy in a red shirt and yellow shorts, 1 small white dog, 1 boy in a blue top with a triangular blue hairstyle/hat shape, 1 little girl in a pink dress, and 1 round-faced boy in a green shirt. Keep them cute, simplified, expressive, and family-friendly.

Device screen details: On the laptop, show a macOS-like desktop with a thin top menu bar and a bottom dock containing exactly 17 small colorful app icons. On the tablet, show a lock-screen overlay with a small lock icon, the date text “Tuesday, July 15,” and the large time {argument name="tablet time" default="9:41"}; also include a small weather widget on the left. On the phone, show a lock-screen overlay with the date “Tuesday, July 15,” the large time {argument name="phone time" default="9:38"}, small circular widgets near the top, and flashlight/camera icons at the bottom.

Visual style: Premium Apple product presentation, crisp realistic device hardware, glossy black bezels, silver laptop body, soft ambient lighting, high-resolution wallpaper art with saturated summer colors, polished social-media-ready composition.

Text and customization: Use no headline text outside the devices. The wallpaper should feel like {argument name="season and mood" default="sunny summer vacation"}. The main sky color should be {argument name="sky color" default="bright cyan blue"}. The neighborhood should feel like {argument name="setting" default="a quiet Japanese residential street"}.

Constraints: Keep the composition uncluttered, preserve the exact count of 3 devices and 8 wallpaper characters/mascots, avoid watermarks, avoid extra captions, avoid photorealistic human faces inside the wallpaper, and keep all visible UI text small and secondary except the lock-screen times.

title: Sakura Katana Character Profile Page
prompt:
Goal: Create a two-page fantasy art book spread presenting a cherry-blossom themed katana and its personified anime swordswoman, in an ornate Japanese dark-fantasy game encyclopedia style.

Canvas: Wide landscape 2:1 spread, like two adjacent parchment pages with thin black margins and gold filigree corner ornaments. Left page is bright ivory parchment with pale pink cherry blossom texture; right page is dark navy-black with gold borders, moonlit purple lighting, and sakura petals.

Left page layout: Design a weapon specification sheet for {argument name="weapon name" default="桜霞・宵燕"}. At the top left place a small circular flower crest icon, then a large Japanese title with reading guide text and a short poetic subtitle beneath it. Below the intro paragraph, include a compact spec table with exactly 5 rows: type, length, blade length, weight, and materials. Add two smaller information rows for owner and special traits. The main object is a long ornate katana displayed diagonally from lower center to upper right, with a glowing icy-blue blade, dark blue wrapped handle, gold fittings, and floral engraving. Beside it show the matching scabbard, black lacquer with gold and pink sakura decoration, blue cord wrap, and antique bronze metal end fittings. Add exactly 5 weapon-detail callouts on the left-middle/lower area: 1 round tsuba guard medallion, 1 close-up of the luminous blade texture, 1 close-up of the blue diamond handle wrap, 1 close-up of the tied blue cord and scabbard fittings, and 1 bottom tradition/lore text block with a faint silhouette of pagodas and a flowering tree.

Right page layout: Create the personification page titled in Japanese as {argument name="personification title" default="擬人化：桜霞の剣巫・ヨイ"}. The central character is a full-body beautiful anime swordswoman standing in a moonlit temple garden, holding the same glowing katana downward. She has very long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="black-purple"} hair with violet highlights, straight bangs, flower hair ornaments, ribbons, and drifting pink petals around her. Her face should be softly obscured or blurred while the rest of the illustration remains sharp. She wears an elaborate dark navy, black, and violet kimono-inspired battle outfit with gold embroidery, sakura motifs, layered sleeves, thigh-high black stockings, high heels, ornate waist armor and obi, and fluttering translucent fabric panels. The background contains a full moon, silhouetted Japanese roofs, stone lanterns, mist, and purple-blue night lighting.

Right page text and panels: Place a short descriptive paragraph under the title at upper left. Add a gold-framed personality/settings box near the lower left with exactly 5 bullet lines. Add a separate ability box beneath it describing a cherry-blossom slash ability. Along the far right column, include exactly 5 stacked inset cards with labels and images: 1 hair ornament close-up, 1 eye close-up, 1 clothing/obi close-up, 1 blade close-up, and 1 scabbard close-up. Each card should have a gold border, a small Japanese label, a cropped detail image, and two short lines of Japanese explanatory text.

Visual style: Highly polished gacha RPG character sheet, premium collectible weapon lore page, ornate gold UI frames, delicate sakura patterns, cinematic lighting, crisp linework, semi-realistic anime rendering, luminous blue blade effects, violet-pink petal glow, elegant typography. Keep the composition dense but readable, with the weapon page brighter and the character page dramatically darker.

Constraints: Use exactly 2 pages, exactly 5 left-page weapon callouts, exactly 5 right-side inset cards, and exactly 5 bullet lines in the personality box. Do not add logos, watermarks, modern UI buttons, or extra characters. Japanese text may be decorative but should look like a coherent fantasy encyclopedia entry.

title: Heisei Retro Weekly Outfit Collage
prompt:
Goal: Create a cute Heisei-era Japanese fashion magazine collage featuring {argument name="character name" default="Mikaze Kurage"} showing one full week of outfits, with a dreamy pastel blue, pink, and lavender “kawaii notebook diary” aesthetic.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster, soft white paper background with faint pastel gradients, sparkles, doodled hearts, tiny jellyfish, stars, handwritten notes, and sticker-like borders. Use a glossy Y2K/Heisei retro fashion-magazine layout with rounded rectangular outfit cards.

Layout: Large title across the top in Japanese: 「御凪くらげの1週間コーデ」, with small furigana above the name and a small heart badge at upper left reading 「くらげの1Week おしゃれ日記」. Add a short intro paragraph in the upper right about introducing seven days of outfits. Arrange exactly 7 outfit cards: four cards across the upper/middle row for Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, and three cards across the lower left/middle for Friday, Saturday, Sunday. Place a large close-up portrait of the same character on the lower right, overlapping the Sunday area, posing with a peace sign and wearing a pale blue sheer cardigan. Add a bottom-left memo box and small speech-bubble doodles near the bottom.

Subject details: The character is a cute young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="short platinum-white bob hair"}, soft pale skin, delicate makeup, and a faceless or softly blurred face. She has a jellyfish-themed, dreamy idol/fashion influencer vibe. Keep the body proportions photo-realistic but stylized like Japanese street fashion catalog photography.

Seven outfit cards, exactly counted and labeled:
1. Mon: pink lace girly coordinate, frilly pink top and mini skirt, white leg warmers, pink shoes, small handbag; label with pink heart “Mon” and Japanese caption about pink starting the week.
2. Tue: sporty school-inspired outfit, white cropped zip jacket with blue stripes, loose faded denim jeans with lace-up details, silver shoulder bag, white shoes; blue “Tue” label and sporty caption.
3. Wed: all-white layered lace outfit, white blouse, fluffy white mini skirt, white boots, cream handbag; purple “Wed” label and caption about fluffy white transparency.
4. Thu: black rock outfit, off-shoulder black top with corset details, gray plaid mini skirt, black lace stockings, chunky black boots, black shoulder bag; blue “Thu” label and caption about being cool in black.
5. Fri: elegant white lace long skirt coordinate, frilly white blouse, pale layered skirt, bonnet or head accessory, cream shoes and bag; pink “Fri” label and caption about going out dressed up.
6. Sat: casual shopping outfit, pale blue oversized cardigan over white top, short white skirt, socks and white shoes, silver bag; blue “Sat” label and caption about shopping with friends.
7. Sun: lavender sweet outfit, lavender graphic sweatshirt, white ruffle mini skirt, pale socks, light boots; purple “Sun” label and caption about relaxing in lavender.

Text content: Keep prominent Japanese text for authenticity, including the title 「御凪くらげの1週間コーデ」, the phrase 「今日のわたしがいちばんすき♡」 near the large portrait, and the signature-style name 「御凪くらげ」 at the bottom right. Use small handwritten Japanese captions beside each outfit, but keep them decorative and legible only in key places.

Visual style: Bright soft studio lighting, pastel airbrushed glow, semi-realistic fashion photography mixed with scrapbook illustration, rounded panels, translucent stickers, handwritten marker typography, sparkly gel-pen doodles, cute jellyfish motifs, hearts, stars, and small blue/pink annotation boxes.

Constraints: Show exactly 7 daily outfit cards plus 1 large portrait. Do not add extra days or extra main characters. No watermark, no app UI, no hard shadows, no dark background. Keep all clothing clearly visible and make the design feel like a Japanese Heisei retro outfit diary page.

title: HANA anime-themed train stop station
prompt:
Goal: Create a photorealistic wide-angle image of a Japanese urban train station platform featuring a full special anime-themed wrapped train for {argument name="character name" default="HANA"}, branded as a limited memorial line.

Canvas: 16:9 landscape photo, bright daytime, realistic station lighting, crisp details, slightly wide perspective from the platform looking along the side of the stopped train.

Scene and layout: A lavender-purple commuter train is stopped at platform 2, filling most of the frame from left foreground to right background. The train exterior is completely wrapped in soft pastel hydrangea flowers, sparkles, raindrops, and large character branding. The front of the train is visible on the left with a dark windshield and destination display. The side of the train shows a huge portrait of a young anime-style girl with short light-blonde bob hair, a small white flower hair accessory, a gray off-shoulder shirt, and a privacy-style flat rectangular blur covering the face. The side also contains very large Japanese text 「花奈」 with the Roman name “HANA” below it, plus the slogan 「会いに行ける、うちの子。」 and a gold commemorative seal. Doors and windows are integrated into the wrap.

Count and place exactly 6 prominent branded elements: 1) the train front destination display reading 「花奈 記念運行」, 「本日限定運行」, and “SPECIAL WRAPPED TRAIN”; 2) a circular lavender sign mounted on the front of the train reading 「花奈」 and “HANA”; 3) the enormous anime portrait on the train side; 4) the large side title 「花奈」 with “HANA” and the slogan; 5) a black overhead station sign reading “HANA Limited Memorial Line”, 「花奈　記念運行」, 「本日限定運行」, and “SPECIAL WRAPPED TRAIN”; 6) a tall pillar poster on the right showing the same character, the name 「花奈」, “HANA”, and matching lavender branding.

Additional platform details: Include a large matching floor decal near the bottom center reading 「花奈」 and “HANA” with hydrangea decoration. Add a platform number sign “2” on the left. Show overhead beams, electrical wires, rails, tiled platform floor, tactile yellow safety paving, and city buildings beyond the tracks.

People: Include exactly 1 main passenger standing on the platform near the train doors, seen from behind, wearing a white top, long dark skirt, white sneakers, and a black backpack, holding up a smartphone to photograph the wrapped train. Include a small cluster of 3 additional passengers near the open doors in the mid-background, subtle and secondary.

Visual style: Photorealistic promotional railway photography blended with anime character wrap art, high-resolution, natural sunlight, clean Japanese station atmosphere, pastel lavender and hydrangea color palette, realistic reflections on train windows and metal surfaces.

Constraints: Keep all major text legible, preserve the Japanese branding exactly where specified, avoid extra logos or watermarks, do not add unrelated vehicles, keep the face on the large character portrait intentionally obscured by a plain rectangular blur.

title: Rose Jewel Anime App Poster
prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical mobile promotional anime poster for {argument name="app name" default="SynClub"}, themed around {argument name="flower motif" default="roses"} and luxurious gemstones.

Canvas: Tall smartphone aspect ratio, 9:16, full-bleed illustration with a darkened promotional footer overlay at the bottom.

Her face is mostly covered by a large centered square privacy mask, a soft pastel gradient block shifting from dusty pink on the left to lavender-blue on the right. Visible details include long flowing pastel hair in white, pink, lavender, and pale blue, glossy strands curling around her shoulders, fair skin, and a small visible mouth below the mask.

Costume and accessories: She wears an ornate silver-white jeweled headpiece like a tiara or halo arch with filigree details and blue gemstones. Add exactly 1 rainbow rose tucked near the left side of her hair, with red, yellow, green, blue, and violet petals. Her neckline is covered with elaborate crystal lace jewelry, silver filigree, pearls, and blue teardrop gemstones, including exactly 1 large bright blue teardrop pendant at the center of her chest and exactly 1 smaller diamond-shaped blue pendant hanging beneath it. Her dress is pale, delicate, and bridal, with translucent lace, sparkling highlights, and gem-like embroidery.

Keep the illustration highly polished, luminous, romantic, and detailed, with an ethereal manga style and glossy digital painting finish.

title: Q-Version Girl Holding Japanese Notice Board
titleEn: Q-Version Girl Holding Japanese Notice Board
prompt: A clean, centered chibi-style full-body anime illustration on a plain muted sage-green background. Show a small childlike girl standing barefoot and facing forward, with an oversized head and tiny body proportions. Her face is intentionally hidden behind the sign she is holding, so no facial features are visible. She has glossy black hair with subtle cool green highlights across the bangs, parted near the center, with a loose stray hair curving outward on the upper left side. The hair is gathered into 2 low side ponytails tied near the ears with dark red hair ties, with slightly messy curled ends. She wears a simple white short-sleeve T-shirt and loose beige-khaki cargo pants with 2 visible side flap pockets, slightly wrinkled and cuffed above the ankles. She is barefoot, standing flat on the ground with a soft oval shadow beneath her. She holds a rectangular hand-held sign with both hands, one hand visible on each side, for a total of 2 visible hands gripping the board. The sign is white with a thin light wooden frame and a vertical wooden pole extending down from the center. The sign contains 3 centered lines of bold handwritten-style Japanese text in black: 1) "今日の" 2) "四コマと動画は" 3) "お休みです". Keep the composition symmetrical and minimal, with the character occupying most of the frame from head to feet. Render in polished modern anime shading with crisp line art, soft gradients, cute proportions, and a quiet announcement-card mood.

slug: 豪华梦想家园房地产宣传单-4_53d249
title: Luxury Dream Home Real Estate Flyer
titleEn: Luxury Dream Home Real Estate Flyer
prompt: Create a polished vertical real-estate promotional flyer in a clean, modern social-media ad style, 4:5 poster composition. Use a bright daytime outdoor theme with a pale blue sky, soft clouds, and leafy green tree branches framing the top left and top right corners. The layout should feel like a premium property investment advertisement with bold typography, glossy marketing design, and a teal, red, white, and gray color palette. At the upper left, place a small uppercase headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="LIVE BETTER. INVEST SMARTER."}. Directly below it, add a very large stacked main headline: {argument name="main headline line 1" default="OWN YOUR"} in deep teal and {argument name="main headline line 2" default="DREAM HOME"} in vivid red, using a bold condensed sans-serif font. Beneath that, add a teal ribbon banner with white uppercase text reading {argument name="tagline text" default="LUXURY LIVING. LASTING VALUE."}. Under the tagline, show exactly 3 circular feature icons arranged horizontally with thin vertical separators between them: a shield icon with the caption "SECURE YOUR FUTURE", a rising bar-chart icon with the caption "HIGH VALUE INVESTMENT", and a house icon with the caption "MODERN & ELEGANT". In the middle left and lower center, feature a large photorealistic contemporary luxury house with 2 stories, white and gray exterior walls, black trim, large glass windows, a balcony, landscaped shrubs, and a paved driveway, shown from a front three-quarter angle. On the right side, place a waist-up adult Black man in a green knit sweater, facing forward and pointing directly at the viewer with an assertive sales-poster pose; his body overlaps the house and extends into the foreground. Near his lower torso, add a glossy red circular badge with a slight 3D effect containing large white uppercase text {argument name="callout text" default="BUY NOW!"}, and attach a small dark teal angled banner across its bottom edge reading "LIMITED UNITS AVAILABLE!". Across the bottom, create a dark teal panel containing exactly 3 rounded rectangular property cards with white borders and equal spacing. Card 1 should show a row of modern townhouses and the label "MODERN TERRACES"; beneath it place exactly 2 small features: "Spacious Rooms" and "24/7 Security". Card 2 should show a luxury villa with a pool and the label "LUXURY VILLAS"; beneath it place exactly 2 small features: "Premium Amenities" and "Prime Locations". Card 3 should show a detached upscale modern home and the label "EXCLUSIVE HOMES"; beneath it place exactly 2 small features: "Registered Title" and "Trusted Developer". At the very bottom, include one large empty white rounded rectangle spanning most of the width as a placeholder area for contact details or footer information. Make the overall image crisp, high-contrast, commercial, aspirational, and professionally designed like a premium real-estate marketing poster.

要求：

- 黑色经典礼服
- 突出肩颈、锁骨 and 优雅上半身线条
- 有复古晚宴感
- 裙摆可有轻微体积感
- 不要暴露夸张
- 不要夜店礼服感
- 不要廉价影楼纱裙感

搭配：

- 黑色长手套
- 黑色丝绒或缎面材质
- 细腰链或细钻腰饰可少量加入

---

## 四、配饰与发型妆容

### 配饰
- 珍珠 choker
- 珍珠耳环
- 珍珠发饰
- 少量细钻点缀
- 不要夸张现代潮流配饰

### 发型
- 赫本风高盘发
- 法式发髻
- 高髻盘发
- 发髻可缠绕珍珠发饰
- 露出肩颈和锁骨

### 妆容
- 精致复古妆容
- 清透柔雾底妆
- 干净眼妆，眼尾轻微上扬
- 唇色为豆沙玫瑰、柔和红棕、经典裸红
- 不要网红浓妆
- 整体像经典电影中的精致女主角

---

## 五、生日场景设计（重点）

场景必须明确是：

**复古晚宴式生日影棚场景**

必须包含以下生日元素中的多项，并在不同照片中交替出现：

### 生日核心道具
1. **复古生日蛋糕**
   - 1 层或 2 层小型生日蛋糕
   - 奶油白 / 黑金 / 香槟白配色
   - 精致裱花
   - 插有细长点燃蜡烛
   - 可有很小的 “Happy Birthday” 蛋糕插牌，但不要大面积夸张文字

2. **欧式银色烛台**
   - 银色烛台
   - 白色长蜡烛
   - 提供晚宴式生日氛围

3. **礼物盒**
   - 黑色、白色、奶油金、香槟色礼盒
   - 缎带包装
   - 数量少而精
   - 体现千金生日收到礼物的感觉

4. **鲜花**
   - 白玫瑰 / 香槟玫瑰 / 奶油白花束
   - 可以放在桌边，也可以手拿

5. **香槟杯**
   - 复古 coupe glass 香槟杯
   - 用于强化生日晚宴氛围

6. **生日纸屑 / 金色碎片**
   - 少量飘落
   - 只作为氛围点缀
   - 不要过多，不要夜店感

### 场景家具与布置
- 黑色深背景
- 一张小型宴会桌 / 甜品桌
- 一把法式椅 / 浅色复古椅
- 桌面可摆放蛋糕、烛台、礼盒、鲜花、香槟杯
- 保持高级感和留白，不要堆满

---

## 六、光线要求

光线统一为：

**暖金色烛光晚宴感 + 柔和主光 + 电影感边缘光 + 前景柔焦光斑**

要求：

- 暖金色整体氛围
- 脸部清晰、皮肤发光
- 烛光柔和
- 前景可有金色虚化光斑
- 轻微镜头 flare
- 有生日晚宴的梦幻感和昂贵感

不要：

- 冷白影棚光
- 廉价强闪光
- 夜店彩灯
- 过暗看不清脸
- 重复古脏滤镜

---

## 七、8张分镜要求（生日元素明确版）

请生成 8 张不同的照片，每一张都要明显包含生日叙事，而不只是单纯摆拍。

### 第 1 张：生日主视觉肖像
人物侧身或微侧身，站在生日桌旁。  
桌上有复古生日蛋糕、点燃蜡烛和银色烛台。  
画面像整组生日写真的主海报。  
突出高盘发、珍珠、黑色礼服和烛光。

### 第 2 张：蛋糕近景照
人物靠近生日蛋糕，轻轻看向蛋糕或低头看蜡烛。  
镜头聚焦于人物脸部、蛋糕、烛光和肩颈线条。  
让人一眼看出“这是生日”。

### 第 3 张：吹蜡烛前的仪式感
人物坐在桌边或椅边，面对点燃蜡烛的生日蛋糕。  
手套手轻扶桌面或礼服，微微靠近蛋糕，像准备吹蜡烛。  
情绪安静、珍贵、被祝福。

### 第 4 张：手捧礼物盒
人物手中拿着精致礼物盒，或礼物盒放在膝上。  
旁边仍有烛台和花束。  
画面要体现“生日收到礼物”的千金小姐感。

### 第 5 张：鲜花与香槟杯照
人物坐在法式椅旁，一手轻扶香槟杯，另一只手靠近花束或轻触下巴。  
桌上可有蛋糕与礼盒。  
画面更像生日晚宴中的优雅时刻。

### 第 6 张：回眸背肩生日照
人物微微转身，露出背肩线条，回头或半回头。  
背景有烛台和飘落金色纸屑，桌边放有生日蛋糕。  
兼具生日感与赫本风电影感。

### 第 7 张：坐姿全身生日照
人物坐在浅色法式椅上，黑色礼服自然铺开。  
旁边有生日桌，能看到蛋糕、礼物盒、烛台。  
构图稍远，体现整套场景布置。

### 第 8 张：终章纪念照
人物低头看向礼物、蛋糕或手中的小贺卡。  
前景有暖金色虚化光斑，背景烛光柔和。  
像生日夜晚结束前留下的一张安静纪念照。

---

## 八、摄影风格

整体摄影风格参考：

- Audrey-inspired birthday portrait
- old money birthday photoshoot
- elegant heiress celebration portrait
- black dress and pearl editorial
- candlelight birthday photography
- luxurious vintage birthday setup
- cinematic birthday portrait
- classy celebration portrait
- retro fine-art birthday photography
- timeless elegant woman

成片要求：

- 高清写实摄影
- 高级商业精修
- 皮肤细腻自然
- 礼服材质清晰
- 蛋糕与礼物质感精致
- 珍珠与烛光有高级反光
- 生日氛围明确
- 像高预算影棚生日大片

---

## 九、负面要求

请避免以下问题：
- 不要廉价气球堆砌
- 不要卡通生日布景
- 不要五颜六色儿童派对感
- 不要夜店风
- 不要网红直播感
- 不要塑料蛋糕
- 不要道具过多杂乱
- 不要错误手指
- 不要奇怪肢体
- 不要比例失真
- 不要过度磨皮
- 不要低俗性感
- 不要婚纱影楼感
- 不要只是单纯赫本风而没有生日元素

---

## 十、最终效果总结

最终画面应让人感受到：

这是一组真正有“生日纪念感”的赫本风千金写真。  
不仅有黑色礼服、珍珠和高盘发，也有明确的生日蛋糕、烛光、礼物、花束和晚宴场景。  
她像在被爱与被庆祝中度过生日夜晚的名媛女主角，优雅、昂贵、安静、难忘。

Create a premium Japanese plastic model kit product-poster layout on a clean white studio background with subtle gray gradients and a glossy floor reflection. The character has a blurred face area, short dark navy-blue hair in a tousled bob with small side strands, and gold horn-like mechanical hair ornaments. Her outfit is a fusion of a Japanese high school sailor uniform and hard-surface sci-fi armor: white armored torso with mechanical panel lines, a red sailor neckerchief, a pleated navy skirt, bulky white armored thighs and shins, red and blue accent parts, gold circular joint details, a dark blue waist ribbon or back cloth, and red mechanical backpack-like attachments at the hips and lower back. The katana has a dark blade and a blue-and-gold wrapped handle. Render the figure like a professionally photographed collectible model or action plastic kit, with sharp material definition, realistic molded plastic surfaces, slight satin sheen, and commercial product-shot lighting.

Design the page as a figure advertisement/spec sheet with exactly 1 large hero image and 5 smaller detail panels stacked vertically on the right. The 5 right-side panels must show: 1) close-up of the head and hair ornaments, 2) upper-body torso detail with sailor scarf and chest armor, 3) weapon and articulated hand close-up with the sword near the face, 4) waist attachment and skirt/hip armor detail, 5) leg detail close-up showing joints and armor construction. Include thin blue divider accents around the right-side panel area.

At the top left, place a large Japanese title in bold serif-like characters reading "女子甲生", with the middle character in dark red and the others in dark navy. Beneath it, add a smaller Japanese subtitle line: "— メカ × 少女 × 青春 —". On the upper right, place a sleek logo and brand name reading "{argument name="brand name" default="TENNEN"}" with small Japanese text beneath it. Add a vertical Japanese slogan block on the left side of the hero figure reading "鋼に咲く、乙女の意志。" with the middle phrase in red. Add Japanese captions beneath each of the 5 right-side detail panels: "表情造形", "上半身ディテール", "武装・可動手", "腰部アタッチメント", "脚部ディテール". In the lower left, include a boxed scale label reading "{argument name="scale label" default="1/12 SCALE"}" and nearby English product text reading "FULL ACTION PLASTIC MODEL KIT". Add two small bullet lines in Japanese beneath that: "◆ 塗装済み髪パーツ付属" and "◆ マーキングデカール付属". Across the bottom, add a dark navy footer band with the brand logo and "{argument name="footer brand" default="TENNEN"}" centered, plus small Japanese text below.

Use a polished modern hobby-brand aesthetic, Japanese mecha-girl collectible packaging design, minimal white negative space, crisp typography, balanced editorial layout, and realistic studio-photo rendering of a non-existent original figure. Color palette: white, navy blue, dark blue, red, gray, black, and metallic gold. Aspect ratio 3:4.

All five background images should be grayscale, soft studio lighting, elegant fashion photography, consistent identity and styling.

Visual style: minimalist black, white, and gray palette with the center subject in natural muted color; high-end editorial fashion look; soft diffused lighting; realistic photography; clean white gutters between collage panels; polished commercial portrait retouching; no text, no logos, no watermark.

Constraints: keep exactly one central full-color standing woman and exactly five black-and-white background portraits; preserve the white shirt and black trouser styling throughout; do not add extra people, props, captions, or decorative graphics.

The room behind her: worn tatami, a dark clay vase on the floor with a single dried branch, shoji screens glowing faintly with the last of the day's light.
East Asian young woman in her early 20s. Almond-shaped eyes with natural double eyelids, gaze soft and slightly lowered. Straight refined nose. Skin tone fair to light beige, warm with the last evening light. Skin subsurface scattering visible under directional light, specular micro-highlights on cheekbones and nose ridge, fine foundation powder grain perceptible.
She wears a {argument name="clothing color" default="dusty rose"} silk qipao with {argument name="embroidery" default="hibiscus embroidery"} in threads of faded burgundy and pale sage — the pattern worn, the rose pigment deepened slightly with age into something closer to old tea-stain pink. The shoji screens glow amber-rose with the last light outside, backlit and softly diffused, casting the room into warm shadow. Her face receives only the reflected warmth — no direct light source visible. title: Korean Q-Version Sticker Diary
prompt:
Create a high-quality “chibi sticker diary portrait” based on the uploaded real-life photo. Preserve the subject’s original identity, realistic facial structure, hairstyle, hair color, glasses, outfit, pose, proportions, lighting, and background. Keep the main subject photorealistic and do not transform the entire image into a full illustration.

Analyze the scene as a {argument name="aesthetic" default="cozy daily lifestyle / casual fashion moment with a clean Korean scrapbook aesthetic"}. Add {argument name="chibi count" default="6–8"} miniature chibi clones of the same person around the main subject. Each chibi should closely resemble the real person with the same hairstyle, glasses, outfit colors, and overall appearance.

Design all chibi clones in a polished kawaii sticker style:

oversized head, small body
expressive eyes and soft facial expressions
smooth digital shading
clean white sticker outlines
soft drop shadows
slightly floating sticker placement

Give each chibi a unique pose and emotion inspired by everyday lifestyle moments:

waving hello
peace sign pose
holding coffee
casual walking
shy smile
sitting relaxed
cheerful greeting
thoughtful/calm mood

Arrange the stickers around the edges of the composition without blocking the main subject’s face or body. Maintain balanced spacing and a clean {argument name="background" default="vertical layout similar to a social media diary collage"}.

Add soft hand-drawn doodles and scrapbook elements throughout the image:

hearts
sparkles
arrows
motion lines
stars
speech bubbles
tiny circles

Use mostly white doodles with subtle pastel pink and pastel blue accents.

Include 5–8 short handwritten-style Korean diary phrases scattered naturally around the image.

Typography should feel hand-drawn, soft, playful, and aesthetic with small decorative underlines and doodle accents.

Composition:

full-body central subject remains the primary focus
chibi stickers surround the subject harmoniously
maintain a clean beige/light neutral background
overall style should feel premium, cozy, polished, and highly shareable like a Korean lifestyle Instagram diary post or sticker scrapbook photo.

title: Beacon Hollow Retro Fantasy Postcard
prompt: Create a vintage fantasy travel postcard poster for {argument name="location name" default="BEACON HOLLOW"}, designed like a large-letter souvenir postcard from the 1950s–1960s. The composition is a single richly detailed horizontal scene with heavily weathered paper texture, rounded postcard corners, faded inks, creases, scratches, foxing, and worn edges. Across the top and center, huge dimensional block letters spell “BEACON HOLLOW” in classic retro postcard style, with warm cream outlines and red-brown extruded shadows; each letter contains miniature painted scenic vignettes of the destination, including alpine peaks, waterfalls, pine forests, a magical manor, glowing towers, and valley landscapes. In the upper left, hand-painted script text reads “GREETINGS FROM” in dark red. In the upper right, include a circular black postal cancellation stamp reading “BEACON HOLLOW / MAY 18 / 1967 / CREATIVE RETREAT,” overlapping a vintage postage stamp labeled “BEACON HOLLOW” and “CREATIVE RETREAT” with “7c,” depicting a moonlit mountain and a lighthouse-like beacon tower. Beneath the title, place a small curved ribbon banner reading {argument name="tagline" default="a magejosh destination"} with tiny compass-star ornaments. The main background should show a majestic golden-hour mountain valley with a winding river, distant snowy peaks, dense evergreen forests, and on the right a large timber-and-stone fantasy lodge perched on a cliff, warmly lit from within, with stairs descending the slope. Scatter subtle magical blue lights and faint arcane circular glyphs around the lodge and foreground for a worldbuilding-meets-magic atmosphere. In the lower left, place exactly 3 foreground desk objects: a dark ceramic mug with a compass emblem, an open sketchbook spread, and a fountain pen resting diagonally across the pages. The left page of the sketchbook is titled “Campaign Ideas” and lists 3 bullets: “The Forgotten Vale,” “Clockwork Pilgrims,” and “Echoes of the First Light,” with a small castle drawing below; the right page shows a tree illustration and the handwritten text “Beery world Hollow.” Across the lower center, add an old illustrated map spread out on the table, showing mountain icons and hand-drawn cartographic details. In the lower right, place exactly 5 more foreground elements: a closed leather journal embossed with a star compass and the phrase “Ideas Become Legends,” a cluster of 4 polyhedral dice, a rustic wooden signpost with 4 directional slats reading “STORY,” “GAME DESIGN,” “WORLD BUILDING,” and “AI FOR CREATORS,” a glowing glass lamp or tube device, and a nearby floating arcane target-like sigil. Add a pinned handwritten note left of center on aged paper reading, “Wish you were here — building worlds, chasing wonder, and turning ideas into adventures. — {argument name="signature name" default="magejosh"}” in blue cursive. Use painterly illustration with high detail, nostalgic Americana postcard design, fantasy concept art sensibility, warm sunset lighting, muted teal sky, sepia aging, and an inviting creative-retreat mood.

prompt: 创建一个极简风格的静态 SaaS 广告，背景为温暖的米白色，采用优雅的编辑排版和清晰的高保真文本渲染。在顶部放置一个两行的大号黑色衬线标题，内容为："{argument name="headline text" default="Your dev team shouldn’t be your analytics team."}"。其中 "dev team" 一词应使用斜体衬线字体，其余部分保持粗体高对比度衬线字体，并采用宽敞的留白和奢华杂志风格布局。在下方居中位置，展示一张略微倾斜的白色纸质发票，带有柔和的投影和中间细微的垂直折痕，如同从上方拍摄。发票使用黑色等宽打字机风格文本，标题明确写着："INVOICE — DEV HOURS, OCTOBER"，随后是 5 行对齐的工时与价格明细："A/B test setup on pricing page   8 hrs   $1,200"、"GTM tag install (3 events)   4 hrs   $600"、"Funnel tracking debug   6 hrs   $900"、"Meta pixel mapping   3 hrs   $450" 以及 "Attribution reporting build   12 hrs   $1,800"。在 5 个项目下方添加一条虚线分隔符，左下方写上粗体等宽的 "TOTAL"，右下方写上总价 "$4,950"。用手绘黄色线条划掉总价。在发票周围添加 4 个涂鸦风格的注释元素：左侧是手写的黄色文字 "every month??"，并配有一个指向纸张的黄色箭头；纸张右上角有一个黄色星形涂鸦；总价下方有一个指向被划掉价格的绿色弯曲箭头；右下角是一个绿色的手绘圆圈，里面写着手写文字 "zero devs"，并与绿色箭头相连。在广告底部中心，添加两行较小的黑色无衬线正文，内容为："{argument name="body text" default="Marketers ship tests and track revenue themselves.\nNo tickets. No tag manager. One script."}"。保持构图通透、高级且以转化为导向，将现代初创公司广告设计与真实的纸张质感及趣味标记注释融为一体。

title: Cockatiel Owner Fails Compilation | Japanese Comic Style AI Illustration

title: Pet Studio Portrait Photography
prompt: 请基于我上传的清晰宠物照片，生成一组 6 张单独成片的宠物潮流棚拍写真。 要求： - 每张都是 3:4 竖构图 - 每张独立输出，不要拼图，不要九宫格，不要海报排版 - 6 张都必须明显是同一只宠物 - 严格保留宠物真实特征：品种、体型、脸型、眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴、耳朵、毛色、花纹、毛发质感、神态气质 - 不能换脸，不能换毛色，不能变成陌生宠物，不能过度拟人化，不能画错动物结构 主题： 宠物潮流棚拍写真。 整体风格： 高级宠物摄影棚，深蓝色或蓝灰色复古纹理背景，时尚杂志感，潮流、可爱、有点拽，像明星宠物写真。 重点要求： 不要生成 6 张差不多的标准棚拍照。 这组图最重要的是表情、动作、角度都要明显不同，更生动，更像抓拍到的有趣瞬间。 6 张图必须拉开这些差异： - 表情不同：冷脸、吐舌、微张嘴、歪头、抬下巴、斜眼看镜头、好奇、搞笑、回头一瞥等 - 动作不同：坐着、站着、侧身、半转身、一只爪子抬起、身体前倾、抬头、探头、像正在动的一瞬间 - 镜头不同：正面、近景特写、侧面、3/4 侧面、低机位、高机位、半身、全身 - 至少 3 张要有明显抓拍感，不要都拍得很端正 服装与配饰： 搭配自然、真实、适合宠物体型的潮流穿搭和轻量配饰，可使用： - 黑白拼色抓绒外套 - 白色高领拉链外套 - 黑色小墨镜 - 复古运动耳机 - 小帽子、围巾、领结 注意： 服装和配饰只是辅助，重点仍然是宠物本身的神态、动作和时尚感。 穿搭必须自然，符合真实宠物穿着逻辑，四肢、脖子、耳朵、尾巴的位置都要自然。 6 张画面分别为： 1. 正面半身照，戴黑色小墨镜，表情冷酷，像潮牌封面 2. 近景大头照，墨镜推到头顶，吐舌或微张嘴，表情搞笑可爱 3. 侧身或 3/4 侧身照，穿黑白拼色抓绒外套，一只爪子自然抬起，像在摆 pose 4. 正面端坐照，穿白色高领拉链外套，戴小墨镜，眼神有点拽 5. 略低机位拍摄，抬下巴看镜头，戴耳机或轻量配饰，像宠物 DJ 6. 特写肖像，微微歪头或回头看镜头，服装简洁，突出五官和毛发细节 质量要求： 写实宠物摄影，高清细节，棚拍质感，真实毛发，真实服装材质，画面自然生动，可爱但高级，有小红书爆款宠物写真感。 避免出现： 不要多只宠物，不要文字水印，不要卡通化，不要玩偶感，不要塑料毛发，不要僵硬摆拍，不要多余爪子，不要畸形耳朵，不要背景杂乱，不要低清，不要过度磨皮。

title: Chinese Calligraphy Poetic Landscape
prompt: A traditional Chinese ink wash hanging-scroll style painting on warm off-white rice paper, vertically composed with large black brush-calligraphy occupying the upper and right-central area and a poetic landscape illustration in the lower left and bottom. The calligraphy must be crisp, fully legible, and written in expressive semi-cursive brush script, arranged in 6 vertical columns read right to left. The exact text of the 6 columns is: “金樽清酒斗十千 玉盘珍羞直万钱”, “停杯投箸不能食 拔剑四顾心茫然”, “欲渡黄河冰塞川 将登太行雪满山”, “闲来垂钓碧溪上 忽复乘舟梦日边”, “行路难 行路难 多歧路 今安在”, “长风破浪会有时 直挂云帆济沧海”. In the painted scene, show 1 ancient Chinese scholar-poet in flowing pale robes with a dark topknot and trailing ribbons, standing on the edge of a rugged cliff at lower left, gazing upward and outward in contemplation. Below and across the lower half, depict a turbulent river or sea with whitecaps and foam, misty ink-wash mountains receding in the distance, sparse grasses and dark brush vegetation near the cliff edge, and soft atmospheric fog. title: Short video attention tax poster
prompt:
A bold editorial poster in a brutalist Swiss-modern infographic style on a light warm-gray background, portrait orientation, with a split composition: oversized typography dominating the left half and a blurred monochrome human face dominating the right half. The main headline is stacked in huge condensed sans-serif uppercase text reading {argument name="headline text" default="SHORT-FORM ATTENTION TAX"}, with “SHORT-FORM” in black and “ATTENTION TAX” in vivid red-orange. Along the far left margin place a small vertical year mark reading “-2024”. At the top left add tiny uppercase text “YOUR ATTENTION. THEIR ECONOMY.” and at the top right add tiny uppercase text “TIME IS LIMITED. ATTENTION ISN’T.” with small plus-sign registration marks near the corners. Beneath the headline on the left, add the subheading “A hidden cost extracted every time you scroll.”

Create 3 numbered information blocks stacked down the lower left side, each marked by a vertical red-orange bar and large black numerals: section 01 titled “WHAT IS IT?”, section 02 titled “WHY DOES IT EXIST?”, and section 03 titled “HOW IT AFFECTS BEHAVIOR”. Under section 01, include body text explaining that the Short-Form Attention Tax is the invisible price paid for consuming endless short-form content and that it is measured in seconds, minutes, and mental energy extracted by platforms designed to keep you scrolling. Under section 02, include body text explaining that platforms compete for attention because attention, data, and profit are linked, and that short-form content is optimized to be instantly rewarding, infinitely scrollable, and hard to stop. Under section 03, include exactly 6 bullet points in red-orange dash style: “Shortens attention span”, “Reduces deep focus”, “Increases impulsive behavior”, “Disrupts memory & learning”, “Drives comparison & anxiety”, and “Creates compulsive usage loops”, followed by a short concluding sentence about reshaping how you think, feel, and act.

In the center-left and lower-middle areas, add supporting editorial typography in mixed sizes: “Attention is the most valuable currency of the 21st century.” with the word “currency” in red-orange; a small stat block saying “THE AVERAGE PERSON SPENDS 90+ MINUTES DAILY ON SHORT-FORM VIDEO APPS.” with “90+ MINUTES” in red-orange; a giant stacked numeric statement reading “16 DAYS” in black with the surrounding text “THAT’S OVER” above and “A YEAR.” below; and a small closing line “TAX AVOIDANCE STARTS WITH AWARENESS.”

On the right half, show a close-up portrait of a human face in black and white, partially cropped, looking forward, with a serious neutral expression. Apply heavy horizontal motion blur, digital smear, scanline-like streaks, and glitch bars crossing the face, especially across the forehead, nose, and mouth. Overlay exactly 5 vertical social-media style interface icons near the center-right of the face: a white circle/profile dot, a red-orange heart, a white speech bubble, a white bookmark ribbon, and a white share arrow. Add a large translucent red-orange circle covering the lower-right part of the face. Include subtle HUD-like graphic elements: a faint circular reticle with a small red-orange triangular wedge near the upper right, a thin vertical measurement scale near the far right edge, a few white square markers, small black and white horizontal bars, and scattered tiny plus signs for layout texture.

At the bottom, place a barcode on the left with tiny coordinate-like text above it, then 3 footer callouts spaced across the width: “PROTECT YOUR ATTENTION. PROTECT YOUR LIFE.”, “BE MINDFUL. BE INTENTIONAL. BE FREE.”, and “RECLAIM FOCUS. RECLAIM TIME. RECLAIM YOU.” Use a restrained palette of black, off-white, and red-orange only. The overall look should feel like a high-end social critique poster, mixing typographic activism, data editorial design, and dystopian tech-noise portraiture, with crisp layout, strong negative space, and print-poster realism.

title: Gothic Anime Symbolism Infographic
prompt:
Goal: Create a dark gothic anime infographic poster explaining the symbolic meaning of {argument name="headline title" default="スティルインラブの『宿縁の罪科』"}. The design should feel like an ornate occult character-analysis card about fate, blood, moonlight, and original sin, with a somber romantic tone.

Canvas: Square 1:1 poster, high resolution, black and deep burgundy palette with ivory Japanese typography, red accents, silver moonlight, antique gold filigree borders, subtle grunge texture, rose petals, sparkles, and a Victorian gothic frame.

Layout: Top title band with large Japanese headline, subtitle, and decorative flourishes. Center hero character in front of a huge full moon. Left and right vertical symbolic panels flank the character. A wide middle-lower panel labeled 背徳 spans beneath the character. Below that, a section labeled シナリオへの影響 contains exactly 4 numbered boxes connected left-to-right by arrows. Bottom contains a concluding quote paragraph in a bordered box with roses in both lower corners.

Central subject details: Draw {argument name="character name" default="Still in Love"} as a beautiful anime horse-girl idol, waist-up, centered, with long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="chestnut brown"} hair, red eyes, soft melancholic expression, horse ears decorated with red ribbons, a small frilled headpiece, and a red-and-white gothic idol dress with off-shoulder sleeves, blue bow accent, choker jewel, bracelets, and lace details. She holds one hand near her chest as if restraining emotion. Backlight her with a luminous full moon and drifting red-black particles.

Top text: Large headline: スティルインラブの『宿縁の罪科』. Subtitle below: 『血・月・背徳』が意味するもの.

Left symbolic panel: Exactly 1 left panel titled 血. Visual: crimson-black tree shaped like veins or blood vessels, red ribbons of blood, shadowy running horse silhouettes at the bottom, circular gothic frame. Text inside: 血統・本能・競走への衝動. Smaller text: 自分の意思を超えて流れ込む、競うための力.

Right symbolic panel: Exactly 1 right panel titled 月. Visual: blue-black night sky with a bright full moon over dark water and a distant traditional building or bridge, quiet clouds, cool moon glow, circular gothic frame. Text inside: 夜・覚醒・隠された本性. Smaller text: 普段は抑えた衝動が、静かに目を覚ます.

Middle-lower symbolic panel: Exactly 1 wide panel titled 背徳. Visual: left side black rose wrapped in thorns, right side pale hand reaching through thorns with a small drop of blood, ornate elongated frame. Main text: 愛の危うさ・独占・越境. Smaller text: 愛が深まるほど、相手との境界を越えそうになる.

Scenario impact section: Include exactly 4 numbered boxes, each with a small circular number medallion and ornate border, connected by arrows. Box 1 text: “理性的な私”と“紅の衝動”の二面性. Box 2 text: 愛は救いであると同時に呪いでもある. Box 3 text: 彼女の苦しみは性格ではなく、宿命として描かれる. Box 4 text: 物語は『克服』ではなく『受容』へ向かう. Emphasize the key red words 紅の衝動, 呪い, 宿命, 受容.

Bottom conclusion text: 『宿縁の罪科』とは、血と運命から背負わされた愛と衝動の原罪。スティルインラブの物語は、それを消すのではなく、抱えたまま愛し、共に生きる物語である。

Visual style: Detailed Japanese anime illustration mixed with dark fantasy editorial infographic design, sharp readable typography, symmetrical composition, ornate gold corner decorations, black marble texture, red roses, thorn vines, subtle embers, cinematic moonlight, high contrast, elegant and tragic mood.

Constraints: Use exactly the listed 3 symbolic panels and exactly 4 scenario boxes. Keep all Japanese text legible and placed as specified. Do not add logos, watermarks, extra characters, extra panels, or modern UI elements.

Below the cook, a smaller confused person mixing in a bowl looks worried, surrounded by exactly 4 question marks. In the center, multiple thick arrows point from the cook’s intuition toward a structured cooking workflow. At upper center is large Chinese text “照着做”. title: Luxury Fashion Ad Poster
prompt: A minimalist luxury fashion advertisement poster for {argument name="brand name" default="GUCCI"}, editorial studio photography on a soft warm beige background with a clean high-end magazine layout. Show a stylish woman from about mid-thigh up in a three-quarter side profile facing right, with a short sleek black bob haircut, a single visible gold hoop earring, and her face intentionally obscured by a large vertical blurred rectangular block centered over the face. She wears a camel wool overcoat layered over a black turtleneck sweater and carries a classic designer shoulder bag tucked under her arm. The bag is beige canvas with a repeating monogram pattern, black leather trim and strap, and a prominent interlocking gold hardware emblem on the flap. Her pose is poised and refined, one hand lightly holding the coat and the other supporting the bag, conveying quiet luxury. Use soft diffused lighting, muted neutral tones, sharp fashion-editorial styling, premium texture detail in the wool coat, leather, canvas, and metallic hardware. On the left side of the composition, place the large serif wordmark {argument name="brand name" default="GUCCI"} in black with a small luxury-style emblem directly beneath it, a thin vertical divider line below, then the stacked tagline {argument name="tagline" default="TIMELESS ELEGANCE"} in small uppercase sans serif, and near the bottom left the season text {argument name="season text" default="FALL WINTER 2024"}. On the right edge, add oversized cropped abstract numeral-like graphic forms in a pale taupe tone as a background design element. Keep the overall composition clean, balanced, and sophisticated, like a luxury campaign poster or magazine cover.

The sky should be vivid sapphire blue with scattered fluffy white clouds, sparkling motes of light, and warm sunlit highlights. title: Healing Sleep Aid Guide Nine Palaces
titleEn: Healing Sleep Aid Guide Nine Palaces
prompt:
[中文]
生成一张适合小红书发布的 3:4 竖版九宫格海报，整体为 3列 × 3行 排版，九个宫格边界清晰，方便后期直接切割成 9 张单图发布。整体风格干净、高级、统一，适合女性向健康生活方式内容，具有小红书爆款封面气质。画面要求 信息排版清晰、文字大、可读性强、留白舒服、配色温柔治愈。

整体视觉风格：
奶油白、浅米色、淡燕麦色、浅焦糖色为主色调，搭配少量深棕色文字，ins风、治愈感、睡眠疗愈主题，简约排版，轻拟物插画点缀，可加入枕头、月亮、星星、热牛奶、香薰、书本、眼罩、窗帘、床铺等元素。整体像专业新媒体设计图，字体工整，适合做知识科普类小红书九宫格。
排版要求：

整张图必须是标准九宫格构图，切分后每一格都能独立成图

每个宫格内容完整居中，不要把标题或正文压在分割线附近
每个格子之间保留明显间隔或细边框，保证裁切后不影响阅读
所有文字使用中文，清晰易读，不要乱码，不要英文
每个宫格都像独立的小红书图文卡片，但视觉风格保持统一
画面精致、真实、自然，不要廉价营销感，不要过度花哨
九宫格具体内容：

第1格（封面）
大标题：让你倒头就睡的8个 tips
副标题：失眠党、熬夜党一定要收藏
封面视觉最吸睛，适合做首图，加入柔软床铺、月亮、枕头、眼罩等治愈睡眠元素，标题突出，排版高级。

第2格
标题：1. 睡前1小时别玩手机
正文：蓝光会让大脑更清醒，越刷越睡不着。
配图元素：手机、月亮、困倦表情的小插画
第3格
标题：2. 睡前把灯光调暗
正文：暖光环境能帮助身体进入“准备睡觉”的状态。
配图元素：床头灯、暖黄色灯光、窗帘
第4格
标题：3. 房间温度别太高
正文：稍微凉一点，更容易快速入睡。
配图元素：空调、温度计、被子
第5格
标题：4. 晚上别喝浓茶咖啡
正文：咖啡因会延迟困意，让你躺很久还睡不着。
配图元素：咖啡杯、茶杯、禁止符号

第6格
标题：5. 睡前洗个热水澡
正文：能让身体放松下来，入睡速度更快。
配图元素：浴室蒸汽、毛巾、热水
第7格
标题：6. 脑子停不下来就写下来
正文：把烦心事和待办清单写下，大脑会更容易放松。
配图元素：笔记本、钢笔、小台灯
第8格
标题：7. 固定上床时间
正文：每天差不多时间睡，生物钟会越来越稳定。
配图元素：时钟、月亮、床
第9格
标题：8. 试试深呼吸放松法
正文：吸气4秒，停4秒，呼气6秒，慢慢就有困意了。
底部小字：收藏这组，今晚试试看
配图元素：呼吸线条、闭眼人物、星星

画质要求：
高清，高级排版，杂志感，真实可发布，新媒体运营审美，小红书爆款图文风格，文字布局规整，适合直接切图。

[English]
Generate a 3:4 vertical 9-grid poster suitable for publishing on Xiaohongshu, with an overall layout of 3 columns × 3 rows. The boundaries of the nine grids are clear, making it easy to directly cut into 9 single images for later publishing. The overall style is clean, premium, and unified, suitable for female-oriented healthy lifestyle content, possessing the vibe of a viral Xiaohongshu cover. Image requirements: clear information layout, large text, strong readability, comfortable white space, gentle and healing color palette.

Overall visual style:
Cream white, light beige, light oat color, and light caramel color as the main color tones, paired with a small amount of dark brown text. Ins style, healing sense, sleep therapy theme, minimalist layout, light skeuomorphic illustration embellishments. Elements such as pillows, moons, stars, hot milk, aromatherapy, books, eye masks, curtains, and beds can be added. The overall look should be like a professional new media design graphic, with neat fonts, suitable for a knowledge-based popular science Xiaohongshu 9-grid.

Layout requirements:
The entire image must be a standard 9-grid composition, and each grid can stand alone as an independent image after being cut.
The content of each grid should be completely centered; do not place titles or body text near the dividing lines.
Keep obvious gaps or thin borders between each grid to ensure that reading is not affected after cropping.
All text must use Chinese, be clear and readable, no garbled characters, no English.
Each grid should look like an independent Xiaohongshu image-and-text card, but the visual style must remain unified.
The image should be exquisite, realistic, and natural, without a cheap marketing feel, and not overly flashy.

Specific content of the 9-grid:

Grid 1 (Cover)
Main title: 8 tips to make you fall asleep instantly
Subtitle: Insomniacs and night owls must save this
The cover visuals should be the most eye-catching, suitable for the first image. Add healing sleep elements such as soft beds, moons, pillows, and eye masks. The title should be prominent with a premium layout.

Grid 2
Title: 1. Don't play with your phone 1 hour before bed
Body text: Blue light makes the brain more awake; the more you scroll, the harder it is to fall asleep.
Image elements: Mobile phone, moon, small illustration of a sleepy expression

Grid 3
Title: 2. Dim the lights before bed
Body text: A warm light environment can help the body enter a "ready to sleep" state.
Image elements: Bedside lamp, warm yellow light, curtains

Grid 4
Title: 3. Don't keep the room temperature too high
Body text: Keeping it a bit cooler makes it easier to fall asleep quickly.
Image elements: Air conditioner, thermometer, quilt

Grid 5
Title: 4. Don't drink strong tea or coffee at night
Body text: Caffeine delays sleepiness, making you lie in bed for a long time unable to sleep.
Image elements: Coffee cup, teacup, prohibition sign

Grid 6
Title: 5. Take a hot shower before bed
Body text: It can relax the body and help you fall asleep faster.
Image elements: Bathroom steam, towel, hot water

Grid 7
Title: 6. Write it down if your brain won't stop
Body text: Writing down your worries and to-do lists makes it easier for your brain to relax.
Image elements: Notebook, fountain pen, small desk lamp

Grid 8
Title: 7. Fix your bedtime
Body text: Going to bed at about the same time every day will make your biological clock increasingly stable.
Image elements: Clock, moon, bed

Grid 9
Title: 8. Try deep breathing relaxation
Body text: Inhale for 4 seconds, hold for 4 seconds, exhale for 6 seconds, and sleepiness will gradually come.
Bottom small text: Save this set and try it tonight
Image elements: Breathing lines, person with closed eyes, stars

Image quality requirements:
High definition, premium layout, magazine feel, realistically publishable, new media operation aesthetics, Xiaohongshu viral image-and-text style, neat text layout, suitable for direct image cutting.
